gist: Music and a warm greeting to the audience; he says the classes are moving a bit ahead of schedule but still according to time.
Remark that nobody wants things to go against their wish, and when they do, it means God wants us to slow down and let things unfold gradually.
A question that came last week: is astrology really true and should one follow it; he says he will answer after starting the class.
Announces the class start and says the story of the Ishta (chosen deity) topic is still unfinished, jokingly like a love story that never ends.
Restates the viewer question: does astrology really work and is it right to go to astrologers; some say there is only one birth, not many lives.
Asks why sudden troubles arrive, where they come from, and what past deeds of ours bring results we receive for free.
Viewer's challenge: why not hit back at a wrongdoer when satsang says keep peace and leave it to God, nobody has seen God, so why go to astrologers and do remedies, and do remedies make a difference.

Starts a short karma story: a very poor farmer whose in-laws died, his wife's younger sister came to live with them, the elder sister fell ill, bore a son and died, and villagers got him to marry the younger sister.
Story continues: first son from the first wife, second son from the second wife, the stepmother loved both and the farmer was happy.

hindi: यह पक्की बात है भयंकर मंगलिक था दूसरी बीवी मर गई मंगल दोष मार देता है जान से
says: Inside the farmer story he says the farmer was a severe Manglik (strong Mars dosha) and his second wife died; his claim is that Mangal dosha can take the life of the partner. Recorded as his tradition claim only, not a prediction or date. He does not name the house or sign of Mars here.
cells_derived_method: Manglik harm is read from the house of Mars counted from lagna (classically 1, 4, 7, 8, 12; some add 2), then modulated by the sign of Mars (own or exalted in Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn softens; debilitated in Cancer worsens) and by what Mars aspects (4th, 7th and 8th from itself). The 7th and 8th carry spouse and marital longevity topics, so Mars there reads hardest. He gives no house or sign in this sentence, so every cell below is derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (4-7+1=-2, so 10). Debilitated Mars sits in the spouse house and aspects the 10th, 1st and 2nd; the sharpest reading of his claim, with friction and anger in the partnership.

Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Mars in own sign in the 1st (Ruchaka-type) aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th; dosha is present by house but Mars is strong, so the method reads forceful and dominating rather than destructive, and many traditions soften this cell.

Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Mars is own-sign, lagna lord and 8th lord together in the 8th, aspecting the 11th, 2nd and 3rd; reads as sudden upheavals in marital life, but own sign gives resilience.

ambiguity: Story context: it is not stated which house Mars occupied for the farmer, and 'kills' may mean literal death or severe harm; Moon and Venus based Manglik checks are not mentioned.
classical_check: Later marriage-matching tradition agrees Mars in 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 harms the partner; death of the spouse is an extreme popular claim, and classical lists also give cancellations he does not mention here.

hindi: मंगलिक जो है बदनाम इसीलिए है जो हमारे पुराने जानकारों ने जाना कि मंगली से शादी मत करो
says: He explains why Manglik has a bad name: the old knowledgeable people observed results and concluded that one should not marry a Manglik. It is a statement about the origin of the marriage-matching caution, with no Mars house or sign given.
cells_derived_method: Whether a given Manglik chart is truly 'do not marry' depends on the house of Mars from lagna (1, 4, 7, 8, 12), its sign (own, exalted or friend's sign can cancel the dosha in commonly quoted lists) and the partner's chart. All cells below are derived by me, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (9-12+1=-2, so 10). Mars in Jupiter's sign in the 12th; commonly quoted lists treat this as a cancelled-dosha cell, so the blanket 'do not marry' is softened here.
Derived: lagna Cancer (10-7+1=4). Mars exalted in the 7th (a kendra, Ruchaka-type) and a yogakaraka for Cancer; dosha by house is present but exaltation is usually read as mitigating.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (5-8+1=-2, so 10). Mars in a friend's sign in the 8th with no cancelling factor; here the strict 'avoid' caution stays in full.

ambiguity: Does not say which houses count as Manglik or whether cancellations apply.
classical_check: Agrees with later tradition that Manglik is a marriage-matching caution; classical and later texts also list exceptions he does not give here.

hindi: 9 पर केस में हर हालत में पति पत्नी को अलग कर देता है एक घर में रहते हुए अलग कर देता है एक बेड पर रहते हुए अलग कर देता है
says: He says that in nearly every case (caption reads '9 par case', probably ninety percent or nine in ten) a Manglik partner separates husband and wife, even when they live under one roof and share one bed, meaning emotional distance and not only physical absence.
cells_derived_method: Separation under one roof points to the 4th (home peace) and 7th (partner) houses; separation on one bed points to the 12th (bed pleasures) and 2nd or 7th. Mars sitting in or aspecting these houses is the derived channel; sign decides whether the effect is anger, coldness or pride. He gives no house or sign, so all cells are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (1-4+1=-2, so 10). Mars in own sign in the 4th aspects the 7th, 10th and 11th (4+3, 4+6, 4+7); the 'same house but apart' reading, with home peace disturbed and the 7th pressured.

Derived: lagna Cancer (3-12+1=-8, so 4). Mars in an enemy sign in the 12th aspects the 3rd, 6th and 7th; the 'same bed but apart' reading, with sexual or emotional distance and a short temper at night.

Derived: lagna Sagittarius (10-2+1=9). Mars exalted in the 2nd aspects the 5th, 8th and 9th; harsh family speech but exaltation reduces the chance of a real break, and only some schools count the 2nd as Manglik.

ambiguity: Caption '9 पर केस' is garbled: could be 90 percent, nine in ten, or 'in every case'; also unclear if he means the Manglik partner alone or a Manglik and non-Manglik pairing.
classical_check: Popular marriage tradition says Manglik causes discord and separation; it does not say 'every case', and classical cancellations contradict the always-true wording.

hindi: एक मंगली है और एक मंगली नहीं है तो बहुत लफड़ा होता है जान से मार भी देता है
says: He says that a marriage in which only one partner is Manglik is the dangerous pairing, bringing a lot of trouble and even death. He does not say outright that two Manglik partners are safe, but that is the usual tradition behind the remark.
cells_derived_method: Compare Mars house (1, 4, 7, 8, 12) in the two charts: harm falls on the partner whose chart has no matching Mars energy. The cell of the Manglik partner's Mars decides which life area is hit. All cells below are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1). Mars as lagna lord in the 7th in Venus's sign aspects the 10th, 1st and 2nd; a non-Manglik spouse is overpowered, so partner dominance and quarrels are the derived result.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (2-4+1=-1, so 11). Mars in the 4th in Venus's sign aspects the 7th, 10th and 11th; the non-Manglik partner loses home peace because Mars dominates the household.

ambiguity: 'Kills' may mean literal death or severe harm; he does not say which partner suffers more.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical matching rule that Mars dosha in both charts cancels; 'kills' is the popular exaggeration of the harm.

hindi: पुरुषों ने समय के साथ यह बहुत बड़ा बहाना बनाया कि लड़की मंगली नहीं होनी चाहिए यानी लड़का जिंदा रहे अगर लड़का मंगली है तो लड़की का मंगली देखने की जरूरत नहीं
says: He criticises the practice of checking only the bride for Mangal dosha so that the groom survives, while a Manglik groom's bride is not checked even if she may die; he calls this injustice to women, and so argues the dosha risk applies to the partner of either sex and both charts should be checked. Caption 'मर्ती तो मरे' is read as 'if she dies, let her'.
cells_derived_method: none: this is a comment on matching practice and fairness, not a house or sign rule.
ambiguity: Mixes a social opinion with an astrological claim; the astrological part is only that Manglik status of either partner matters.
classical_check: Classical matching checks Mars in both charts and uses mutual cancellation, so his point agrees with the two-sided check and disagrees with the one-sided practice he describes.

gist: Story only: time passes and the two boys begin to grow up.
The farmer watches the two sons from different mothers with different upbringing and a slight sense of otherness, worries, and in time arranges the elder son's marriage.

As the farmer nears death he tells everyone to live with love and asks the elder daughter-in-law to look after the younger son, reminding her that this boy's mother raised her husband lovingly; she promises.
Greed takes over: the elder daughter-in-law keeps telling her husband the younger brother is useless and will become owner of half the property, and the younger boy falls seriously ill.
The boy stays neither alive nor dead for long with heavy expenses, so the elder bhabhi proposes meeting a physician to have the child poisoned.
Digression on ear-filling in families: a mother tells her son what his wife did, the inexperienced son acts like a postman and chats with his wife about it.
Digression continued: the wife wonders how the news leaked, takes secret revenge by telling her husband things about his mother, and he goes and quarrels with his mother.

The mother is shocked that the wife exposed her, vows not to spare the daughter-in-law; he concludes the son is the main cause of saas-bahu quarrels and that if mother and wife told him nothing there would be no fight.
Says men by nature like to fight and speak loudly, so a wise man tells his mother not to provoke him and his wife to handle it herself, making the home heaven.
Back to the tale: the wife provokes her husband into agreeing to poison the boy, they find a physician through the lure of money and pay him a fee.
The physician agrees to give slow poison, the younger boy dies, and the couple live happily thinking the property is all theirs.

A year later the couple have their own son and rejoice, the husband says it was well done to end the dispute because the father had made a mess with two marriages and partition would have been needed.
When the child is about four he falls ill with an incurable disease that drags on for years, and the next ten years go badly for the family.
Story: a father tried every doctor, foreign medicines, every deity, every pandit and even beggars' feet, but his sick child did not recover.
Story: hoping the bride's luck would heal him, the father got the sick son married to a small girl; the illness still did not go and got worse.

Story: the narrator reaches the scene where the sick young man sits with his parents, the child-wife lies quietly aside, and he announces it is time for him to go because the property account is finished.
Story: the son reveals he is the parent's own brother from an earlier life, poisoned by him, who came back as his son to settle the money account and has been ill for ten years.
Story: the settlement is complete and only the funeral remains; the father asks what to do with the little girl they brought in hope her fortune would save the boy.
Story: the son says the physician who poisoned him has come back as his wife and must burn on his pyre; he leaves, the parents weep and the whole birth is wasted.

hindi: यह हमारे जीवन के कर्म है जो हमारे पास लौट के आते हैं और हम ये हैरान होते हैं कि यार हमारे साथ ये पाप क्यों हुआ मेरे दोस्त ने पैसे क्यों खा लिए उसने मुझे पैसे दिए फिर वापस क्यों मांग लिए
says: He draws the moral of the story: the troubles we meet (a friend eating our money, money lent and then demanded back, a misfortune that feels like punishment) are our own past deeds returning to us, and people are puzzled only because they do not see the cause.
cells_derived_method: none: a general karma-returns claim, not dependent on a house or sign.
ambiguity: Whether he ties this to a specific chart factor is not said here; it is a general karma statement.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish broadly accepts that the chart shows past-life karma coming to fruition (prarabdha); this folk story is not a classical rule.

hindi: क्यों मेरे साथ मेरा ही बच्चा मेरे ऐसी तैसी कर रहा है क्यों किसी ने मेरे को पत्थर मारा क्यों नहीं है क्यों बिल्कुल क नहीं है सब लेखा जोखा बंधा बंधाया है
says: He claims nothing is random: even a child troubling you or a stranger throwing a stone at you belongs to a ledger of give-and-take that was fixed in advance (lekha-jokha bandha-bandhaya).
cells_derived_method: none: determinism claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled in 'क्यों नहीं है क्यों बिल्कुल क नहीं है'; only the closing claim that the whole account is pre-set is clear.
classical_check: Fixed karmic account matches the classical prarabdha idea; the classics also allow some change through remedies, which he does not mention here.

hindi: और इसी के कारण से हमारा जीवन होता उसी जन्म नक्षत्र उसी ग्रह के अनुसार होता है कि हमें कर्म लेन और देन के लिए प्रस्तुत होना है इसलिए हमारा जीवन बंधा हुआ है
says: He says our life is shaped by the birth nakshatra and the planets, which mark the karmic give-and-take we must show up to settle in this birth, and that is why life is bound (fixed) and not free.
cells_derived_method: none: states that nakshatra and planets carry the karmic ledger; no house or sign differences given.
ambiguity: 'उसी जन्म नक्षत्र उसी ग्रह' could mean the birth nakshatra and its lord, or the birth nakshatra and the planets in general; he does not specify.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that the birth chart (nakshatra, planets) shows destiny from past karma; no specific classical rule is quoted.

hindi: आप सबने एक्सपीरियंस किया होगा जीवन बंधा हुआ है झटके से कुछ परिवर्तन होता है कहीं कोई दूर बैठा हमारे दिमाग को हमारे जीवन को चला रहा है पता नहीं कौन चला रहा है
says: He appeals to common experience: life feels pre-set, with sudden jolts of change, as if some unseen power sitting far away steers our mind and our life, and we do not know who it is.
cells_derived_method: none: general fate statement.
ambiguity: He does not say who or what the hidden driver is (God, planets or karma); he only calls it unknown.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it is a philosophical premise behind the classical idea that planets signal a destiny set earlier.

hindi: अब उस चलाने को जानने वाले डॉक्टर को ज्योतिषी कहते हैं
says: Definition: the astrologer is the 'doctor' who knows how that hidden steering of a person's life works.
cells_derived_method: none: a definition of the astrologer's role.
classical_check: Silent; the astrologer as a diagnostician of karma is a common traditional framing, not a text rule.

hindi: अगर सही ज्योतिषी मिल जाए तो व आपकी रीडिंग सही कर देगा
says: Claim: if you meet a right (competent) astrologer, he will read you correctly, so the reading you get depends on finding the right person.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'रीडिंग सही कर देगा' could mean give a correct reading or set right the person's reading/life; the first fits the context better.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do stress that the astrologer must be learned and ethical but give no rule for meeting one.

hindi: समस्या य होती है आपकी किस्मत कई बार इतनी बुरी फूटी होती है कि ज्योतिषी से बात नहीं होती सही ज्योतिषी या सही डॉक्टर कहते हैं ना सही डॉक्टर नहीं मिला
says: The problem he names: your fortune can be so bad that you never get to speak to the right astrologer, just as some people never find the right doctor, so even access to good help is decided by fate.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or planet is named for this fate-blocks-help claim.
ambiguity: He gives no chart factor for who gets good help; this is a general statement, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link helpers and advisers to specific houses, but he does not do so here.

gist: Anecdote: small-clinic doctors cure patients whom big doctors failed; a man who spent lakhs elsewhere is healed by a 500-rupee medicine and is told his time was only this much.

hindi: ऐसी ऐसी प्रॉब्लम होती है बड़े-बड़े डॉक्टरों की नजर से निकलती है डॉक्टर का फल्ट नहीं है की किस्मत फूटी है
says: He says that when a problem slips past even the best doctors, it is not the doctors' fault but the patient's broken fortune. This is a fate claim only, with no chart rule and no medical statement.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Caption 'फल्ट' is read as 'fault'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts tie disease and cure to the 6th house, the lagna lord and dashas, none of which he names here.

hindi: इसलिए किस्मत फूटी के मुद्दे के लिए सर्वप्रथम अपनी बुद्धि के अंदर ज्ञान डाल के रखो
says: First remedy he offers for bad fortune: before anything else, fill your own intellect with knowledge.
cells_derived_method: none: general advice, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say what knowledge (astrology, scripture or self-knowledge); the next lines point toward self-knowledge.
classical_check: Silent; study and upasana are general classical remedies, but this exact advice is not a text rule.

gist: Opinion: the intellect keeps misleading and wandering, and unless we meet and know ourselves life cannot get better.
Opinion: success should be judged by your own contentment, not others'; a car is useless if you quarrel in it or have an accident, real wealth is peace, joy and love.
Opinion: you are not poor, God keeps you happy with less money while rich people carry hidden sorrows; look inward and the story changes.
Opinion: never think only you are sad, everyone is sad in their own way.
Opinion: desires keep people unhappy while needs satisfy and calm because God fulfils them; if you are sad, you are holding some wish.
Audience question: people ask how to wish correctly; he says it will come slowly by watching the classes.

hindi: लौटते हैं हम अपनी क्लास के ऊपर हम बात कर रहे हैं ज्योतिष के ऊपर ग्रहों की और इन ग्रहों के द्वारा निर्धारण किए जाने वाले इष्ट की
says: Back to the class topic: he states that the ishta (personal chosen deity) is fixed by the planets, and that the series is currently on the planets and the ishta they decide.
cells_derived_method: none: the method for choosing the ishta is not given in this sentence.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet or house decides the ishta here; that is left to the earlier and later classes.
classical_check: Jaimini derives the ishta devata from the planet in the 12th from Karakamsa, so planet-derived ishta is classical; his own method may differ and is not stated here.

gist: Class housekeeping: he jokes that the ishta topic keeps dragging on (maybe God wants it, it is deep), says the ishta is still not fixed, and promises new syllabus going forward with no repetition of old classes.

hindi: इष्ट के लिए क्यों जरूरी है क्योंकि वह इष्ट वो कृपा देता है जिसके कारण आपको सही डॉक्टर मिलेगा सही ज्योतिषी मिलेगा सही मोची मिलेगा आपको सही ड्राइवर मिलेगा आपको सही बच्चे मिलेंगे सही पति या सही पत्नी
says: Why the ishta matters: he claims the ishta gives grace (kripa), and through that grace you meet the right doctor, astrologer, cobbler, driver, children, and the right husband or wife.
cells_derived_method: none: the claim is about the ishta in general, with no house or sign dependence given.
ambiguity: Whether the ishta here means a deity worshipped or a planet-linked force is not clear in this slice.
classical_check: Worship of the ishta devata is an accepted classical remedy, but the specific list of people it brings is his claim and not a text rule.

hindi: यानी कि आपके ऊपर कृपा है यार किसी का हाथ है वो होता है ना
says: He explains grace in plain words: having kripa means someone's protecting hand is over you.
cells_derived_method: none: a definition of kripa.
classical_check: Silent; this is a devotional definition, not a classical technical term.

gist: Analogy: at home people feel safe while the elder uncle (tauji) is sitting there, or a neighbourhood tough who bullies others but loves you; that patron's favour is what grace feels like.

hindi: अगर आपको कृपा मिल रही है तो आपका जीवन खुश है अगर आपके जीवन में कहीं भी कोई झंझट दुख है तो ये गांठ बांध लो कृपा नहीं है
says: Rule of thumb he gives: if grace is flowing your life is happy, and if there is any trouble or sorrow anywhere in your life, tie this knot in your mind that grace is missing.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives an all-or-nothing test of grace, not tied to any house or sign.
ambiguity: He treats any sorrow as proof of missing grace; whether small troubles count the same as large ones is not said.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts attribute sorrow to afflicted houses and dashas, not to missing grace, so this is his own framing.

hindi: हम सोचते हैं पैसा मिल जाए पति मिल जाए पत्नी मेरे हिसाब से चल जाए नहीं नहीं नहीं नहीं आपके पास कृपा नहीं है इसीलिए वो कमिया है
says: He says people aim at the wrong thing (money coming, a husband found, a wife who follows my wishes); the real cause behind each of those shortfalls is that grace is absent.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent, though money, spouse and similar topics would classically sit in the 2nd, 11th and 7th houses.
ambiguity: 'कमिया' is read as 'kamiyan' (shortfalls).
classical_check: Silent; classical texts attribute these shortfalls to specific houses and dashas, which he does not name here.

hindi: यह कृपा कहां से लेनी है यह कृपा लेनी है इष्ट से
says: He states the source of grace: it has to be taken from the ishta, so the ishta is where you go for it.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; ishta devata worship for grace is a common traditional practice.

hindi: इष्ट कई किस्म के हुए
says: He says the ishta is of several kinds, and does not list or name the kinds in this part.
cells_derived_method: none: the kinds are not named here.
ambiguity: 'किस्म' may mean types of deity, or types of ishta by method (for example from planet, house or nakshatra); not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Classical texts name different ishta types (ishta devata, kula devata, gram devata), but whether he means those is not clear.

gist: 'इष्ट वो खाना हुआ' - cannot tell whether he means the ishta is a house (khana) of the chart or something else; the caption is cut.

hindi: यह हमारी एक जन्म कुंडली होती है इस जन्म कुंडली में 12 भाव होते हैं फिक्स एक से शुरू होता है ये और यह इधर जाता है तो ये एक नंबर बनता है
says: Chart basics: the birth chart (janma kundli) has 12 fixed houses (bhavas), numbering starts from 1 and he traces the next positions round the chart by pointing.
cells_derived_method: none: a layout description, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'फिक्स' suggests a North-Indian-style chart where house positions are fixed and signs rotate; the pointing is not captured, and 'ये एक नंबर बनता है' may be a garbled '2'.
classical_check: Twelve bhavas numbered from the lagna agrees with all classical texts.

hindi: चार नंबर सात और 10 ये 11 12
says: Still reading the chart layout aloud: he names the positions of houses 4, 7 and 10 and then 11 and 12 as they are placed around the chart.
cells_derived_method: none: numbering labels only; no meaning is attached to any house in this sentence.
ambiguity: Only the numbers are in the caption; which corner each sits in comes from his pointing. He does not say here that 1, 4, 7, 10 are the angular houses (kendras).
classical_check: Houses 1, 4, 7 and 10 are the angular houses (kendras) classically; he has not said so in this line.

hindi: दो तीन पाच छ आन यह तो है भाव यह है फिक्स ये ऐसे ही रहेंगे
says: Houses (bhavas) are the fixed frame of the chart: whatever the lagna, each house position stays where it is, and he says this while reading out house numbers, setting up the contrast that the signs are what move from chart to chart.
cells_derived_method: The house itself (its body part and life topic) is the same in every chart; what changes across the 12 lagnas is the sign sitting on that house, so every house meets all 12 signs across charts and takes on that sign's colour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Capricorn chart the 4th house (home, mother, chest) carries Aries, so home matters take a quick, heated, initiating tone.
Derived: in the lagna Cancer chart the same 4th house carries Libra, so home matters take a balancing, negotiating, relationship-minded tone.

ambiguity: 'दो तीन पाच छ आन' is a garbled run of numbers, probably him reading house numbers as he points; the exact numbers cannot be recovered.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts treat the 12 bhavas as fixed divisions counted from the lagna, while the rashis move through them.

hindi: यानी यह सिर यहां यही रहेगा यह पेट पेट यही रहेगा दो घुटने इधर उधर रहेंगे ये पांव के पंजे यहीं रहेंगे यह छाती यहीं रहेगी
says: He ties the fixed house positions to fixed body locations: the head at one spot, the belly at another, a knee on each side, the soles of the feet and the chest each at their own spot; this body map does not change from one horoscope to another.
cells_derived_method: Standard bhava body map (inferred, not spoken here): head 1st, chest 4th, belly 5th, knees 10th, feet 12th. How the sign on a body-house colours that region follows the sign's own nature and ruler; this is a tradition association only and not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, tradition only: Aries on the head-house (lagna Aries) gives the head region a Mars-type, hot, impact-prone theme; this is not a medical statement.
Derived, tradition only: Aquarius on the knee-house (lagna Taurus) gives Saturn-type stiff, slow themes, and Aquarius is itself the calf-and-ankle sign, so the lower-leg region is doubly marked.
Derived, tradition only: Scorpio on the belly-house (lagna Cancer) links the lower-abdomen sign with the belly region under a Mars-type rule.

ambiguity: He only points ('यहां', 'इधर उधर'), so the house number for each body part is not spoken; the parts named are just head, belly, knees, soles of the feet and chest.
classical_check: Agrees in broad idea with the bhava body map (head 1st through feet 12th); the house numbers are not spoken here so a line-by-line match is not possible.

hindi: ये एक कंधा ये दूसरा कंधा एक आंख दूसरी आंख ये फिक्स है ये फिक्स है
says: Paired organs, the two shoulders and the two eyes, also sit at fixed places in the house frame, one of each pair on either side of the chart, and both sides of each pair are fixed.
cells_derived_method: In the usual map the eyes fall on the 2nd and 12th houses and the shoulders on the 3rd and 11th (inferred, not spoken). The two houses of a pair carry different signs in any one chart, so the two sides of the body get different sign flavours; tradition association only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, tradition only: in the lagna Taurus chart the 2nd (one eye-house) carries Gemini, a Mercury-type quick, restless colour.
Derived, tradition only: in the lagna Taurus chart the 12th (the other eye-house) carries Aries, a Mars-type hot, sharp colour, so the two eyes read differently.
Derived, tradition only: in the lagna Leo chart the 3rd (a shoulder-and-arm house) carries Libra, a balanced, Venus-type colour.
Derived, tradition only: in the lagna Leo chart the 11th (the other shoulder-and-arm house) carries Gemini, a Mercury-type active, restless colour.

ambiguity: 'एक आंख दूसरी आंख' says only one eye and the other; the house numbers (2nd and 12th for eyes, 3rd and 11th for shoulders in the usual map) are not spoken.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual bhava body map (2nd and 12th for the eyes, 3rd and 11th for arms and shoulders), though this clip does not state the numbers.

hindi: अब इसके अंतर्गत हो सकता है आपका एक तिल यहां हो या तिल यहां हो तिल यहां हो कहीं भी कुछ हो सकता है आपको चोट लगी है पीछे लगी आगे
says: Within each fixed body-house the exact spot stays open: a mole could be anywhere in that region and an injury could be at the back or the front, so the house gives the region and not the precise spot.
cells_derived_method: The region comes from the house; any finer spot (front or back, left or right, upper or lower) could only come from the sign on that house and its ruler, an idea he does not state. Tradition association only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, tradition only: lagna Aries puts Cancer on the chest-house, a sign that is itself the chest sign, so the region is doubly pointed at the chest but front versus back stays undecided.
Derived, tradition only: lagna Cancer puts Gemini, the arms-and-hands sign, on the feet-house, so marks on the feet or on paired limbs are the region this combination points at.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a pointing gesture and no house numbers are spoken; he mixes moles and injuries, so it is unclear whether he means these are readable from the chart or only that they can fall anywhere.
classical_check: Moles and body marks are read in Samudrika Shastra and by some Jyotish authors through house and sign body parts; this loose statement is not a classical rule.

hindi: यानी कि राशियां गोल गोल घूम सकती है इसमें यहां पर आपकी बीमारी गोलगोल घूम सकती है यहां आपकी मस्ती अलग-अलग घूम सकती है
says: Because the signs keep turning through the fixed houses, a person's trouble spot (he says illness) and their enjoyments can land in different places from chart to chart; the sign on a house decides what that part of life feels like. He is describing a tendency, not naming any condition.
cells_derived_method: Each (house, sign) cell is exactly one lagna, so the same house meets a different sign in each of the 12 lagnas and the same life area (and its body region) is coloured differently each time, which shifts where stress or pleasure shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Gemini chart the 6th (work stress, daily struggle) carries Scorpio, so stress comes in an intense, secretive, long-drawn way.
Derived: in the lagna Taurus chart the same 6th carries Libra, so stress comes through disputes, partners and a need to restore balance.
Derived: in the lagna Scorpio chart the 5th (pleasure, children, creativity) carries Pisces, so enjoyment is dreamy, devotional or escapist.
Derived: in the lagna Aquarius chart the same 5th carries Gemini, so enjoyment is talkative, playful and curious.

ambiguity: 'बीमारी' is used loosely and no specific condition is named; 'यहां पर' is a gesture.
classical_check: Agrees with the general principle that a house's results are coloured by the sign on it; the 'illness wanders' wording is his own.

hindi: तो जो राशियां है राशियों के नंबर भी ऐसे ही दिए गए एक दो तीन चार यह भाव है राशि होती है मेष वृष मिथुन कर्क सिंह इत्यादि
says: Signs are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 and so on in the same way as houses, with Mesh (Aries) 1, Vrish (Taurus) 2, Mithun (Gemini) 3, Kark (Cancer) 4, Singh (Leo) 5 onwards, so the same numerals serve for houses and for signs.
cells_derived_method: A cell pairs a house number with a sign number, and sign number minus house number plus one gives the lagna sign number. Where the two numbers are equal the sign sits in its own natural house, which happens only for the Aries lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sign number 4 in house number 1 is the lagna Cancer chart; here the numeral 4 is a sign, not a house.
Derived: sign 4 in house 4 is the lagna Aries chart, where house and sign numbers coincide and mixing them up does no harm.
Derived: house number 4 holding sign number 1 is the lagna Capricorn chart, where a reader who confuses the numerals would wrongly treat house 4 as Cancer.

ambiguity: He calls the numbers 1 to 4 'भाव' (house) and then names signs, so it is unclear whether a given number means a house or a sign; sign numbering Aries=1 to Pisces=12 is confirmed in this series.
classical_check: Agrees: rashis are numbered from Mesha as 1 and bhavas 1 to 12 from the lagna.

gist: Acknowledges an audience reply and notes that the signs are already filled into the chart on display.
Chooses Krishna ji's chart, which starts from sign number 2, as the worked example and starts from there.

hindi: घड़ी ऐसे चलती है ना तो धरती धरती अंतरिक्ष धरती अंतरिक्ष में एंटी क्लॉक वाइज घूमती है
says: He begins the explanation of why the chart runs the way it does: clock hands go one way, but the Earth in space turns anticlockwise, the opposite of the clock.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ऐसे' for the clock direction is a gesture; the next lines make clear he means the usual clockwise motion.
classical_check: Astronomically correct (Earth spins west to east, anticlockwise seen from above the north pole); classical Jyotish texts give no such explanation.

gist: Astronomy aside that Venus spins clockwise while the Earth spins anticlockwise.
Caption fragment about taking the Earth as a model, too garbled to read.

hindi: ये घड़ी हमारी ऐसे चल रही है ये ऐसे जाती है घड़ी लेकिन उल्टा इसलिए क्योंकि धरती यूं घूमती है धरती ऐसे नहीं घूमती
says: Our clock hands travel one way, yet the chart's order runs the opposite way round, and the reason he gives is the Earth's own turning: the Earth does not turn the way a clock does.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The thing that runs 'उल्टा' is left out of the sentence; later lines show he means the signs and house order in the chart. 'ऐसे' and 'यूं' are gestures.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on this reasoning; the anticlockwise order of houses in the North Indian chart is a drawing convention that matches the signs rising in the east in turn.

hindi: घड़ी तो हमने धरती पर ऐसे घुमाई है लेकिन धरती ऐसे घ सूरज के इर्दगिर्द पिछला सारा दि उल्टा धरती अपनी एक्सिस पर घूम रही है ना
says: The Earth makes two turns at once, going round the Sun and spinning on its own axis, and both run opposite to how clock hands were made to go on the Earth; the caption is broken mid-phrase so the exact wording is uncertain.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'धरती ऐसे घ' and 'पिछला सारा दि' are cut off; whether he says both motions are anticlockwise or only the spin is not certain.
classical_check: Astronomically both the spin and the orbit are anticlockwise seen from the north; classical Jyotish is silent.

gist: Gesture-only line showing the directions of Earth, Venus and Mars; the directions themselves are not in the caption.
Physical demonstration: he stands as the Sun and mimics the Earth and Venus circling him.

hindi: तो जब धरती ऐसे घूम रही है तो घोल घोल घूमते हुए वो ऐसे ऐसे भी घूम रही है एक दिन में फिर आगे आगे आगे जा रही है
says: Taking the Earth as the centre, it spins round in a single day and, while doing so, also keeps moving forward along its path day after day; he builds the rotation of signs on this daily spin plus slow forward drift.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The spin and forward-drift are shown by gestures ('ऐसे ऐसे'), and he does not name which motion he calls the daily one; the last part of the sentence about Venus is cut into the next chunk.
classical_check: Astronomically sound (daily rotation plus annual orbit); classical Jyotish uses the apparent geocentric motion and gives no such account.

gist: Says Venus moves in another way from the Earth, with no further detail.

hindi: हम एंटी क्लॉक वाइज एक दिन में 24 घंटे में उल्टा घूम रही है तो इसलिए राशि ऐसे घूमती है
says: The Earth makes one anticlockwise turn in 24 hours, and because of that the signs sweep round the chart through the day in that same anticlockwise sense, which is why the chart's houses run counter to a clock.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'हम' is the Earth ('धरती' dropped from the caption); 'राशि ऐसे घूमती है' is a gesture, so the exact direction is read from the previous lines.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: the signs rise in the east in zodiac order through the day, which gives the anticlockwise layout; the reasoning is astronomy, not from a classical text.

gist: Praises an audience question on why the chart is made to run the reverse way and answers that it is reverse because of the Earth's turning.

hindi: अब ये कृष्ण जी की कुंडली है ये दो नंबर की राशि से कृष्ण जी पैदा हुए हैं कृष्ण जी ऐसे समय पैदा हुई जब दो नंबर राशि यहां थी
says: In the example chart, Krishna ji was born with sign number 2, Taurus, as the lagna: he was born at a moment when sign 2 stood at the first-house spot of the chart.
cells_derived_method: With Taurus as lagna each house carries the sign one place further on than its number: 2nd Gemini, 3rd Cancer, up to the 12th Aries, so every later reading in this chart pairs house H with sign number H+1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Taurus chart the career-and-status 10th carries Aquarius, a Saturn-ruled fixed sign, giving slow-building, structured, public-facing work.
Derived: in the lagna Taurus chart the partnership 7th carries Scorpio, a Mars-ruled fixed sign, giving intense, loyal and conflict-prone relationships.
Derived: in the lagna Taurus chart the home-and-heart 4th carries Leo, the Sun's sign, giving a proud, regal tone to home life.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a gesture; 'sign 2 here' is taken as the first house because the later lines say sign 2 is in the lagna and at the top of the chart. 'दो नंबर की राशि से' could also point to the Moon sign, which is Taurus in this chart as well.
classical_check: Agrees with the commonly cited Krishna chart (Taurus lagna, Moon in Taurus, Sun in Leo); sources differ on details, so treat it as tradition, not proof.

hindi: सूरज रोज सुबह यहां होगा चाहे कुछ भी कर लो 12 बजे यहां होगा शाम 6:00 बजे यहां और आधि रात को यहां
says: The Sun's place in the fixed house frame depends only on the clock time: every day it is at one fixed spot at sunrise, another at noon, another at 6 pm and another at midnight, whatever else changes; by the usual scheme these are the 1st, 10th, 7th and 4th houses.
cells_derived_method: The Sun sign is set by the date and the Sun house by the time of day, so together they fix the lagna: lagna sign number = Sun sign number minus Sun house number plus one. One Sun sign therefore gives four different lagnas at these four anchor times.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo at sunrise (Sun in the 1st) means lagna Leo, so the body-and-self house is ruled by the Sun itself.
Derived: Sun in Leo at noon (Sun in the 10th) means lagna Scorpio, with the Sun at its strongest directional spot in the career-and-status house.
Derived: Sun in Leo at 6 pm (Sun in the 7th) means lagna Aquarius, with the Sun in the partnership house.
Derived: Sun in Leo at midnight (Sun in the 4th) means lagna Taurus, with the Sun at the lowest, directionally weakest spot, as in the Krishna example.

ambiguity: He says only 'यहां' each time while pointing; the house numbers 1, 10, 7 and 4 are inferred from the standard sunrise, noon, sunset and midnight scheme and from the Krishna midnight Sun later being in the 4th. 'गुड मॉर्निंग में' just means the morning sunrise.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is near the ascendant at sunrise, on the 10th at noon, the 7th at sunset and the 4th at midnight, a standard birth-time check.

hindi: लेकिन राशियां घूम रही क्योंकि सुबह से रात होनी है
says: While the Sun's spot for any given hour is fixed, the signs keep turning through the houses as morning becomes night, so over one day every sign takes its turn in every house.
cells_derived_method: Over a day the 10th house, for example, meets each of the 12 signs in turn, which is why one Sun sign and one house for the Sun can still come with 12 different lagnas across the people born that day.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: when the lagna Cancer chart is rising, the 10th carries Aries, so career themes are pioneering and self-started.
Derived: in the lagna Gemini chart the 10th carries Pisces, so career themes lean towards imagination, care and service.
Derived: in the lagna Capricorn chart the 10th carries Libra, so career themes lean towards negotiation, balance and dealing with the public.

ambiguity: The caption does not say how long each sign stays on a house (about two hours classically); the sentence is cut off at 'तो' and continues into the Krishna birth.
classical_check: Agrees: the twelve signs rise one after another through a day, about two hours each on average.

hindi: आधी रात का सूरज यहां पर आ गया इस सूरज ने जब जन्म लिया आधी रात तो उस समय दो नंबर राशि थी यानी कि वृष राशि थी अंतरिक्ष में टॉप पर
says: Krishna ji was born at midnight; the midnight Sun sits at the bottom spot of the chart, and at that moment sign 2, Taurus, was at the top, rising: a Taurus lagna with the Sun in the 4th house.
cells_derived_method: Midnight births always put the Sun in the 4th; the Sun's sign (set by the date) then fixes the lagna. Here the Sun in Leo at midnight gives lagna Taurus; other dates give other lagnas for midnight births.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo at midnight gives lagna Taurus, as here, with the Sun in its own sign in the home house.
Derived: Sun in Aries at midnight gives lagna Capricorn, with the Sun exalted in sign but at the nadir spot where its directional strength is weakest.
Derived: Sun in Libra at midnight gives lagna Cancer, with the Sun debilitated in sign and also at the nadir spot of the home house.

ambiguity: 'टॉप पर' is read as the first house at the top of the North Indian diagram; 'यहां' for the midnight Sun is a gesture, taken as the 4th house because Krishna's Sun is next said to be in sign 5, the 4th house of a Taurus lagna.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard Krishna chart (midnight birth, Taurus rising, Sun in Leo in the 4th); some sources quote other charts for him.

hindi: तो सूरज तो पांच ही नंबर का रहेगा पूरे एक महीने एक राशि में एक महीना रहता है सूरज तो उस एक महीने में जो भी दुनिया में पैदा होगा उसका पांच ही नंबर का सूर्य होगा
says: The Sun stays in one sign for about a month, so everybody born anywhere in the world during that month has the Sun in the same sign; in this example it is sign 5, Leo, for the whole month around Krishna's birth.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's sign tells only the month of birth; which house the Sun falls in depends on the time of day. So a Leo Sun can fall in any of the 12 houses, each a different lagna with different house lordship of the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries) is the Sun in its own sign in the house of intellect, children and creativity.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 8th (lagna Capricorn) is the Sun in its own sign in a hidden, transformative house, so willpower shows up through crises.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 12th (lagna Virgo) is the Sun in its own sign in the house of loss, foreign places and withdrawal, so ego is spent away from home.

ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break; 'पांच नंबर' is read as sign 5 (Leo), not house 5.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun spends about 30 days in each sidereal sign, and Leo for a Bhadrapada birth like Krishna's matches the traditional chart.

hindi: लेकिन किसी का सूर्य यहां है यहां है यहां है गुलगुल घूम रहा है
says: Even though everyone born that month has the Sun in the same sign, one person's Sun sits in one house and another's in another because the signs keep rotating through the day: same Sun sign, different Sun house.
cells_derived_method: The (house, sign) cell for the Sun is what separates people born in the same month: Leo Sun in each of the 12 houses are 12 different lagnas, with different house lordship and different life areas for the Sun's results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 2nd (lagna Cancer) is the Sun in its own sign in the money-and-speech house, giving authoritative speech and pride in family wealth.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 6th (lagna Pisces) is the Sun in its own sign in the house of service and rivals, which tradition reads as good for overcoming opponents.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) is the Sun in its own sign as the 9th lord in the 9th, a strong, fortunate, authority-linked placement.

ambiguity: 'यहां है यहां है यहां है' is repeated pointing with no house numbers; sign 5 is carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun's house at birth depends on birth time, so the same Sun sign gives all twelve lagnas.

hindi: चंद्रमा अलग राशि में हर ढाई दिन में
says: The Moon moves into a different sign about every two and a half days (his figure), so it runs through all the signs in roughly a month.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: A short fragment with no verb; later in the lecture he says the Moon changes every two days, so the figure is approximate.
classical_check: Close: the Moon stays about 2.25 days in a sign on average; 2.5 is a round figure.

hindi: बृहस्पति पूरे 13 महीने में या 12 महीने में बदलेगा
says: Jupiter changes sign in about 13 months, or 12 by his count, giving it roughly one sign per year.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter takes about 13 months per sign (about 12 years round the zodiac).

hindi: मंगल डिपेंड करता है कभी चार महीने कभी एक
says: Mars does not keep a fixed pace: sometimes it stays about four months in a sign and sometimes only one.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The unit for 'एक' is not spoken; it is read as one month.
classical_check: Roughly agrees: about 1.5 to 2 months a sign on average, with retrograde loops stretching it to six months or more.

hindi: राहु डेढ़ साल में बदलता है
says: Rahu changes sign roughly every one and a half years.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees: the mean node takes about 18 months a sign; the caption does not mention that it moves backwards.

hindi: शुक्र भी सवा डेढ़ महीना
says: Venus likewise takes about a month and a quarter to a month and a half in a sign.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'सवा डेढ़' is ambiguous between 1.25 and 1.5 months and may be a caption slip.
classical_check: Roughly agrees: Venus averages about a month per sign, with retrograde spells stretching it.

hindi: शनि 30 साल लेता है घूमने में ढाई साल एक राशि में इसलिए ढैया ढैया नाम से बदनाम है
says: Saturn needs about 30 years to go round the zodiac and stays about two and a half years in each sign, which is why it carries a bad name under the label dhaiya.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Timing agrees (about 29.5 years round, about 2.5 years a sign); classically dhaiya means Saturn in the 4th or 8th from the Moon, so his use as a general 2.5-year stay is looser.

hindi: बुध जो है यह सूर्य के साथ रहता है महीने भर के लिए अंदाजा प्लस माइनस घूमता रहता है
says: Mercury keeps company with the Sun, staying around the same place for about a month, give or take a bit.
cells_derived_method: Mercury sits in the Sun's own sign or the sign just before or after it, so the Sun's house gives a three-house window for Mercury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with Sun in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus), Mercury can sit one sign behind in Cancer in the 3rd, giving a communicative, effort-minded colour.
Derived: with Sun in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus), Mercury can sit with the Sun in Leo in the 4th, close to the Sun's glare, with home and mother matters coloured by it.
Derived: with Sun in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus), Mercury can sit one sign ahead in Virgo, its own and exalted sign, in the 5th house of intellect and children.

ambiguity: 'अंदाजा प्लस माइनस' means roughly plus or minus; he gives no angular limit.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is never more than about 28 degrees from the Sun, so it is in the Sun's sign or an adjacent one.

hindi: ऐसे सारे ग्रह अलग-अलग घूमते सूरज वही रहता है एक महीना फिर एक महीने के बाद सूरज पांच का छह में आएगा फिर सात में फिर आठ में ऐसे ऐसे ऐसे जोडियक गोल गोल घूमता है
says: All planets move at their own speeds, but the Sun holds one sign for a month and then steps on sign by sign (5 to 6, then 7, then 8), so the zodiac keeps turning round.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's sign month by month gives the month of birth; its house from the time of day fixes the lagna. So each month's births with the same clock time share one lagna pattern shifted by one sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a noon birth in the Virgo month (Sun in Virgo in the 10th) gives lagna Sagittarius, with the Sun in the career house in an analytical sign.
Derived: a noon birth in the Libra month (Sun in Libra in the 10th) gives lagna Capricorn, with the Sun in the career house but debilitated.
Derived: a noon birth in the Scorpio month (Sun in Scorpio in the 10th) gives lagna Aquarius, with the Sun in the career house in Mars's sign, a friend's sign.

ambiguity: 'पांच का छह में' is read as sign 5 (Leo) moving into sign 6 (Virgo); it could be house numbers, but a Sun transit moves through signs.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun moves one sidereal sign about every 30 days.

gist: Says this is elementary and that going deeper would turn the session into a class for small children.
Advises that nobody needs to learn how the chart is cast since software supplies it; learn to read the ready-made chart instead.
Says to know the Sun's motion only roughly and, for detail, to buy any good book rather than rely on the many classes.
Says many people are running courses and attending them is a waste of time.
Says how sharp your brain is depends on grace; if grace is there you will grasp it, otherwise you will not.
Garbled fragment just before the Sade Sati explanation, nothing recoverable.

hindi: साढ़े सती का मतलब शनि साढ़े साल के लिए आपकी राशि के एक राशि पीछे एक राशि आगे और एक सेम में
says: Sade Sati means Saturn working on you for seven and a half years in all, spread over the sign just behind your sign, your own sign, and the sign just ahead of it.
cells_derived_method: Sade Sati is counted from the sign the natal Moon occupies, so the houses Saturn presses are the 12th, 1st and 2nd from the Moon; count three signs from the Moon, then convert them to houses from the lagna, and the life areas pressed depend on the Moon's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra): Saturn passes the 9th (Gemini), the 10th (Cancer) and the 11th (Leo), so luck, then career, then gains feel the pressure in turn.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo): Saturn passes the 3rd (Libra), the 4th (Scorpio) and the 5th (Sagittarius), so effort, then home, then children and intellect feel the pressure.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer): Saturn passes the 11th (Taurus), the 12th (Gemini) and the 1st (Cancer), so gains, then expenses and losses, then the self feel the pressure.

ambiguity: 'साढ़े साल' drops the 'सात' and is read as seven and a half years; 'आपकी राशि' is the birth (Moon) sign, which the next lines confirm.
classical_check: Agrees: Sade Sati is Saturn's transit through the 12th, 1st and 2nd signs from the natal Moon sign, about 7.5 years.

hindi: जब रहेगा तो शनि सबसे पावरफुल आपकी राशि पर काम कर रहा है
says: When Saturn sits in the very same sign as your birth sign it works most powerfully on your sign, so the middle of the three stretches is the strongest.
cells_derived_method: The strongest stretch is Saturn over the natal Moon sign, which as a house falls wherever the Moon sits, so the life area pressed hardest is the Moon's own house in that chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio): the peak stretch falls on the partnership house, so relationships are tested most.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo): the peak stretch falls on career and status, so work responsibility is tested most.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius): the peak stretch falls on home and mother, so domestic responsibility is felt most.

ambiguity: 'जब रहेगा' leaves out what Saturn is staying in; it is read as 'when it stays in the same sign' from the previous phrase 'एक सेम में'.
classical_check: Roughly agrees that Saturn over the natal Moon is the core of Sade Sati; classical commentators differ on which of the three stretches is the hardest.

hindi: जैसे ये पर चंद्रमा दो राशि का है तो जब शनि यहां पर आया इनका तो इनको सासती शुरू हो गई तो शनि बिल्कुल क्लोज है आपके चंद्रमा के
says: Using Krishna ji's chart as the example: his Moon is in sign 2, Taurus, so his Sade Sati began once Saturn reached the spot he points to next to that sign (read as the sign before it), and from then Saturn is very close to his Moon.
cells_derived_method: For a Moon in Taurus Sade Sati starts when Saturn enters Aries, the 12th from the Moon; which house that is from the lagna depends on where the Moon sits, so the first stretch presses a different life area in each chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): Sade Sati begins as Saturn enters Aries, which is the lagna itself, so the first stretch presses the self and body house.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 9th (lagna Virgo): Sade Sati begins as Saturn enters Aries, the 8th house, so the first stretch presses hidden matters and sudden change before it reaches the 9th.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer): Sade Sati begins as Saturn enters Aries, the 10th house, so the first stretch presses career before it reaches the 11th and 12th.

ambiguity: 'यहां पर आया' is a gesture; the start is read as Saturn entering the sign before the Moon sign (Aries) but the caption does not name the spot. In Krishna's chart the Moon is in the 1st house. 'ये पर' is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard Krishna chart (Moon in Taurus in the lagna) and with Sade Sati starting when Saturn enters the 12th sign from the Moon sign.

hindi: तो चंद मामा हर दो दिन में घूम रहा है लेकिन आपका जन्म की राशि दो नंबर की है वृष राशि कहते हैं इसे
says: The Moon changes sign about every two days, but your birth sign is fixed as the sign the Moon was in when you were born; in the example it is number 2, called Vrish (Taurus).
cells_derived_method: The birth sign is where the Moon was, whichever house that is, so the same Moon sign can sit in any of the 12 houses; the house sets the area of life the Moon's moods and needs focus on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 3rd (lagna Pisces): the same birth sign as Krishna but the emotional focus falls on effort, communication and siblings.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn): the Moon is exalted in sign and the emotional focus falls on creativity, children and learning.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra): the Moon is strong by sign but sits in a hidden house, so emotional depth, secrecy and ups and downs are the focus.

ambiguity: 'चंद मामा' is the Moon ('Chanda Mama'); the two-day figure differs slightly from the two and a half days he gave earlier.
classical_check: Agrees: janma rashi is the sidereal sign of the Moon at birth and the Moon stays about 2.25 days in a sign.

hindi: वृष कौन होता है बैल कृष्ण जी कैसे थे दो नंबर लगन में लगा हुआ है भैया जो टिक गए वो टिक गए किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनूंगा अपने आप की भी नहीं सुनूंगा
says: Vrish (Taurus) is the bull, so the Taurus temperament is immovable: with sign 2 in the lagna, as for Krishna ji, once such a person settles on something they stay put and will listen to nobody, not even themselves.
cells_derived_method: Taurus's fixed, stubborn, holding-on nature colours whichever house it falls on, so its expression changes with the life area of that house in each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Aries chart Taurus on the 2nd shows as stubbornness over money and speech, holding savings and opinions tightly.
Derived: in the lagna Leo chart Taurus on the 10th shows as immovability at work: steady and slow to change course, resistant to advice.
Derived: in the lagna Scorpio chart Taurus on the 7th shows as a possessive, steady partner who is hard to persuade in a dispute.
Derived: in the lagna Sagittarius chart Taurus on the 6th shows as obstinacy in daily routine and with rivals, hard to dislodge.

ambiguity: 'अपने आप की भी नहीं सुनूंगा' is hyperbole in the bull's voice; the caption does not show whether he means Taurus only in the lagna or Taurus anywhere in the chart.
classical_check: Agrees: Taurus is a fixed (sthira) earth sign, steady and stubborn; Krishna's Taurus lagna is the standard chart.

gist: Jokes with a Salman Khan film dialogue that the bull does not budge.

hindi: किसी तरह से यहां पर शनि आया दोबारा दूसरी ढैया चालू हो गई यहां पर आया तीसरी ढैया फिर यहां जब गोल गोल घुमा तो ढैया नहीं है उस आदमी की
says: As Saturn walks on sign by sign it gives the person a first dhaiya (a two-and-a-half-year stretch) at the first spot, a second when it reaches the next, and a third at the one after; once it goes past those and keeps circling, that person has no further dhaiya, so the pressure is three stretches only.
cells_derived_method: The three stretches are the 12th, 1st and 2nd signs from the Moon; as houses they fall on three consecutive houses counted from the lagna starting at the house that is 12th from the Moon's house, so which three life areas are pressed depends on where the Moon sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): the three stretches fall on the 12th (Pisces), the 1st (Aries) and the 2nd (Taurus), so expenses, self, then money.

Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo): the three stretches fall on the 5th (Sagittarius), the 6th (Capricorn) and the 7th (Aquarius), so intellect and children, then service and rivals, then partnership.
Derived: Moon in Libra in the 11th (lagna Sagittarius): the three stretches fall on the 10th (Virgo), the 11th (Libra) and the 12th (Scorpio), so career, then gains, then expenses.

ambiguity: He points at spots ('यहां पर') without naming signs; they are read as the three consecutive Sade Sati signs (before, same, after the Moon sign), not the separate Kantaka Shani dhaiya.
classical_check: Agrees with Sade Sati being three stages of about 2.5 years; classically 'dhaiya' separately means Saturn in the 4th or 8th from the Moon, a different idea.

hindi: उसकी ढैया सिर्फ इतनी ही है और इस ढैया के तौर पर बदनाम किया हुआ है ऐसा कुछ नहीं है
says: That person's Saturn stretch is only that long, and the heavy reputation it has been given under the dhaiya label is exaggerated: there is nothing like that.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ऐसा कुछ नहीं है' could mean Saturn's period is not harmful at all or only that its bad name is overblown; the next lines suggest the milder reading.
classical_check: Differs from the common classical fear of Sade Sati, though texts also say results depend on the Moon's strength and Saturn's lordship, so his claim is a modern softening.

hindi: राम और रावण की राशि भी सेम थी कृष्ण और कंस की भी सेम सिर्फ शनि को ब्लेम करने से कोई फायदा नहीं है कि अकेला शनि बुरा था यह बेकार की व्यर्थ बातें हैं
says: Ram and Ravan had the same sign, and so did Krishna and Kansa, yet they turned out opposite, so putting the blame on Saturn alone for bad times is pointless talk.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'राशि' could mean the Moon sign or the lagna sign; the caption does not say which.
classical_check: Cannot be checked: Ram's Cancer sign is standard but the signs of Ravan and Kansa are not fixed in classical texts, so 'same sign' is his claim.

hindi: इंसान की ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस से बढ़कर कुछ भी नहीं है
says: Nothing is above human consciousness: a person's awareness and choices outweigh what any planet, Saturn included, does to them.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: A short philosophical line; it is read as the conclusion of the Saturn-blame point before it, but it could be a general remark.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; the idea that effort (purushartha) can modify destiny exists classically, but no text ranks consciousness above the planets.

hindi: वो नौवे नंबर में 10 नंबर की राशि अब वहां उस समय ग्रह क्या है ग्रह गोलगोल घूम रहे हैं मंगल है 10 नंबर का मंगल 10 नंबर का
says: In this Taurus-lagna chart the ninth house carries sign 10, Capricorn, and Mars is placed there: Mars in Capricorn in the 9th house.
cells_derived_method: Mars's results change with the lagna's lordships for the same planet and house; in other signs of the 9th house the same Mars gives different lagnas, lordships and dignity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Leo chart Mars, lord of the 4th and 9th, is in its own sign Aries in the 9th, a strong trine placement for fortune, dharma and home luck.
Derived: in the lagna Scorpio chart Mars, lord of the 1st and 6th, is debilitated in Cancer in the 9th, so its drive for fortune and dharma is weak unless the debility is cancelled.
Derived: in the lagna Sagittarius chart Mars, lord of the 5th and 12th, sits in Leo, the Sun's sign, in the 9th: a 5th lord in a trine with a 12th-house loss lordship, so the result is mixed.

ambiguity: 'नौवा नंबर जो घर था' is the 9th house and '10 नंबर की राशि' is sign 10; he uses 'नंबर' for both, but for a Taurus lagna the 9th house is indeed Capricorn.
classical_check: Consistent with a Taurus lagna chart, where the 9th is Capricorn; Mars in Capricorn in the 9th matches popular versions of the Krishna chart but is not verified here.

gist: Tells students they will have to memorise these placements from a tabulated chart.

hindi: मंगल 10 नंबर का जो होता है वो उच्च का होता है उच्च सबसे पावरफुल
says: Mars in sign number 10, Capricorn, is exalted (uccha), and an exalted planet is at its most powerful.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Mars is strong everywhere, but what it energises depends on the house and on the houses Mars rules for that lagna; a kendra placement also makes Ruchaka yoga in tradition, while the 4th, 8th and 12th are Manglik positions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Capricorn chart Mars, lord of the 4th and 11th, is exalted in the 1st, a kendra, which tradition counts as Ruchaka Mahapurusha yoga: strong body, drive and leadership.

Derived: in the lagna Libra chart Mars, lord of the 2nd and 7th, is exalted in the 4th, also a kendra giving Ruchaka yoga and home and property strength, though the 4th is a Manglik position, so the result is mixed.
Derived: in the lagna Gemini chart Mars, lord of the 6th and 11th, is exalted in the 8th, so strong energy sits in a hidden, difficult house, showing as resilience in crises; also a Manglik position.
Derived: in the lagna Aquarius chart Mars, lord of the 3rd and 10th, is exalted in the 12th, so courage and career drive go into foreign places, expenses or solitude.

ambiguity: '10 नंबर' is read as sign 10, Capricorn, since he is speaking of Mars's exaltation, and it matches the exaltation table.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn (deepest at 28 degrees).

hindi: हनुमान जी है शनि के घर में गए जब हनुमान अग्नि तेल के पास जाएगी तो तेल हाथ जोड़ के खड़ा हो जाएगा
says: Picture Hanuman (Mars, fire) stepping into Saturn's house (Capricorn): when fire goes near oil, the oil stands with folded hands, so Mars exalted in Saturn's sign makes Saturn submit instead of troubling.
cells_derived_method: The Saturn-bows idea holds only for Mars in Capricorn; the house decides which area benefits, and which houses Saturn rules for that lagna shows which Saturn matters get overpowered.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Aries chart Mars is exalted in the 10th, in the sign of Saturn who rules the 10th and 11th, so Saturn's pull on career is overpowered and the career house gets forceful, commanding energy.

Derived: in the lagna Virgo chart Mars is exalted in the 5th, in the sign of Saturn who rules the 5th and 6th, so the intellect-and-children house gets bold, fiery energy and Saturn's delays are said to be eased.

Derived: in the lagna Pisces chart Mars is exalted in the 11th, in the sign of Saturn who rules the 11th and 12th, so gains come through bold action and Saturn's drag on gains is said to be overpowered.

ambiguity: 'हनुमान जी है' is read as Hanuman standing for Mars; the oil and fire picture is his allegory, not a rule worked out with numbers.
classical_check: Mars exalted in Saturn's own Capricorn is classical; Saturn 'bowing' to it is his allegory, and Hanuman worship against Saturn's troubles is a folk tradition, not a Parashari rule.

hindi: शनि तेल होता है तेल का दिया जलाते ना और मंगल अग्नि होती है पेट में होती है नाभी जठराग्नि
says: Saturn stands for oil, as in the oil lamp we light, while Mars stands for fire, the fire in the belly at the navel, the digestive fire (jatharagni).
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is fire-natured and tied to heat and digestion, and Saturn to oil and iron; 'jatharagni as Mars' is a common later reading rather than a Parashari line.

gist: Retells Hanuman setting Lanka on fire with his tail to show the oil standing with folded hands before the fire.

hindi: यह मंगल यहां बम का गोला है आपका
says: He calls this exalted Mars in the 9th house of the example chart a bomb shell, meaning a very powerful, explosive force; the sentence is cut off after 'आपका', so the rest of the point is missing.
cells_derived_method: The explosive reading of exalted Mars depends on the house it falls in; the 9th (fortune and dharma) is only one of many.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the lagna Scorpio chart Mars, lord of the 1st and 6th, is exalted in the 3rd, so the bomb-shell force goes into courage, effort and initiative.
Derived: in the lagna Leo chart Mars, lord of the 4th and 9th, is exalted in the 6th, so the explosive force goes against rivals and obstacles, though a strong yogakaraka sits in a difficult house.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a gesture at Mars in the 9th house; the sentence ends at 'आपका' and is cut at the batch end, so the full thought is unknown; 'बम का गोला' is a metaphor for strength.
classical_check: Silent on the metaphor; exalted Mars is classically strong and forceful.

hindi: उच्च का ग्रह बैठा है भाग्य स्थान इष्ट स्थान देव स्थान यह खुद देवता के समान है
says: An exalted planet sitting in the 9th house is special because the 9th is the seat of fortune, of the personal deity (ishta) and of divinity, so the planet placed there is itself like a god.
cells_derived_method: The exalted sign is fixed by the planet (Sun Aries, Moon Taurus, Mars Capricorn, Mercury Virgo, Jupiter Cancer, Venus Pisces, Saturn Libra), so each exalted planet in the 9th gives a different lagna, and the god-like quality takes that planet's flavour: authority (Sun), devotion and mind (Moon), courage (Mars), reasoning (Mercury), wisdom (Jupiter), art and love (Venus), discipline (Saturn).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in the 9th gives lagna Leo; the lagna lord itself is exalted in the fortune house, so luck comes through authority, the father and self-confidence.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 9th gives lagna Scorpio; Jupiter (2nd and 5th lord) is at full strength in its own karaka house, so faith, teachers and dharma carry the person.
Derived: Saturn exalted in the 9th gives lagna Aquarius; the lagna lord is exalted in the fortune house, so luck comes late and through discipline, duty and long service rather than flash.

ambiguity: He says 'उच्च का ग्रह' without naming the planet, so which planet is meant is open; 'भाग्य, इष्ट, देव स्थान' are three names for the 9th, not three different houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts treat the 9th as dharma, fortune and guru, and an exalted planet in a trikona is strong; ishta devata is classically read from the 5th/9th lords or Jaimini's Karakamsha, so 'the planet is itself a god' is his extension.

hindi: और मंगल पराक्रम का देवता है यानी कि यह आदमी अपने भाग्य में जरा सा हिला डला नहीं आग लगा देगा
says: Mars is the deity of courage and valor, so exalted Mars in the 9th means the native needs only a small push to set his own fortune ablaze with energy and drive.
cells_derived_method: Mars's fire is applied to whatever the house stands for, and exalted Mars is Capricorn only, so the lagna shifts with the house: in the 1st it energises the self, in the 5th intellect and children, in the 10th career. He names only the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 1st (lagna Capricorn; a Ruchaka-type kendra placement) puts the fire into body, stamina and personal leadership; Mars rules the 4th and 11th there.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) is lagna lord and 8th lord in a kendra, so the fire goes into career, status and bold public action.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 5th (lagna Virgo) rules the 3rd and 8th; competitive intellect and bold creativity, but the 8th lordship brings sudden turns.

ambiguity: 'आग लगा देगा' is vivid and can mean either productive energy or reckless burning; he intends the positive reading here.
classical_check: Differs in tone: Parashari texts usually call Mars in the 9th a mixed placement (friction with father and guru); exalted Mars makes Ruchaka only in a kendra, and the 9th is a trikona, so the fire-in-fortune claim is his reading. Mars as the deity of valor is traditional.

hindi: तो कृष्ण जी ने नौवे घर में मंगल लेकर जन्म लिया पैदाइशी तौर पर ही भाग्यशाली है इस आदमी को कोई हरा ही नहीं सकता
says: He offers Krishna's chart as the proof case: Krishna was born with exalted Mars in the 9th house, so he was lucky from birth and nobody could defeat him.
cells_derived_method: none: this is a single example chart (Taurus lagna, Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 9th); the general rule sits in the two previous rows.
ambiguity: He says only 'Mars in the 9th'; exalted Capricorn is inferred from the previous sentence and confirmed a few lines later as the '10 number' sign.
classical_check: Krishna's birth chart is traditional lore with several versions and no classical text lists his Mars; exalted Mars in a trikona is strong, but Ruchaka needs a kendra, so 'nobody can defeat him' is his dramatisation.

hindi: अब इसकी अपनी कॉन्शसनेस है कि ये कितना उठेगा
says: The chart gives only the potential; how far the person actually rises depends on his own level of consciousness, which the planets cannot supply.
cells_derived_method: none: a general qualifier on all results, not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: 'कॉन्शसनेस' could mean awareness, self-belief or spiritual level; he develops it as self-belief and inner awareness a few lines later.
classical_check: Silent: classical chart rules judge results by dignity, aspects and dasha; the role of the native's awareness is his philosophical qualifier.

hindi: इनके लग्न में उच्च का चंद्रमा है उच्च बेस्ट राशय चंद्रमा की ये शिव होते हैं
says: Krishna's lagna holds an exalted Moon, which he calls the Moon's best state, and he compares such a person to Shiva, the deity who wears the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Moon is exalted in Taurus only; the house decides which area of life receives the calm, joyful and emotionally strong mind: the lagna gives personality, the 4th home and peace, the 10th public standing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in the 4th (lagna Aquarius) sits in its own karaka house for mother and home: emotional security and a comfortable house; the Moon is 6th lord there, so service and routine themes also appear.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 10th (lagna Leo) as 12th lord: popularity, public contact and care or food-related work, with a foreign or behind-the-scenes thread.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 8th (lagna Libra) as 10th lord: deep intuition, interest in hidden subjects and sudden shifts in career.

ambiguity: 'ये शिव होते हैं' could mean the native is Shiva-like or that this Moon is the Moon of Shiva; 'राशय' is a caption slip for राशि.
classical_check: Agrees that Moon in Taurus is exalted and strong in a kendra; the Shiva comparison is symbolic, not a textual rule.

hindi: दो नंबर कहां होता है हृदय चक्र पे दो नंबर चंद्रमा जब हृदय चक्र पर आता है जब मुन्ना हृदय के साथ एकमत हो जाता है
says: He ties the Moon (number 2) to the heart chakra and says that when the Moon works at that heart level the mind, which he calls 'Munna', agrees with the heart, so thinking and feeling pull the same way.
cells_derived_method: none: he links the Moon to the heart chakra in general and gives no house or sign split.
ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' can be the Moon's planet number (Sun 1, Moon 2) or sign number 2 (Taurus, where Krishna's Moon sits); 'मुन्ना' is probably मन (mind) or his pet name for it; 'आता है' (arrives at the heart chakra) is vague.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon as the mind (manas) is classical and the 4th house is the heart; the chakra mapping is yogic and not in Parashari texts.

hindi: यह बहु होती है शुक्र
says: In his household picture Venus plays the bahu, the daughter-in-law of the family.
cells_derived_method: none: a role assignment for the planet, not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of wife and women; reading her as the daughter-in-law is his extension, seen from the mother's side.

hindi: याद करें पिछली ड्राइंग्स के चौथे घर में शुक्र है सास यहां बैठी है चंद्रकांता यहां बैठी है
says: He asks the audience to recall his earlier drawings where Venus sat in the 4th house; in that picture the mother-in-law (the Moon, called Chandrakanta) sits in the same place, so Venus and Moon meet in the home house.
cells_derived_method: Venus and Moon together in the 4th (home, mother, comfort): the sign decides whose home it is. Moon's own sign Cancer makes the saas the host; Venus's own signs Taurus or Libra make the bahu the host.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus with the Moon in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): the Moon is in her own sign, so the saas is host and Venus the guest; domestic comfort exists but the wife adjusts to the mother's ways.

Derived: the Moon is exalted and Venus sits in her own sign in the 4th (lagna Aquarius): the bahu is host and the Moon the pampered guest; a pleasant, well-furnished home and an easy mother-wife relation.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 4th with the Moon in Pisces (lagna Sagittarius): bahu at her best, with comfort and vehicles, but Venus is 6th and 11th lord, so some friction with staff or routine.

ambiguity: 'पिछली ड्राइंग्स' points to earlier lecture material not in this slice; 'यहां' is not named; the 4th could mean house 4 or Cancer (sign 4); Krishna's Moon here is in Taurus, so the 4th-house Venus belongs to a different example.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives the Moon and Venus the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law roles; Moon as mother and Venus as wife are the classical karakas.

hindi: और शुक्र यानी कि बेटे की पत्नी या जो प्रेमिका है वो यहां रहती है जब वो यहां
says: Venus here means the son's wife or the girlfriend in his life, and she is the one who lives in this spot, so the spot is her own home that the Moon will be seen visiting.
cells_derived_method: none: this defines Venus's role and her 'home'; the visit scene that follows carries the house and sign meaning.
ambiguity: 'यहां' could be Venus's sign (Taurus or Libra) or the 4th house just mentioned; the sentence is cut at the chunk boundary and continues at 20:01.
classical_check: Venus as wife or lover is classical (kalatra karaka for men); the son's partner seen from the mother is his extension.

hindi: आती है तो सासू का नमस्कार करती है बहू खड़ी रह जाती है कहती है हां जी आइए सासू मां बैठिए मेरे स्थान पर आप जो कहेंगे आपके लिए पाव दबाओ फलाना करो ढिमरा पीठ पीछे भले ही गाली बके
says: When the mother-in-law (Moon) enters the daughter-in-law's (Venus's) own place, the bahu greets her, stands, offers her seat and service; the host defers outwardly to the guest, while what she says behind her back is a separate matter.
cells_derived_method: Host-guest model (his picture, extended by me): the sign lord is the host and a planet sitting in that sign is the guest. The guest gets outward respect when it is dignified or the host is friendly, and polite coldness otherwise; the house decides in which area of life the hosting plays out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon (3rd lord) in the 4th in Leo (lagna Taurus) has the Sun as host, a friend of the Moon; the home is run by a proud, respected elder who receives the mind warmly.
Derived: Moon (lagna lord) in the 7th in Capricorn (lagna Cancer) is hosted by Saturn, a natural enemy of the Moon in the classical scheme; the partner is a correct but cold host.

Derived: Moon (7th lord) in the 6th in Gemini (lagna Capricorn) is hosted by Mercury, whom the Moon counts as a friend but who counts the Moon an enemy; a lopsided welcome in a place of daily work and disputes.

ambiguity: He does not name the sign in this sentence; the earlier line places Venus's 'place' but not which sign; the 'abuse behind the back' can be hidden resentment or just a joke.
classical_check: Extends the classics: dignity uses natural and temporary friendship and exaltation, not hospitality; Venus is a natural enemy of the Moon in BPHS, so the bahu's deference fits the Moon's exaltation in Taurus rather than friendship.

hindi: लेकिन चंद्रमा उच्च है उच्च चंद्रमा मींस जो सासू मां है वो भी वहां मस्त होती है बहू के यहां अठखेलिया करेगी अपने मन में नाचने की इच्छा नाच भी लेगी श्रृंगार भी कर लेगी और मस्ती भी मारेगी
says: Because the Moon is exalted here, the mother-in-law feels completely at home in the bahu's place: she plays, fulfils her wish to dance, dresses up and enjoys herself; in chart terms an exalted Moon gives a playful, expressive mind that enjoys adornment and fun.
cells_derived_method: Moon exalted in Taurus in other houses sends the same playful joy into that house's topic: romance and arts in the 5th, partnership in the 7th, private pleasures and spending in the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in the 5th (lagna Capricorn) as 7th lord: joyful romance, music, dance and creative play, and a happy bond with children.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) as 9th lord: a charming, pleasure-loving partner and fun in partnerships.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 12th (lagna Gemini) as 2nd lord: enjoyment in private and bedroom pleasures or foreign stays, with money going to luxuries.

ambiguity: The saas is the Moon visiting Venus's sign Taurus; the dancing and adorning is a metaphor for the exalted Moon's mood, not a literal sign of the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: an exalted Moon is cheerful, beauty-loving and popular in classical texts; the dance and adornment details are his imagery.

hindi: यानी महा महा मस्त होते हैं ऐसे लोग इसीलिए चंचल बहुत कृष्ण के चरित्र में आनंद बहुत है मस्ती बहुत है चालाकी बहुत ज्यादा है प्रसन्न बहुत रहते हैं
says: He lists the character this gives: such people are extremely merry and therefore restless and fickle, and Krishna's nature shows much bliss, fun, a lot of cleverness or cunning, and constant cheerfulness.
cells_derived_method: The same traits (joy, fickleness, cleverness) show in the area of the house where the exalted Moon sits: speech and performance in the 3rd, speech and food in the 2nd, friends and gains in the 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in the 3rd (lagna Pisces) as 5th lord: witty, entertaining speech, performing arts and short travel, but fickle effort.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 2nd (lagna Aries) as 4th lord: sweet, charming speech and a love of food and family warmth.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 11th (lagna Cancer) as lagna lord: a cheerful circle of friends and easy gains.
