ambiguity: 'चंचल' is given as a result of extreme merriment; 'चालाकी' can be read as cleverness or as cunning.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: the Moon is changeable (chanchala) and an exalted Moon is cheerful; 'cunning' is not a standard exalted-Moon result.

hindi: ऐसे लोगों को दुखी करना लगभग असंभव है हर समय मस्त रहते हैं हर समय पागलों की तरह मस्त रहते पता नहीं क्यों रहते क्योंकि उनको पीछे से ही परमात्मा ने ऐसा बनाक भेजा है
says: He claims such natives are almost impossible to make sad; they stay cheerful like madmen for no visible reason because, as he puts it, God sent them already made that way, meaning an inborn rather than acquired nature.
cells_derived_method: Mood resilience follows the Moon's dignity and company more than the house: an exalted Moon keeps the cheerfulness in any house but points it at different areas. A Saturn or Rahu conjunction would dull it (derived, not said).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in the 9th (lagna Virgo) as 11th lord: optimism and a trusting belief that things will work out.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 6th (lagna Sagittarius) as 8th lord: stays cheerful through disputes and debts but is sensitive about daily routine and diet.

ambiguity: 'पीछे से' could mean past-life karma or simply 'from birth'; 'बनाक भेजा' is caption noise for बनाकर भेजा.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not say an exalted lagna Moon makes grief impossible; they only call the exalted Moon steady and pleasant.

gist: One-line wrap-up that Krishna had to turn out like this; adds no new rule beyond the Moon description.

hindi: अब यह 10 नंबर की राशि की बात हो रही है यहां मंगल है
says: He moves from the Moon to the sign numbered 10 (Capricorn), where Mars sits; this fixes that the exalted Mars of the 9th-house example is in Capricorn, so the '10' is a sign number and the 9th is the house.
cells_derived_method: none: this only names the sign of the cell already described.
ambiguity: '10 नंबर' could be mistaken for the 10th house; it is the sign number (Aries=1), and with Mars in the 9th the lagna works out to Taurus (10-9+1=2).
classical_check: Arithmetic agrees: Capricorn is sign 10, Mars is exalted there, and with Mars in the 9th the lagna is Taurus.

hindi: अब यहां इनके हि इष्ट कौन है जिसका नव घर में ही का ग्रह बैठा है वह स्वयम इष्ट है अब य बड़ी अजीब सी बात है यानी वह स्वयं ही ईश्वर के समान है
says: Asked who the ishta deity of such a native is, he answers that whoever has an exalted planet in the 9th is his own ishta, which he calls strange: the person is himself equal to God.
cells_derived_method: The 'god' he becomes takes the flavour of whichever exalted planet holds the 9th, so one can read which side of the divine the native embodies: intellect for Mercury, loving devotion for Venus, and so on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in the 9th (lagna Capricorn): the self-as-deity shows as intellect, speech and analysis of scripture.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 9th (lagna Cancer): the self-as-deity shows as devotion through love, art and beauty.

ambiguity: The caption 'ही का ग्रह' is read as 'उच्च का ग्रह' from the surrounding lines; 'नव घर' is the 9th house.
classical_check: Differs: classically the ishta devata comes from Karakamsha (12th from the Atmakaraka in navamsa, Jaimini) or from the 5th/9th lords, not from 'the native himself'; this is his philosophy rather than a classical rule.

hindi: पंगा कहां होता है बहुत लोगों के उच्च के ग्रह बैठे होते हैं कभी मंगल है राहु है बुध है केतु है कोई ना कोई बैठा उनको स्वयं पर यकीन नहीं है कि मैं कर सकता हूं
says: The catch is that many people do have an exalted planet in the 9th (Mars, Rahu, Mercury, Ketu or another) but they do not believe in themselves, so the placement never turns into achievement.
cells_derived_method: The unrealised promise looks different per planet: exalted Mars in the 9th unused means idle energy, exalted Sun unused means unclaimed authority; Rahu and Ketu exaltation signs are disputed, so no cell is derived for them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 9th is the same cell as Krishna's chart (lagna Taurus), but a self-doubting native leaves that energy unused.
Derived: Sun exalted in the 9th (lagna Leo), the planet of self-confidence, gives authority and father support that a self-doubting native fails to claim.

ambiguity: He lists Rahu and Ketu among exalted planets without naming their signs; 'कोई ना कोई बैठा' means some planet or other.
classical_check: Classical texts do not treat self-belief as a modifier: dignity, aspects and dasha decide. Rahu and Ketu exaltation is disputed (Taurus/Scorpio in some texts, Gemini/Sagittarius in others).

gist: Philosophy that we spend life on the outer journey watching other people and never take the inner journey to the self.

hindi: जब मैं ही स्वयं बन गया यानी कृष्ण ने कहा अहम ब्रह्मास्मि मैं ही ईश्वर हूं कौन सा मैं अहंकार वाला नहीं जो मैं अंदर है जो चेतना मुझे जीवित किए बैठी है जो सबको जीवित किए बैठी है
says: When the 9th-house native becomes the self, it is the Aham Brahmasmi state; the 'I' meant is not the ego but the inner consciousness that keeps him and everyone else alive.
cells_derived_method: none: a philosophical gloss on the 9th-house self-as-ishta idea, not house or sign dependent beyond the 9th.
ambiguity: 'मैं' could be read as ego or as consciousness; he states clearly that he means consciousness.
classical_check: Not a classical astrology rule: Aham Brahmasmi is an Upanishadic statement, not a line of Krishna, used here as a Vedantic gloss on the 9th-house idea.

gist: Philosophy about who inside us listens and understands: the ear cannot refuse to hear, but understanding needs attention that is not elsewhere.
If the listeners are connected but their minds are on work or the shop, they only hear; it is recorded like a file but never replayed, so they cannot implement.
People say they attended the class while driving or cooking; such multitasking means they will never implement what they understood.
Body and mind must both be present to manifest; ears alone give mind-level change only, so dedication is needed; the numbers 72 and 12 in the caption are unclear.
Habits like cooking and driving run on the trained subconscious, so the body drives while the mind abuses people on the phone and types messages.
Where body and mind are in sync a person becomes a saint; ordinary people have them out of sync.
Health claim that heart attack or liver failure, even in a non-drinking ascetic, comes from body and mind being out of sync; not astrology and not endorsed.
Garbled lines about the body not obeying the mind, alcohol and going mad; the intended statement cannot be reconstructed.
The mind never labels relatives (mother-in-law, brother, sister, wife, son) as good or bad; good and bad do not exist in the mind.
Claims alcohol does not exist as a thing in the mind and that realising this means the liver will never fail; health claim, not endorsed.
If one has truly known Brahman the 'if' is a mirage and the question of puja-path becomes meaningless; the fragment '10 नंबर का किसकी' is garbled.

hindi: इसीलिए जिनका नौवा भाव उत्तम और उच्च होता है उस व्यक्ति को अगर समझ है कि मैं ही ब्रह्म हूं और वह स्वयं को ही ईश्वर तुल्य मानता है अहंकार की बात नहीं हो रही कि मैं भगवान हूं
says: People whose 9th house is excellent and exalted, and who also understand 'I am Brahman', regard themselves as divine; he stresses this is not ego-boasting ('I am God, I will do this'), which he calls foolishness.
cells_derived_method: How the divine self shows depends on the sign of the strong 9th: philosophical and teacher-like in Sagittarius, devotional and mystic in Pisces, emotional and nurturing in Cancer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Sagittarius (lagna Aries), Jupiter's own sign: the divine self shows as a teacher, philosopher and upholder of law and faith.
Derived: 9th in Pisces (lagna Cancer): devotional, mystic, surrender-type divinity in which the self dissolves into the whole.
Derived: 9th in Cancer (lagna Scorpio): faith that is emotional and mother-linked, a nurturing sense of the divine.

ambiguity: 'नौवा भाव उत्तम और उच्च' may mean the 9th holds an exalted planet or that the 9th house and its lord are simply strong; 'ब्रह्म हूं' is a spiritual self-knowledge condition, not a chart factor.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a strong 9th with a well-placed lord is classically good for fortune and dharma; 'the native is his own deity' is not a Parashari rule.

hindi: मुझ में ही तो बैठा है तो वो पूजा कर रहा है नहीं कर रहा कोई लेना देना नहीं वो स्वयम इष्ट हो गया
says: Since the divine already sits inside him, it makes no difference whether such a native performs puja or not; he has himself become his ishta, so external worship is not what drives his results.
cells_derived_method: Applies to a strong 9th only, as he sets it up; for a weak or afflicted 9th he implies the opposite (see his later warning on worshipping a debilitated planet), so ritual relevance changes with the 9th's condition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 9th (lagna Scorpio): a case where by his rule formal puja is unnecessary because the guru principle already lives in the native.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) is the opposite case, where his later rule says worship of that planet is not safe.

ambiguity: He does not say whether ritual is useless for everyone else; 'कर रहा है नहीं कर रहा' can mean puja neither helps nor harms this native.
classical_check: Differs from classical remedial practice, where worship (graha shanti, ishta upasana) is prescribed for every native, strong 9th or not; this is his spiritual stance.

hindi: अब हमारा माइंड ट्रेंड है इसमें नहीं बाहर जाते हैं टीले वाले बाबा पर जाते हैं हनुमान जी दिया कहां जलाए कोई लिंक नहीं है यार नहीं जब अंदर का ही दीप जला डाला तो काम हो गया
says: Our minds are trained to look outward, going to hilltop babas and asking where to light a lamp for Hanuman; he says there is no real link between these outer acts and results, because once the inner lamp is lit the work is done.
cells_derived_method: none: a general stance on remedies, not house or sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: 'कोई लिंक नहीं है' could mean no link between the outer ritual and results, or no link between the babas and the native; unclear whether he rejects all remedies or only for natives with a strong 9th.
classical_check: Differs from classical and common practice of temple worship, lamps and graha remedies; his stance is inward-first.

hindi: अंदर का दीप जला देना ही सिमरन है कहते हैं ना वाहेगुरु वाहेगुरु बोलने की जरूरत नहीं है राम राम बोलने की जरूरत नहीं है हनुमान जी काम कर रहे हैं उसके बाद भी राम राम अजप अजप
says: Lighting the inner lamp is itself simran (remembrance); one need not chant Waheguru or Ram aloud, because the unspoken chant (ajapa) keeps running inside even while a figure like Hanuman is busy with his tasks.
cells_derived_method: none: a general view of mantra and remembrance, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'हनुमान जी काम कर रहे हैं उसके बाद भी' is loose: it may mean even Hanuman, while working, has Ram-Ram running inside, or that Hanuman's work continues after the chant.
classical_check: Ajapa-japa is a known yogic and bhakti idea, not an astrological remedy; classical remedies prescribe spoken or counted mantra recitation, so he differs.

hindi: आपके अंदर क्या चल रहा है वह मुख्य काम है इष्ट कहां से झनक हुआ जो अंदर चल रहा है आपके अंतर मन में क्या है वह आपका इष्ट है
says: What is running in your inner mind is the main thing; the ishta is not the picture on the wall but whatever actually occupies the subconscious, and that is your real ishta.
cells_derived_method: none: a psychological definition of ishta, not house or sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: 'इष्ट कहां से झनक हुआ' is garbled, perhaps 'झलक' (glimpse); the sentence is read as saying the ishta comes from the content of the inner mind.
classical_check: Differs: the classical ishta devata is fixed from the chart (Atmakaraka/Karakamsha or 5th/9th); here it is defined psychologically.

hindi: हो सकता है आपके अंतर मन में य क्लेश फसा हो पैसा पैसा पैसा तो आपके अंतर मन में पैसे को आपने इष्ट बना रखा है आपके अंतर मन में राम है कृष्ण है सत्य है झूठ है वो आप इष्ट है
says: Examples of the inner ishta: if your inner mind is stuck on conflict or money-money-money, money is your ishta; if Ram, Krishna, truth or even a lie lives there, that is the deity you actually follow.
cells_derived_method: none: illustrative examples of the inner ishta, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'य क्लेश फसा हो' is garbled and read as 'strife is stuck'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text defines the ishta by what the subconscious holds.

hindi: अगर यहां नीच का ग्रह बैठा है कोई यही मंगल चार नंबर का होता तो आपका भाग्य बहुत ज्यादा नेगेटिव होता
says: If a debilitated planet sat in this 9th house instead, for example this same Mars in the sign numbered 4 (Cancer, Mars's fall sign), the person's fortune would be strongly negative.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated planet in the 9th weakens fortune, but the sign differs per planet (Sun Libra, Moon Scorpio, Mars Cancer, Mercury Pisces, Jupiter Capricorn, Venus Virgo, Saturn Aries), so each gives a different lagna and a different weak spot (father, guru, belief, luck).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in the 9th (lagna Aquarius): weak father or authority support and low self-belief in matters of dharma.
Derived: Moon debilitated in the 9th (lagna Pisces): anxious, emotionally stormy faith, with luck swinging with mood.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 9th (lagna Taurus): doubt about gurus and teachings and rule-bound belief; a classical neecha-bhanga could cancel the fall.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is the 9th house; 'चार नंबर का' is sign number 4 (Cancer), which fits Mars's debilitation, though it could be misheard as the 4th house.
classical_check: Agrees that a debilitated planet in the 9th is weak for fortune; classical neecha-bhanga rules can cancel the fall, which he does not mention.

hindi: हालांकि बड़ी विचित्र बात है यह ज्योतिष में समझने की बात है चार नंबर का मंगल भी आग की तरह ही काम करता है करोड़पति बनाता है
says: Strange but worth noting: even the debilitated Mars of sign number 4 still works like fire and can make the person a crorepati (very rich), so a debilitated Mars is not purely a loss in wealth terms.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars in Cancer sends its fire and money drive into the house it sits in: wealth speech in the 2nd, gains in the 11th, career in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) as 6th and 11th lord: sharp speech and family-money struggle, but the gains lord in the wealth house can bring money through effort.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 11th (lagna Virgo) as 3rd and 8th lord: gains come through effort and sudden jolts, in a fiery circle of associates.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 10th (lagna Libra) as 2nd and 7th lord: a driven, competitive career and wealth through business ties, with frequent conflict at work.

ambiguity: The context is the 9th house, but the sentence names only the sign (4); 'आग की तरह' means energetic, not necessarily harmful.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts rate a debilitated planet weak; a debilitated Mars gives wealth only through neecha-bhanga or dhana yogas, and 'crorepati' is his claim.

hindi: पर किडनी खा जाता है य किडनी उड़ा देगा यह किडनी का एरिया है कमर का एरिया है मंगल किडनी पर डालता है
says: He adds the cost: this debilitated Mars 'eats' the kidney, since the kidney and waist region is the area Mars loads; this is a health claim recorded as his tradition statement, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: He does not say which house or sign gives the kidney effect. The classical body map puts kidneys and lower back under Libra and the 7th house, so the claim would fit best when the debilitated Mars also touches the 7th (derived, not said).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) sits in the classical kidney and lower-back house, the best fit for his claim, along with partnership strain.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 4th (lagna Aries) sits in the chest and home zone, not the kidney house, so his kidney claim fits poorly and is not cell-specific.

ambiguity: 'किडनी खा जाता है' and 'किडनी उड़ा देगा' repeat the same hyperbole; it is not stated which house or sign gives the effect.

hindi: सूर्य नीच का हो तो किडनी में स्टोन दे देता है

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in the 7th (lagna Aries) as 5th lord, in the classical kidney and lower-back house; fits his claim best, with partner and ego friction.

hindi: अगर यहीं पर आपका नीच का ग्रह है और आप उसी दे देता की पूजा कर रहे हैं तो वो नीचता करेगा और आपकी जिंदगी बर्बाद कर

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in the 9th (lagna Aquarius): by his rule, taking Surya as ishta would turn against the native through ego clashes and reversed status.

hindi: इसलिए इष्ट बहुत डिफिकल्ट है समझे बिना करना आप समझेंगे नहीं समझने के लिए आपको ज्योतिषी बनना पड़ेगा

hindi: आप अपने जीवन में सिर्फ यह सोच कर करेंगे कि जी हमने पूजा कर ली हम बड़े महान हो गए व सब छलावा है आपके जीवन में कोई फायदा नहीं होने वाला व्यर्थ की पूजा पाठ से

hindi: अगर आपका मंगल मान लो य उच्च का है तो हनुमान जी है

hindi: पूजा कौन कर रहा है जो खुद को अना समझता है जिसने खुद को अह ब्रह्मास्मि समझ लिया उसे कोई लेनदेन नहीं उसे कोई लेनदेन नहीं है

hindi: आपके मंगल उच्च होने से हनुमान है मंगल हनुमान है

hindi: हनुमान जी की पूजा करने से यह व्यक्ति बहुत उठेगा क्योंकि मंगल की दृष्टि यदि यह लड़की है और हनुमान की पूजा करेगी तो हनुमान की पूजा से बहुत उठेगा

hindi: हनुमान तो क्या करेगा ब्रह्मचारी बना देगा अब लड़कियां हनुमान जी की पूजा कर रही है शादी के बाद भी कर रही है पति से दूरी ब नहीं र
