hindi: अगर यहां बुध छ नंबर का है और आपका छ नंबर में उच्च होता है राहु की राशि में उच्च का है तो इष्ट बिल्कुल बढ़िया है
says: If Mercury is in sign number 6 (Virgo), where it is exalted and which he links to Rahu, then money as ishta is perfectly good for you.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Mercury in Virgo is fixed by sign, but the area where money-as-ishta pays depends on the house: wealth and speech in the 2nd, service and debt-handling in the 6th, partnership trade in the 7th, business and career in the 10th. The lagna is 6 minus house plus 1, wrapped at 12.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, exalted Mercury in the 2nd (lord of 2nd and 11th); money flows through speech, family trade and savings.
Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Mercury in the 6th (lord of 3rd and 6th); money flows through service, analysis, loans and competition.
Derived: lagna Pisces, exalted Mercury in the 7th (lord of 4th and 7th); money flows through partnerships and customer-facing trade.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, exalted Mercury in the 10th (lord of 7th and 10th); money flows through business and profession.

ambiguity: 'छ नंबर' could be sign 6 or house 6; 'exalted in number 6' fits only the sign Virgo, so the sign is used. Virgo is called Rahu's sign here, which is his scheme (Virgo: Mercury or Rahu).
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is exalted in Virgo; Rahu as co-lord of Virgo is not classical Parashari.

hindi: आप कभी मंदिर नहीं जाते पैसा पैसा करते रहते हो आपका जीवन बढ़िया है सोचो कैसा विचित्र है ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस
says: With exalted Mercury and money as ishta, you can skip temples entirely and keep chasing money, and your life is still good; he calls it strange how human consciousness works.
cells_derived_method: none: it follows from the previous row and does not change with house.
ambiguity: He does not repeat the sign here; it is read from the previous sentence (Mercury in sign 6).
classical_check: Silent; the idea that a strong planet needs no remedy is common but not a quoted classical rule.

hindi: और आपका य 12वां बुध है 12 नंबर का नीच का होता है बिल्कुल तबाह पैसा आपका इष्ट है
says: If your Mercury is in sign number 12 (Pisces), where it is debilitated, and money is your ishta, you are completely ruined.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mercury in Pisces is fixed by sign; the house decides where the money ruin lands: self in the 1st, home and base in the 4th, hidden loss and sudden collapse in the 8th, expenditure and outflow in the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, debilitated Mercury in the 1st (lord of 4th and 7th); self-image and partnerships are tied to unstable money.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, debilitated Mercury in the 4th (lord of 7th and 10th); the business and career base at home is shaky.
Derived: lagna Leo, debilitated Mercury in the 8th (lord of 2nd and 11th); savings and gains get stuck or collapse suddenly.
Derived: lagna Aries, debilitated Mercury in the 12th (lord of 3rd and 6th); money drains out through spending and losses.

ambiguity: '12वां बुध' could mean the 12th house or sign 12; since he says 'नीच का', the sign Pisces is used.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is debilitated in Pisces; 'completely ruined' overstates it, as classical texts allow Neecha Bhanga to cancel the debility, which he does not mention.

hindi: आप कभी जीवन में मंदिर मत जाना अगर आप मंदिर गए अपने बुद्ध की नीचता एक्टिवेट कर दी आप कंग हो जाओगे
says: Do's and don'ts claim: with debilitated Mercury and money as ishta, never go to a temple, because going activates Mercury's debility and you will become a pauper.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives it for any house where Mercury is debilitated in Pisces; the temple warning is not house-specific.
ambiguity: 'कंग' is garbled, probably 'कंगाल' (penniless). Recorded as his claim only; this is a tradition do-and-don't and a financial outcome claim, not advice.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts recommend worship and charity for a weak planet; this reverses it.

gist: Says such people are told the opposite of the usual advice and may object that then they must give up dharma; he retorts that dharma has nothing to do with this.
Says going to a temple has no head or tail; God does not call you to the temple but to the inside of your own mind.
Compares people who have not grasped this to children in first or second class being taught ABCD; such a child will simply go to school, and a temple at least gives him one place to go and cry.

hindi: मंदिर जाना बहुत अच्छी बात है ... आपके मिरर रोन जन होते हैं वहां जाकर आप थोड़ी देर औरों को देख कर के उनकी वजह से इफेक्टेड और इफेक्टेड हो जाते हो तो आपका जीवन सुधर जाता है
says: Visiting a temple or gurdwara is a good thing: his mechanism is mirror neurons, so by watching other devotees for a while you get influenced by them and your life improves. He adds that temple-going cannot be called bad, it is very necessary, but it is only a first step.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Caption 'मिरर रोन जन' is a garble of mirror neurons. He does not say which temple or deity suits which chart here.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish lists temple worship and upasana as a general remedy, so it agrees in outline; the mirror-neuron explanation is modern psychology, not from a Jyotish text.

gist: After repeating that temple-going is necessary and good, says you must next learn to go inside your own mind, because human consciousness runs there.

hindi: हमने चित्रगुप्त क्लास की थी कि हमारी आंखें जहां देख रही है उसके अलावा भी आंखें देख रही है इसीलिए घर के वास्तु के अंदर हम कहते हैं हमारा मूड माइंड बहुत परेशान
says: Referring back to his earlier Chitragupta class: our eyes take in more than the spot we are looking at, so the whole surrounding is being read by us; this is why, in home vastu, he says the mood and mind of the occupants get disturbed by how the house is set up.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at the chunk end and continues into a story. It is a vastu-psychology link, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Vastu tradition broadly agrees that the layout of a dwelling affects its residents; the 'eyes see beyond focus' mechanism is his own framing and not a classical text claim.

gist: Story: a husband and wife visiting from outside rang him the day before in great domestic tension; he asked only what had been done in the West direction, and they said the house had been fixed 15 days earlier.
Story: the couple rushed into the bedroom where sheets and pillows were being changed; he asked the colour of the sheets and pillow covers and they said red.

hindi: बोले जी लाल अभी ढको लाल रंग वेस्ट में हाईली नेगेटिव है
says: Rule: the colour red placed in the West direction of a home is highly negative; he applies it to red bedsheets and pillow covers in a west-side bedroom as the cause of the couple's home tension.
cells_derived_method: none (a direction and colour rule, not house or sign dependent). Possible link, derived and not stated by him: in the standard direction-house scheme the West is the 7th house direction, so the claim would touch spouse and home-partnership matters.
ambiguity: He gives no reason why red is bad in the West and names no planet; whether it is the fire or Mars colour clashing with the West, or any strong colour, is not said.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts: no classical source gives colour-per-direction rules for bedding; this is modern vastu practice, where West is Varuna's direction.

gist: Story: the couple hesitated or argued; he told them to just do what he said, as in that time they had already worn out his head.

hindi: उन्होंने चादर सिर्फ लगाई ढका एक घंटे में मैसेज आया जी पता नहीं क्या हो गया शांति है बड़ी सबकॉन्शियस माइंड उसे देख रहा है सिर्फ तकिए के लिहाफ और चादर बेड डालने मात्र से ठीक हो गए
says: Remedy claim backed by a testimonial: the couple only covered or changed the red bedsheet and pillow covers in the west bedroom, and within an hour they wrote that calm had come. His explanation is that the subconscious mind keeps seeing the colour, so merely changing the linen cleared the home tension.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Single uncontrolled anecdote. The word for covered leaves it unclear whether the linen was replaced or only draped over.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a colour-change remedy for a west-side bedroom is a modern vastu practice and the result rests on one story.

gist: Story: next morning the couple sent another long thank-you message crediting his grace and said they felt a sudden change (sentence ends in the next chunk).

hindi: क्योंकि सबकॉन्शियस माइंड आपका पढ़ रहा है इसलिए आपका सबकॉन्शियस माइंड अफेक्टेड और इफेक्टेड हो जाएगा उस चीज से जो जो आप अंदर अजपा जप चलाए हुए बैठे हैं
says: Principle: the subconscious mind is constantly reading what is around you and gets affected by it, and in the same way by whatever ajapa-japa, the silent automatic inner repetition, you keep running inside yourself.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is not clear whether 'that thing' means the surroundings that are seen or the inner repetition, or both.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; this is a psychology and meditation idea he uses to explain why remedies and surroundings work.

gist: Explains why he digresses from Jyotish: human consciousness must be understood, and bookish knowledge alone will not do.

hindi: इसलिए आपको स्वयं पता हो आपका इष्ट कौन है
says: A person should know for himself who his ishta, his personal deity, is rather than worshipping at random; this is the lead-in to his warning that the wrong deity can harm.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He gives no method here for finding the ishta; it is not clear whether he means the Jaimini method or his own planet-sign scheme.
classical_check: Classical methods exist (Jaimini: the planet in the 12th from the Karakamsa; also the 5th house and its lord), but he does not use any in this sentence.

hindi: अब मंदिर नहीं जाना जिसका बुद्ध यहां नीच का है और पैसे की हाय हाई नेगेटिव ऑन हो जाएगी तो सोचो उसको ना जाने से फायदा हो रहा है
says: Garbled, but apparently: for a person whose Mercury is debilitated, going to a temple (the deity is not named) would switch on a negative craving for money, so for him not going is actually the beneficial course; an example of temple-going harming instead of helping.
cells_derived_method: Mercury governs money, trade and intellect. Debilitated in Pisces, the claimed harm would show through Mercury's money themes, so which houses Mercury rules and occupies decides where it lands: the 2nd and 11th houses make it a direct money-craving reading, other houses move it to their own topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in lagna Aquarius, debilitated Mercury (lord of the 5th and 8th) sits in the 2nd house of wealth and speech, so the money-craving theme falls straight on savings and speech.
Derived: in lagna Taurus, debilitated Mercury (lord of the 2nd and 5th) sits in the 11th house of gains, so the money-hunger shows through income, networks and desires.
Derived: in lagna Virgo, Mercury is lagna lord and 10th lord and is debilitated in the 7th, so the claimed harm shows through self-image and career via partnerships rather than money.
Derived: in lagna Pisces, debilitated Mercury (lord of the 4th and 7th) sits in the lagna, so the effect shows in personality, home peace and spouse more than money.

ambiguity: Caption word for Mercury is read as Budh, not the Buddha. 'यहां' points at a diagram, so the sign or house is not in the caption; a debilitated Mercury can only be Pisces. The temple or deity is lost, and the line is garbled.
classical_check: Mercury debilitated in Pisces agrees with the classics. A temple visit harming such a person is not a classical claim; classical remedies for a weak Mercury usually include worship, so he differs from normal remedy practice.

hindi: किसी का मंगल यहां चार नंबर का है और नीच का मंगल कहते हनुमान मंदिर जाएगा उसकी किडनी फेल हो जाएगी
says: Example: Mars in sign number 4 (Cancer, where it is debilitated); if such a person goes to a Hanuman temple, as people advise, he says kidney failure will follow. This is a medical-outcome claim recorded only as his statement; it is not a diagnosis and not to be used as one.
cells_derived_method: The harm is said to come from worshipping the deity of a spoilt Mars, so it travels with the houses Mars rules and occupies from each lagna. Derived by classical house-lordship and sign logic; the kidney link is his claim and is a flagged medical claim.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in lagna Cancer, debilitated Mars (lord of the 5th and 10th) sits in the lagna, so the strain falls on the person's own body and drive, and on children and career.
Derived: in lagna Aries, Mars is lagna lord and 8th lord and is debilitated in the 4th, so the strain falls on home, chest and peace of mind, with an 8th-lord hidden-trouble flavour.
Derived: in lagna Sagittarius, debilitated Mars (lord of the 5th and 12th) sits in the 8th, so the strain is sudden, hidden and tied to losses and the 12th-house side.

Derived: in lagna Libra, debilitated Mars (lord of the 2nd and 7th) sits in the 10th; the 7th lordship is the nearest link to his kidney remark, since Libra and the 7th stand for the kidney area in the body map, but this is a flagged medical claim.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign number 4 = Cancer, which matches Mars being debilitated; it could be house 4, but then the sign would not be fixed as debilitated. 'यहां' points at the diagram.
classical_check: Mars debilitated in Cancer agrees with the classics. Hanuman worship is the usual popular remedy for Mars, so his warning is the opposite of common practice.

hindi: यह सबकॉन्शियस माइंड रीड कर रहा है कि इसने हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस को यहां प्लेस कर दिया है नहीं कर सकते आपका खुद का जीवन बर्बाद तो पूजा पाठ से बर्बाद होंगे
says: Mechanism he offers for the Mars example: the subconscious reads that the devotee has installed Hanuman (Mars) consciousness on the very spot where Mars is spoilt, which cannot be done safely, so a person's life can get ruined by his own puja-path.
cells_derived_method: Same as the previous row: the harm is carried to the topics of the houses the debilitated Mars rules and occupies. No separate examples.
ambiguity: Continues the previous Mars example, so the cell is taken from it. 'नहीं कर सकते' can mean 'you cannot do it' or 'one should not'; 'यहां' points at the diagram.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; the consciousness-placement idea is his own.

gist: Imitates devout people who say they visit many temples and do much satsang yet complain 'O God, my organ has failed' (sentence runs into the next chunk).

hindi: भगवान कहता है ज्ञान करो बेटा ढंग से करो जानकारी लो तब करो पूजा पाठ तब मेरे को पकड़ो तुम्हारे को इतने डिपार्टमेंट खोल के रखे सही जगह एप्लीकेशन क्यों नहीं लगाते
says: Speaking as God: first gain proper knowledge, and only then do puja-path and hold on to me; many departments (deities for different planets and needs) have been opened, so submit your application at the right department instead of at random.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The departments are a metaphor for deities or planets; he does not say here how to pick the right one.
classical_check: Classical remedial astrology also matches deity and mantra to the planet involved, so the idea agrees in outline; his warning against worshipping a spoilt planet's deity is his own.

gist: Says people start with the thought that astrologers and doctors are thieves who will mislead and loot them, and then go to that very thief.
Many clients come after ten years of wandering among doctors; he asks what other option they have, to keep taking beatings or, if his advice suits, to say jai jai, otherwise to abuse him.

Says there is no option but trial until the right doctor is found, that calling all doctors thieves attracts a thief, and that a good doctor, joshi and guide exist but you have not found one in ten years because you only abuse.

Parenting remark (sentence starts at the end of the previous chunk): telling a child to look at the uncle's son who is doing well creates a lifelong comparison, ends their friendship and drops the child's confidence.

hindi: आप अपने जीवन में खुद किस खोपड़ी से कौन सा ग्रह उठा रहा है बिठा रहा है यह ध्यान देना जरूरी है
says: Warns that one must watch, with one's own head, which planet one is picking up and installing in one's own life, through chosen worship, colours and surroundings; it continues his point that wrongly placing a planet's consciousness is the person's own doing.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; the subject of 'lifting and seating a planet' is not clear and may refer to the person or to a hypothetical devotee.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: सबसे इंपॉर्टेंट चार्ट को समझना सूर्य जो है राजा है चंद्रमा माता देवी हो गई
says: Says the most important thing is to understand the chart, and begins a family-style roll call of planets: the Sun is the king, the Moon is the mother, a goddess figure.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees with the classics: the Sun is king, soul and authority, and the Moon is mother and mind.

hindi: मंगल बुध बृहस्पति गुरु बेटी बेटा
says: Continues the roll call with Mars, Mercury and Jupiter, listed together with the roles guru, daughter and son; the caption does not pair them, but the intent is likely Jupiter as guru and Mars and Mercury as the younger generation, the son and the daughter.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Which planet is the son, which the daughter and which the guru is not fixed by the caption; the words may also be a loose list of roles around these three planets.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically Jupiter is the guru and the karaka of sons, Mars is the karaka of brothers and Mercury of younger relatives; a Mars-son and Mercury-daughter pairing is his framing.

hindi: शुक्र प्रेम राग रंग मौज मस्ती
says: Venus stands for love and attachment, colour, revelry, fun and pleasure.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees with the classics: Venus is the karaka of love, pleasure, arts and enjoyment.

hindi: राहु केतु दैत्य हो गए
says: Rahu and Ketu are the daityas, the demons, of the planetary family.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees with the classical lore that the nodes are asura or daitya in origin.

hindi: शनि महाराज रह गए बीच में
says: Saturn, whom he calls Maharaj, is the one left in the middle of his roll call, between the god-like planets and the daitya pair Rahu and Ketu.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'बीच में' could mean the middle of the list order or a neutral, mediating position between devas and daityas; the caption does not settle it.
classical_check: Silent: the classics call Saturn a servant and a natural malefic, not a middle figure; this is his framing.

hindi: सूर्य जो है यह अग्नि है आग का गोला है
says: The Sun is agni, a ball of fire.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees with the classics: the Sun is fiery and hot in nature.

hindi: जो इंद्र वरुण और यम है यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो
says: Indra, Varuna and Yama are the Vedic names he uses for Uranus, Neptune and Pluto in that order.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: The classical texts know only nine planets; the Indra, Varuna and Yama names for the outer planets are a later usage and not Parashari.

hindi: प्लूटो शनि की तरह चलेगा प्लूटो वरुण शुक्र की तरह चलेगा
says: Pluto (Yama) will behave like Saturn, and Varuna (Neptune) will behave like Venus; the second Pluto in the caption looks like a stray repeat.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption reads 'Pluto Varuna Venus'; it is taken as Pluto equals Saturn-type and Varuna equals Venus-type, which fits his later ghee and Venus remark about Varuna.
classical_check: Not in classical texts; it matches his sign-lord scheme in which Aquarius is Saturn or Pluto and Libra is Venus or Neptune.

hindi: वरुण इंद्र इंद्र किसकी तरह चलना चाहिए मंगल की तरह यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो
says: Indra (Uranus) should be read like Mars, which completes the three outer-planet pairings: Pluto with Saturn, Neptune with Venus, Uranus with Mars.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Not in classical texts; it matches his sign-lord scheme in which Scorpio is Mars or Uranus.

hindi: अब यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो को देखता ही नहीं है इसीलिए बड़ा भारी लफड़ा होता है
says: Complaint that nobody in mainstream astrology looks at Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, and that is why big problems in charts stay unexplained.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: The classical method uses nine planets only, so he differs from it on purpose.

hindi: यदि आपका नेप्चून यानी वरुण नीच का हो किस राशि में होता है नाभि पर नाभि पर आग
says: Asks in which sign Neptune (Varuna) is debilitated and answers through the body diagram: it falls at the navel, the place of fire, meaning Neptune's fall is in the fire sign of the body map.
cells_derived_method: Cannot produce cells until the sign is confirmed. Once it is, the burn is meant to land on the topics of whichever house Neptune occupies, as in the later 7th-house rule.
ambiguity: The sign is not named in the caption. The navel fire is plausibly the Sun's fire sign (he later calls the Sun lord of sign 5 and says this is our fire), which would be Leo, but that is my inference and not stated by him.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives a debilitation sign for Neptune.

hindi: वरुण देव कहां है एक तो यहां बैठे हुए हैं जल चक्र पर यह घी के चक्र पर घी होता है शुक्र
says: Varuna sits on the water (jal) chakra of the body, which he also calls the ghee centre because ghee is Venus.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यहां' points at the body diagram, so the exact body location is not in the caption.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; the chakra and planet pairing is from the tantra or yoga side. He treats Venus and Varuna as the same water or ghee nature, which fits his Neptune equals Venus-type rule.

hindi: अब घी को आग में डालो तो नष्ट ही है नष्ट कर देगा ना खत्म करेगा जलेगा खूब और वरुण क्या है समुद्र का देवता पानी तो वो भी नष्ट करेगा
says: Reasoning for the harm: ghee (the Venus and water nature of Varuna) poured into fire is simply destroyed and burns away; Varuna is the sea god, water, and he too will destroy. The sentence stops mid-way and continues with the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The object of 'will destroy' is not stated: water may destroy the fire, or a spoilt Varuna may destroy whatever house it sits in. The next rows suggest the second.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; it is an elemental analogy of fire against water.

hindi: अगर उसका सातवां भाव जो पत्नी का पति का भाव होता है गृहस्थ में
says: The 7th house is the house of the wife or the husband, the spouse in household life.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house always stands for spouse and partnership; the sign that touches it from each lagna gives the spouse's nature. Derived by sign-nature logic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in lagna Aries, the 7th house is Libra, a Venus sign, so spouse and partnership carry Venus nature: attractive, balanced, artistic.
Derived: in lagna Cancer, the 7th house is Capricorn, a Saturn sign, so the spouse tends to be serious, older or duty-bound, and marriage may come late.
Derived: in lagna Virgo, the 7th house is Pisces, a Jupiter sign, so the spouse is caring or spiritual but boundaries can feel vague.
Derived: in lagna Capricorn, the 7th house is Cancer, a Moon sign, so the spouse is emotional and home-centred, with mood-driven partnership.

ambiguity: The opening 'अगर उसका' is a lead-in to the next row; this row only records the house meaning.
classical_check: Agrees with the classics: the 7th is kalatra bhava, the house of spouse and marriage.

hindi: कोई ग्रह समझ नहीं आ रहा जो कि यार फेल क्यों हो रही है शादी और सातवें घर के अंदर आठ नंबर या एक नंबर राशि इफेक्ट हो गई है जो मंगल की होती है और वहां पर नेप्चून बैठा है 100% तलाक होगा
says: When no ordinary planet explains why a marriage keeps failing: if the 7th house is touched by sign number 8 or 1, the two Mars signs Scorpio and Aries, and Neptune sits there, he says divorce is 100 percent certain and the couple will cry tears of blood. He offers Neptune as the hidden cause of a failing marriage.
cells_derived_method: His ghee-in-fire logic is that a Neptune sitting in a Mars sign burns whatever the house stands for. Applied by classical house topics: the same placement in another house would hit that house's topic, with the sign pair Aries or Scorpio kept. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in lagna Pisces, Neptune in Aries in the 2nd house, so the burn would land on family harmony, speech and stored wealth rather than the spouse.
Derived: in lagna Leo, Neptune in Scorpio in the 4th house, so the burn would land on home peace, property and the mother's side.
Derived: in lagna Cancer, Neptune in Aries in the 10th house, so the burn would land on career and status, with work repeatedly collapsing.
Derived: in lagna Sagittarius, Neptune in Scorpio in the 12th house, so the burn would land on expenses, sleep, foreign matters and bed pleasures.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर या एक नंबर राशि' is read as sign numbers 8 and 1 (Scorpio, Aries), which fits 'Mars's signs'; it could be house numbers, but he says sign. Whether Neptune must sit in that sign or only in the 7th house touched by it is unclear; as houses are multi-sign, the 7th may be only partly Aries or Scorpio. The 100 percent is an absolute claim with no measured support.
classical_check: Not in the classics (no Neptune); they judge the 7th through its lord, Venus, Jupiter and Mars, Saturn or Rahu afflictions. He says himself this is written nowhere. A 100 percent certainty is not a classical-style claim.

hindi: यह कहीं है ही नहीं ऐसे ही केतु है राहु है इंद्र है इनकी कोई बात ही नहीं है कहीं
says: States that this Neptune-in-Mars-sign divorce rule is written nowhere, and likewise nothing is said anywhere about Ketu, Rahu or Indra; he presents them as an uncovered area of Jyotish.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ऐसे ही' could mean that the nodes and Indra also lack in-depth rules, or that they also cause hidden damage like Neptune; the next row leans towards the second.
classical_check: The classics do discuss Rahu and Ketu at some length, so 'nothing is said' is an overstatement; Indra, Uranus, is absent from the classics.

gist: Says even understanding the nine planets is a lot, and the practice of big astrologers runs well enough on just the nine.

hindi: वो बहुत इन डेप्थ है जहां पल्ले ही नहीं पड़ रहा कि तलाक और शादी बच्चे खराब मिसकैरेज रोज का रोना पिटना केतु कराए बैठा पता ही नहीं समझ ही नहीं है क्यों हो रहा है
says: Claims that in deep cases where the nine-planet reading cannot explain divorce, failed marriage, trouble with children, miscarriages and daily misery, Ketu is the hidden cause and astrologers do not realise why it happens. Miscarriage is a medical event; this is recorded only as his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: By classical house topics, Ketu's damage shows through the house it occupies: 7th for marriage, 5th for children. The sign changes the flavour. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in the 7th house (Gemini), so detachment and cutting show in spouse and partnership, matching his marriage-failure claim.
Derived: in lagna Libra, Ketu in the 5th house (Aquarius), and the 5th is the house of children, so child troubles fit his claim; the miscarriage part is a flagged medical claim, not for use.

ambiguity: He does not say which house or sign Ketu must be in; the cause could also include Rahu or the outer planets he just named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu in the 7th or 5th is classically seen as hard for marriage or children, but he states it without any condition, so it is stronger than a classical rule.

hindi: सूर्य है पांच नंबर राशि का मालिक
says: Reminds that the Sun is the lord of sign number 5, Leo, in his 1 to 12 numbering where Aries is 1.
cells_derived_method: Sun in its own sign Leo takes its meaning from the house Leo falls in for each lagna. Derived by house-lordship logic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in lagna Sagittarius, the Sun is 9th lord and sits in its own sign in the 9th, so fortune, father and dharma are strong.
Derived: in lagna Taurus, the Sun is 4th lord and sits in its own sign in the 4th, so home, property and mother matters carry Sun authority and pride.
Derived: in lagna Scorpio, the Sun is 10th lord and sits in its own sign in the 10th, so career and public authority are strong.

classical_check: Agrees with the classics: Leo is the Sun's own sign and the 5th sign from Aries.

hindi: डायग्राम याद है जो शरीर पर यह बनता है एक नंबर यहां चला दो तीन चार पांच छह ऐसे गोल गोल घूमते घूमते 12 राशि हो गई
says: Recalls his body diagram, in which the sign numbers are laid on the body: sign 1 starts at one point and 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 follow in a round (spiral) path until all 12 signs are placed.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The positions are visual and lost in the caption; where sign 1 starts and the direction of the spiral are not recoverable.
classical_check: Classical Kalapurusha maps signs from head (Aries) to feet (Pisces); his round layout looks like his own diagram and cannot be checked from the caption.

hindi: यह हमारा आग हो गई यह हमारा सांस का एरिया है शुक्र होता है यहां यहां पर बुध ग्रह होता है
says: On the same body diagram he points to the fire area and to the breath (air) area, and says Venus is at one spot and Mercury at another; because he is pointing at a picture, the exact body locations cannot be recovered.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यहां' refers to spots on a drawing; which body areas hold Venus and Mercury is not recoverable, and the fire and breath areas are only partly clear.
classical_check: Silent: the body-planet map here is not classical; classical Kalapurusha assigns body parts to signs, not planets to spots as he does.

hindi: यह सूर्य चंद्रमा है ना भी मंगल उसके नीचे बृहस्पति शनि फिर इंद्र वरुण यम राहु केतु साइड में ब्रेन के चंद्रमा के ये पांच नंबर ये चार नंबर
says: Reads off the planets on the body diagram from top to bottom: Sun and Moon first, then Mars, below it Jupiter and Saturn, then Indra, Varuna and Yama, with Rahu and Ketu at the sides of the brain beside the Moon's number; ends by pointing at sign numbers 5 and 4 (Leo, Cancer).
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ना भी' may be 'नाभि' (navel), which would put Mars at the navel; the order is a guess from a spoken tour of a picture, and the final 5 and 4 may be the Sun's and Moon's signs or body spots.
classical_check: Silent: a planet-to-body-spot diagram of this kind is not in the classical texts.

hindi: एक और आठ तीन और छ न दो वैसे सात भी है 10 11
says: He reads out sign lordships by sign number: Mars owns signs 1 and 8 (Aries, Scorpio), Mercury owns 3 and 6 (Gemini, Virgo), Venus owns 2 and also 7 (Taurus, Libra), and Saturn owns 10 and 11 (Capricorn, Aquarius). This is the usual dual-lordship table with Aries as 1.
cells_derived_method: Lordship decides which houses a planet rules for each lagna: house = sign number - lagna number + 1, wrapping at 12. The same planet therefore rules a different pair of houses for every lagna, and its results change with the topics of those two houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4). Mars owns Aries as the 10th and Scorpio as the 5th, so one planet carries career and children/intellect together.
Derived: lagna Gemini (2-12+1=-9, so 3). Venus owns Taurus as the 12th and Libra as the 5th, so it mixes loss/foreign topics with children and purpose.
Derived: lagna Leo (10-6+1=5). Saturn owns Capricorn as the 6th and Aquarius as the 7th, so it links the service/disease house to the marriage house.

ambiguity: Planet names before each number pair are missing in the caption, so the planet-to-pair assignment is read from standard lordship, not heard.
classical_check: Agrees with Parashari lordship for Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn.

hindi: इसकी सात हो गई इसकी 12 हो गई राहु की छह नंबर हो गई केतु की 12 हो गई
says: He finishes the lordship round with his node assignments: Rahu gets sign 6 (Virgo) and Ketu gets sign 12 (Pisces). Two earlier fragments ('its 7', 'its 12') name lords for Libra and sign 12 whose planet names the caption lost.
cells_derived_method: In his 12-planet scheme Virgo is shared by Mercury and Rahu, and Pisces by Jupiter and Ketu, so a node in its own sign changes how it behaves per lagna. House of the sign = sign number - lagna + 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (6-6+1=1). Rahu in his own sign in the 6th: by his logic strength in the enemy-and-service house, so struggle turns into competitive success.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Ketu in his own sign in the 12th: moksha, isolation and foreign-residence themes are strongest here.
Derived: lagna Cancer (12-9+1=4). Ketu in his own sign in the 9th: detachment from fixed belief and father-figures, a seeker's route to dharma.

ambiguity: The 'its 7' and 'its 12' fragments have no planet named; likely Neptune for Libra and Jupiter or Ketu for Pisces but not heard.
classical_check: Nodal lordship of Virgo and Pisces is not in the classical texts (Parashara gives the nodes no sign); his scheme is his own.

hindi: यह राशियां राशिया मतलब जोडियक सिंह राशि सिंह पाच 12 राशि होती है जो हमने पीछे जोडियक बनाया था
says: He defines rashis as the zodiac: there are 12 signs, the same zodiac wheel he drew earlier in the series. The words 'Singh rashi, Singh, five' are a stumble that repeats Leo as number 5.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The 'Singh, five' repeat is a stumble or caption echo, not a new claim.
classical_check: Agrees: twelve rashis make the zodiac.

hindi: मेश क्या है मेड़ा है
says: Starting the picture tour of the zodiac, he names sign 1 Aries (Mesha) as the ram. He attaches no trait yet, only the symbol.
cells_derived_method: The ram's head-first charge is the sign's nature; how it shows depends on the topic of the house the sign sits on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4). The ram's forceful push lands on career, so work style is direct and competitive.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (1-3+1=-1, so 11). The ram on the 3rd house gives bold, impulsive effort and speech.

classical_check: Agrees: Mesha is the ram.

hindi: दो नंबर क्या है बैल वृष
says: Sign 2 Taurus (Vrisha) is the bull. Again only the picture is given, no result attached.
cells_derived_method: The bull stands for steady, slow, resource-holding energy; the house it sits on shows where that stubborn accumulation is felt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (2-2+1=1). Bull on the wealth-and-speech house: steady saving and a slow, fixed way of speaking.
Derived: lagna Libra (2-8+1=-5, so 7). Bull on the 8th: stubborn hold on shared money and hidden matters.

classical_check: Agrees: Vrishabha is the bull.

hindi: तीन नंबर मिथुन व मेल फीमेल दो की फोटो लगी हुई है बहुत सोशल लोग होते हैं ऐसे
says: Sign 3 Gemini (Mithuna) is drawn as a male and a female pair, and he says people of this sign are very social. This is the first trait he ties to a sign picture.
cells_derived_method: Sociability is a sign trait; the house decides which area of life becomes talkative and connected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius (3-7+1=-3, so 9). Social, chatty partners and public dealings; many contacts in marriage or business.
Derived: lagna Aries (3-3+1=1). Sociability in communication, siblings and short travel.
Derived: lagna Cancer (3-12+1=-8, so 4). Social ties abroad or in secluded settings.

classical_check: Agrees: Mithuna is the couple and the sign is communicative.

hindi: चार नंबर कर्क केकड़ा बना हुआ है
says: Sign 4 Cancer (Karka) is shown as a crab. No trait is added for it in this sentence.
cells_derived_method: The crab (hard shell, soft inside, clings) suggests protective, emotional behaviour; house topic decides where this shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Crab in the home house: strong attachment to mother, house and comfort.
Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). Crab on the career house: public work with a caring, protective flavour.

classical_check: Agrees: Karka is the crab.

hindi: पांच नंबर में सिंह यह पांच नंबर आप देखेंगे सिंह है
says: Sign 5 is Leo (Simha), the lion; he asks the audience to note that number 5 is the lion.
cells_derived_method: Lion = commanding, proud, central; the house topic shows where authority is sought.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (5-1+1=5). Lion on the self house: commanding presence, wants to lead.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (5-9+1=-3, so 9). Lion on the 9th: authority in dharma, teachers and father matters.

classical_check: Agrees: Simha is the lion.

hindi: कन्या छ नंबर है
says: Sign 6 is Kanya (Virgo). He simply states the number; the caption has no picture or trait for it.
cells_derived_method: Virgo reads as the careful, analytical, service sign (Mercury's earth sign); the house topic shows where this fussy attention applies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (6-6+1=1). Analytical service and routine work in the 6th.
Derived: lagna Libra (6-12+1=-5, so 7). Detail-minded handling of expenses and foreign matters.

ambiguity: No symbol or trait is heard for Virgo here.
classical_check: Agrees on number 6; the maiden symbol is classical but not stated.

hindi: तुला तराजू बना है
says: Sign 7 Libra (Tula) is pictured as the scales or balance; he does not say the number 7 aloud here.
cells_derived_method: Scales = weighing, balance and partnership; the house topic shows which dealings need balance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1). Scales on the spouse house: seeks balance and fairness in marriage and contracts.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (7-10+1=-2, so 10). Scales on career: diplomatic, negotiating style of work.

ambiguity: Number 7 is implied by the order, not spoken.
classical_check: Agrees: Tula is the balance.

hindi: वृश्चिक केकड़ा बहुत सीक्रेट लोग होते हैं ऐसे लोग जिनका आठ नंबर का होता है बहुत सेक्रेटिव अंदर की बात निकालना असंभव
says: Sign 8 Vrischika is described as very secretive: people of number 8 hold their inner matters so tight that drawing anything out of them is impossible. The caption calls the symbol a crab, but the sign is the scorpion.
cells_derived_method: Secrecy is the sign's trait; the house shows what the person hides, and the house-8 topics already carry secrecy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Secretive sign on the 8th: hidden finances and private life are guarded extremely well.
Derived: lagna Leo (8-4+1=5). Secrecy at home: family matters kept inside the house.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (8-12+1=-3, so 9). Hidden expenses, private bed-life or secret foreign dealings.

ambiguity: Caption says crab (keekda) for Scorpio; likely a misspeak or a caption error for scorpion.
classical_check: Secretive nature agrees with tradition; the crab is Cancer's symbol, so the caption is wrong or he misspoke.

hindi: धनु नौ नंबर यह तीर मारता फिर रहा है घोड़ा दौड़े जा रहा है कुछ पता ही नहीं क्या करना है
says: Sign 9 Dhanu (Sagittarius) is shown as an archer shooting arrows and a horse running on without knowing what it is meant to do. He reads the sign as restless motion with no clear target.
cells_derived_method: Restless, running energy without a fixed goal; the house decides which area lacks direction or is always in motion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1). Restless seeker on the dharma house: roams between beliefs and teachers.
Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5). Mind and education run in many directions; children are lively.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (9-2+1=8). Speech and money flow quickly, without a clear plan.

classical_check: Archer and horse (centaur) are classical; the 'no clue what to do' reading is his own colour.

hindi: यह भेड़ है टॉप पर चढ़ना है इसने
says: The next sign, which by order must be number 10 Capricorn, is described as a sheep or goat that wants to climb to the top. He reads the sign as pure upward ambition.
cells_derived_method: Climbing-goat ambition; the house topic shows which field the person wants to top.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Climber in the career house: relentless pursuit of position.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (10-1+1=10). Climber on the self house: a driven, status-seeking personality.
Derived: lagna Leo (10-6+1=5). Ambition in service and competition: wants to top rivals.

ambiguity: Number and sign name are not in the caption; Capricorn is inferred from the order between Sagittarius 9 and Aquarius 11. He says sheep (bhed) where the classical symbol is the goat-fish or goat.
classical_check: Climbing ambition matches Capricorn tradition; the symbol is makara or goat, not sheep.

hindi: कुंभ मददगार
says: Sign 11 Kumbha (Aquarius) is called helpful, a helper type. A one-word trait, no more explanation.
cells_derived_method: Helper nature of the sign; the house shows whom or what it helps.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (11-11+1=1). Helpful sign on the gains house: income through service to groups and friends.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (11-3+1=9). Helps siblings and neighbours through effort and communication.

classical_check: Aquarius as humanitarian or group-helping sign agrees with tradition.

hindi: मीन सोशल पांच चार यह राशियां इनकी बैठी हुई है
says: Sign 12 Meena (Pisces) is called social. The trailing words 'five four' before 'these signs are seated' are unclear and may be a wrap-up of the numbers just covered.
cells_derived_method: A social, fluid-boundaried sign; the house decides where this mixing with people happens.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Social sign on the 12th: mixes with people in distant or secluded places, ashrams, hospitals.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (12-4+1=9). Home life is open and full of visitors.

ambiguity: 'Five four' after Pisces is unreadable; also Gemini was called social, so 'social' is his word for both.
classical_check: Pisces as empathic and mixing with others is consistent with tradition.

gist: Starts the planet list with 'this Sun... everyone already knows' but the caption words around the Sun are garbled.

hindi: चंद्रमा पानी है ये हो गया पानी धरती का सारा पानी चंद्र मामा से होता है
says: The Moon is the water planet: he says all the water on earth comes from and is governed by Chandra mama, the Moon. He starts mapping each planet to an element.
cells_derived_method: Moon as water meets signs of different elements; in his logic water in a fire sign clashes while water in a water or earth sign is comfortable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Moon in its own water sign on the 4th: emotional comfort and strong home.
Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7). Water Moon in a fire sign on the 7th: warmth and friction in partnership.

classical_check: Moon as water and liquids is classical; element mapping agrees.

hindi: यह होता है अग्नि आग
says: He names a planet as fire (agni, aag) next in his list; the caption dropped the planet name, but by the list order and his later logic it is Mars, whose signs 1 and 8 he treats as fire.
cells_derived_method: Fire planet in water signs or with water Moon shows clash; in air or fire signs it is fed. Effect depends on sign element.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Fire planet in a water sign on the 4th: home tension, anger inside the house, the debilitation of Mars.
Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Fire in its own fire sign on the self house: energetic, bold, fully fed.

ambiguity: Planet name missing; Sun is also called heat later, so this could be the Sun.
classical_check: Mars as fire is classical; Sun is also fiery.

hindi: बुध है हवा
says: Mercury is the air element in his planet-element list.
cells_derived_method: Air interacts with the element of the sign it sits in: fans fire, disperses or beats water. Detailed rules follow in the next sentences.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (3-3+1=1). Mercury as air in its own air sign on the 3rd: communication and initiative thrive.
Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). Air Mercury in a water sign on the 10th: his rule would damage career matters.

classical_check: Mercury is the air-linked planet in some systems and earth in others (classical lists Mercury as earth-element); this is his scheme.

hindi: बृहस्पति हो गया ज्ञान गुरु
says: Jupiter stands for knowledge and the guru, placed in his planet-element list without naming a physical element.
cells_derived_method: Guru-knowledge significance is read through the house and sign: strong signs give clear teaching or study, weak signs cloud it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5). Jupiter in its own sign on the 5th: strong knowledge, teacher quality and children.
Derived: lagna Libra (10-4+1=7). Jupiter debilitated on the 4th (the education house): learning and school guidance are blocked.

classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of knowledge and gurus is classical.

hindi: शुक्र हो गया सारा सुगंध इत्यादि सौंदर्य सुंदर
says: Venus rules fragrance and everything of beauty and loveliness.
cells_derived_method: Beauty and fragrance matters show through the house Venus occupies and its sign strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius (12-2+1=11). Venus exalted on the 2nd house of face and speech: pleasing looks and voice.
Derived: lagna Aries (6-6+1=1). Venus debilitated on the 6th: beauty and sensual pleasure strained by work and health friction.

classical_check: Venus as karaka of beauty, scent and luxury is classical.

hindi: शनि हो गया काला पत्थर जैसा सख्त यही प्लूटो यही वरुण यही इंद्र
says: Saturn is the hard, black, stone-like planet, and he says the same stone-hard nature belongs to Pluto (Yama), Neptune (Varuna) and Uranus (Indra). Saturn and the outer planets are in one hard family.
cells_derived_method: Hardness and heaviness show in whichever house Saturn sits; in Saturn's own signs it holds firm, in Aries it is debilitated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Saturn in its own sign on the 10th: stone-solid career, slow rise, durable position.
Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Saturn debilitated on the self house: the hard quality becomes rigidity and fear instead of strength.

ambiguity: 'Yahi' (this same) could mean the outer planets are Saturn-like in hardness, or that they replace Saturn; read as the first.
classical_check: Saturn as hard, black and stony is classical; the outer planets are absent from the classical texts.

hindi: राहु और केतु राहु बिल्कुल शनि के साथ शनि का एजेंट है ये शनि का एजेंट हनुमान जी किसके एजेंट है राम जी के यह शनि का एजेंट
says: Rahu works entirely on Saturn's side as Saturn's agent, the way Hanuman is the agent and servant of Rama. He is setting up the master-and-agent picture for the nodes.
cells_derived_method: Rahu is read as Saturn's executor, so Rahu in or around Saturn's signs and houses acts like Saturn; in other signs it acts as Saturn would if it stood there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Rahu in its master's sign on the 10th: works like Saturn, slow, organised, hard career effort.
Derived: lagna Leo (11-7+1=5). Rahu in Saturn's Aquarius on the 7th: Saturn-like heavy, delayed partnership results.

ambiguity: The caption order is jumbled around 'Rahu with Saturn'; the clean reading is Rahu is Saturn's agent.
classical_check: Agrees: classical practice treats Rahu as acting like Saturn.

hindi: जब जब सूर्यकांत शनिचर को बोलता है हां भाई काम करो यह वाला लेकर आओ तो फटाफट राहु को बोलता है अरे बहुजी ने य मंगाया लेकर आ सारा काम इसके पास है
says: He dramatises a chain of command: the Sun orders Saturn to do a job, Saturn passes it at once to Rahu to fetch what is needed, and so all the actual running about is with Rahu. The caption renders 'Surya' as 'Suryakant'.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Names are noisy ('Suryakant', 'bahuji'); the structure Sun to Saturn to Rahu is clear.
classical_check: The Sun-as-king, Saturn-as-servant picture is classical; the three-step chain through Rahu is his own illustration.

hindi: और राहु जोथी बनाता है जिसने अपने जीवन में यंग एज में राहु जी लिया उस व्यक्ति ने चाय बेची और मौज कर ली
says: A person who has lived Rahu (a hard Rahu-type period) in young age sold tea and later enjoyed life; he reads early Rahu hardship as the start of a later rise. The opening words 'Rahu jothi banata hai' are garbled.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Unclear whether 'lived Rahu' means Rahu dasha, or simply a hard early life with Rahu qualities.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not tie Rahu hardship in youth to a rise.

gist: Aside that he does not know whether the Prime Minister actually lived that Rahu period; says that is not what is being discussed.

hindi: या शुरू के जीवन के अंदर जितना आपने कष्ट भोगा उतनी आपकी खोपड़ी शार्प होती है और आप सिर्फ खोपड़ी से काम करके रॉकेट की तरह उठते हो लाइफ में
says: The more hardship a person suffers in early life, the sharper the head becomes, and working with the head alone they rise in life like a rocket. He treats Rahu as the head-sharpening planet.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's head-sharpening effect is read through the house and sign it occupies: in houses of effort and competition it turns struggle into rise; elsewhere the hardship is felt in that house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (6-6+1=1). Rahu in his own sign on the 6th: early struggle against rivals and debts sharpens the mind and brings a later rise.
Derived: lagna Aries (11-11+1=1). Rahu in Saturn's sign on the gains house: income through clever, head-led work after early struggle.

ambiguity: He does not say which house or sign of Rahu produces this.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts say Rahu in 3, 6, 10 or 11 can give a rise, but not this 'sharp head from early suffering' idea.

hindi: केतु मंगल का एजेंट है मंगल एजेंट केतु
says: Ketu is Mars's agent, just as Rahu is Saturn's. He pairs the nodes with the two hard planets.
cells_derived_method: Ketu is read as Mars acting through the back door, so Ketu in Mars's signs or houses behaves like Mars.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Ketu in its master's Scorpio on the 8th: sharp, Mars-like cutting and sudden change, plus occult interest.
Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Ketu in Aries on the self house: Mars-like bluntness and restlessness with detachment.

classical_check: Agrees: classical tradition says Ketu acts like Mars.

hindi: केतु पूंछ है धूम केतु कुत्ते की पूंछ केतु गाय की पूंछ केतु
says: Ketu is the tail: the comet (dhoom-ketu) with its tail, a dog's tail, a cow's tail. Anything tailed belongs to Ketu.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Ketu as comet and tail is classical; the dog and cow tail items are his folk extension.

hindi: शुक्र और केतु साथ हो गए गाय हो गई पूंछ वाली कुत्ता
says: Venus together with Ketu makes the cow, the tailed animal; the dog is the other tailed Ketu animal. He builds animals by joining planets.
cells_derived_method: A Venus-Ketu conjunction is read as the cow principle: gentle, milk-giving, detached comfort, whose flavour depends on the house and sign where they meet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (2-7+1=-4, so 8). Venus with Ketu in Taurus on the 7th: gentle, cow-like partner but detachment inside marriage.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Venus exalted with Ketu on the 12th: refined, spiritual comforts and foreign or secluded pleasures.

ambiguity: Caption order is loose; he may mean Venus's cow quality plus Ketu's tail, not a strict conjunction rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not equate Venus-Ketu with the cow.

hindi: इसीलिए केतु के काम करने तो केतु की पूजा करनी है केतु का सुख लेना है स्किन सारी केतु है हमारी चमड़ी चमड़ी का कोई रोग है पूंछ वाले की सेवा करो
says: To get Ketu's work done and receive Ketu's comfort, worship and serve Ketu; the whole skin is Ketu, so for any skin ailment serve a tailed creature. Recorded only as his tradition remedy, not as a medical diagnosis or treatment.
cells_derived_method: Skin trouble is tied to Ketu's condition: weak or afflicted Ketu in a sign or house is the cell he would look at for skin matters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (2-1+1=2). Ketu on the self house in Venus's sign: body and skin-related Ketu issues would be read here; remedy is serving a dog or cow.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (3-6+1=-2, so 10). Ketu on the 6th in Gemini: health-and-service house with Ketu, so skin complaints are read from here.

ambiguity: Which Ketu placement counts as a skin problem is not given.
classical_check: Ketu with skin disease is found in some later texts; this exact 'serve the tailed one' remedy is folk tradition.

hindi: पूछ किसकी है स्त्री के जो सिर के बाल है वो भी राहु और केतु की
says: He asks whose tail it is and answers that a woman's head hair is also counted as belonging to Rahu and Ketu. Hair is treated as the nodes' tail.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk ('...like Rahu and Ketu are considered').
classical_check: Hair as a Rahu-Ketu matter is not classical; it is his own folk logic.

hindi: जितने लोग बाल बांध के रखते हैं साधु लोग सबने बांध रखे हैं यह सब केतु सेट किया हुआ है इन्होंने केतु मोक्ष का द्वार है
says: All who keep their hair tied up, such as sadhus, have in effect set their Ketu right. Ketu is the door to moksha, which is why ascetics bind the hair.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Ketu as moksha karaka is classical; the hair-tying link is his own.

hindi: इसलिए जितने लोगों ने बाल बांध रखे हैं जूड़ा बांधती है लेडीज वो भी वही बंध गया ऑटोमेटिक है ये आपके इतनी क्रिया मात्र से आपके पूरी बॉडी पूरा ग्रह पूरा जीवन का सिस्टम संचालित हो गया
says: When women tie their hair in a bun, Ketu is bound automatically, and by that single act the whole body, the planetary system and the life system get regulated. He claims a very large effect from a tiny act.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Overstated; he gives no condition on which Ketu placement needs this.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text gives hair-binding as a remedy.

hindi: लोग टीके लगवा हैं नाभी पर लगा लो यह लगा लो यह सब सूचक हैय काम करता है किसी के ग्रह की प्लेसमेंट करनी है मुस टैटू बनवा देते हैं बाजू पर लगा ले
says: Tilak dots, a mark on the navel and tattoos on the arm are all pointers that place a planet on the body; because skin is Ketu, these marks work as planet-placement remedies. He says they do work.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Which planet goes at which body spot is not said here.
classical_check: Silent; tattoos as remedies are not classical, tilak is traditional practice.

hindi: अगर आपको ये ठीक करना है तो पूंछ वाले की सेवा करो तो आपकी पत्नी जो है उसको बोलो बाल लंबे रख
says: Remedy for a Ketu problem: serve a tailed creature, and ask your wife to keep her hair long. Hair length is treated as Ketu support.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Whether the long-hair advice is for any Ketu problem or only skin is not clear.
classical_check: Silent; folk remedy.

hindi: बहन गाय कुत्ता जो पूर्ण रूप है केत का वो मछली है क्योंकि मछली है ही पूंछ मछली का मुह मैंने कहने को है बाकी तो पूछ है
says: Cow and dog are Ketu animals, but the complete (purna) form of Ketu is the fish, because a fish is nearly all tail with only a token mouth. The word 'behen' at the start is a garble.
cells_derived_method: Fish links Ketu to Pisces, which he already gave to Ketu; Ketu in Pisces is therefore the full form and the strongest placement by his logic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Ketu as fish in Pisces on the 12th: moksha and seclusion at their fullest.
Derived: lagna Libra (12-6+1=7). Ketu in its fish form on the 6th: strong against enemies and debts, detached from disputes.

ambiguity: He does not say Pisces aloud here; the link is from the fish and from his earlier giving sign 12 to Ketu.
classical_check: Ketu with fish and Pisces is a modern association; classical texts do not state it.

hindi: पूरी पूरी बॉडी पूछ है ना हाथ है ना पाव कुछ है नहीं फिंस गिने नहीं जाते तो मछली केतु है
says: His reason for the fish: its whole body is tail, with no hands or feet (fins are not counted as limbs), so the fish is Ketu. Limblessness is the Ketu mark.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Ketu as the headless, limb-poor body is in the Rahu-Ketu myth; the fish argument is his own.

hindi: इसलिए केतु अच्छा है तो कुत्ता पा लो नहीं तो मरोगे
says: Keep a dog if Ketu is good (or to make Ketu good), he tells the listener, adding a blunt 'otherwise you will die'. The last words are hyperbole in his lecture tone and are not recorded as a prediction.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Could mean 'if Ketu is good for you' or 'to make Ketu good'.
classical_check: Silent; keeping a dog for Ketu is a folk-remedy.

hindi: केतु पता लगा नीच कोई नेगेटिव दृष्टि है घर में कुत्ता पाल लिया क्लेश
says: The warning side: if Ketu is found debilitated or under a negative aspect and you still keep a dog at home, you get household strife (klesh). A dog helps only when Ketu is sound.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's weakness is read by sign dignity and by malefic aspects; texts that make Taurus the weak sign for Ketu and Scorpio a strong one give the contrast cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius (2-4+1=-1, so 11). Ketu in Taurus on the 4th (home): by his rule a dog at home brings domestic strife.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (8-12+1=-3, so 9). Ketu in Scorpio, which many texts treat as strong, so the dog-strife warning would not apply.

ambiguity: He does not define 'neech' for Ketu; the dignity table used here is the common classical one.
classical_check: Ketu's exaltation and debilitation signs are disputed in classical texts; this folk dog rule is not classical.

hindi: अच्छा केतु अच्छा है हम तो घर में काला कुत्ता काले आए जी हमारी तो रॉकेट बन गई लाइफ आपको केतु की
says: With a good Ketu, he says he brought a black dog home and his life became a rocket. He speaks of this as personal testimony.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Personal anecdote; no chart is given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको केतु की सेवा करने का मौका मिल रहा है रोज कृपा है
says: Looking after the dog daily is itself a chance to serve Ketu and counts as divine grace each day. He frames pet care as ongoing Ketu worship.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous chunk and finishes in the next.
classical_check: Silent; devotional framing.

hindi: इसी तरह से राहु का बिल्ली होती है राहु लोग बिल्ली पाल देते हैं कछुआ पालते हैं पता नहीं क्या क्या
says: Similarly the cat belongs to Rahu, and people with Rahu issues keep cats, tortoises and who knows what else. Rahu gets its own set of pet remedies.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; Rahu is classically linked with snakes and unusual creatures, not cats.

hindi: लेकिन व बड़े ध्यान से जैसे हमने इष्ट पाल लिया ऐसे नहीं कि टेढ़ इष्ट पाल लिया बैठ के वो खा जाएगा हमें
says: Such pets must be chosen with great care, like choosing an Ishta deity: a wrongly chosen one will sit there and devour us. The warning is that a badly matched pet works against you.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Tedha ishta' is read as a wrongly chosen or crooked ishta; caption is rough.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपका कुत्ता सूट नहीं करता और आप घर ले आए तो प्रॉब्लम केतु कितना बड़ा देवता है स्वर्ग का द्वा है यह गांठ बांध लो
says: A dog that does not suit your chart becomes a problem if brought home; he reminds that Ketu is a great deity and the gate of heaven, and tells the listener to tie that in memory.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: How to judge whether a dog suits the chart is not given.
classical_check: Ketu as moksha dwar agrees with tradition; dog-suitability is folk.

hindi: घर में अगर कुत्ता है और आपका ग्रह ओके है घर में चार लोगों के तो घर में जो पहली प्रॉब्लम आनी है शरीर की वो कुत्ते के शरीर पर होगी वो अपने शरीर पर ले लेगा
says: If the house has a dog and the family's planets are fine, the first bodily problem due in the house falls on the dog's body, because the dog takes it on himself. This is his claim about a dog acting as a shield; recorded as a claim, not as a health diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Which houses of the family chart carry the bodily problem is not said.
classical_check: Silent; folk belief.

hindi: 100% आपके कुत्ते पर बीमारी आएगी वोह आप पर आनी है वह आपको बचा लेता है
says: He says with full certainty that the illness comes to the dog because it was meant for you, and the dog saves you by absorbing it. Stated as a 100% claim; flagged as an unverified health-related claim.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Absolute wording; no condition on whose planets or which house.
classical_check: Silent; folk belief, no classical basis.

hindi: ये केतु बड़ा कमाल का ग्रह है सारे ग्रह कमाल के ऐसी बात नहीं
says: Ketu is a remarkable planet, and he adds a line about all planets being remarkable; the words could mean every planet is wonderful, or that not every planet is as wonderful as Ketu.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Saare grah kamaal ke aisi baat nahi' reads two ways: all planets are great, or not all are great.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह पांच नंबर है सूरज चंदा इनके बीच मित्रता है तो अगर कोई सूरज इसकी राशि में है तो मित्री है गुड करेगा खराब कर ही नहीं सकता नेगेटिव इफेक्ट आएगा नहीं
says: Sun and Moon are friends, so a planet standing in a friend's sign does good and simply cannot do harm; no negative effect comes. The example is the Sun in the Moon's sign, with number 5 (Leo) as the Sun's own sign.
cells_derived_method: Friend-sign test: planet in a friend's sign gives good results. The house decides which topic benefits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (4-9+1=-4, so 8). Sun in the Moon's Cancer on the 9th: father, dharma and luck are helped without harm.
Derived: lagna Gemini (5-3+1=3). Moon in the Sun's Leo on the 3rd: effort, courage and siblings are helped.

ambiguity: 'Iski rashi' leaves open who is the owner; read as the Sun in the Moon's sign.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Moon are mutual friends and a planet in a friend's sign is comfortable.

hindi: चंद्र सूरज अगर एक दूसरे की राशि में है चार या पांच प्रॉब्लम नहीं है
says: If Moon and Sun are in each other's signs (signs 4 and 5), there is no problem at all. The mutual placement is safe for both.
cells_derived_method: Mutual-sign exchange between friends is read as safe; the house shows which topic is smooth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces (4-5+1=0, so 12). Sun in Cancer on the 5th: children and education unharmed.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (5-10+1=-4, so 8). Moon in Leo on the 10th: public standing and career are supported.

ambiguity: Whether the pair must sit together in an exchange or each only needs to be in the other's sign is not said.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Moon in each other's signs is a mild parivartana-type friendly state.

hindi: मंगल एक और आठ बेटा है ये ये भी इसका मित्र है ये कभी भी तंग नहीं करेगा इसको किसी हालत में खराबी नहीं आ सकती
says: Mars, owner of signs 1 and 8, is also a friend of the Sun, so the Sun in a Mars sign is never troubled and nothing can spoil it. He calls Mars a 'beta' (son figure).
cells_derived_method: Sun in Aries or Scorpio is in a friend's sign, so results are protected; the house shows what is protected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4). Sun exalted in Aries on the 10th: strong career and authority.
Derived: lagna Leo (8-4+1=5). Sun in Mars's Scorpio on the 4th: home and mother matters stay untroubled by his rule.

ambiguity: 'Iska mitra' could refer to the Sun or the Moon; the next line turns to water and fire, so the 'never troubled' remark is read for the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Mars are classical friends.

hindi: लेकिन यह पानी है या आग है पानी जब आग में जाएगा नष्ट है आग जब पानी में जाएगी तो नष्ट है
says: Element clash rule: a water planet entering a fire sign is destroyed, and a fire planet entering a water sign is destroyed. Element overrides friendship.
cells_derived_method: Moon is water and Mars-type planets are fire; the clash is read by planet element against sign element, and the house shows which topic is destroyed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (1-4+1=-2, so 10). Water Moon in a fire sign on the 4th: home and mother matters suffer by this rule.
Derived: lagna Virgo (4-11+1=-6, so 6). Fire Mars in the Moon's water sign on the 11th: gains and friendships are spoiled.

ambiguity: He exempts the Sun-Moon Leo and Cancer pair by friendship, yet Mars (a classical friend of the Moon) is treated as hostile on element grounds, so the two principles pull against each other.
classical_check: Differs from Parashara where Moon and Mars are friends; the element-based reading is his own.

hindi: यानी चंद्रमा ग्रह अगर एक और आठ नंबर में बैठा है तो नेगेटिव इफेक्ट देगा
says: The Moon sitting in signs 1 or 8 (Aries or Scorpio) gives a negative effect, a direct application of the water-in-fire rule to Mars's signs.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Mars's signs gives negative results; the house gives the topic that suffers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (1-4+1=-2, so 10). Moon in Aries on the 4th: peace of mind, mother and home are disturbed.
Derived: lagna Cancer (8-5+1=4). Moon debilitated in Scorpio on the 5th: intelligence, children and emotions are hit.

classical_check: Moon in Scorpio is classically debilitated, which agrees; Moon in Aries is not classically bad, so partly differs.

hindi: मंगल अगर एक और आठ में बैठा है तो नेगेटिव इफेक्ट देगा
says: As captioned, Mars in signs 1 and 8 gives negative effect. This is almost certainly a repeat slip of the Moon line, since those are Mars's own signs.
cells_derived_method: If taken literally Mars in Aries or Scorpio would be harmful; the house gives the topic. Not accepted without the correction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Mars in its own sign on the self house, classically a Ruchaka yoga; the literal reading contradicts that.
Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Mars in its own sign on the 8th, a dusthana; mixed even in classical texts, so negative here would be less surprising.

ambiguity: Very likely a slip or caption repeat of the previous Moon sentence; the Moon is the planet that goes negative in Mars's signs.
classical_check: Contradicts the classical view that Mars in its own signs is strong.

hindi: मंगल अगर चार में बैठा है तो नेगेटिव इफेक्ट देगा
says: Mars sitting in sign 4 (Cancer) gives a negative effect, the fire-in-water half of the clash rule.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer is harmful; the house shows which topic gets the anger or heat.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). Mars debilitated on the 10th: career friction and short temper at work.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (4-7+1=-2, so 10). Mars debilitated on the 7th: tension and heat in marriage and partnership.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: बुध तीन और बुध है हवा हवा अग्नि को क्या करती है और उठा देती है बहुत बढ़िया कमाल कर देती है
says: Mercury (signs 3 and, by his earlier list, 6) is air, and air raises fire higher, which works wonderfully. This sets up Mercury doing well in fire signs.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in fire-element signs is lifted; the house shows which topic is lifted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra (5-11+1=-5, so 7). Mercury (air) in fire Leo on the 11th: gains and networks flare up.
Derived: lagna Cancer (9-6+1=4). Mercury in fire Sagittarius on the 6th: sharp skill in debate and competition, by his air-fans-fire logic.

ambiguity: 'Budh teen aur' is cut off; the second sign (6) is from his lordship list.
classical_check: Silent on air-fans-fire; element logic is his own.

hindi: अगर बुद्ध एक और आठ नंबर राशि में होगा वेरी गुड
says: Mercury in signs 1 or 8 (Aries or Scorpio) is very good, because air feeds the Mars fire.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Mars's signs is boosted; the house shows which topic is boosted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius (1-3+1=-1, so 11). Mercury in Aries on the 3rd: bold, quick communication and strong effort.
Derived: lagna Gemini (8-6+1=3). Mercury (own lagna lord) in Scorpio on the 6th: sharp tongue wins debates and disputes.
