Derived: lagna Aquarius (3-5+1=-1, so 11). Rahu in Gemini, which he treats as its exaltation, on the 5th: unusual cleverness in study and ideas.

ambiguity: Which planet is exalted in which sign is not said outright; read as Mercury in 6 and Rahu in 3 from the earlier line.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is exalted in Virgo; Rahu's exaltation is Taurus in most texts and Gemini in some, so partly agrees.

hindi: और क्योंकि यह जुड़े हुए हैं राहु कौन है ज्ञान आपकी सिर्फ खोपड़ी से काम होगा
says: Because Mercury and Rahu are joined, and Rahu stands for knowledge, the person's work will come from the head alone. The conclusion from the Rahu-Mercury link is head-work, not body-work.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as knowledge is partly classical (cleverness and technology), the head-work conclusion is his own.

hindi: यदि बुध छ नंबर राशि में है बैठा हुआ या तीन नंबर राशि में है काम मत करो अगर शरीर से काम करोगे बुद्ध पावर नहीं पकड़ेगा
says: If Mercury sits in sign 6 or sign 3 (Virgo or Gemini), do not do body work; if you work with the body Mercury will not gather power. Such a person should earn through the head, not physical labour.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Virgo or Gemini points to head, speech and desk work; the house shows the field where this applies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (3-6+1=-2, so 10). Mercury in its own sign on the 6th: better in analytical, service or consulting work than manual labour.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (6-11+1=-4, so 8). Mercury exalted on the 11th: gains come through skill, analysis and networks, not labour.

ambiguity: 'Kaam mat karo' is read as 'do not do physical work', since the contrast is with working through the head.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Mercury as the intellect planet, but the prohibition on body work is his own.

hindi: यहीं से करो देखो सुनो सोचो समझो बात करो वाणी आप गोल्ड बोलोगे आप जो बोल दोगे वाक सिद्धि हो जाएगी आपने बोल क्या काम हो गया
says: Work from the head: see, listen, think, understand and talk, and your speech will be gold; whatever you say will come true as vak siddhi, and the job gets done the moment you speak. This is the reward of using Mercury well.
cells_derived_method: Speech-power shows most where Mercury is strong and on speech-related houses (2nd, 3rd).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (3-2+1=2). Mercury in its own sign on the speech house: spoken words carry weight and tend to materialise.
Derived: lagna Cancer (6-3+1=4). Mercury exalted on the 3rd: sharp, effective communication and persuasive effort.

ambiguity: No condition is given on which Mercury placement earns vak siddhi.
classical_check: Vak siddhi is a classical idea tied to a strong 2nd house and Mercury or Jupiter; the flat promise is his own.

hindi: अगर यही बुद्ध आपका खराब है चार का है 12 का है खराब
says: If this same Mercury is bad for you, meaning it sits in sign 4 or sign 12 (Cancer or Pisces), speech brings trouble. He names the two bad Mercury signs together.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Cancer or Pisces is the sign-fault case; the house shows where the fault lands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini (4-2+1=3). Mercury in Cancer on the 2nd: speech and family matters carry the fault.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Mercury debilitated on the 12th: confused or costly communication and foreign dealings.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge; the result is given in the following lines.
classical_check: Pisces agrees as Mercury's debilitation; Cancer is not a debilitation, so partly differs.

hindi: शनि भी इसका मित्र है शनि इसका पूर्ण मित्र है शुक्र इसका पूर्ण मित्र है बिल्कुल साथ में है
says: Saturn is also Mercury's friend, a full friend, and Venus is a full friend as well; the three stand completely together. He sets Mercury's friend list as Saturn and Venus.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Saturn's or Venus's signs (Capricorn, Aquarius, Taurus, Libra) is in a friend's home and so protected; the house gives the topic protected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini (7-5+1=3). Mercury in Venus's sign on the 5th: study and children topics are well supported.
Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Mercury in Saturn's sign on the 10th: steady, disciplined career effort.

ambiguity: A stray 'r' opens the sentence; 'purn mitra' (full friend) is his own grading.
classical_check: Venus as Mercury's friend agrees; Saturn is neutral toward Mercury in Parashara, so that part differs.

hindi: अगर आपका यही बुद्ध खराब हो गया तो आप बोलो मत बोलते ही क्लेश होता है आप कहते मैंने बोल क्या दिया क्लेश हो गया
says: If this Mercury is damaged, do not speak, because the moment you speak there is a quarrel, and you are left saying 'what did I even say, a fight broke out'. Bad Mercury makes ordinary words cause strife.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: afflicted Mercury giving harsh or quarrelsome speech is a standard reading.

hindi: जिन लोगों के बुद्ध में दोष होता उनको हम यही कहते हैं भैया आप चुप रहा करो मौन में चले जाओ
says: His standard advice to people with a Mercury dosha is to stay quiet and go into silence (maun). Silence is the remedy for troubled Mercury.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; maun as a Mercury remedy is traditional.

hindi: अब अगर वक्री है बुध या बकरी का होता है सिस्टम उल्टा चलता है ग्रह कुंडली में ही है जन्म में ही है तो वो व्यक्ति चुप नहीं रह सकता
says: If Mercury is retrograde (the caption says 'bakri'), the system runs in reverse; since it is that way in the birth chart itself, such a person cannot keep quiet. Retrograde Mercury makes silence impossible.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Bakri' is a caption slip for vakri; 'system runs reverse' is his image of retrogression.
classical_check: Silent on the quiet-impossible claim; classical texts give retrograde planets extra strength.

hindi: उसके उपाय कराने पड़ते हैं कोई स्टोन पहनाए बिना चैन नहीं पड़ता उसकी आत्मा का
says: Such a person needs remedies done and will not find peace until a gemstone is worn; the soul stays restless without it. Recorded as his claim about gem remedies, not a purchase recommendation.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The stone is not named; for Mercury it would normally be emerald but he does not say.
classical_check: Gem remedies are traditional; the claim of no peace without one is his own.

hindi: बहुत बहस करता है बुध वाला व्यक्ति
says: A person with an active Mercury argues a lot, picking debates constantly. It restates the argumentative trait in a one-line summary.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Mercury wala' is loose: any strong or afflicted Mercury, not specified.
classical_check: Silent; debating nature of Mercury people is a common reading.

gist: Starts a recent anecdote: a sweet young man from Gujarat came to see him and, once the consultation was over, spoke up with something to say.
The visitor says the guruji part was fine but he has a complaint; Gautam replies that only people with complaints come to him and he has met nobody happy in this lifetime.
The visitor complains that Satyavan spoke to him very rudely; Gautam apologises on Satyavan's behalf and asks him to forgive a young person's mistake.
The visitor insists such behaviour should not happen; Gautam agrees it was wrong and should not have occurred.
The visitor then asked again whether a certain thing would surely happen and got a yes, then asked the same again two minutes later and got yes once more.
Gautam points out he was asked four times in three minutes on top of two earlier times, asks if he should be rude too, and says Satyavan is only human and was irritated.

Says the man must have irritated Satyavan badly to make him speak crookedly, that Satyavan knows everything and more than Gautam, and that fights start when you keep testing another person's patience.

hindi: बोले गुरु जी आप क्यों नहीं इरिटेट हुए मैंने कहा मुझे पता है बेटा तेरा दिमाग खराब है तेरा बुध बकरी है मैं ये सपाटी बोलता हूं सेम शब्द है
says: Asked why he himself was not irritated, he says it is because he knows the man's mind is disturbed and his Mercury is retrograde (caption: bakri), and he tells him so bluntly in those same words. He reads the repeated, irritating questioning as the retrograde Mercury at work.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Bakri' is a caption slip for vakri; the chart itself is not shown, so the retrograde state is asserted, not demonstrated.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not tie retrograde Mercury to pestering behaviour.

hindi: अनसेंसर्ड कि बेटा तेरा दिमाग खराब है तेरे एक दो ग्रह अच्छे हैं इसलिए थोड़ा सा कम खराब है उससे तू समझ रहा है पर एक्चुअली तेरा दिमाग खराब ही है
says: Uncensored, he tells the man his mind is disturbed, but one or two good planets in his chart make it a little less so, which is why he can still understand things; underneath, the mind remains spoiled. Good planets cushion a Mercury affliction without curing it.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Which 'one or two' planets count as good is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: other strong benefics soften an affliction; the blunt 'mind spoiled' phrasing is his own.

gist: The man touches his feet and says his own father says the same, asks to call Gautam papa; Gautam jokes that would make him a sinner (papi).
Tells the man he talks too much, pesters people and chases after them, and so irritates everyone.
The man then reveals that his wife has left for three months because she says he drinks her blood; no chart details are given.

hindi: पर हम चकि समझ रहे हैं इसलिए मैं उसे लेवरेज दे रहा हूं अरे यह बोलेगा ही 10 बार इसका क्या कर सकते हैं उसका दोष नहीं है
says: Because we understand the cause, we give him allowance: he will say a thing ten times, nothing can be done about it, and it is the planet's fault, not his. Patience is the proper response to someone with a Mercury affliction.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Leverage' is read as allowance or latitude.
classical_check: Silent; a counselling attitude, not a classical rule.

hindi: इसलिए आपके घर में देखिए आपके बच्चे हैं आपके अड़सी पड़ोसी वह सब बेचारे बुद्ध से ग्रसित है परेशानी होगी उनको हरे रंग की चीजें गिफ्ट कीजिए
says: Look around your home: your children and neighbours are probably gripped by Mercury trouble and will struggle, so give them gifts of green things. The gift is aimed at easing others' Mercury problems, not your own.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Adsi padosi' is a caption garble for neighbours.
classical_check: Silent; gifting green items is a folk extension of Mercury charity.

hindi: उनको जितनी वो चीजें मिलेंगी सोफ ही दे दो कुछ नहीं चलो मीठी दे दो मेंथोल वाली दे दो उसी से रिलीफ आ जाएगा कितना सिंपल है
says: Give as many such green items as you can find; if nothing else, give saunf, or the sweet or menthol kind, and relief will come: it is that simple. He lowers the bar for what counts as a Mercury gift.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'Sof' is read as saunf (fennel), as in the earlier chunk.
classical_check: Silent; folk remedy.

hindi: हरा पान दे दो चलो मीठे की भी ऐसी तैसी नहीं समझ है तो दे दो उससे नेगेटिव नहीं होगा पॉजिटिव ज्यादा होगा अगर थोड़ा नेगेटिव भी हुआ
says: Give a green paan, and if you do not understand the sweet-paan question, give it anyway: it will not turn negative, it will be mostly positive, even if slightly negative. This loosens his earlier rule that paan must not be sweet because sweet belongs to Mars.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Contradicts or relaxes his earlier statement that sweet paan should not be used for Mercury.
classical_check: Silent; he contradicts himself on sweet paan rather than any classical text.

hindi: इसीलिए बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है इसलिए आप देखेंगे मुस्लिम लोग कितना पान खाते हैं उसी धर्म उसी रंग से प्रेरित है उनके पान चलता है तो बु इसका मतलब य सब कुछ
says: That is why it matters so much: he points out how much paan Muslims eat and says it is inspired by the same religion and the same green colour, which he reads as Mercury operating in daily custom. A sweeping generalisation about a community, recorded only as his stated association.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence trails off ('so Mercury, it means all this').
classical_check: Silent; a cultural observation, not a classical rule.

hindi: इसलिए बुध में कोई दोष है अब क्या दोष है य तो बहुत लंबा समझने का खेल है
says: So there is some fault in Mercury, but exactly which kind of fault it is takes a long process to understand, and he leaves that for later. He closes the Mercury topic by admitting the diagnosis of the fault type is lengthy.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the sign-fault and retrograde-fault split given earlier.

gist: Jokes that the Mercury topic keeps not ending, blames this on Mercury's dosha and not on himself, and says that is why he talks so much.
Remark that the screen-share and green-screen set-up was done out of compulsion and never before, and that something is not visible on screen.
A viewer asks whether the planets differ between a baby delivered by caesarean on a pandit's advice and one born by normal delivery.
Reacts with 'oh dear, what a question', jokes that Mercury will be left unfinished, and says the viewers have rightly pulled him up for talking too much.

hindi: बैठे हैं वो जो बताते हैं इतने बजे करो इस टाइम प न्यूरोलॉजी वाले बैठे होते हमारे जीवन में जो हम कहते फैब्रिकेटेड बेबी पैदा करते हैं
says: Beginning his answer on timed births, he mentions those who tell you to deliver at a particular hour and calls the resulting children fabricated babies; the answer breaks off at the end of the chunk. Recorded as an opinion on chosen-time births, not as a rule or medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence is garbled ('neurology wale') and the answer is cut off.
classical_check: Silent in this fragment; classical texts allow muhurta for conception and birth rites but this opinion is his own.

hindi: फैब्रिकेट करते हैं उसे यानी अपने साइज के अनुसार उसको बनाते हैं अपने लिए उपलब्ध ग्रहों में तो उसका 100% इफेक्ट होता है
says: Carrying on from the timed-caesarean talk, he says that when a birth is 'fabricated' (the delivery moment is chosen so the child's chart is tailored out of the planets that are available), the chosen chart then works at full 100 percent effect. This is his claim about chosen birth times and is not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: the sentence names no planet, house or sign. Which planets end up in which houses decides the fabricated chart, and he gives no rule for that here.
ambiguity: The sentence starts mid-thought from the previous batch. '100% effect' could mean the chosen chart fully replaces the natural one, or only that the chosen planets act at full strength.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts treat the birth moment as fixed by destiny and say nothing about surgically timed births. This is a modern practice he is explaining.

hindi: लेकिन उसके बली है कि कट लगेगा तो आप मंगल में मूवमेंट ले रहे हैं
says: He says the price of such a chosen birth is that a surgical cut will be made, so by arranging it you are drawing the child's arrival into the territory of Mars, the planet of cutting.
cells_derived_method: none: he ties the cut to Mars as a planet and names no house or sign.
ambiguity: 'उसके बली है' is probably 'उसकी बलि है' (its sacrifice). 'मूवमेंट' is loose and may mean moving the event into Mars's domain or into a Mars time.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars governs cuts, surgery and blood; the 'price' framing is his own.

gist: A garbled stretch about moving from Mercury to Mars when Jupiter was meant to come, plus a mention of God's grace; the caption is too broken to recover a rule.

hindi: तो बॉडी में कट लगता है सिजेरियन होगा कट लगाया बलि देनी पड़ी
says: Once Mars is the active planet the body takes a cut. Here the cut is a caesarean, and because the cut was made a bali, a sacrifice or payment, has to be given to the planet.
cells_derived_method: none: Mars as the planet of cuts is stated without any house or sign.
ambiguity: 'Bali' could mean a literal ritual offering or the cost or risk of the surgery; he does not say which.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars rules cutting and surgery. The idea of paying a bali after a Mars cut is his own framing and is not in the classical texts.

hindi: बलि दे दो ग्रह कहता है मुझे बलि दे दो कर लो मैं अलाव करता हूं
says: He puts words in the planet's mouth: 'give me my offering, then go ahead, I allow it'. The claim is that a change in fate is permitted by the planet only once it has been paid its bali.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'अलाव' is the English word 'allow' written in Devanagari. He says 'the planet' without naming it, so Mars is assumed from context. What the bali actually consists of is not stated.
classical_check: Silent on this wording. Classical shanti and daan are offerings made to a planet, so the idea of paying the planet agrees in spirit.

hindi: हमारे जीवन में किसी भी जगह पर हम जब भी जहां खड़े हैं वहां परमात्मा हमें चॉइस दे रहा है किधर मुड़ना है इधर मुड़ते ही बेटा तेरे लिए नया सेट फिक्स लाइफ बना दूंगा फिक्स प्रारब्ध
says: He says that at every point of life God offers a choice of which way to turn, and whichever way you turn He will set up a fresh fixed life for you, a fixed prarabdha belonging to that path.
cells_derived_method: none: a general philosophy of choice and destiny with no planet, house or sign.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether the new fixed life replaces the old prarabdha or is just a different route to it; the next sentence leans towards the second reading.
classical_check: Partly agrees with the classical split between fixed prarabdha karma and kriyamana (present-choice) karma, but classical texts do not say God builds a new fixed life at each turn.

hindi: आपका फिक्स प्रारब्ध हर जगह से जा सकता है ... भोगना वही पड़ेगा ना बदलता जो नसीब में लिखा लाए उसे कोई माइका लाल चेंज नहीं कर सकता
says: He says a fixed prarabdha can be reached by many routes (you may walk round one way or the other and still arrive at the same place), but what is written in your fate must be endured, and nobody can change it.
cells_derived_method: none: a general fatalism statement.
ambiguity: 'माइका लाल' is a colloquial 'mai ka lal' (anyone at all). He does not say whether remedies he teaches elsewhere are meant to be an exception.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical doctrine that prarabdha karma must be experienced. It sits in tension with remedy sections of the texts and with his own remedy teaching, which assume some softening is possible.

hindi: यह मंगल की बलि है आपने मंगल एक्टिवेट किया
says: He names the whole cut-and-sacrifice episode as Mars's bali and says that by choosing it you have switched Mars on.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given.
ambiguity: 'Activate' is used loosely: he does not say whether it means a Mars dasha, a transit, or just using Mars through the surgical or ritual act.
classical_check: Silent: 'activating' a planet by an act is his own framing.

hindi: मंगल एक अकेला ग्रह है सूर्य का सेनापति है मंगल राजा का सेनापति सारी कमांड इसके पास ही है
says: He says Mars is the single planet that serves as the Sun's commander-in-chief. Since the Sun is the king, all the command of action sits in Mars's hands.
cells_derived_method: none: a planetary role, not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees: the classical planetary cabinet makes the Sun king, the Moon queen and Mars the commander (senapati).

gist: Aside that Mars is the planet closest to Earth and Elon Musk says he will send a spaceship and settle people on Mars.
Tells that long ago (the caption's numbers of 50 thousand, 50 lakh and 500 years are garbled) the Bermuda Triangle region, where ships vanish, held an ancient civilisation and Atlantis sank there.

Describes Atlantis as a huge land said to be full of gold, visited by beings from other planets through portals, where aircraft vanished and were never found; some call the Triangle mystery nonsense, others say a portal is open there.
Places Atlantis in the sea between the US and Europe, where the Bermuda Triangle is now, and says people of other planets used to arrive there; the sentence runs into the next minute.
Says the great wars of the Mahabharata age, with Brahmastras answering Brahmastras, may have been fought in spaceships with weapons able to destroy the earth.
Claims all those Brahmastras were redirected, by a deity, Brahma or Krishna, to Mars, where they burst and in effect wrecked that planet.

hindi: नष्ट कैसा कर दिया गंजा कर दिया वहां कोई प्लांटेशन नहीं है अग्नि है पानी है ही नहीं पानी ढूंढा जा रहा है कोई हरियाली है ही नहीं बुध है ही नहीं तो मंगल बुध की भी नहीं सुनता
says: Mars was left bald: no plantation, no water, no greenery, only fire. Because Mercury (the green, vegetative planet) is absent from Mars, Mars does not listen to Mercury either.
cells_derived_method: Where Mars sits in Mercury's signs (Gemini, Virgo) or Mercury is weak next to Mars, Mercury topics (talk, reasoning, trade, schooling) are overridden by Mars-style action. The house decides which topic suffers. He names no house or sign, so these cells are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (6-6+1=1). Mars sits in Mercury's sign in the 6th, the house of rivals and disputes; he wins arguments by force and brushes aside advice or reasoning.
Derived: lagna Virgo (3-10+1=-6, so 6). Mars in Mercury's sign in the 10th; career in sales or speech is pushy and fast, with little patience for analysis or paperwork.
Derived: lagna Pisces (1-2+1=0, so 12). Mars in own sign in the 2nd with no Mercury help; speech is blunt and commanding, and reasoning from others is not heard.

ambiguity: He argues from the physical Mars (no water or plants) to the astrological Mars; whether 'does not listen' means enmity or just indifference is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: in the Parashari friendship table Mars treats Mercury as an enemy. The reason he gives (a barren Mars) is his own.

gist: Repeats that Mars is not green and does not listen to greenery, adds that he also ignores water, and notes there is no water on Mars.

hindi: मंगल किसी के ज्ञान के भी ऐसी की तैसी फिरता है लेकिन गुरु के आगे नमन करता है क्योंकि बृहस्पति पीछे से उसको खींच रहा है
says: Mars brushes aside anybody's knowledge or advice, yet he bows before the guru, Jupiter, because Jupiter is pulling him back from behind.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's hold on Mars should show where Mars sits in Jupiter's signs (Sagittarius, Pisces) or is joined or aspected by Jupiter. The house then says which area of life Mars's drive is steered into. He gives no cells; these are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1). Mars in Jupiter's sign in the 9th, the house of dharma and teachers; drive is channelled into duty, mentors and higher learning.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Mars in Jupiter's sign in the 12th; aggression is turned inward or towards retreat, charity and foreign places.
Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5). Mars in Jupiter's sign in the 5th; temper is held in check by teaching, advice and children's matters.

ambiguity: 'Pulling from behind' is metaphorical and could mean Jupiter's aspect, Jupiter's sign position or just the planets' orbital order.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is Mars's friend and tempers him in the classical friendship table; the 'pulling from behind' image is his own.

hindi: अंतरिक्ष की फोटोग्राफी याद कीजिए बृहस्पति बैठा है या मंगल बैठा है बिल्कुल साथ में
says: He asks the listener to recall pictures of space in which Jupiter and Mars appear sitting right next to each other, and uses that closeness to support the idea that Jupiter holds Mars in check.
cells_derived_method: none: an appeal to space photography with no house or sign.
ambiguity: The caption is loose ('बैठा है या' could be 'whether Jupiter or Mars is shown'). He may mean the orbit order, although the asteroid belt actually lies between the two planets.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no orbit-order argument. The friendship of Jupiter and Mars is classical, but this astronomical picture is not.

hindi: बृहस्पति आपका यहां बैठा है स्वाधिष्ठान पे और मंगल नाभि पे बृहस्पति इसको सेट करके बैठा है
says: In the human body he places Jupiter at the Swadhisthana chakra (lower belly) and Mars at the navel, with Jupiter sitting there keeping Mars in order.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-mapping claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He points with a gesture ('यहां'), so exactly which spot is meant for Jupiter is read from the word Swadhisthana only.
classical_check: Silent: planet-to-chakra mapping is not in the Parashari texts, and later schemes differ on which planet goes with which chakra.

gist: Body example: during vomiting or loose motion the navel pulls and tries to hold things while the intestine pushes them down and out. A physiology illustration, no astrology rule stated.

hindi: नाभि ऊपर की ओर अगर आ रहा है तो यह मंगल को फोड़ता हुआ आता है यानी बृहस्पति ने ही इसको संभाल रखा है
says: If the pressure at the navel comes upward, he says it comes by breaking through Mars, which shows that Jupiter alone has been holding it in place.
cells_derived_method: none: a body illustration of the Mars-Jupiter relation, no house or sign.
ambiguity: It is not clear what exactly 'comes up' (food, pressure, energy); it reads as an analogy, not a health claim.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss the navel in this way.

gist: Folk talk about people whose navel is displaced (dharan) and a toe-length way of checking it; the caption is garbled and it is not an astrology statement.
Repeats that it is Jupiter who is pulling, and that Mars folds his hands before Jupiter because he is the guru (sentence ends in the next minute).

hindi: लेकिन सुनता मानता अपने हिसाब से किसी की नहीं है शनि जो है शनि की ऐसी की तैसी
says: But Mars listens to and obeys nobody and goes by his own reckoning; he even disregards Saturn, the planet of rules and discipline.
cells_derived_method: Mars's refusal to yield to Saturn shows most where Mars sits in Saturn's signs (Capricorn, Aquarius). The sign decides whether Mars beats Saturn (exalted) or just clashes with him. These cells are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (10-3+1=8). Mars exalted in Saturn's sign in the 3rd; courage and self-effort win over restraint and delay.
Derived: lagna Cancer (11-8+1=4). Mars in Saturn's sign in the 8th; he is stubborn, impatient with rules, and breaks restraint in sudden ways.

ambiguity: The sentence continues from the previous minute ('जोड़ता है गुरु है वो'); the 'but' contrasts his respect for Jupiter with his defiance of everyone else.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: in the Parashari table Saturn counts Mars as an enemy, while Mars counts Saturn as neutral.

gist: Says Mars moves round and round in space and promises to explain it later with a diagram.

hindi: तो सूर्य के आकर्षण में सारे ग्रह चल रहे हैं सूर्य खींच के ले जा रहा है
says: All the planets are moving under the Sun's attraction; the Sun is dragging them along their paths.
cells_derived_method: none: an astronomical principle with no house or sign.
ambiguity: He uses 'attraction' in the modern gravitational sense, not in any technical Jyotish sense.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari. Classical siddhanta astronomy explains planetary motion by the pravaha wind, so this is modern language placed on top.

hindi: मंगल की ऐसे मजे हैं कि मंगल कभी यहां घूमता है तो कई कई महीने घूम लेता है बाकी ग्रह अपने हिसाब से फिक्स चलते हैं शनि भी ढाई साल ही चलेगा एक राशि में कसम है 84 साल में ही यूरेनस घूमेगा पूरे के पूरे
says: Mars's stay in a sign is irregular and can run on for several months, while the other planets keep a fixed pace: Saturn will take about two and a half years in a sign, and Uranus needs 84 years to go round the whole zodiac.
cells_derived_method: none: transit durations, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'Several months' for Mars is vague; normally it is about a month and a half per sign and stretches only around retrogression.
classical_check: Saturn's 2.5 years per sign and Uranus's 84-year circuit are astronomically right. Parashari does not use Uranus.

hindi: मंगल कहता है अपनी मौज है भाई अपन चार महीने रहेंगे आज इस राशि में सूरज चला हुआ है अपना बेचारा कहता ठीक है यार बेटा भी तो ही है मेरा सेनापति भी ही है संभालता भी तो ही है कोई नहीं
says: In a comic dialogue, Mars says it is his own pleasure and he will stay four months in this sign. The Sun, the poor king pulling the planets along, puts up with it because Mars is his commander who also keeps things together, though he stretches the tolerance only up to a limit.
cells_derived_method: none: the stay length is not tied to any house or sign.
ambiguity: Calling Mars the Sun's 'son' (बेटा) is affectionate talk and not the classical relation. The four-month figure fits a stay that includes retrogression.
classical_check: Silent: it is a humorous way to explain Mars's variable stay in a sign. The Sun-Mars friendship is classical.

hindi: जब मंगल ग्रह चार नंबर का था चार नंबर हो गया चंद्रमा का नीच का उस समय मंडल कमीशन हुआ था चार महीने तक देश जला था
says: He gives a mundane example: when Mars was in sign number 4 (Cancer, the Moon's sign, where Mars is debilitated), the Mandal Commission upheaval happened and the country burned for four months. His claim is that Mars in Cancer brings public unrest.
cells_derived_method: For a person, Mars in Cancer by transit or in the birth chart is read by the house that Cancer falls in: 4th (home, public peace), 10th (authority, career), 1st (self). Debilitation makes the reading harsher than a normal Mars placement. All cells are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Debilitated Mars as lagna lord in the 4th; unrest at home and in the public mood, a restless mind.
Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). Debilitated Mars in the 10th; clashes with authority and agitation in career.
Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Debilitated Mars in the lagna, a yogakaraka weakened; body and temper are strained, and the result depends on whether cancellation of debilitation exists.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign 4 (Cancer) because he adds the Moon's sign and Mars's debilitation. 'चंद्रमा का नीच का' is garbled; Cancer is the Moon's own sign, not its fall. I did not check the historical dates.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is debilitated in Cancer. Linking Mars in Cancer to riots is a mundane (samhita) style claim; I could not verify the historical correlation here.

hindi: जब जब अंतरिक्ष में ये चार नंबर तीन नंबर पांच नंबर घूमता है और चार नंबर के कपल पर इफेक्ट डालता है बम ब्लास्ट होते हैं
says: Whenever Mars moves through sign numbers 4, 3 and 5 (Cancer, Gemini, Leo) and also hits what he calls the number-4 'couple', he says bomb blasts happen.
cells_derived_method: For one person, the same Mars transit hits a different house depending on the lagna: Cancer, Gemini and Leo become the 4th, 3rd, 5th and so on counted from lagna. Blasts are read as fire or accident risk in the life area of that house. All cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Transit Mars over the 4th: risk to home, vehicle and peace of mind.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (5-10+1=-4, so 8). Transit Mars over the 10th: heat and conflict at work, accidents on the way to work.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (3-5+1=-1, so 11). Transit Mars over the 5th: anger or injury touching children, speculation or romance.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर के कपल' is garbled: it may mean a pair or the 'koṇa' (trine) of sign 4, or a couple. The numbers could also be houses. 'पाच पांच नंबर' repeats five.
classical_check: Silent on blasts. Classical mundane astrology links malefic transits (Mars especially) to fires, explosions and war, which fits in general terms.

hindi: अभी भी चार चल रहा है युद्ध चल रहा है
says: At the time of recording he says the same number-4 condition is running again and a war is on, offered as a present-day match for the Mars claim above.
cells_derived_method: none: a single present-day remark, no house dependence.
ambiguity: It is unclear what 'चार' refers to: Mars in sign 4 now, or the number-4 influence in general. The date of recording is not given, so I cannot check it.
classical_check: Silent: a topical remark that I did not verify.

hindi: तो विश्व विश्व में आग लगाता आग का देवता है आग फेंकता है यह काबू नहीं आता
says: Mars sets the world on fire: he is the god of fire, throws fire about, and cannot be brought under control.
cells_derived_method: none: Mars's fiery nature stated generally.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the fiery, cruel planet of conflict in the classical texts.

hindi: तो यह क्या करता है बॉडी के अंदर आग निकालता है लाल रंग निकालता है खून निकालता है मंगल से दुर्घटनाएं होती है
says: In the body Mars brings out fire, red colour and blood, and accidents come from Mars.
cells_derived_method: Where the accident or blood trouble falls follows the house Mars holds: 3rd (arms, short travel), 8th (sudden events), 12th (hospital, loss). Own sign softens the result and enemy signs sharpen it. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Mars in own sign in the 8th; sudden cuts or bleeding are possible, but own-sign strength usually gives survival.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (1-3+1=-1, so 11). Mars in own sign in the 3rd; injuries to hands and arms through risk-taking or sport.
Derived: lagna Cancer (3-12+1=-8, so 4). Mars in Mercury's sign in the 12th; blood loss linked to hospital stays or night-time mishaps.

ambiguity: 'आग निकालता है' could be fever or inflammation in the body; he does not list conditions.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of blood, fire, wounds and accidents.

hindi: साउथ ईस्ट का डायरेक्शन जो है वह अग्नि का है
says: The south-east direction of a house belongs to Agni (fire), the fire quarter that he links to Mars in what follows.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu direction, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: He does not say here that the south-east is Mars's direction; the link comes from the next sentences about Mars's grace.
classical_check: Agni as lord of the south-east (Agneya) agrees with vastu. In the classical graha-direction scheme, however, the south-east belongs to Venus and Mars rules the south, so linking SE to Mars is his own tilt.

hindi: आपके घर में साउथ ईस्ट का डायरेक्शन में यदि दरवाजा हो पंक्चर हो अंतरिक्ष और अनिल दो देवता होते हैं e8 और s1 के अगर वहां पंचर हो ... तो आपके घर के पुत्र मुख्य तौर पर बेटे मर जाते हैं
says: Vastu claim: if the south-east of the house has a door or opening (a 'puncture') at the two devata positions E8 and S1, Antariksha and Anil, then the sons of the house die and the boys do not survive. Recorded only as his tradition claim, not a prediction.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu placement, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'पंक्चर' means an opening, door or hole; 'E8' and 'S1' look like the 8th pada on the east side and the 1st pada on the south side of the grid. The caption names 'अनिल' for the second devata.
classical_check: Classical vastu texts do list door results by pada and warn against doors at the fire corner, and the devata names fit the standard outer padas. I cannot confirm a flat 'sons die' result, which reads as an extreme popular claim.

hindi: क्यों मंगल देवता की कृपा नहीं मिल रही भाई अग्र डिस्टर्ब कर दिए तुमने घर के अंदर
says: He explains the reason: Mars's grace is not reaching you because you have disturbed the fire (Agni) inside the home.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu cause-and-effect with no chart cell.
ambiguity: 'अग्र' is likely 'अग्नि'. He does not say what 'disturbing' means beyond the door example just given.
classical_check: Silent: tying Mars's favour to the home's fire corner is his own framing.

hindi: और ऐसे ही नाभि का अगनी आपने डिस्टर्ब अगर कर दी तो आपको पुत्र का सुख नहीं देगा बहुत डिस्टरबेंस हो जाएगी सेनापति नहीं होगा आपके पास
says: In the same way, if the fire at the navel (the body's Agni) is disturbed, Mars will not give you the happiness of sons. There will be great disturbance, you will have no commander and no one to take charge.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent as spoken.
ambiguity: 'Navel's fire' may mean the body's digestive fire or a ritual or yoga practice. How the navel fire gets disturbed is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give Jupiter, not Mars, as the karaka of sons. Mars's link to sons is his own framing.

hindi: ये मंगल कट लगाता है स्त्री के गर्भ पे और उसके पश्चात फैब्रिकेटेड बेबी पैदा करते हैं हम कि ये बढ़िया ग्रह का है तो बली बिना नहीं हो रहा
says: Mars is the one who makes the cut on the mother's womb. After that a 'fabricated' baby is produced, with the birth moment picked so that a good planet is well placed, but none of this happens without the bali. This describes a practice he mentions and is not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given for the chosen planet.
ambiguity: The caption's last words ('तो बली बिना नहीं हो रहा') are rough; it likely means 'it does not happen without a bali'. 'Good planet' is not named.
classical_check: Silent on choosing a surgical birth time. The Mars-cut link is classical (Mars rules surgery); the rest is modern practice.

gist: Says that after the birth he will read the child's planets to show how it turned out, leading into the next example.

hindi: ऐसा भी होता है कि लड़की की कुंडली में योग है कि यह मर जाएगा बच्चा इसका
says: He says it also happens that the girl's own chart carries a yoga showing that her child will die. This is a death claim, recorded only as his statement and not as a prediction.
cells_derived_method: none: he names no yoga, house or sign; a classical reading would look at the 5th house, its lord and Jupiter, but nothing here gives a cell.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in the next batch ('इसका' then 'तो भैया बली ना हो जाए...'). It is unclear whether 'the girl' is the mother or a daughter being born.
classical_check: Silent on this yoga: classical putra-bhava rules exist (affliction to the 5th house and Jupiter) but he states none.

hindi: तो भैया बली ना हो जाए कट लगा कर के निकाल लो
says: Following on from a chart that shows the child dying, he says that to stop the sacrifice (the child's death) from taking place, the baby should be taken out by a surgical cut, meaning an early or caesarean delivery. This is his remedy claim and not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: no house, sign or timing rule is given for when to cut.
ambiguity: 'बली ना हो जाए' is read as 'so that the bali (death) does not happen'. He does not say how the delivery time is chosen or which planet's strength is being used.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no caesarean remedy. It follows from his Mars-cut-as-bali idea in the previous batch.

gist: Tells that Chanakya is said to have cut open Chandragupta's mother's belly to take the child out, reasoning she would die anyway and the child would become emperor; adds a garbled line that the story did not form the other way round.

hindi: यह मंगल ग्रह एक और आठ नंबर का है मेश जोडियक की स्टार्टिंग यही है सबसे पहली कौन है इसके देवता मेश और आठ वृश्चिक
says: Mars is the planet of sign number 1 and sign number 8: Mesha (Aries), which is where the zodiac begins, and Vrischika (Scorpio).
cells_derived_method: When Mars sits in his own signs, his strength is high and the house decides the topic: in kendras he forms a Ruchaka-type yoga, and for lagnas where he rules a trine he becomes the main giver. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (8-4+1=5). Mars rules the 4th and 9th for Leo and sits in own sign in the 4th, a kendra; home, land and mother matters carry a strong Mars colour.
Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4). Mars rules the 5th and 10th for Cancer and sits in own sign in the 10th; strong career drive, a Ruchaka-type placement.
Derived: lagna Gemini (8-6+1=3). Mars rules the 6th and 11th for Gemini and sits in own sign in the 6th; strong against rivals and illness, gains through contests.

ambiguity: 'एक और आठ नंबर' is read as sign numbers 1 and 8 because he links them to Aries and Scorpio; the caption around 'इसके देवता मेश' is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries and Scorpio are Mars's own signs. In his wider scheme Scorpio can also go to Uranus, but he does not say so here.

hindi: वृश्चिक बिच्छू छोड़ता नहीं है मार देता है जान से डंक बड़ा भयंकर कहा जाता है बिच्छू का इसलिए मंगल का दोष यदि बन जाए तो प्रॉब्लम
says: He reads Scorpio through the scorpion, which does not let go and can kill with its fearsome sting, and concludes that if a Mars dosha forms it is a serious problem.
cells_derived_method: Mars dosha is counted by Mars's house from lagna (1, 4, 7, 8, 12); Scorpio is his own sign, so strength is high but the 'sting' quality is sharp. The house then says where it bites. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (8-7+1=2). Mars in own sign in the 7th is a Manglik placement; the sting is felt in marriage as intensity and temper.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (8-12+1=-3, so 9). Mars in own sign in the 12th is a Manglik placement; anger turns inward, with strain in the bedroom and in expenses.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (8-1+1=8). Mars in the lagna in own sign is a Manglik placement by house; bold and dominating, the sting is in the personality.

ambiguity: The scorpion link is symbolic. He does not say which houses make the dosha here, only that it is a problem if it forms.
classical_check: Agrees that Scorpio is Mars's own sign. The Mars dosha by house is standard in later marriage-matching texts, and the scorpion image is his own.

hindi: मंगल क्या है अग्नि मंगल है महूरत मंगल है लाल रंग लाल रंग है
says: He lists what Mars stands for: fire, muhurat (the auspicious timing of an event) and the colour red.
cells_derived_method: none: karaka list, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Linking muhurat to Mars rests on a word-play between Mangal (Mars) and mangal (auspicious).
classical_check: Fire and red are classical Mars significations; the muhurat link is a pun and not classical.

hindi: जो हिंदुओं के लगाए सिंदूर मंगल की सेटिंग के लिए ही लड़की सिंदूर लगाती है
says: The red sindoor that Hindus apply is, in his reading, for setting Mars right: a bride wears sindoor precisely to manage Mars.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'सेटिंग' is loose and could mean pacifying, balancing or activating Mars.
classical_check: Silent: sindoor's Mars link is a popular explanation, not a classical rule.

hindi: अगर किसी का मंगल डिस्टर्ब है और शुक्र साथ नहीं दे रहा शुक्र होता है बायोलॉजी डॉक्टर बनना है आपका शुक्र सेट होना बहुत जरूरी है मंगल के साथ
says: If someone's Mars is disturbed and Venus is not supporting, that is a problem; he links Venus with biology, so a person who wants to become a doctor needs Venus well set along with Mars.
cells_derived_method: Medical work is read from Mars (instruments, cutting) and Venus (life science) together, shown where they sit in each other's signs or conjoin, in the 6th (service, health) or 10th (profession). Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (2-10+1=-7, so 5). Mars in Venus's sign in the 10th; a career built on instruments and the body, with Venus giving the life-science side.
Derived: lagna Taurus (7-6+1=2). Mars in Venus's sign in the 6th; health-service work with a combative, procedural edge.

ambiguity: 'शुक्र ... बायोलॉजी' is stated as a plain equation; he does not say whether Venus means reproduction or life science in general.
classical_check: Silent on Venus as biology. Classically Venus rules reproduction and Mars rules surgery and instruments, so the pairing is plausible but the career rule is his own.

hindi: मंगल रफाल का देवता है ना दांत तोड़ोगे आप मेडिकल साइंस में जा रहे हो दांत तोड़ना मींस डेंटिस्ट बन रहे हो ठीक कर रहे हो तो ये सारा का सारा मंगल के बिना नहीं होगा
says: Mars is the deity of weapons such as the Rafale jet and of breaking and cutting; in medical science, pulling and fixing teeth (dentistry) cannot happen without Mars.
cells_derived_method: none: karaka statement without house or sign.
ambiguity: 'रफाल' is read as the Rafale fighter jet. The opening line is a lead-in joke.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the karaka of weapons, surgeons and cutting. Dentistry is a modern extension of the same idea.

A garbled line saying that then he will tell whatever has to be told; no usable rule.

hindi: आपके मंगल के द्वारा आपके जीवन में विवाह है क्योंकि अग्नि के फेरे होते हैं

Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Mars in own sign in the lagna aspects the 7th; marriage is entered by an assertive self and the partner is pressed.

hindi: हिंदू मैरिज की फेलियर क्यों है तलाक नहीं था हिंदुस्तान हिंदुस्तान में डिफरेंट सिस्टम चला है हमारे यहां आपके मंगल को इग्नाइट करते हैं अग्नि के फेरे लेते हैं

hindi: यह सिख लोगों का बढ़िया है संडे होया शादी कर दी साला उनके तो कोई लफड़े नहीं होते अरे तो वह अग्नि नहीं चलाते मोरत का लफड़ा ही खत्म आग ऑन ही मत करो

cells_derived_method: none: a ritual comparison, not house or sign dependent.

ambiguity: The protective reason is only given in the next lines. The sentence starts with 'कर दिया' from the previous batch's last sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not treat head covering as a planetary remedy.

gist: Adds that hijab has become a source of quarrel and political controversy these days and asks what can be done about it.

hindi: यते आदमी ब ढकते हैं अरब में वह रक्षा देता है क्योंकि काले बाल ज सूरज अंकल है
says: He says that even men cover their heads in Arab lands, and that the covering gives protection, because of the black hair and the Sun ('Uncle Sun'), implying the head needs shelter from the Sun's force.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The caption 'यते ... ब ... ज सूरज अंकल है' is garbled. It could mean black hair draws the Sun's heat, or that the Sun acts through the head. I read it only as 'the covering protects from the Sun'.
classical_check: Silent: the Sun as ruler of the head is classical, but covering the head as a remedy is not a classical rule.

gist: A mostly garbled stretch praising how well they do this, then saying the system is changing nowadays because these things are no longer present in society; the middle words cannot be recovered.

Joking commentary that Hindus too have taken up 'I love you' and Gandharva marriage, with a mock exchange about what 'I love you' means and that it is an English-culture matter you would not understand.

hindi: ये हो गया शुक्र ये शुक्र का ऑन हो गया इसकी सभ्यता के हिसाब किताब के कारण क्या आपका आई लव यू हो गया अब आपको गंधर्व करना है आपको लिविन में रहना चाहिए आपको शादी करनी ही नहीं चाहिए
says: He ties this to Venus: Venus has been switched on by that culture's way of life, so you say 'I love you', then want a Gandharva (love) marriage, think you should live in together, and feel you need not marry at all.
cells_derived_method: Venus-led romance is read from the 5th (love), 7th (partner) and 11th (desire fulfilled); Venus in own signs (Taurus, Libra) makes the love-first pattern strong. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini (7-5+1=3). Venus in own sign in the 5th, and also lord of the 5th; a love-led union and attraction before commitment.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (2-7+1=-4, so 8). Venus in own sign in the 7th; a comfort-loving, attractive partner and a relationship that begins in affection.

ambiguity: 'आपको शादी करनी ही नहीं चाहिए' is spoken in the voice of the love-minded person and is not his own advice.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is the planet of love and attraction. Gandharva marriage is one of the eight classical marriage forms, but his link to Western culture activating Venus is his own.

hindi: यह लिविन में आप रहोगे परफेक्टली गुड लाइफ चलेगी लेकिन आपकी कुंडली में मिसमैच है
says: In a live-in arrangement you will live a perfectly good life, he says, even though your charts are a mismatch.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives no cells; the mismatch is left unnamed.
ambiguity: The sentence is unfinished here and the planet is not named; Mars is assumed from the surrounding fire-ritual talk. 'Mismatch' is not defined (Manglik, dasha or other).
classical_check: Silent: classical matching does not discuss live-in relationships.

hindi: आप लिविन से 14 साल के बाद 15 साल बाद पता लगा अब तो शादी कर ले तलाक हो जाता है क्योंकि ग्रह कहता है तुम्हें यही सूट करने दूंगा भैया तुमने छेड़ा नहीं है मुझे तंग नहीं किया है
says: If a live-in couple with mismatched charts decides to marry after 14 to 15 years, divorce follows, because the planet had let the live-in suit them while they did not disturb it, and the wedding finally troubles it.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given. The 14 to 15 year figure is a stated pattern and not tied to a dasha or transit.
ambiguity: The planet is unnamed (Mars assumed). '14 साल के बाद 15 साल बाद' is a loose range. It is a claim about divorce after a late wedding, recorded only as his tradition claim.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no rule for live-in-then-marry timing. This is his own pattern from consulting.

gist: Concluding line that handling Mars's fire is therefore a big matter.

hindi: अगर आप मंगलिक हैं या मंगल का दोष है किसी किस्म से कुंडली में एक च सा 8 12 इन घरों में मंगल की प्लेसमेंट जब होती है जो फिक्स है
says: He states the Mars dosha rule: when Mars is placed in the 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house of the chart, the person is Manglik, and this list is fixed.
cells_derived_method: The sign on that house then moves the severity: own or exalted signs of Mars usually reduce it, a debilitated Mars raises it, and friend signs sit in between. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Debilitated Mars in the 4th; dosha by house plus debilitation, so home peace is disturbed unless a cancellation applies.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (5-8+1=-2, so 10). Mars rules the 4th and 11th and sits in a friend's sign in the 8th; dosha by house, with strain on the marriage's length and on sudden events.
Derived: lagna Gemini (2-12+1=-9, so 3). Mars rules the 6th and 11th and sits in Venus's sign in the 12th; dosha by house, with friction in bed pleasures and spending.

ambiguity: The caption 'एक च सा 8 12' is read as 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 (एक, चार, सात). He does not mention the 2nd house or the Moon and Venus based checks.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars in 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 is the widely quoted Manglik list, and some schools add the 2nd.

gist: A garbled reference to a diagram of Krishna's chart with house numbers 2, 3, 4 and 5 and a corner; the caption is too broken to recover what is being claimed.
Restates that a person with Mars sitting in such a placement is called Manglik.

hindi: उसको मंगलिक से शादी करनी चाहिए
says: A Manglik person should marry another Manglik.
cells_derived_method: none: the matching rule applies to any Manglik chart as he states it.
ambiguity: It is not said whether the partner must be Manglik by the same house, or whether partial Manglik counts.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard marriage-matching practice of matching Manglik with Manglik.

hindi: अगर इन्हीं घरों में शनि भी बैठा हो कहीं भी मंगल एक में शनि सात में आठ में चार में 12 में कहीं भी है तो मंगल भंग हो गया
says: If Saturn also sits in these same houses (1, 4, 7, 8, 12), anywhere among them, even if it is a different one from Mars (Mars in the 1st, Saturn in the 7th, 8th, 4th or 12th), the Mars dosha is broken and no longer applies.
cells_derived_method: The cells here are where Saturn sits. His sign changes how firmly Saturn cancels the dosha: own or exalted Saturn is firm, a debilitated Saturn is weak. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (7-4+1=4). Saturn exalted in the 4th, a firm cancelling placement for any Manglik Mars in the list of houses.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (10-12+1=-1, so 11). Saturn in own sign in the 12th, a firm cancellation by the house rule.
Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7). Saturn debilitated in the 7th; listed by house, but a weak Saturn is often read as cancelling little.

ambiguity: He does not say whether Saturn in the same house as Mars counts, though 'कहीं भी' suggests any listed house. The dignity of Saturn is not discussed by him.
classical_check: Agrees with commonly quoted Kuja dosha parihara (cancellation) that Saturn in these houses removes the dosha; I did not check a specific verse.

hindi: अब मजे की बात एडवांटेज उस लड़के या लड़की की शादी मंगली से भी हो सकती है और नॉन मंगली से भी अब वो और बढ़िया हो गया उसके जैसा तो है ही कोई नहीं
says: The advantage: once Saturn has broken the Mars dosha, that boy or girl can marry a Manglik or a non-Manglik, which makes the person better placed than anyone.
cells_derived_method: none: the consequence follows from the cancellation rule, with no house or sign given.
ambiguity: 'उसके जैसा तो है ही कोई नहीं' is a boast-style flourish; he does not add conditions such as the partner's own chart.
classical_check: Agrees that a cancelled dosha removes the Manglik matching restriction. The 'better than anyone' claim is his flourish.

gist: Blood-group analogy for the cancelled Mars dosha: group O can give blood to everyone, a universal donor, and AB positive can receive anyone's blood (the caption says 'ए भी पॉजिटिव'). An illustration, with no astrology rule.
Joke that a Brahmin deity has no tension and accepts alms from anyone, 'like me'.

hindi: मंगल के नेगेटिविटी है आप अपना ब्लड टेस्ट रेगुलर कराते रहोगे मंगल शांत रहेगा खून निकलता रहता है
says: If you carry Mars negativity, keep getting your blood tested regularly: blood keeps being drawn and Mars stays calm. This is a remedy claim only and is not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is not said how often is 'regular', or whether donating blood works the same way as a test.
classical_check: Silent: giving blood to appease Mars is a modern popular remedy, not found in the classical texts.

hindi: आपको दुर्घटना का बोला गया है आप ब्लड निकलवा के लाते हो रुई की ठगी मिलती है छोटी सी य लगा देते हैं हां उसको निकालो और चलती सड़क पर फेंक दो आपका खून सड़क पर है
says: Remedy for someone who has been warned of an accident: get blood drawn, and the small cotton swab that carries your blood should be taken and thrown out on a busy road, so that your blood is lying on the road. Recorded as his claim, not as a prediction of any accident.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy for any chart showing an accident warning, with no house or sign given.
ambiguity: 'रुई की ठगी' is read as a cotton wad or swab. It is unclear which chart feature counts as the accident warning.
classical_check: Silent: a modern popular remedy, not classical.

hindi: जब ग्रह कहेगा हेलो इसका खून निकालना सड़क पर मारना है देखो यार गिरा हुआ है पहले नहीं आ चुका ... लिख लो टिक कर दो भाई इसका ब्लड आ गया सड़क के ऊपर
says: The logic of the swab remedy, in a planet dialogue: when the planet wants to spill your blood on the road through an accident, it looks and finds your blood already lying there, and ticks the demand off as met.
cells_derived_method: none: a comic argument, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The planet is unnamed (Mars assumed). The dialogue is a joke used to explain the logic, not literal speech.
classical_check: Silent: folk reasoning that a symbolic offering satisfies a planet's demand.

hindi: वो जो दुर्घटना है वो तो होगी जो घटना है वो होगी आप बच जाओगे यानी 12 ही परट रह गया रेमेडी 72 बच गया तो आपने वो रुई का पोया खून लगा हुआ सड़क पर फेंक दिया
says: He says the accident itself will still happen, since the event is fixed, but you will survive so narrowly that you will say Hanuman ji himself came. The remedy leaves only a small part of the harm (the numbers 12 and 72 are probably percentages but are garbled), because you threw the blood-stained cotton on the road.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: '12 ही परट रह गया रेमेडी 72 बच गया' is garbled: it may mean 12 percent of the harm remained and 72 percent was saved, and the numbers do not add up. Hanuman ji is the popular Tuesday and Mars deity of protection. This is a survival and accident claim recorded only as his statement.
classical_check: Silent: no classical source gives remedy percentages. The numbers are unmeasured.

hindi: हा शुगर वाला फो फेंक दो हमें तो ब्लड से मतलब है
says: Detail on the swab remedy: the cotton from a blood-sugar test can be thrown out too, because all that matters is that it carries blood.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'फो' is probably 'फोया' (cotton swab).
classical_check: Silent: a modern popular remedy.

gist: A garbled line starting 'if the accident has to happen anyway' and something about putting it in vain; cannot be recovered.
Says this is why the word guru exists: there has to be someone who tells you.
Introduces people who suddenly get gallbladder and kidney stones and says there is a pleasant, connected explanation, without giving the rule yet.

hindi: ये गॉल ब्लेडर का स्टोन का जो लफड़ा है सारा का सारा ये सारा का सारा हमारे साउथ ईस्ट दिशा के अंदर साउथ साउथ ईस्ट साउथ इसके अंदर आता है
says: Vastu-body link: he places the whole gallbladder-stone trouble in the south-east direction of the home, meaning the south, south-south-east and south-east zones. Recorded as his mapping and not as a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu body-zone mapping, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'साउथ ईस्ट ... साउथ साउथ ईस्ट साउथ' mixes several compass sectors; the exact extent of the zone is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: a vastu body-zone mapping is a modern scheme, not found in classical vastu or Jyotish texts.

hindi: किडनी आ गई हमारी नॉर्थ नॉर्थ वेस्ट से हम स्टार्ट करते हैं उसके बाद नॉर्थ आता है और नॉर्थ नॉर्थ ईस्ट के अंदर आपके डिस्टरबेंस होती है तो किडनी में स्टोन बनता है
says: Vastu-body link for the kidney: it falls on the northern belt, counted from north-north-west, then north, then north-north-east, and a disturbance in these zones is said to produce a kidney stone. Recorded as his mapping and not as a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu body-zone mapping, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'Disturbance' is not defined (clutter, a toilet, colour or a defect). The start of the sentence ('इस गॉल ब्लैडर किडनी जो आती है') is loose.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts; a modern zone mapping.

hindi: ये दोनों जनस अगर आपके घर के अंदर सेट है तो आपको ठीक है
says: If both these zones, the south-east belt and the northern belt, are set right inside your home, then you are fine.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu condition, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'जनस' is read as 'zones'. 'Set' is not defined beyond the earlier word 'disturbance'.
classical_check: Silent: a modern vastu claim.

gist: A garbled line that seems to say there is strife and tension in the mind or skull; the opening words are broken and no clear rule can be taken.

hindi: किडनी में स्टोन सूर्य के दोष से बनता है गल ब्लेडर भी किडनी भी
says: He says kidney stones are formed from the Sun's dosha, and the gallbladder stones as well as the kidney ones. This is his claim and not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A Sun that is weak or afflicted (debilitated in Libra, in a dusthana, or hit by Saturn or Rahu) would be the starting point for his claim; Libra is also the sign that rules the kidneys in the zodiac body. He gives no cells here, so the examples are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (7-6+1=2). Debilitated Sun in the 6th, the house of disease; this would be the clearest cell for his kidney-stone claim.
Derived: lagna Gemini (10-8+1=3). Sun in Saturn's sign in the 8th (a hostile, hidden house); a Sun dosha reading with hidden or sudden health strain.

ambiguity: He gives no house or sign for the Sun's dosha. The next lines define the dosha as missing blessings, which is a different kind of dosha from an astronomical affliction.
classical_check: Silent on a Sun-stone link. Classically the kidneys fall under Libra (the 7th sign), where the Sun is debilitated, which makes a partial link plausible, but the claim as stated is his own.

hindi: आपका जो घर का साउथ एरिया है वह आपका डिस्टर्ब है वहां पर हर हालत में या तो नीला रंग है
says: For these stone cases he says the south area of the home is the disturbed one, and in every case it carries blue colour there.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu observation, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'या तो नीला रंग है' is read as 'blue colour is present'. The sentence runs across the minute mark, and the following rows state the colour rule directly.
classical_check: Silent: a colour rule for zones is modern. Blue and black as Saturn's colours is classical.

hindi: साउथ में नीला रंग नहीं साउथ साउथ ईस्ट साउथ साउथ ईस्ट नीला रंग नहीं होना चाहिए आपके पास पैसे का भी स्यापा रहेगा जिंदगी में
says: There should be no blue colour in the south, the south-south-east or the south-east; if there is, you will have money trouble in life.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu colour rule, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'पैसे का स्यापा' means money trouble or woe. It is not said whether blue paint, furniture or both count.
classical_check: Silent: classical vastu does not give this colour rule. Blue is Saturn's colour in the classical scheme.

hindi: जिनको पैसे का स्यापा है सब देख लो आपके साउथ साउथ साउथ ईस्ट और साउथ ईस्ट में हर हालत में नीला रंग होगा काला हो सकता है ग्रे हो सकता है
says: As a diagnostic check: for people with money trouble, look at the south, south-south-east and south-east of the home, where he says you will always find blue, and possibly black or grey.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu diagnostic, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'हर हालत में' is a sweeping 'in every case' claim, with no evidence offered.
classical_check: Silent: a modern diagnostic claim. Blue, black and grey are all Saturn-type colours classically.

hindi: प्योर वाइट सुपर मिल्की वाइट यह रंग नहीं होने चाहिए अगर ये रंग आपके हैं तो आपको कैश की प्रॉब्लम चलती ही रहेगी फर्नीचर में भी नहीं होने चाहिए
says: Pure white and super-milky white must also not be present in those zones, and if these colours are there you will keep having cash problems. They should not be in the furniture either.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu colour rule, not a chart cell.
ambiguity: 'यह नहीं होने' just before it may also forbid blue, black and grey, so the list of banned colours is not fully clear. The caption 'वाट बल बना हा' that follows is garbled.
classical_check: Silent: classical vastu gives no such rule. White as the Moon's or Venus's colour is classical.

gist: A garbled line about such people maybe having had a small lottery win, which he calls a different story needing details; no rule can be taken.
Returns to the point that the stone problem is the Sun's dosha.

hindi: सूर्य का दोष क्या है पिता के आशीर्वाद की कमी आपके गुरु के आशीर्वाद की कमी आपके पति के आशीर्वाद की कमी आपके पिता के आशीर्वाद घर के बड़े बुजुर्ग ताऊ फलाने इनके आशीर्वाद की कमी
says: He defines the Sun's dosha as a shortage of blessings: from the father, the guru, the husband (for a wife) and the elders of the house such as an uncle.
cells_derived_method: A Sun that is weak or afflicted in a house that touches father, guru or elders (the 9th or 10th) would read as this dosha. He names no cells, so the examples are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius (7-9+1=-1, so 11). Debilitated Sun in the 9th, the house of father and teachers; strain with the father or guru and a shortage of their blessings.
Derived: lagna Pisces (11-12+1=0, so 12). Sun in Saturn's sign in the 12th; distance from father figures and elders, and loss of their support.

ambiguity: 'पति' appears in a list otherwise about father and elders, and may refer to a married woman's husband. 'आशीर्वाद की कमी' is a moral and relational definition and not an astronomical one.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun signifies father and elders. The husband link and the 'dosha means missing blessings' definition are his own.

hindi: आपकी सूर्य सात नंबर का यदि है सूर्य पांच नंबर है सूर्य यहां भी ठीक काम करेगा नॉट वेरी बैड नॉट वेरी गुड गर्म कर देगा सिर्फ
says: He says that with the Sun in sign number 5 (Leo) the Sun works acceptably here too, neither very bad nor very good, and mostly just makes things hot.
cells_derived_method: The house that Leo falls on decides what gets heated: 1st (self, ego), 9th (father, dharma), 10th (career, authority). Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (5-1+1=5). Sun in own sign in the lagna; a hot, proud nature, with ego as the main heat.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (5-9+1=-3, so 9). Sun in own sign in the 9th; heat in dealings with father and teachers, though the placement is strong.

ambiguity: The numbers could be signs or houses. 'आपकी सूर्य सात नंबर का यदि है' is an unfinished clause; he completes the number 7 case later with kidney stones and divorce. 'Not very bad, not very good' for Leo is odd.
classical_check: Differs: Leo is the Sun's own sign and is classically a strong placement, so 'neither good nor bad' is milder than the texts.

hindi: यह तो लाजवाब करेगा एक नंबर में सूर्य उच्च का होता है
says: The Sun in sign number 1 (Aries) will do wonderfully, he says, as that is where the Sun is exalted.
cells_derived_method: The house Aries falls on sets where the Sun's high status shows: 10th (authority), 5th (intellect, leadership), 1st (vitality). Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4). Sun exalted in the 10th; authority, fame and a strong career.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (1-5+1=-3, so 9). Sun exalted in the 5th, lord of the 9th; intelligence, leadership and standing through children or learning.

ambiguity: 'यह तो लाजवाब करेगा' could refer back to the Sun in number 5, but the sentence flows into the Aries exaltation, so I attach it here.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is exalted in Aries.

hindi: मंगल के घर सेनापति के पास जब जाता है तो राजा की मौज नहीं है आग है
says: When the Sun, the king, goes to Mars's house, the commander's, there is no comfort for the king there and it is all fire.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Mars's signs is read as heat and drive without ease; the house says where the burning shows. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (8-4+1=5). Sun as lagna lord in Mars's sign in the 4th; heat at home and a restless domestic life, with no comfort.
Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Sun (5th lord) in Mars's sign in the 8th; fiery strain and sudden events.

ambiguity: Aries is also the Sun's exaltation, which he has just named, so he may mean Scorpio only, or he may mean that even in Aries there is only heat and no comfort. 'मंगल के घर' covers both Mars signs.
classical_check: Partly differs: the Sun and Mars are friends in the classical table, and Aries exalts the Sun, so 'no comfort' is his own colour.

hindi: यह बुद्ध है बिटिया है इसको भी लाड है
says: For the Sun in Mercury's house, he says Mercury is the daughter, who is also pampered, so the king treats her house gently.
cells_derived_method: The Sun in Mercury's signs is a gentler placement; the house shows where the king's affection towards intellect and speech lands. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (3-3+1=1). Sun (5th lord) in Mercury's sign in the 3rd; a confident communicator and bold writer.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (6-10+1=-3, so 9). Sun (9th lord) in Mercury's sign in the 10th; authority through analytic or administrative work.

ambiguity: In his scheme Virgo can go to Mercury or Rahu, so Virgo is listed as Mercury's sign here only. He does not say whether it is good, only that she is pampered.
classical_check: Agrees in tone: the Sun and Mercury are friends in the classical table, so a smooth placement fits.

hindi: ये गुरु है बहुत बढ़िया राजा आया गुरु के घर गुरु को राजा को कहता है आ बैठ उच्च पद नहीं देता अपना स्थान
says: For the Sun in Jupiter's house he says it is very good: the king has come to the guru's house and the guru tells him to come and sit, though Jupiter does not give up his own seat to make the king exalted.
cells_derived_method: The Sun in Jupiter's signs is a welcomed, supported placement; the house shows who the advisers and benefactors are. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1). Sun (5th lord) placed in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 9th; mentors and a father figure support him, with dharma and good fortune.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (12-5+1=8). Sun (10th lord) placed in Jupiter's sign Pisces in the 5th; advisers back his ideas, and learning and children are favoured.

ambiguity: The phrase 'उच्च पद नहीं देता अपना स्थान' is loosely joined: it can mean Jupiter does not grant the exalted post or does not give up his seat. The caption has the two ideas run together.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Jupiter are friends, so a good placement in Jupiter's signs fits, and the Sun is exalted only in Aries.

hindi: मंगल छोड़ता है कि आओ महाराज बैठिए गुरु गुरु के स्थान पर रहता है गुरु को नहीं हिला सकते हम
says: His reason for why the Sun's exaltation is in Mars's sign: Mars vacates his seat for the king saying 'come, Maharaj, sit down', while Jupiter stays in his own place and cannot be moved.
cells_derived_method: none: a story for the exaltation logic; the cell readings follow from the Aries and Jupiter-sign rows above.
ambiguity: The reading is partly an inference: the caption does not say outright that this explains the exaltation, but it follows the lines about Mars's and Jupiter's houses.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts simply assign exaltation signs without such a story, so the reasoning is his own.

hindi: शुक्र है ये यहां जब आता है ना तो यह कौन है यह गर्लफ्रेंड है लवर है सौंदर्य है राजा बर्दाश्त नहीं करता चरित्र हीनता या खराबी या कोई दिक्कत वो कहता ऐसी की तैसी तो यहां नष्ट कर देता है
says: For the Sun in Venus's house: Venus is the girlfriend, the lover and beauty, and the king does not tolerate loose character, fault or any problem there, so he destroys what he finds.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's burning of Venus topics (partner, love, comfort, money) shows in the house Taurus or Libra falls on, with Libra worse since the Sun is debilitated there. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (2-2+1=1). Sun (5th lord) in Venus's sign in the 2nd; harsh pride in speech, strain on family comforts and savings.
Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1). Debilitated Sun in the 7th; ego and character clashes in the partnership, the cell he flags next for divorce.
Derived: lagna Leo (2-10+1=-7, so 5). Sun (lagna lord) in Venus's sign in the 10th; a career in beauty, art or finance that is burnt by ego problems.

ambiguity: 'यहां' means the Sun in Venus's signs, which I read as Taurus and Libra (in his scheme Libra can also go to Neptune). The caption gives no explicit verdict word beyond 'नष्ट कर देता है'.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: the Sun and Venus are enemies in the classical friendship table.

hindi: सूर्य दो नंबर का भी किडनी स्टोन देगा सात नंबर भी किडनी स्टोन देगा शादी से संबंधित घर में बैठा होगा तो तलाक दे देगा विध्वंस आग लगाकर फूक के खत्म कर देगा
says: The Sun in sign number 2 (Taurus) will give kidney stones, and in number 7 (Libra) as well. If it sits in a marriage-related house it will bring divorce and burn the matter down. Recorded as his claim and not as a diagnosis or prediction.
cells_derived_method: The 'marriage-related house' is read as the 7th (partner), or 8th and 2nd (marriage length, family). The Sun in Venus's signs combined with those houses gives his divorce claim. Cells derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1). Debilitated Sun in the 7th, where both his kidney-stone and divorce claims meet; the strongest cell for his statement.
Derived: lagna Aries (2-2+1=1). Sun in Venus's sign in the 2nd (family house); the kidney-stone claim by sign, and strain on the family bond.
Derived: lagna Libra (2-8+1=-5, so 7). Sun in Venus's sign in the 8th; a hidden, sudden break in marriage by his house logic.

ambiguity: Numbers 2 and 7 are read as sign numbers (Taurus, Libra) because he has just used Venus's houses; 'marriage-related house' is not named. The mix of a body claim and a marriage claim in one sentence is loose.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Libra rules the kidneys in the zodiac body and the Sun is debilitated there, and the Sun in the 7th is a classic separative influence. Taurus as a kidney sign is not classical.

hindi: अगर दो तीन डिग्री का है तो नहीं देगा क्योंकि पावर
says: If the Sun is at only 2 to 3 degrees in the sign, it will not give these results, because its power has not yet taken hold (the caption cuts off after 'power').
cells_derived_method: none: the condition depends on the degree of the planet, not on its house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence is completed in the next batch's first words ('पकड़ी नहीं है'), which I read as 'has not taken hold'. 'Not give' refers to the kidney-stone and divorce results above.
classical_check: Agrees in direction with the baladi avastha idea that a planet in its first few degrees is still weak (from memory, I did not check the exact fraction table).

hindi: कई लोग ऐसे होंगे जो य देखेंगे क्लास कहेंगे अच्छा हमारा तो सातवा सूर्य है हमारा तो तलाक नहीं हुआ क्योंकि तुम्हारी डिग्री कम है
says: He expects viewers to object 'I have the Sun in the 7th house but I never got divorced', and answers that the Sun's degree in your chart is low, so it is not really delivering as a 7th-house Sun. He is claiming a 7th-house Sun normally threatens marriage (divorce) and that a low degree is what can stop a planet from giving the full result of that house.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 7th is read as a marriage-stress placement; whether it fires depends on the Sun's degree against the 7th bhava cusp. A very low degree can slip the Sun back into the 6th bhava (when the lagna degree is higher than the Sun's degree), so the 7th-house harm moves toward service, disputes and debts. The sign decides the flavour: Libra is its fall, Aries its exaltation, other signs are neutral.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 7th of lagna Aries; if its degree is low and bhava chalit drops it into the 6th, the ego clash with the spouse is claimed to turn into workplace or legal disputes instead, which is the case his defence fits best.

Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 7th of lagna Libra; a very early degree may slide it into the 6th (Pisces side), so the dominance in partnership shows as victory over rivals rather than marital friction.

Derived: Sun in the Moon's sign Cancer in the 7th of lagna Capricorn; if the low degree shifts it to the 6th (Gemini), the separative Sun acts through colleagues, debts and health routine rather than through the marriage.

ambiguity: He does not say what degree counts as 'low', nor whether his 7th house here is the sign-based house or the bhava; the caption also cuts the lead-in ('पकड़ी नहीं है नहीं नहीं') so the start of the thought is lost.
classical_check: Sun in the 7th harming marriage is classical; testing the true house with bhava chalit by degree is also classical (Sripati), so it agrees, though classics give no 'low degree' cut-off.

hindi: अभी तो चलित रण भाव चलित और केपी कुंडली यह देखेंगे हम तो कई बार बैठा ही नहीं उस घर में कम डिग्री का तो पीछे आगे किसका होता है
says: He says the proper check of whether a planet is really in a house is the Chalit (Bhava Chalit) chart and the KP chart; with a low degree the planet often does not actually sit in that house there and its result is handed to the neighbouring house, the one behind or the one ahead.
cells_derived_method: A planet shown in house H of the sign chart can be read in house H-1 or H+1 in bhava chalit or KP, depending on its degree against the cusp and bhava middle: an early degree tends to fall back, a late degree tends to move forward. Every one of the 144 cells therefore has two shifted twin readings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars at about 1 degree of Leo in the 4th of lagna Taurus can drop into the 3rd bhava, so home and mother results weaken and courage, effort and siblings themes appear instead.
Derived: Saturn at about 29 degrees of Capricorn in the 11th of lagna Pisces can move forward into the 12th, so gains turn toward expenses, foreign links and loss themes.

ambiguity: The caption word 'रण' is garbled (probably 'यानी'), and 'पीछे आगे किसका होता है' could mean the planet's house moves or whose results move; he gives no degree thresholds.
classical_check: Agrees: Sripati bhava chalit shifts planets between houses and KP uses cusp-based placement; the classics are silent on his 'low degree' wording.

hindi: दो और सात ये किडनी में गॉल ब्लेडर में स्टोन देगा आपको अगर इसके ट्रीटमेंट नहीं हुई
says: He says 'two and seven' will give you stones in the kidney and gallbladder if its treatment or remedy is not done. This is a medical claim recorded only as his statement, not endorsed and not a diagnosis; what exactly is meant by two and seven is unclear.
cells_derived_method: If 2 and 7 are houses, the 7th (Libra, kidneys) and the 2nd (Taurus, intake and the digestive start) are the body-linked houses; stones are then read when a harsh planet or the lord of 2 or 7 afflicts them. If they are signs (Taurus and Libra, both Venus-ruled) the same Venus-sign body link applies. Which house or sign is afflicted changes the organ story.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra is the kidney sign and sits in the 7th of lagna Aries, so an afflicted 7th here is the strongest match for his kidney claim.
Derived: Aries in the 7th of lagna Libra puts Mars-type heat and dryness on the kidney house, matching a stone-formation reading in his terms.
Derived: Taurus in the 2nd of lagna Aries ties the 2nd-house gallbladder and intake claim to Venus' own sign; affliction there would be the match for his 2nd-house half.

ambiguity: 'दो और सात' may mean the 2nd and 7th houses, signs number 2 and 7, or a Sun in 2nd/7th continuing the previous thought; it is also unclear what the 'treatment' is (medical or ritual remedy).
classical_check: Libra and the 7th for kidneys is classical; the pairing of 2 and 7 for gallbladder stones is not a standard classical rule, so the classics are mostly silent.

hindi: और आप अपने पिता से भयंकर नाराज है पति से भयंकर क्लेश में रहते हैं तो किडनी खड़वा देगा
says: He claims that if you are fiercely angry with your father and live in heavy conflict with your husband, it will end up damaging the kidney. Father is the Sun and the spouse is the 7th-house side, so he ties the Sun-in-7th trouble to these two relationships. Health claim recorded only as his statement, not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: Father relation is read from the Sun and the 9th house; spouse relation from the 7th house, its lord and Venus or Jupiter. The body link is the 7th/Libra kidney idea. The claim is strongest where the Sun or the 9th lord touches the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th of lagna Aries joins the father significator with the kidney sign and spouse house, the textbook place for his claim.
Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 9th of lagna Sagittarius makes the father relation proud and prominent, so anger toward the father matters more there than the spouse link.
