ambiguity: 'खड़वा' is a garbled caption (probably 'खराब करवा'); it is not clear whether he means the person's own husband or any husband, since the example addresses women.
classical_check: Sun as father and 7th as spouse are classical; linking resentment to organ damage is his own psychosomatic claim, which the classics do not state.

hindi: साल का हो का बच्चा छोटा है सूर्य का दोष है उसका अपने बाप के पिता कहीं तो कोई दोष बनता लेकिन पिता का आशीर्वाद चाहिए हो सकता है पितरों का
says: Using the example of a small child of a few years whose chart shows a Sun dosha, he says the fault must come from the father's side, from the father's father somewhere, and the cure is the father's blessing and possibly the ancestors' (pitar) blessing. The Sun's affliction is thus treated as a paternal-lineage debt, not the child's own doing.
cells_derived_method: An afflicted Sun in a child's chart is traced upward: father (Sun, 9th house), grandfather (Sun from the 9th, i.e. 5th house) and ancestors (9th and Sun). The house and sign decide how clearly the lineage debt is visible and how strong the Sun is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 9th of lagna Aquarius sits on the father house itself, so the lineage and blessing claim is read very directly.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 9th of lagna Leo is strong, so the father's blessing is available and the dosha reading is weaker.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 5th of lagna Gemini touches the child's own house and past-merit house, pointing to ancestral karma carried by the child.

ambiguity: The caption is broken: the child's age ('साल का हो का'), whose father is meant and what exactly 'कहीं तो कोई दोष बनता' refers to are not clear.
classical_check: Sun as father and pitru dosha from an afflicted Sun or 9th is classical; the specific cure of paternal blessing is traditional advice, not a textual rule.

hindi: सारा खेल तो यही है अगर हम इष्ट की बात कर रहे हैं अकेले तो आपके इष्ट हो सकता है पितर हो आपके इष्ट हो सकता है कुलदेवी या कुल देवता हो
says: He says that when only the Ishta (personal deity) is the question, your Ishta may well be your ancestors (pitar), or your family goddess or family deity, so the answer need not be a famous god chosen from a planet or sign.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'सारा खेल तो यही है' points back to the preceding father and ancestor point, but it is not clear which part he means.
classical_check: Ishta devata is classically read from the Atmakaraka and the 12th from Karakamsha or the 5th; Kuladevata and pitar as Ishta is a family-tradition view, so it differs from the textual method.

hindi: हम सिर्फ राशियां डाल-डाल के लोग मुझसे अंदा दंद पूछते रहते हैं हमारा इष्ट तो बता दो इष्ट भी इतना कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है कि उसको ऐसे बता के मैं तो मोटे तौर पर वो इष्ट
says: People just give their signs (rashi) and keep asking him 'tell me my Ishta'; he says the Ishta is far too complicated to be answered from signs alone, so a quick sign-based answer is not the real determination.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'अंदा दंद' is garbled (maybe 'अंदाज़ा' or 'अंदर से'); the sentence runs on into the next caption line.
classical_check: Agrees with the classics, which need the full chart (Atmakaraka, Karakamsha and the 5th or 9th) and not the moon sign alone for Ishta.

hindi: बताता हूं जिसका कोई लेना देना नहीं वो गलत भी कर देंगे तो कर दें उनको पता ही कुछ ना चले लेकिन इट इज वेरी डिटेल्स
says: He admits that to casual askers he gives only a rough Ishta, one with little real connection to them, and if they follow it wrongly they will not even notice; the true Ishta analysis is very detailed.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The phrase 'जिसका कोई लेना देना नहीं' could mean the rough Ishta has no link to the person, or the asker has no link to practice; the caption is jumbled.
classical_check: Silent on his rough-answer habit; the textual Ishta method is indeed detailed, so the remark that it is very detailed is consistent.

hindi: करना क्या है गुरुजी मंत्र जाप कर ले शिव जी का मैं कहता हां कर लो तुमने ना उसको सिद्ध करना है ना तुम्हें पता
says: Asked whether one may simply chant a Shiva mantra, he says yes, go ahead; the person is not trying to perfect (siddh) the mantra and does not know the full method anyway, so ordinary chanting is acceptable and harmless.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'सिद्ध करना' may mean attaining siddhi or just chanting correctly; he does not say how many repetitions or which Shiva mantra.
classical_check: Silent on casual japa; the classics attach Shiva worship to Saturn and Moon remedies, but he does not link it to a planet here.

hindi: अगर तुम अंदर से वाइब्रेट कर रहे हो तो तुम सिद्ध कर भी सकते हो बिना नियम के अदर वाइज नियम चाहिए
says: He says that if you truly vibrate inside with the practice you can even attain siddhi without rules, but otherwise strict rules are needed. Inner sincerity can replace discipline; lacking sincerity, the prescribed discipline must be followed.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'अदर वाइज' is Hindi-English for 'otherwise'; he does not define 'vibrating from inside' or what the rules are.
classical_check: Mantra shastra normally demands niyam (rules) for siddhi; allowing siddhi through inner vibration alone is his own view.

gist: He quips that few people have the discipline for rules; most just ring a bell for two minutes.

hindi: whatsapp-web वर्क प्लेस है वहां मंगल बैठा है तो आप सेनापति के पद में होंगे
says: He says the house that is the workplace has Mars seated in it, and in that case you will hold a commander (senapati) type post at work. The caption word 'whatsapp-web' stands where the house number should be; workplace points to the 10th house, so Mars in the 10th gives a command and authority role.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 10th gives a commanding career; the sign shapes what kind of commander: Capricorn (exalted) a top-ranked leader, Aries or Scorpio (own) a natural field commander, Cancer (debilitated) an unsteady command, Gemini a command through words and teams.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th of lagna Aries, the strongest case for a senapati post in defence, police, engineering or large operations.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th of lagna Libra; the command role comes with emotional reactivity and weak backing, so the commander post is shaky.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 10th of lagna Cancer, where Mars is also lord of the 5th and 10th, giving authoritative and decisive leadership.
Derived: Mars in Mercury's sign Gemini in the 10th of lagna Virgo; the command is exercised through negotiation, communication and technical teams more than force.

ambiguity: The house number is lost in the garbled caption ('whatsapp-web'); 10th is inferred from 'workplace', but it could also be the 6th (service), so the 10th reading is medium confidence.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars in the 10th is classically a strong placement for command, discipline and authority (Ruchaka when in own or exalted sign in a kendra).

hindi: सीधा कहा जाता है तुम्हारे ऊपर एक बॉस है लेकिन तुम भी बॉस ही हो बंदा कहता है यस परफेक्टली फाइन
says: He explains the commander post plainly: there is one boss above you, but you are also a boss to others, so you are a second-in-command who gives orders downward while taking orders from above; the person hearing it says that fits him exactly.
cells_derived_method: The Mars-in-10th post carries one superior above and subordinates below. The sign shows who the superior is and how the command is felt: a Sun-ruled sign points to a government-style superior, a Mercury-ruled sign to an administrative or technical one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Leo in the 10th of lagna Scorpio; the boss above is a high-authority or government type and you command a loyal team beneath you.
Derived: Mars in Virgo in the 10th of lagna Sagittarius; the superior is an analytic administrator and you command as a hands-on technical team lead.

ambiguity: It is not stated that this sentence is about Mars; it follows the previous Mars-in-workplace line and is read as a continuation.
classical_check: Classics describe Mars in the 10th as commander or army-chief type; the 'one boss above, boss to others' reading is his own illustration.

hindi: इसी के पास जायदाद है जमीन है इसलिए अग्नि तत्व है
says: He says Mars holds property and land and is the fire element, listing Mars's natural significations; the 'therefore' linking property to fire is his own loose logic.
cells_derived_method: Mars as land and property karaka matters most through the 4th house (land, home) and 2nd house (assets). Its strength by sign decides the outcome.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 4th of lagna Capricorn supports ownership of land and property.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th of lagna Aries makes land and property matters contested or unstable.

ambiguity: The connective 'इसलिए' (therefore) between property and fire element is odd and may be a speech gap; the subject 'इसी' is taken to be Mars from the previous lines.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is bhumi karaka (land) and a fire planet in the classics; the causal link is not classical.

hindi: लाल रंग का इस्तेमाल करने के लिए इसीलिए जो पूजा पाठी लोग हैं उनके लिए कहा गया है लाल बिंदी लगा ले बहन लाल सिंदूर लगा ले
says: As a remedy tied to Mars he says to use the colour red, and for religiously inclined women it has been prescribed to wear a red bindi and red sindoor.
cells_derived_method: Red as a Mars remedy would be emphasised where Mars is Manglik or weak, in houses 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 or in Cancer; he states it generally, not by cell.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the lagna (lagna Cancer), where a red remedy is traditionally most urged to strengthen Mars.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 8th of lagna Aries, a Manglik-type placement where red is used to channel the heat.

ambiguity: It is not clear whether this remedy is only for Mars in the workplace house just discussed or for Mars generally; it is also directed only at women who do puja.
classical_check: Red for Mars is a standard remedy colour; bindi and sindoor as a Mars remedy is a folk-tradition extension, not a textual rule.

hindi: आजकल कोई लगाता नहीं है फिर कहते है शादी में कलेश है
says: He says nobody wears these red marks nowadays and then people complain of discord in their marriage, linking the neglect of the red Mars remedy to marital quarrels.
cells_derived_method: Mars-linked marriage discord is classically read from Mars in 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12; the red-colour link claims the remedy matters most there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th of lagna Cancer is strong yet Manglik; the red remedy is claimed to calm marital friction.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 8th of lagna Virgo, an 8th-house Manglik placement where he would see skipped red marks as feeding quarrels.

ambiguity: 'फिर कहते है' ties discord to not wearing the marks, but he does not say it is the only cause or whether it needs a Mars placement.
classical_check: Manglik discord in marriage is classical; blaming absence of bindi or sindoor for it is a folk claim, not in the classics.

gist: Mimics women's objections: who wears it now, it looks ugly, it is embarrassing, everyone will call me bhabhi ji when I am only a girl.

hindi: अरे भाभी जी तुम्हारे को लगाया इसलिए जाते है तुम्हारी रक्षा र तो कुत्ते घूम रहे हैं
says: Answering the objection, he says the mark is put on for the woman's own protection, because there are 'dogs' roaming around; in other words the red mark works as a protective shield for her.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'कुत्ते' is a metaphor for predatory men; the text 'तुम्हारी रक्षा र' is partly cut so the purpose is read as 'for your protection'.
classical_check: Sindoor as an auspicious and protective mark is traditional; textual jyotish is silent on it as protection.

hindi: इतने कुत्ते घूम रहे हैं सारे के सारे ये शनि राहु केतु हैं जितने कुत्ते घूम रहे हैं
says: He identifies the roaming 'dogs' (lustful, hunting men) as Saturn, Rahu and Ketu: all of them are expressions of those three planets, which he treats as the planets behind predatory and unclean attention.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'कुत्ते' is figurative; it is not clear whether he means men carrying these planets in the chart or men of that nature in general.
classical_check: Ketu is classically the dog; Saturn and Rahu as lowly or predatory is a looser tradition, so partly agrees and partly is his own gloss.

gist: Claims men cannot take their eyes off a woman and women also cannot bear to be ignored.
Jokes about a woman who dressed up, straightened her hair and put on kajal, and complains the 'dog' did not even look; also quips about not seeing black hair at 70.

hindi: इसी का नाम गुरु है बृहस्पति देखता ही नहीं उसे परवाह ही नहीं बीवी साथ हो तब भी नहीं देखना
says: In contrast to the Saturn-Rahu-Ketu 'dogs' he says that a deity-like man who does not look at others, who does not care, is what Guru (Brihaspati, Jupiter) stands for; Jupiter is the principle of restraint and indifference to temptation, even with the wife beside you.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption is broken ('दस को ये कह' runs into the next chunk) and it is unclear whether he means Jupiter in a chart or Jupiter as an ideal quality.
classical_check: Jupiter as guru, dharma and self-restraint is classical; the 'does not look' image is his own.

gist: Caption overlap repeats 'even if the wife is with you, do not look at another woman'.
Says you do look anyway so do not lie, the only difference is you cannot get anything out of it; with the wife present do nothing.

hindi: ये भी ध्यान दे क्योंकि पत्नी भी आपका शुक्र है वही आपको पालन पोषण कर रही माता समाज तो आपका चंद्र भी है
says: He adds that the wife is your Venus, but since she also nurtures and looks after you she plays the role of mother and society, which is the Moon, so the wife carries both a Venus and a Moon significance.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he means the wife is Moon in addition to Venus or the mother and society are the Moon; the parse of 'माता समाज' is uncertain.
classical_check: Venus as wife karaka and Moon as mother and public are classical; Moon as the nurturing side of the wife is his own extension.

gist: Exclamations followed by a garbled line about father, mother as Moon and work that cannot be reconstructed.

hindi: इसलिए हो रहा है क्योंकि आदर सत्कार नहीं रहा प्रेम नहीं रहा ध्यान नहीं है
says: He says the troubles are happening because respect and hospitality are gone, love is gone and attention is missing in the key relationships (father, mother, spouse), meaning the chart's bad results grow from neglect of these relationships.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यह' has no clear referent because the previous line is unreadable; it is taken to refer to the family troubles just described.
classical_check: Classics do not state this; it is a moral and psychological reading, and it is silent on mechanics.

hindi: यह सब ह्यूमन कॉशसनेस का खेल है कुंडली उसको पंप मार देती है
says: He says all of this is a play of human consciousness and the kundali only pumps it up, amplifying what our own awareness and behaviour already carry rather than creating it.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'पंप मार देती है' is colloquial; it means the chart inflates or amplifies, not that it determines the result.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts present the chart as karmic indication, not as an amplifier of consciousness.

gist: Starts a story: once a king went into the forest to hunt, found no game, and was angry and tense.
In his tension and anger the king wandered around and his horse threw him in the middle of the road.
The king drew his sword to kill the horse, then saw the horse simply needed to pass dung, which was why it was restless, and put the sword away.
Still angry, the king blames the horse's dung for the shove, grumbles that he found no game, but has to head back.
There was a sadhu's hut nearby and the sadhu, hearing the king's grumbling, burst out laughing at the angry king.
The king picked up the horse dung and hurled it at the sadhu, who kept on laughing.
The king rode home, forgot the episode, and big problems then began in his life.
The king complains he makes wrong decisions, his ministers do not work properly, and it is not in his fate, so he asks the court astrologer.

hindi: बोले महाराज कोई कृपा की कमी है आपके ऊपर ग्रह तो आपके ठीक चल रहे हैं
says: Inside the story the court astrologer tells the king that his planets are running fine, so the trouble comes from some lack of grace (kripa) upon him; he is saying that bad results can exist even when the chart and periods look good, because of missing blessing from a past wrong.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is a story line, so it is a narrative device for his point and not a chart rule; 'ग्रह ठीक चल रहे हैं' could mean dasha, transit or natal strength.
classical_check: Classics allow karma and papa beyond the chart (prayashchitta ideas) but give no chart-based test for 'lack of grace'; silent on this.

hindi: तो बोले मैं करूं क्या यार कहां जाऊं बोले अब जाओ कोई संत ढूंढो
says: Told that grace is lacking, the king asks what to do and where to go, and the advice is to go and find a saint; so the prescribed remedy for a missing-grace problem is to seek out a saint, not to do a planet-based remedy.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: This is story dialogue; it is not stated as a general rule for all people.
classical_check: Sant-darshan and seva as a remedy is traditional; the planet-based classical remedies are not used in this answer.

gist: The saint is far away in the forest and the king must go alone; he sets off and the forest road starts to look familiar.
The king recalls he came here to hunt and found nothing, and guesses the saint's influence may have prevented any hunting.
He reaches the saint, sees a huge mountain of horse dung near him, and is puzzled how such a saint can have it.
The king touches the saint's feet, the saint laughs again and asks why he came, and the king says he is amazed at so much horse dung.
The king asks what the dung mountain is doing there and the saint says it was given by the king himself.
The king, confused, realises it was that day's angry act and says he committed a great sin.

hindi: बोले बेटा कोई बात नहीं बोले लेकिन इतना बड़ा पहाड़ बेटा वो संत है हम तो हमें कोई कुछ दे दे तो उसके तो कई गुना पलट के देंगे हम
says: The saint says whatever someone gives a saint, he returns many times over, which is why one thrown handful of dung has become a mountain; the principle is that what we give, including insult, comes back multiplied by the receiver's greatness.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is a story line, so it is a moral about karma; he does not state it as a chart rule.
classical_check: Karma returning with interest is a Puranic idea; the classical jyotish texts are silent on multiplied return from a saint.

gist: The king repeats his troubles, says the royal astrologer found his planets and transits fine but grace lacking, confesses the sin and begs for a way to release.
The saint says since the king has come he will show a way out, as saints do, and tells him to do a certain thing.
The saint recalls that the king got angry at him, insulted him and abused him for laughing and smiling.

hindi: तो बेटा अब ऐसा करो अब तुम अपने पर निंदा करवाओ लोग तुम पर हंसे भूके गाली बके मजाक बनाए तो जितनी निंदा है हजारों लोगों में बट जाएगी तो तुम्हारा ये कोटा कट जाएगा
says: The saint's remedy is to let yourself be criticised in public: let people laugh at you, abuse you and mock you, so the blame owed for insulting a saint gets divided among thousands of people and your karmic quota is cut. It is a remedy-by-humiliation claim for a sin of insulting a saint.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption is rough ('भूके' probably means 'थूके' or 'फूके'); the story ends in the next batch, so how the king applies it is not shown here.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish; it is a folk and Puranic style prayashchitta, not a chart-based remedy.

gist: The king asks whether he should get himself insulted, and the saint's reply begins; the story continues into the next section.

hindi: ऐसा कुछ करना जो तुमने सच में ना किया हो नहीं तो किए का फल मिल जाएगा होना ड्रामा है लेकिन करना है ये दिखावे के लिए
says: Finishing the saint's advice, he says the remedial act must be something you have not truly done, because a real wrong act would bring a real fruit; it is staged drama, but it has to be performed, for show. A remedy works as an acted-out symbolic deed, not as a genuine repeat of the sin.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The opening words continue the saint's instruction from the previous section, so the start of the thought is cut by the batch boundary.
classical_check: Symbolic or enacted prayashchitta is traditional; the classics do not state this 'drama must not be real' wording, so silent.

hindi: जब ग्रहों के दोष हटाते हैं तो दिखावे के लिए हम पूजा पाठ कराते हैं यज्ञ कराते हैं दिखावे के लिए
says: He generalises from the story: when we remove planetary doshas we get puja-path and yajna performed, and these are all 'for show', meaning symbolic enactments whose job is to cut the energy of the dosha and not to bargain with the planet directly.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'दिखावे' (show) is his word for symbolic; he does not mean fake or useless, but a listener could read it as dismissive.
classical_check: Puja and yajna as graha-shanti remedies are classical; calling them dramatised symbolic acts is his framing, not the texts'.

hindi: विष्णु विवाह होता है विष्णु जी से शादी कराते हैं लड़की की घड़े से शादी कराते हैं पीपल से कराते हैं अलग-अलग ग्रहों के लिए ये दिखावा होता है ड्रामा किया जाता है ऊर्जा कटती है
says: He names symbolic marriages as examples of such staged remedies: marrying the girl to Vishnu, to a pot, or to a peepal tree, each done for different planets; it is drama but the energy of the dosha is cut by it.
cells_derived_method: By tradition these symbolic marriages are prescribed for a delayed or endangered marriage, mainly from Mars (Manglik) placements in 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12 and from harsh planets in the 7th or 8th. He does not tie each marriage to a specific planet, so the cells below are only where the remedy would be called for.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 7th of lagna Libra is a Manglik placement on the marriage house, where a pot or peepal marriage would be prescribed in this tradition.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 8th of lagna Aries is the classic risk-to-spouse placement for which these enacted marriages are used.

ambiguity: 'अलग-अलग ग्रहों के लिए' says different planets but gives no mapping of which marriage goes with which planet; the gender of the person is taken as female because he says 'लड़की'.
classical_check: Kumbh, Ashwattha and Vishnu vivah are classical or traditional remedies for Manglik and widowhood-type doshas; the 'for different planets' mapping is not given.

gist: Next day the king sits at a crossroads with a liquor bottle and his royal crown, with no guards or commander, and the world is amazed.
Everyone spits in disgust and thinks the king has become corrupt, wondering what will happen to their city and cursing him.
Onlookers mock that he visits the dancing girls and keeps bad company, a gambler, a trader and filthy ministers; the king sits there all day.
The king runs to the saint that same night and, on arriving, sees what has happened to the dung.
The mountain of horse dung has vanished and only a small amount of dung is left.
The king says that by the saint's blessing he got so much blame today, he sees his sins cut and the mountain gone, but asks why this little dung remains.

hindi: बोले बेटा जो तुमने दिया वो तो फिर भी तुम्हारा कर्म है चाहे कुछ भी उखाड़ लो वो तो तुम पड़ेगा अब इस लीद को खु खुद उठा के ले जाओ
says: The saint answers that the original thing you gave is still your own karma, and whatever you try, that part will fall on you; so carry this remaining dung away yourself. The remedy removes the compounded pile but not the base deed, which you must bear.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'वो तो तुम पड़ेगा' is garbled and is read as 'it will fall on you'.
classical_check: Prarabdha that must be experienced even after remedies is a standard idea; the classics say remedies only soften, so it agrees in spirit.

hindi: यह वो 12 पर है आप कुछ भी कर लो कितना बड़े से बड़ा कर्म कर लो जो आपने किया है वह पलट के आएगा और 12 पर मींस वह हटेगा नहीं
says: He says there is a remaining part that cannot be removed: whatever you do and however large a remedial deed you perform, what you originally did will turn back on you, and this residue will not go away. The caption's '12 पर' seems to label that unremovable remainder.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: '12 पर' is garbled and may be '1 percent' or '12 percent' or the twelfth house; the size of the unremovable residue is not clear, only that it stays.
classical_check: Classics hold that some prarabdha is unavoidable; the numeric share is his own and is not found in the texts.

hindi: व मुन्ना है आपका मुन्ना है बृहस्पति और शनि बृहस्पति है छनु मुन्ना है शनि
says: He gives pet nicknames to Jupiter and Saturn, calling them your own 'munna' pair, with Saturn as Munna and Jupiter under another pet name; he is singling out these two planets as the personal pair he is about to name the pawns and the pulls around.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The nicknames 'मुन्ना' and 'छनु' are garbled; the meaning beyond 'these two planets are the special pair' is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter and Saturn as the two slow, karmic planets is a common view, but the pet-name framing is his own.

hindi: शनि के प्यादे हैं राहु केतु इंद्र वरुण यम
says: He says the pawns (foot soldiers) of Saturn are Rahu, Ketu, Indra (Uranus), Varuna (Neptune) and Yama (Pluto), putting these five under Saturn as his subordinates.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Whether 'pawns' means Saturn rules them, gives them his results, or just that they move under his lead is not stated.
classical_check: Partly differs: Parashara says Rahu acts like Saturn and Ketu like Mars, so Rahu under Saturn fits and Ketu does not; Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are modern and not in the classical texts.

hindi: यह सारे के सारे अंतरिक्ष में हमारे सर्वाइवल के लिए हमें खींच रहे हैं
says: He says all of these bodies are pulling us from space for our survival, that is, the dark outer planets act as a pull that keeps us alive and on our karmic track, and not only as troublemakers.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ये सारे' is taken to be the pawns just listed, but it could mean all planets; 'survival' is not defined.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that planets physically pull us for survival is not classical and is his own physics-style framing.

hindi: एक देवता होता है असुर असुर सुर नहीं है उसका कोई बेसुरा
says: He plays on the word asura: an asura is also a deity, but a-sur means not in tune (besura), so asuras are deities who are out of tune or disturbed. In his scheme this is the group of dark or outer planets, which he confirms later when he lists them as the ones that must be set 'in sur'.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence itself does not name the planets; the mapping to Rahu, Ketu, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto is taken from his later lines, and the caption phrase before it ('डब् सि में') is unreadable.
classical_check: Asura here is a wordplay and not a planet label in the classics; the classics link Venus (Shukracharya) with the asuras, which differs from his mapping.

hindi: जब जब आपके जीवन के अंदर एडी एचडी आ रहा है मानसिक प्रेशर आ रहा है तनाव आ रहा है डिप्रेशन हो रहा है थायराइड प्रॉब्लम हो रही है और आप कुछ सिस्टम से नहीं चल रहे आपके असुर डिस्टर्ब है
says: He says that whenever ADHD, mental pressure, stress, depression or thyroid problems appear and you are not running life by any system, it means your asuras (the out-of-tune dark planets) are disturbed. Medical conditions are named here only as his claim, not endorsed and not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence does not say which planets he means by asuras (inferred from his later list), nor which house or sign shows the disturbance; the sentence also runs into the next caption block.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts tie mind and nerve troubles to Moon, Mercury and Rahu with the 4th, 5th and 6th houses, and do not mention the outer planets or ADHD.

hindi: असुर देवता है यानी उस असुर को ठीक करना है तो वहां क्या करो वहां असुर की फोटो लगा दो कौन असुर एलियंस प्रेडेटर्स
says: Since an asura is a deity, the way to correct a disturbed asura is to place a picture of an asura in that zone, and he names aliens and predators as the kind of asura images to use. This is a vastu-type picture remedy for the dark planets.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'वहां' (that zone) is not defined; it likely means the vastu zone tied to the disturbed planet, but he does not give direction or house.
classical_check: Silent: picture-placement of aliens or predators is not a classical remedy and has no textual basis.

hindi: हमने जो लगाई हम वही बता रहे हैं बाकी हमें पता नहीं है किसी भी असुर की फोटो वो लगा दीजिए उस जोन के अंदर आपके असुर ठीक होंगे
says: He adds a caveat: he reports only what he himself has put up and says he does not know beyond that, and that the photo of any asura placed within that zone will set your asuras right. The remedy comes from his own practice, not a rule he can source.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Which zone ('जोन') is meant is still not said; he states that any asura image works but gives no size, count or direction.
classical_check: Silent; he himself says it is only his own experience.

hindi: ये वो असुर है जो कृपा दे रहे हैं यह जो निंदा कर रहे हैं लोग आपकी आप उसको गाली बक रहे
says: He says the people who are criticising you are themselves the asuras giving you grace; by absorbing your blame they cut your karma, yet you answer them with abuse and waste the gift.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is not clear if the critics are asuras in the sense of the dark planets or only that they play the asura role; no planet is named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish; it is a karmic-moral view.

gist: Two sisters fight: one abuses the other, the other abuses back harder, so they are equal and both have built mountains of horse dung.

hindi: कर दी कर दी भाई खत्म कर ले तू मर मैंने तुझसे ली ही नहीं लीद तेरे घर पर आकर तेरे सिर गिरेगी तू ही मरेगी
says: If someone throws abuse at you and you do not accept it (you did not take the dung from them), the abuse comes back and falls on the giver's own head; so the way to stop the quarrel is to refuse to receive the insult.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is a sister's voice in an illustration, so 'तू मर' is a figure of speech; he is not predicting anyone's death.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish; it echoes the Buddhist and Puranic idea of an unaccepted gift returning to the giver.

gist: Asks why we fight and answers that it is a habit, our 'chhain' switches on and says it will hit.
When the first sister could not be hurt, the other began beating herself, and the 'Chhenu' arrived to beat and then leave.

hindi: यदि आपके पास कोई निंदा कर रहा है आपकी आपका ग्रह कट रहा है आप यह मत सोचो किसी ने गाली बकी है तो उसने जिंदगी नर्क कर दी नहीं वो आप पर बड़ा भारी एहसान कर रहा है
says: If someone is criticising you, then your planetary affliction is being cut; do not think the abuser has ruined your life, because he is doing you a very heavy favour. He treats public criticism as a way the grahas are cleared, and says to be thankful and not retaliate.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not say which planet is cut, or whether it works for all planets, or for any criticism or only unjust criticism.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; this is a folk-karmic claim.

hindi: इसलिए जो मर्जी कर लो बृहस्पति और शनि यह दो ग्रह हैं जिनके लिए आपको करेक्शन करनी अत्यावश्यक है क्योंकि यहां पर आपके प्रारब्ध रहते हैं
says: He says that whatever else you do, Jupiter and Saturn are the two planets for which correction is absolutely essential, because your prarabdha (destiny karma) lives in these two. Remedies should therefore be aimed first at Jupiter and Saturn.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यहां पर' (here) is not clear: it could mean in these planets, or in their houses and signs; he does not say how correction is done.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Saturn is the classical karaka of karma and Jupiter of dharma and merit; the claim that prarabdha lives only in these two is his own emphasis.

hindi: यह आपके ग्रह हैं नस अर्थ मार्स फलाना ढिकाना वगैरह वगैरह यूरेनस नेप्चून और यहां है आपका प्लूटो यम
says: He rattles off the rest of your planets as one layout of the sky: Venus, Earth, Mars and so on, then Uranus, Neptune, and out at the edge Pluto as Yama; in his scheme these all belong to your chart as planets alongside Jupiter and Saturn.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'नस अर्थ मार्स' is garbled (likely 'Venus, Earth, Mars'); Earth is not one of his twelve planets, so it may be a loose astronomical list, and 'फलाना ढिकाना' skips names.
classical_check: Differs: the classics use only the seven visible planets plus Rahu and Ketu, and do not count Earth, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto as grahas.

hindi: यह जुपिटर इधर खींच रहा है सबको और शनि इसको खींच रहा है शनि जुपिटर को खींच रहा है यह जुपिटर बड़ा है तो सूरज इसको नहीं खींच रहा इसको खींच रहा है
says: He describes a hierarchy of pull: Jupiter, being huge, pulls everything, Saturn in turn pulls Jupiter, the Sun is not the one pulling Jupiter, and then the smaller bodies pull backwards; so Saturn sits at the top of the chain of control and Jupiter just under it.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption is very jumbled and the order of who pulls whom is partly guessed from the repeated phrases; he uses gravity as a metaphor and the exact claim is unclear.
classical_check: Differs: in astronomy the Sun dominates every planet's orbit, so 'the Sun is not pulling Jupiter' is not correct; the classics have no gravity chain.

hindi: तो जुपिटर को संभाला हुआ है आपके जीवन के सारे ज्ञान को ज्ञान होता है
says: He says Jupiter is the planet that holds and keeps all the knowledge of your life; knowledge in every form is under Jupiter's care.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'संभाला हुआ है' could mean Jupiter holds, supports or controls knowledge; the earlier gravity talk may be the basis of 'holds'.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of knowledge, wisdom and teachers.

hindi: सारे ज्ञान को संभालने वाला कौन है चिजी बिना लक्ष्मी विष्णु नहीं और बिना विष्णु लक्ष्मी नहीं प्रकृति नहीं तो पुरुष नहीं पुरुष नहीं तो प्रकृति नहीं
says: Asking who holds all that knowledge, he answers with inseparable pairs: there is no Vishnu without Lakshmi and no Lakshmi without Vishnu, no Purusha without Prakriti and no Prakriti without Purusha; knowledge (Jupiter) cannot stand alone and needs its counterpart.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not say here which planet is Lakshmi or Prakriti; from the next line about feet and Saturn the partner is read as Saturn, and 'चिजी' is an unclear filler word.
classical_check: The Purusha-Prakriti pair is Samkhya and Puranic; the classics do not map it to Jupiter and Saturn, so this mapping is his own.

hindi: यानी आपके जितने प्यादे हैं यह पैर शनि आपके जीवन में जितनी बीमारी आएगी सारी की सारी बीमारी के लिए डॉक्टर कहेगा चलो शर करो चलो हिलो
says: He links Saturn with the feet and with your 'pawns', and says that for every illness that will come in life the doctor's answer is the same, 'walk, move'; the feet and movement are the handle on Saturn and its pawns. Health advice is recorded as his claim, not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यह पैर शनि' is read as 'these are the feet, Saturn'; the caption word 'शर करो' probably means 'start' (शुरू करो).
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn is classically tied to legs, bones and slow movement; walking as a universal cure is not a classical rule.

hindi: जब तक ये चलाओगे नहीं आपके शनि राहु केतु यूरेनस नेप्चून पलूटो ये सेट नहीं होंगे ये असुर सुर में नहीं आएंगे
says: Until you actually make your legs and body move, your Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto will not get set and the asuras will not come into tune (sur); so physical movement is the prescribed way to settle the whole dark-planet group.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ये चलाओगे' is taken as 'if you do not make this (legs) move'; he gives no duration or distance.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text ties walking to Rahu, Ketu or the outer planets; the Saturn link to physical labour is partial agreement.

hindi: बॉडी ठीक करनी है चलो पेट ठीक करना है चलो सिर का दर्द गैस परेशानी सब चलो
says: He lists body ailments, a weak body, stomach trouble, headache and gas, and gives the single advice 'walk' for all of them. Health advice recorded as his claim only, not endorsed as treatment.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence; the Saturn and asura link is carried over from the lines before it.
classical_check: Silent; walking as a health practice is general advice, not a jyotish rule.

hindi: तो चलने फिरने वाले जितने लोग हैं आपकी गाड़ी चलती फिरती है आपका सेवक चलता फिरता है आपके सेवा करने वाला व्यक्ति काम करता है
says: He lists the things and people that keep moving for you, your vehicle, your servant and anyone who serves you, as belonging to the same moving, service side that he has just tied to Saturn; he does not name Saturn in this sentence.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The planet is only implied from the 'feet and walking' context; vehicles are classically Venus, so the vehicle item may not belong under Saturn.
classical_check: Servants and labour as Saturn is classical; vehicles as Saturn differs, since the classics give vehicles to Venus (and the 4th house).

gist: Observes that husbands send wives to fetch things and wives send husbands to the market, as an everyday example of running errands.

hindi: ये चलना ये आपके बृहस्पति को ठीक रखेगा यानी आपकी बुद्धि को ठीक रखे
says: He claims this habit of walking and moving will keep your Jupiter in good order, which he spells out as keeping your intellect (buddhi) sound; the legs (Saturn) are the route to keeping Jupiter healthy.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Saturn appears only by context (legs and movement); the sentence itself names only Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent; the classics have no remedy linking walking to Jupiter, though Jupiter is the karaka of intellect.

hindi: अगर आपका गुरु ठीक है तो गुरु सूर्य भी उसके आगे झुकता है चंद्रमा भी झुकता है मंगल भी बुध भी शुक्र भी शनि भी गुरु ठीक
says: He says that if your Jupiter (Guru) is in good shape, then the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn all bow before it, so a sound Jupiter lifts the whole chart and the other planets act in its favour.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is 'fine' when it is in an own or exalted sign or in a kendra or trikona, and not hurt by Rahu; the sign and house decide how strong the bowing effect is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st of lagna Cancer is the strongest case of a sound Jupiter lifting the whole chart.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 7th of lagna Cancer is a weak Jupiter, so the claim that the other planets bow to it would carry little force here.

ambiguity: 'ठीक' is not defined (sign dignity, house or aspects), and 'झुकता है' is figurative.
classical_check: Agrees in part: a strong Jupiter in a kendra is said to remove many doshas; the claim that all planets bow to it is his emphasis.

hindi: है तो सब ठीक है आपका गुरु आपसे प्रसन्न है सब प्रसन्न है आपका इष्ट आपसे प्रसन्न है आपके आपका सब कुछ प्रसन्न है
says: Continuing, if Jupiter is fine everything is fine, and when your guru (Jupiter) is pleased with you then everyone is pleased and your Ishta is pleased with you too; he joins Jupiter's condition to the happiness of your teacher and your chosen deity.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'गुरु' can mean the planet Jupiter or your human teacher, and the sentence moves between them.
classical_check: Silent on Ishta pleasure through Jupiter; Jupiter as the guru karaka is classical.

hindi: कई दोष खत्म हो जाएंगे कई दोष समाप्त क्योंकि जुपिटर का मुकाबला नहीं है
says: He says many doshas will end because Jupiter has no equal; a strong Jupiter cancels a large number of chart afflictions since no other planet can match it.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not name which doshas are cancelled.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts say a strong Jupiter in a kendra destroys many doshas.

hindi: इस जुपिटर को नाश कौन करता है जुपिटर को सिर्फ खराब करता है राहु यानी कि बुद्धि भ्रष्ट हो गई
says: Asked who destroys Jupiter, he answers that only Rahu spoils Jupiter, which means the intellect gets corrupted; Rahu is the planet that damages Jupiter's wisdom.
cells_derived_method: Rahu spoils Jupiter by conjunction or aspect; the house and sign of Jupiter show which area of knowledge is clouded.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 9th of lagna Aries with Rahu, where belief, teachers and higher learning get tainted by unorthodox or confused thinking.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 5th of lagna Scorpio with Rahu, where intelligence and judgement about children and studies are clouded.

ambiguity: The word 'सिर्फ' (only) is strong and may mean Rahu is the main spoiler and not the only one; he does not state conjunction or aspect.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Guru-Chandala yoga is the classical Jupiter-Rahu spoiling; but the classics also let Saturn, Mercury and the 6th, 8th and 12th lords harm Jupiter, so 'only Rahu' differs.

hindi: किसी दूसरे इंटॉक्सिकेशन में आ गए शराब कबाब असुर ले लिए आपने कोई वीड ले ली तो आपका ज्ञान उड़ जाएगा
says: He warns that falling into any other intoxication, liquor, meat (kebab), or weed, makes your knowledge fly away, treating intoxicants as the way Rahu destroys Jupiter. It is a do-not claim, recorded only as his tradition view.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'असुर ले लिए' is garbled; it could be 'सुरा' (liquor) or 'asura-type' food; the meaning is read as a third intoxicant.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts forbid intoxicants for Jupiter-minded or sattvik life and link intoxication with Rahu; the exact wording is his.

hindi: अगर गुरु मजबूत है तो वीड लेकर आप ज्यादा ज्ञानी हो जाओगे
says: He claims that if Jupiter is strong, then taking weed will make you more knowledgeable, reversing the earlier warning when Jupiter is weak. This is recorded only as his statement; drug use is not endorsed and nothing here is advice.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not define 'strong' Jupiter, and the claim contradicts classical restraint; he may be speaking in a half-joking way.
classical_check: Differs: the classics prohibit intoxicants whatever the strength of Jupiter and give no support for gaining wisdom through them.

gist: Says that once you become knowing you will see right and wrong are ultimately just games of the mind.
Says there is right, wrong, and neither, comparing it to the electron, proton and neutron triple.

hindi: गलत भी ईश्वर कर रहा है तो किसी कारण से कर रहा है आपके प्रारब्ध कट रहे हैं
says: He says even the wrong done to you is being done by God for a reason, and the reason is that your prarabdha is being cut; so apparent harm is read as karmic clearing, and not as a pure evil.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence begins in one caption block and ends in the next; 'ईश्वर' may mean God or the Ishta; it is a philosophical position, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish; compatible with the prarabdha-exhaustion view in Vedanta.

hindi: इसीलिए मंगल के ऊपर से चले थे हम मंगल आपके जीवन के अंदर अमंगल होने से बचाता है
says: He recalls why the discussion began from Mars and says Mars (Mangal) saves your life from inauspiciousness (amangal); the name itself is read as the planet that protects from bad events.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'मंगल के ऊपर से चले थे हम' probably refers to earlier talk on Mars, perhaps the red-colour remedy; the exact reference is not clear.
classical_check: Mars as Mangala (auspicious) is a name-based reading; classically Mars is a malefic, so the protective role is his gloss.

hindi: इसलिए विवाह की पद्धति अग्नि वाली बहुत मजबूत है
says: Because Mars is fire and guards against inauspiciousness, he says the marriage ritual done around the sacred fire is very strong and protective.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The link to Mars is implied from the previous sentence; 'अग्नि वाली' is the pheras around the fire.
classical_check: Agni-sakshi marriage is Vedic; tying its strength to Mars is his own link.

hindi: लेकिन जब जानकारी ना हो तो ठीक है जी कोर्ट मैरिज कर लो साइन मैरिज कर लो गंधर्व विवाह कर लो ऐसे ही साथ रह लो लेकिन ब्लेसिंग्स नहीं मिलेंगी
says: Without the knowledge or means for the fire ritual, he allows court marriage, signing marriage, gandharva marriage or simply living together, but warns that no blessings will come with them. The unions are acceptable but lack the protective grace of the ritual marriage.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ब्लेसिंग्स' is not defined (divine, elders' or Jupiter-related); it is not said whether the lack of blessings brings real harm.
classical_check: Gandharva marriage is one of the eight classical forms and is accepted in the texts; the claim that it lacks blessings is his own view.

hindi: इसलिए और कुछ मिले ना मिले गुरु की ब्लेसिंग्स जरूर ले लो
says: His advice is that whether or not you get anything else, you must take the blessings of your guru; so seeking the guru's blessing is the one remedy to hold on to.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'गुरु' may mean the human teacher or Jupiter; he moves between them.
classical_check: Guru seva as a Jupiter remedy is traditional and agrees.

hindi: आपके लिए जीवन जीवन में सूर्य चंद्र का बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट हिसाब है सारा का सारा हिसाब किताब सेट हो जाएगा
says: He says the account between the Sun and the Moon in your life is very important, and that once it is set, the whole of your life's accounting will fall into place; Sun and Moon are the two lights that the rest of the chart depends on.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'हिसाब' is not defined; it could be the Sun-Moon relation by house, aspect or lunar phase, or father and mother; the conditional part is missing.
classical_check: Sun and Moon as the two luminaries are central in the classics; the 'accounting' phrase is his, so only broadly agrees.

hindi: शुक्र जो है यह देवी है स्त्री मानी जाती है और सौंदर्य की देवी है यह आपके जीवन के सारे आनंद है
says: He describes Venus as a goddess, regarded as female and as the goddess of beauty, and says it holds all the pleasures and joys of your life.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: None significant; 'देवी' here is a figure of speech for Venus as a feminine planet.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of beauty, pleasure, women and the arts.

hindi: इसी के पास बायोलॉजी सब्जेक्ट है आपका अगर शुक्र में खराबी है शुक्र वक्री है तो आपका बायोलॉजी वीक होगा ही बच्चे के बायो में नंबर नहीं आएंगे
says: He assigns the subject of biology to Venus and says that if Venus is flawed or retrograde, the child's biology will be weak and the child will not score in biology; this is a school-subject link, not a general rule on intelligence.
cells_derived_method: Venus is read for biology in the study houses (4th for school learning, 5th for intelligence); its sign dignity and retrograde state decide the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 4th of lagna Gemini, so school-level science, and biology in particular, comes out weak.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 5th of lagna Scorpio, giving an easy grasp of living-world subjects and a good chance of high biology marks.

ambiguity: He does not say how much flaw or which kind of flaw (afflicted, combust, retrograde, weak in sign) counts; 'वक्री' is named explicitly.
classical_check: Silent on biology; the classics give Mercury and the 4th and 5th houses to studies, and Venus is only partly tied to life sciences through procreation, so this is largely his own assignment.

hindi: 16 साल की एक विशेष होती है 15 और 16 जब बृहस्पति यदि खराब है तो काम नहीं करता
says: He says the ages 15 and 16 are special for Jupiter, and that if Jupiter is bad it does not work, meaning a child with a weak Jupiter will falter around this age, especially in studies.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's results are expected to switch on at about 16, and its house and sign decide where the failure shows; a Jupiter weak by sign or house will show it most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th of lagna Libra, so a slump in schooling around age 15-16 is the expected form.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th of lagna Leo, so the 15-16 age turn is expected to hold or improve academic work.

ambiguity: 'ख़राब' is not defined, and the sentence is cut at the end of the caption block, so it is unclear whether it means that Jupiter fails to deliver or turns negative.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the classical graha-maturity ages put Jupiter at 16 years; the texts do not say a weak Jupiter fails school, which is his application.

gist: Mothers often say that up to 15 or 16, class ten, the child was so good and always came first; the sentence is cut off at the end of this section.
Voice of the mother: after that, who knows what evil eye has struck, some aunt (tai) did something.

hindi: निंदा कर दी फ्री में आपको आपने ताई की ताई के तो पाप काटे आपके बढ़ गए
says: He says the aunt criticised you for free, and if you answered by running her down in return, it is the aunt's sins that got cut and your own that grew; retaliating against a critic hands the benefit to the critic and adds to your own load.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption is garbled and the sentence could instead mean that your own criticism of the aunt cut her sins; the reading follows his earlier teaching that critics clear your karma.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish; it is a karmic-moral claim carried over from the saint story.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर तो 15 साल तक जो बच्चा पढ़ता था हालांकि बृहस्पति दोष है उसने पढ़ाई लिखाई डाउन कर दी
says: He gives the case of a child who studied well until age 15 even though Jupiter carries a dosha, and then let studies fall; so a Jupiter dosha tends to show up in studies from around 15 or 16, not before that age.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence is spoken as part of the mother's complaint, so the 'age 15' is an example and may not be a fixed rule; the exact dosha is named next as retrograde.
classical_check: Agrees in part with the classical idea that Jupiter matures at about 16; the claim that its dosha hits studies at that age is his application.

hindi: बृहस्पति का दोष आ गया वक्री हो गया किसी ग्रह के अंदर दोष आया तो हर हालत के अंदर तेज बोलेगा
says: Jupiter's dosha has now come in the form of retrogression, and he states a general rule that when a dosha enters any planet, that planet speaks loudly under every condition; a flawed planet expresses itself more forcefully, not more weakly.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'तेज बोलेगा' may be literal loud speech by the child or a figure for a planet's strong effect; the next sentences read it for the child.
classical_check: Agrees in part: classical texts give a retrograde planet extra strength (cheshta bala), so intensified expression fits, but they do not call it a dosha.

hindi: बृहस्पति के दोष मिनिमम है लेकिन मोस्ट पावरफुल वक्री एक अकेला वक्री एक दोष होता है यह रेडीमेड मिलेगा आपको ना भी समझ आए तो कुंडली में लिखा होगा व वक्री
says: He says Jupiter has only a few doshas, but the most powerful of them is retrogression; a lone retrograde Jupiter is itself one dosha, and it comes ready-made because the chart simply prints the retrograde mark, so even a beginner can spot it.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not list the other minimal Jupiter doshas; 'अकेला वक्री' may mean retrograde without any other affliction.
classical_check: Differs: Parashara treats a retrograde planet as strong (cheshta bala) and the results as intensified, not as a dosha; calling retro Jupiter the main Jupiter dosha is his own view.

hindi: वक्री ग्रह अगर है तो वह बच्चा तेज चिल्लाएगा उसकी कंसंट्रेशन टोटल लॉस होगी पढ़ने लिखने में किताब क्या दिख गई सामने उसको नींद आएगी मौत पड़ेगी उसे मैं पढ़ना ही नहीं चाहता
says: With a retrograde Jupiter the child will shout loudly and lose concentration totally in studies; the moment a book appears he becomes sleepy, as if hit by death, and says he does not want to study at all. These are behaviour claims, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He says 'वक्री ग्रह' without naming Jupiter in this sentence, but the whole passage is on retrograde Jupiter; 'मौत पड़ेगी' is figurative.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give no such behavioural profile for a retrograde Jupiter.

hindi: क्योंकि ज्ञान वक्र हो गया है उलट गया है तो वो कहां जाएगा अज्ञान की तो वो उल्टी चीजों में परम ज्ञानी हो जाएगा
says: Because the knowledge karaka has gone crooked and reversed, the child is pushed away from ordinary subjects and becomes supremely knowledgeable in the opposite, unconventional things; retrograde Jupiter turns learning toward the reverse side of ordinary study.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'उल्टी चीजें' is not defined: it could mean occult, rebellious, unconventional or non-school subjects.
classical_check: Silent; a link between retrograde benefics and unorthodox knowledge is a later astrological view and not a classical rule.

hindi: बृहस्पति तो गुरु है ज्ञान है ज्ञान तो देगा ही तो उल्टी चीजों का ज्ञानी हो जाएगा और उसको धरती पर कोई समझा नहीं सकता क्योंकि गुरु है इसलिए गुरु वक्री है आपका
says: Since Jupiter is the guru and is knowledge, it will give knowledge in any case, so the child turns knowledgeable in reversed subjects, and no one on earth can persuade him because he himself acts as the guru; this is why a child with retrograde Jupiter resists being taught.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next caption block ('आपका बच्चा').
classical_check: Silent on teachability; Jupiter as guru is classical.

hindi: बच्चा अगर ये कहता है कि मुझे मत समझाओ मुझे मत बताओ मुझे आता है मैं कर लूंगा चार डायलॉग है ये फिक्स है चारों यही बोलेगा
says: He gives a recognition test for a retrograde-Jupiter child: four fixed lines, 'do not explain to me', 'do not tell me', 'I know it' and 'I will do it myself'; he says the child will speak all four.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He calls them four dialogues but lists the four lines loosely; 'ये फिक्स है' means the pattern is fixed for this placement.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural signature his own observation.

gist: Jokes that when you tell the mother about the retrograde Jupiter she will gush 'you are God', and being called God by people feels so good you will love it.

hindi: ईगो बढ़ेगी ईगो कहां बढ़ती है जुपिटर पे
says: He says ego will grow when people treat you like God, and that ego grows on Jupiter, so Jupiter (and above all a retrograde one) is the planet that swells with ego and the sense of being special.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is not clear whether ego is a general Jupiter trait or only of a retrograde Jupiter.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give ego and pride to the Sun, and Jupiter is humility and wisdom; this mapping is his own.

hindi: जुपिटर कहां है आपका स्वाधिष्ठान स्वाधिष्ठान में कौन रहता है छैन
says: He places Jupiter in your body at the Svadhisthana (sacral) chakra, and says the one who lives there is 'Chhain', his pet name for the Jupiter ego-self, so the ego sits at that chakra.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'छैन' is a caption form of 'छेनू/छनु', which he earlier used as a nickname for Jupiter ('बृहस्पति है छनु'); it is taken as the same.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; it matches a common tantric-astrological scheme (Muladhara Saturn, Svadhisthana Jupiter, Anahata Venus).

hindi: ईगो बढ़ेगी आपको जब यह पता होगा तो वो ईगो आपके काम आएगी अगर आपकी ो बढ़ रही है और आपको पता नहीं है तो काम नहीं आएगी
says: He says the growing ego becomes useful to you only when you know that it is growing; if it rises without your awareness it is of no use, so awareness is what turns the Jupiter ego into an asset.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The word 'ईगो' is clipped ('ो बढ़ रही है') in the caption; the subject is read as ego.
classical_check: Silent; it is a psychological and spiritual point, not a jyotish rule.

hindi: मुन्ना तो काम करता ही है जब छेन काम करेगा तो रॉकेट की तरह उठाएगा रॉकेट आपके हजार गुना स्पीड होगी
says: Munna (Saturn) works on its own all the time; when Chhain (Jupiter) is also put to work consciously it lifts you like a rocket at a thousand times the speed, so Jupiter running together with Saturn is the high-speed state.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is taken as Saturn and 'छेन' as Jupiter from his earlier pet names; a thousand-fold is figurative.
classical_check: Silent; the pet-name scheme and the speed claim are his own.

hindi: नोट छाप तो अंधा लोगों से मिलोगे अंधाधुन आपने मुंह से जो बोल दिया पूर्ण क्योंकि बृहस्पति पकड़ में आ गया
says: He says that once Jupiter is caught (mastered) you will print money, meet well-placed people, and whatever you say with your mouth will come true; wealth and fulfilled speech are the rewards of mastering Jupiter. This is an outcome claim and not investment advice.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'अंधा लोगों से मिलोगे अंधाधुन' is garbled; it may mean meeting rich or powerful people, or being wildly lucky; 'पकड़ में आ गया' means mastered or understood.
classical_check: Silent; speech that comes true (vak siddhi) is a tantric idea and Jupiter-as-wealth is classical only in general terms.

hindi: साक्षी भाव मेट्रिक्स फिल्म देखिए आखिर में जो नियो है तीसरा नेत्र वह जीतता ही मुन्ना से
says: He recommends the witness attitude (sakshi bhav) and points to the film Matrix, where Neo at the end, with his third eye, wins against Munna (Saturn, the mind); awareness is shown as the way to beat the mind.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The sentence spills into the next block; Munna is taken as Saturn, which he makes explicit later when he says the mind shuts.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as mind is not classical (Moon is the mind), and the film is only an illustration.

hindi: साक्षी भाव से मुन्ना से जीता ही साक्षी भाव से जा सकता है अदर वाइज सवाल ही नहीं होता
says: Munna (Saturn, the mind) can be beaten only through the witness attitude; he insists on this as the single route and says otherwise there is no question of winning.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'जीता जा सकता है' may mean winning over Saturn's effects or over the mind itself.
classical_check: Silent; classical Saturn remedies are service, discipline and charity, not witnessing.

hindi: कहते मन को कंट्रोल करो वो कंट्रोल होने वाली चीज ही नहीं है कौन नहीं है कंट्रोल होने वाली चीज यह बृहस्पति और शनि
says: People say 'control the mind', but he says it is not a thing that can be controlled, naming Jupiter and Saturn as the two that cannot be controlled; they can only be watched or worked with and not forced.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He equates the mind with these two planets without saying which part of the mind is which.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give the mind to the Moon, so tying it to Jupiter and Saturn is his own scheme.

hindi: यह कहां रहते हैं नीचे के चक्र पर यह बति है यह शनि है यह चक्र है यह वो इलाका है जहां पर आपके जीवन के अंदर सब कुछ बनता है
says: He says Jupiter and Saturn live in the lower chakras of the body, and that this region is where everything in your life gets made; each planet sits at its own lower chakra, though he does not say here which one is Saturn's.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यह बति' is a clipped 'बृहस्पति'; which exact chakra belongs to Saturn is not stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; it fits the common tantric scheme where Saturn is the root chakra and Jupiter the sacral one.

hindi: अगर आप अपने जीवन के अंदर किसी भी लायक नहीं हो तो यह दोनों चक्र तो चलेंगे आप सुसू करोगे पटी करोगे बच्चे पैदा करोगे खाना खाओगे और मर जाओगे यहां तो कुंडली है ही
says: He says that even if you are fit for nothing in life, these two lower chakras will keep running by default, you will eat, excrete, produce children and die, and the chart (kundali) is at work in this basic survival layer.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यहां तो कुंडली है ही' could mean the birth chart or the coiled kundalini energy; the pun is probably intended.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter for children and Saturn for the lower functions of the body is partly in line with the classics.

hindi: अब गुरु की इज्जत हो रही तो सेवक की भी चाहिए और हम सेवक की ही इज्जत नहीं करते कमाल की बात हो गई यार सेवक की इज्जत करनी है
says: He pairs the guru (Jupiter) with the servant (Saturn) and says that since the guru is honoured, the servant must be honoured too, yet we do not respect our servants; the remedy is to give real respect to servants and service workers.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Saturn is not named in the sentence; 'सेवक' is taken as the Saturn role, which fits his earlier feet-and-service talk.
classical_check: Agrees: respect for servants and the labouring class is the classical Saturn remedy.

gist: Asks who the servant is and answers Arjuna, the guru being Krishna, who washes the chariot wheels, yokes the horses and cleans the seat where the servant will sit.
Completes the picture: while Krishna serves, the servant Arjuna bows to the guru, showing mutual respect between guru and servant.

hindi: बृहस्पति क्या करता है कि कहीं भी कुछ नहीं कर छाया हुआ कहीं पर भी झुकता नहीं
says: He says Jupiter is a planet that bows nowhere; it simply stays spread over everything, overshadowing it, and does not bend to any other planet.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'कुछ नहीं कर छाया हुआ' is rough speech and is read as 'does nothing, just stays overhead'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter is the highest benefic and the preceptor of the gods.

hindi: बृहस्पति बुध के घर गया तो बुद्ध इसका बेटा माना जाता है गले पर एवरेज फल देता है क्योंकि बेटा इससे नफरत करता है लेकिन नेगेटिव नहीं
says: When Jupiter goes to Mercury's house it gives only average results, because Mercury is regarded as Jupiter's son and the son dislikes him, but the result is not negative; the sign of the son dilutes the father's blessing without harming it.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Gemini or Virgo gives middling results in whatever house it falls; the house decides the area where the dilution is felt, and Virgo is also shared with Rahu in his scheme.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 7th of lagna Sagittarius, partnership and marriage run on talk and trade; Jupiter's blessing arrives only in a diluted form.
Derived: Jupiter in Virgo in the 4th of lagna Gemini, home, comforts and schooling are steady but ordinary, with no special lift from Jupiter.

ambiguity: 'गले पर' is a caption slip for 'औसत' or 'ऐसे में'; 'बुध के घर' could mean the signs Gemini and Virgo or just a conjunction with Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter and Mercury are natural enemies in the Parashari table and Jupiter in enemy signs gives mixed results; calling Mercury Jupiter's son rests on the puranic story that Budha was born to Tara, Jupiter's wife, by the Moon.

hindi: शुक्र के पास जाता है तो भी पॉजिटिव नहीं लेकिन नेगेटिव नहीं
says: When Jupiter goes to Venus it is not positive but also not negative, a neutral outcome; the Venus signs neither lift nor harm Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Taurus or Libra gives a flat result in any house; the house shows only the area where nothing much changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 2nd of lagna Aries, wealth and family speech stay neutral, neither a gain nor a loss from Jupiter.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 7th of lagna Aries, marriage and partnerships are neither helped nor harmed by Jupiter.

ambiguity: 'के पास जाता है' could mean being with Venus (conjunction) or in Venus's sign; the signs Taurus and Libra are the sign reading.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter and Venus are natural enemies in Parashara, so a flat or mixed result in Venus's signs is plausible.

hindi: शनि के पास जाता है तो नीच फल देता है बृहस्पति ही नीच का होता है
says: When Jupiter goes to Saturn's place it gives low (neecha) results, and he adds that it is Jupiter that gets debilitated there, meaning Capricorn, Saturn's sign where Jupiter falls.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Capricorn is truly debilitated; in Aquarius it is not, though his rule groups both Saturn signs. The house shows the area that suffers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th of lagna Libra, home and mother matters get low results from Jupiter.
Derived: Jupiter in Saturn's other sign Aquarius in the 10th of lagna Taurus, on his grouping this gives low results in career, though classically Aquarius is no fall for Jupiter.

ambiguity: 'शनि के पास' may mean Saturn's signs (Capricorn, Aquarius) or conjunction with Saturn; only Capricorn is Jupiter's fall, and his 'ही नीच का होता है' points to that sign.
classical_check: Agrees on Capricorn as Jupiter's debilitation; Aquarius is not a fall in the classics, so the grouping of both Saturn signs differs.

hindi: लेकिन फिर भी गुरु है यह नीच में भी नष्ट नहीं करेगा क्योंकि ज्ञान है
says: Even in debilitation Jupiter is still the guru and will not destroy anything, since it is knowledge; a fallen Jupiter gives low results but does not wreck the person.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Jupiter keeps its wisdom in every house; the house decides which area gets the diminished but not destroyed results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th of lagna Taurus, faith and dharma are weak yet the person still keeps basic wisdom.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 1st of lagna Capricorn, the self is modest and unsure but not harmed in its core knowledge.

ambiguity: 'नीच में' follows the Saturn sentence, so it refers to Jupiter's fall in Capricorn.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a debilitated planet is weakened but cancellation (neecha bhanga) can restore it; his 'it does not destroy' is a softer claim.

hindi: राहु के घर जाता है केतु के घर जाता है तब भी खराब नहीं करता
says: When Jupiter goes into Rahu's house or Ketu's house it still does not spoil the results; the shadow-planet signs do not damage Jupiter by themselves.
cells_derived_method: In his scheme Rahu has Virgo (shared with Mercury) and Ketu has Pisces (shared with Jupiter); Jupiter in those signs is unspoiled in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 9th of lagna Cancer, dharma and fortune stay intact and a Ketu-style detachment adds to it.
Derived: Jupiter in Virgo in the 6th of lagna Aries, knowledge of service, health and analysis stays unspoiled even in Rahu's sign.

ambiguity: The sentence does not name the signs; Virgo and Pisces come from his twelve-planet sign lordship (Rahu and Ketu), and it appears to clash with his earlier line that Rahu spoils Jupiter, unless that was about conjunction or intoxicants.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not give Rahu or Ketu any sign in the usual scheme, and Jupiter in Pisces is its own sign, so the claim is partly trivial.

hindi: केतु और बृहस्पति एक ही जगह एक साथ राशि शेयर करते हैं दोनों स्वाधिष्ठान प
says: Ketu and Jupiter share one place and one sign together (Pisces in his scheme), and both belong to the Svadhisthana chakra, so they sit as neighbours in the same sign and the same body centre.
cells_derived_method: In his scheme Pisces is owned jointly by Jupiter and Ketu, so a planet in Pisces falls under both lords in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: planets in Pisces in the 12th of lagna Aries are under Jupiter and Ketu together, so loss, sleep and liberation themes are strongly marked.
Derived: planets in Pisces in the 1st of lagna Pisces are under Jupiter and Ketu together, the self is spiritual and wise but prone to drift.

ambiguity: The sentence does not name the sign; Pisces is inferred from his sign lordship (Pisces Jupiter or Ketu); the last word 'प' is clipped and read as 'पर'.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give Pisces to Jupiter only; Ketu's sharing it is his own scheme.

hindi: इसलिए केतु स्वागत करता है क्यों फसाने के लिए बादल है केतु
says: He says that is why Ketu welcomes Jupiter into its place, and the reason is to trap him; Ketu is a cloud, so Jupiter entering Ketu's sign is drawn into haze and entanglement.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Pisces, where Ketu shares ownership, is the case he means; the house shows where the entanglement happens.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 5th of lagna Scorpio, intelligence and children matters can get clouded by spiritual or imaginative haze.
Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 8th of lagna Leo, a pull into the occult and hidden matters can trap the person.

ambiguity: 'फसाने के लिए बादल है' is rough; it is read as 'to ensnare, Ketu is a cloud'; the sign is Pisces only by inference.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu as haze or cloud is a loose image and not a classical karaka.

hindi: केतु लिंग है केतु सेक्स ऑर्गन्स है केतु कान है केतु मोक्ष का द्वार है
says: He lists Ketu as the male organ (ling), the sex organs, the ear and the door of moksha (liberation), putting reproduction, hearing and spiritual release together under Ketu.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'कान' is read as ear; the link between sex organs and moksha is his own and he explains it next.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Ketu as moksha karaka is classical; sex organs and ears are not standard Ketu items.

gist: Says that when ecstasy peaks in sex it feels as if heaven has been found.

hindi: क्योंकि मनुष्य को पता ही नहीं साधना का इसलिए सेक्स एक ऐसी चीज बना दी है कि इसके द्वारा ही मनुष्य एक्सी को अनुभव कर सकता है
says: He claims humans do not know sadhana, so nature made sex the one doorway through which a person can taste ecstasy; this ties Ketu, the door of moksha, to a brief glimpse of release for those who have no spiritual practice.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Ketu is not named in this sentence; the link follows from the Ketu list just before it; 'एक्सी' is a clipped 'ecstasy'.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that sex is a gateway to moksha is a tantric view, not a classical jyotish rule.

hindi: एक्सी का अर्थ है माइंड शट हो गया दो सेकंड के लिए तो जब थोड़ी देर के लिए माइंड मुन्ना शट हो जाता है
says: He defines ecstasy as the mind shutting off for a couple of seconds, and since he calls the mind 'Munna', Saturn is the mind here and ecstasy is Saturn going quiet for a moment.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'माइंड मुन्ना' equates the mind with Munna, which he elsewhere uses for Saturn.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give the mind to the Moon, and not to Saturn.

gist: Claims a chemical, DMT, strikes the brain in those moments and makes bliss feel real; a biochemical claim that is not astrology and not checked here.
Says nature put so much ecstasy into the reproduction process that people long for it and even die for it.

hindi: मुन्ना शट मींस शनि महाराज कहते हैं ओके डार्कनेस बंद लाइफ में डार्क एनर्जी ऑफ हो गई ऑफ होने का मतलब थोड़ी देर के लिए संपर्क टूट गया तो सिर्फ वाइट लाइट रह गई
says: He says Saturn is the dark energy of life; when Saturn (Munna) is briefly switched off, the contact with darkness is cut and only white light remains, and that white light is the bliss. So Saturn is darkness and its short pause is felt as joy.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'डार्क एनर्जी' is used as a metaphor for Saturn's heaviness, not as the physics term.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn as darkness, heaviness and the dark planet is classical; the white-light bliss reading is his own.

gist: Restates that both of these belong to the lower chakras, with Jupiter and Saturn in the lower areas.

hindi: राहु जो है यह ज्ञान देता है केतु जो है यह हजारों चीजें देता है यह एंडलेस है
says: He says Rahu is the one that gives knowledge and Ketu gives thousands of things and is endless; so he assigns knowledge to Rahu and an endless abundance of things to Ketu.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'यह एंडलेस है' may refer to Ketu's gifts or to the whole topic; 'ज्ञान' for Rahu may mean worldly or foreign knowledge.
classical_check: Differs: the classics make Ketu the knowledge and moksha karaka and Rahu the worldly craving, so his allocation is nearly reversed.

gist: Says each of these topics could be a full separate class, but what matters now is to understand the signs, who is the friend and who the enemy of whom.
Says the chart has much detail if taken up and again lists Pluto, Indra, Varuna and Yama as belonging with Saturn.
States today's main aim: to receive the grace of the Ishta devata, and that the signs are now laid out.

hindi: अब ये नाइंथ हाउस है इस नाइंथ हाउस में जो राशि है हाउस तो य नाइंथ ही है राशि हो सकता है यहां यह वाली ना हो एक हो हो सकता है राशि यहां पर एक हो हो सकता है राशि ना दो हो
says: To find the Ishta (chosen deity) he looks at the 9th house: the house is always the 9th, but the sign sitting in it can be any of the twelve, number 1, 2, 3, 4 and so on, and each sign number gives a different deity. In effect the sign in the 9th house, through its lord, decides the Ishta.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house with each of the 12 signs gives 12 different Ishta outcomes by the lord of that sign. The lagna follows from the sign: the 9th sign number plus 4 gives the lagna, wrapping at 12.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 9th of lagna Taurus is a Saturn sign, so by his sign-lord rule the deity would follow Saturn, a mapping he has not given in this section.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 9th of lagna Aries is a Jupiter sign, so by his rule the deity would follow Jupiter, which he has not named here.

ambiguity: He may mean the 9th house of the lagna chart (sign-based) and not a bhava; it is not said whether the Navamsa is also used. Sign numbers follow Aries=1.
classical_check: Differs: Jaimini reads the Ishta devata from the 12th of Karakamsha (Atmakaraka's Navamsa); reading it from the 9th house sign is a popular later method, so it differs from Jaimini.

hindi: अगर एक नंबर राशि है तो मंगल की है हनुमान जी आपके इष्ट हो गए
says: If the sign in the 9th house is number 1 (Aries), it belongs to Mars, and Hanuman ji becomes your Ishta.
cells_derived_method: Mars owns Aries and Scorpio; he states only sign 1, so Scorpio is derived by lordship and not by his words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 9th means lagna Leo, where Mars is also lord of the 4th and 9th, so Hanuman worship has strong chart support.
Derived: Scorpio in the 9th means lagna Pisces and Scorpio is also a Mars sign, so by lordship Hanuman could also be the Ishta, though he has not said this.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर' is read as sign number 1 (Aries), but he sometimes says house numbers the same way; the 9th house is fixed by the setup.
classical_check: Silent in the classics for Hanuman as Ishta; Mars as the planet of Hanuman is a popular link.

hindi: दो नंबर है तो शुक्र की है शुक्र कौन है लक्ष्मी इस पर क्लास हुई पड़ी है हमारी सनातन
says: If the sign in the 9th house is number 2 (Taurus) it belongs to Venus, and Venus is Lakshmi, so Lakshmi is the Ishta; he notes that a class on this is already done on his channel.
cells_derived_method: Venus owns Taurus and Libra; he states only sign 2, so Libra is derived by lordship and not by his words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 9th means lagna Virgo, where Venus is lord of the 2nd and 9th, so Lakshmi as Ishta is backed by a strong 9th lord.
Derived: Libra in the 9th means lagna Aquarius, where Venus is lord of the 4th and 9th, a yogakaraka for that lagna, so Lakshmi would also fit by lordship.

ambiguity: The opening 'हनुमान दो नंबर है' is garbled; it is read as the next number after Hanuman's sign; 'सनातन' is the name of his channel.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; Venus as Lakshmi is a common link.

hindi: लक्ष्मी हृदय चक्र पर
says: He places Lakshmi (Venus) on the heart chakra, so Venus is the planet of that chakra in his body map.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The short phrase is a fragment of the sentence 'हमारी सनातन लक्ष्मी हृदय चक्र पर'; the verb is missing.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; it fits the common tantric scheme where Venus is the heart chakra.

hindi: तीन नंबर जो है यह हमारी कौन सी राशि है बुध की बुध कौन है दुर्गा सरस्वती
says: Sign number 3 (Gemini) is Mercury's, and Mercury is Durga and Saraswati, so those goddesses become the Ishta when Gemini is in the 9th.
cells_derived_method: Mercury owns Gemini and Virgo; he states only sign 3 here and handles Virgo separately.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 9th means lagna Libra, where Mercury is lord of the 9th and 12th, so Durga or Saraswati worship is backed by an own-sign 9th lord.
Derived: Virgo in the 9th means lagna Capricorn, where Mercury is lord of the 6th and 9th, and Virgo carries Rahu too in his scheme, a mixed picture he handles next.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर' is read as sign number 3 (Gemini); naming both Durga and Saraswati is not narrowed down here.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; Mercury as Durga or Saraswati is a popular association.

hindi: चार नंबर ये चंद्रमा चंद्र कौन है चंद्रमा रखते हैं शिवजी शिव जीी ही इष्ट है
says: Sign number 4 (Cancer) is the Moon's, and since Shiva carries the Moon, the Moon stands for Shiva, so Shiva ji is the Ishta when Cancer is in the 9th.
cells_derived_method: The Moon owns only Cancer, so the rule is by sign lord: a Moon in the 9th in another sign does not make Shiva the Ishta by his rule.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 9th means lagna Scorpio, where the Moon is the lord of the 9th in its own sign, so Shiva as Ishta has a strong base.
Derived: Taurus in the 9th means lagna Virgo; even though the Moon is exalted in Taurus, the sign lord is Venus, so by his sign-lord rule the Ishta would be Lakshmi, not Shiva.

ambiguity: 'चंद्रमा रखते हैं शिवजी' is the Moon worn by Shiva; the caption 'शिव जीी' is a double letter slip.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; Moon with Shiva is a standard puranic link.

hindi: पांच नंबर कौन है सूर्य सूर्य कौन है विष्णु सारा कार्यक्रम करने वाले और सूर्य ही है
says: Sign number 5 (Leo) is the Sun's, and the Sun is Vishnu, the one who runs the whole programme, so Vishnu is the Ishta when Leo is in the 9th.
cells_derived_method: The Sun owns only Leo, so the rule is by sign lord and not by occupant: a Sun sitting in the 9th in another sign does not change the deity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 9th means lagna Sagittarius, where the Sun is lord of the 9th in its own sign, so Vishnu as Ishta has a strong base.
