Derived: Aries in the 9th means lagna Leo; even if the Sun is exalted there, the sign lord is Mars, so by his sign-lord rule the Ishta would be Hanuman, not Vishnu.

ambiguity: The sentence ends with 'और सूर्य ही है एक तरह से यह हो गई', which is a loose closing phrase and is not read as a rule.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; Sun as Vishnu (Surya-Narayana) is a standard puranic link.

gist: Rapid enumeration of the remaining sign numbers 6 to 12 with no deities given at this point.

hindi: छ नंबर राशि यह राहु की थी हमारी राहु की राशि के साथ कौन था बुध राहु
says: Sign number 6 (Virgo) he says belonged to Rahu in his scheme, and the other lord with Rahu's sign was Mercury, so Virgo is shared by Rahu and Mercury.
cells_derived_method: Rahu and Mercury share Virgo, so for a 9th-house Virgo both deities are in play; Mercury's other sign Gemini has no Rahu share.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo in the 9th means lagna Capricorn, where Mercury is lord of the 6th and 9th; Rahu's share in Virgo adds an unconventional or foreign colour to the deity link.
Derived: Gemini in the 9th means lagna Libra, where Mercury alone is the sign lord, so no Rahu share enters the Ishta reading.

ambiguity: 'छ नंबर' is read as sign number 6; 'थी' (was) hints at an earlier class on Rahu's sign.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give Virgo to Mercury alone and give Rahu no sign in the usual scheme.

hindi: तीन नंबर का देवता उच्च होता है तो सरस्वती है सरस्वती देवी की बात हम करेंगे तो जब तीन नंबर का होता है सरस्वती है आप सरस्वती की पूजा करो सरस्वती माता का मंत्र जाप करके जाओ
says: For the Rahu-Mercury sign Virgo he says the Mercury (number 3) deity is exalted there, so the Ishta is Saraswati, and the advice is to worship Saraswati and chant her mantra.
cells_derived_method: Mercury is exalted only in Virgo, so Saraswati as the Ishta is strongest where Virgo holds Mercury; in other signs of the 9th the deity follows the sign lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 9th of lagna Capricorn, so Saraswati worship carries the highest backing in the faith house.
Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 5th of lagna Taurus, so a Saraswati mantra suits the intelligence and study house.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर का देवता उच्च' is read as the Mercury deity exalted in Virgo; it could also mean sign 3 itself, which he already gave as Durga and Saraswati.
classical_check: Mercury exalted in Virgo is classical; Saraswati as Ishta from Virgo is his own.

hindi: सारी याददा सारा मेमोरी बैंक थड फ घर के अंदर पूरा का पूरा सेट देवता होते हैं इसके सुग्रीव कत्ल की तरह मेमोरी रहेगी
says: He claims Saraswati worship gives you the whole memory bank, with a full set of deities inside the house, so that memory stays sharp; the caption is garbled but the claim is that Saraswati's mantra improves memory.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption is badly broken ('थड फ घर', 'सुग्रीव कत्ल की तरह'); the memory benefit is read from 'याददा' and 'मेमोरी बैंक', and the comparison is lost.
classical_check: Silent: the classics link memory to Mercury and the Moon, and Saraswati worship for memory is a traditional practice.

gist: Praise of his memory trick: you will not forget it, the maths and the numbers are now all in your pocket, quick and easy.
Fragment 'this is your Rahu ... recite the mantra' whose subject is lost; it probably closes the previous number-to-deity item but the caption does not say which.

hindi: गायत्री मंत्र बृहस्पति है न
says: He says the Gayatri mantra is Jupiter's mantra, so reciting it is the way to work with Jupiter (Brihaspati, the guru planet) when Jupiter's deity is the Ishta.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-to-mantra link, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The stray word 'नंबर' right after it may be a lost sign number for Jupiter (his Jupiter signs are 9 and 12); the caption does not give it.
classical_check: Differs in part: classically the Gayatri is addressed to Savitr (the Sun); tying it to Jupiter is a modern remedial convention.

hindi: नंबर महा मूर्ति शिव का चार नंबर
says: He gives Shiva's mantra (the caption shows 'Maha-murti', most likely the Mahamrityunjaya mantra) to number four, which is the sign Cancer, the Moon's sign.
cells_derived_method: The sign is fixed (Cancer, Moon). The house only decides which life area the Shiva-worship theme serves: Cancer on a kendra reads as home and mind comfort, on the 6th as relief from disease and rivals, on the 12th as sleep, release and foreign lands. Sign number 4 is assumed, not house number 4.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius (4-6+1=-1, so 11). Cancer is the 6th house, so Shiva mantra practice is read as a remedy lens for illness, debt and enemies, softened by the Moon's calming tone.
Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). Cancer is the 10th house, so Shiva worship is tied to career and public standing, with nurturing or public-care work as the theme.
Derived: lagna Leo (4-12+1=-7, so 5). Cancer is the 12th house, so the Shiva mantra is read as a moksha, sleep and foreign-land remedy.

ambiguity: 'महा मूर्ति' is probably a garble of 'महामृत्युंजय'; the stray 'नंबर' before it may belong to the Jupiter sentence. Sign number is assumed, not house number.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Shiva and the Moon (Soma, Chandrashekhara) are linked in tradition; the Mahamrityunjaya mantra is classically for health and longevity, not a Moon-sign rule.

hindi: दुर्गा करते हैं ओम नम काई ओमंग चामुंडा वि यह सारे छ नंबर छ नंबर दुर्गा
says: For Durga worship he cites the Chamunda mantra (caption: Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundayai Vichche) and places all these Durga forms at number six, the sign Virgo, repeating that six is Durga.
cells_derived_method: Sign is fixed (Virgo); the house sets what the Durga mantra is aimed at. Virgo is the natural 6th sign of disease, debt and enemies, which fits Durga's protective role; moving it to other houses changes the target of the protection.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (6-3+1=4). Virgo is the 3rd house, so the Durga mantra is a courage, effort and communication remedy.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (6-8+1=-1, so 11). Virgo is the 8th house, so Chamunda is read as protection against sudden trouble and hidden danger.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (6-10+1=-3, so 9). Virgo is the 10th house, so Durga is the protector deity of career and status.

ambiguity: The mantra syllables are garbled ('नम काई ओमंग'); the standard Navarna mantra is assumed. 'छ नंबर' is taken as sign six (Virgo), not the 6th house. He names no planet here (Virgo's lord is Mercury, or Rahu in his scheme).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Durga as protector of the 6th (enemies, disease) theme is traditional; the Durga to Virgo link is his scheme, since classical texts tie Durga to Rahu or Mars-type power.

hindi: तीन नंबर सरस्वती दोनों कर सकते हैंक बुद्ध यही तो गड़बड़ है
says: Number three is Saraswati and number six is Durga; because both numbers are Mercury's signs (Gemini and Virgo), he says a Mercury person can worship either deity.
cells_derived_method: Mercury owns two signs, so two deities attach to one planet. Gemini carries the Saraswati side (speech, learning); Virgo the Durga side (service, protection). Which one a native picks depends on whether the house topic is learning or protection.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (3-2+1=2). Gemini is the 2nd house of speech and family wealth, so the Saraswati option suits a speech or teaching-based income.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (3-7+1=-3, so 9). Gemini is the 7th house, so Saraswati suits trade and partnership communication.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (6-9+1=-2, so 10). Virgo is the 9th house, so the Durga option is read as protection on the path of dharma and luck.

ambiguity: The caption ends the sentence with 'यही तो गड़बड़ है' (this is the confusion), which I read as the start of his next remark about too many deities. 'छ नंबर' in the earlier clause is sign six.
classical_check: Silent on deity choice; Mercury owning Gemini and Virgo is classical, the two-deity split is his scheme.

hindi: अगर यह गड़बड़ कर दे आदमी के हमारे य यही लफड़ा है 20 भगवान के फोटो लगा दिए मंदिर में
says: He calls it the real mess that a planet can have more than one deity, and says this is why people end up putting twenty gods' photos in the home temple without knowing which one is theirs.
cells_derived_method: none: a general remark on confusion in deity choice, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'अगर यह गड़बड़ कर दे' is broken; I read it as 'if a person mixes this up'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts speak of one Ishta (Jaimini, 12th from the Karakamsa) but do not forbid several household images, so this is his practical view.

hindi: अब कौन सा काम कर रहा है सारे कर रहे हैं यह ऐसे मान के चलो
says: Asked which of those twenty photographed gods is actually working, he answers that all of them are, and tells the listener to proceed on that assumption.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Unclear whether 'all work' means all give some effect on the subconscious or that all are equally the Ishta.
classical_check: Tension with his own next claim (G04-16-014) that Ishta is exactly one, the single best; the two fit only if 'working' means influence and 'Ishta' means the best one. Classical texts are silent.

gist: Points back to an earlier Chitragupta class: only those who watched that class will understand this reference.

hindi: चित्रगुप्त को चार चीज दिखाई 20 व अपने आप देख रहा है 1000 उसने रजिस्टर सबकी फोटो खींच रहा है चित्रगुप्त हमारा ब्रेन तो फोटो खींचता है
says: In his usage Chitragupta, the divine record-keeper, is our own brain: it automatically photographs everything we see and registers it like a ledger of pictures.
cells_derived_method: none: a definition, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The numbers 'four things', '20' and '1000' are garbled in the caption and cannot be recovered; the brain-as-camera meaning is clear.
classical_check: Differs: in the Puranas Chitragupta is Yama's accountant of deeds; equating him with the brain is his own reading.

gist: Everyday illustration: looking at you from the side he notices someone passed by or something was kept there without paying attention, because the brain registers it automatically.

hindi: अब 40 फोटो लगा रखे है भगवान की चित्रगुप्त काम कर रहा है आपकी सबकॉन्शियस को पकड़ रहा है अंतरिक्ष से आने वाली किरणें पकड़ रहा है अपने आप
says: Even with forty god photos displayed, Chitragupta keeps working: it catches your subconscious and automatically picks up the rays coming from space, so the effect goes on regardless of the images.
cells_derived_method: none: a general mechanism claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say what the rays are or how they carry planetary influence.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts have no 'space rays and subconscious' mechanism, this is his bridge between planets and the mind.

hindi: राहु केतु मंगल आपकी लाइफ में प्लस भी हो रहा है माइनस भी हो रहा है
says: He names Rahu, Ketu and Mars as planets that are working in your life on their own, giving gains and losses both.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given for these planets.
ambiguity: Why exactly these three are singled out is not said; likely they are the planets of the deities just discussed (Durga, Ganesh, Hanuman), but that is my guess.
classical_check: Agrees in general that Rahu, Ketu and Mars give mixed results, but nothing specific is cited.

hindi: इष्ट का मतलब ही एक इष्ट तो होता ही एक है
says: Definition: the word Ishta itself means the single best deity, so by meaning a person can have only one Ishta.
cells_derived_method: none: a definition of the term.
classical_check: Agrees: Jaimini's Ishta devata is a single deity read from the 12th of the Karakamsa; it conflicts with his earlier 'all deities work' remark.

gist: Shop analogy: you ask the shopkeeper to show the best piece and he shows two or three, but the best is only one and nothing can be better than best; repeats that Ishta is only one.

hindi: इन्हीं चीजों की वजह से राशि बदली जाती है सेम राशि थी राम और रावण की दोनों उल्टे क्यों थे क्योंकि प्लेसमेंट ग्रह की अलग अलग थी एक का चंद्रमा कहीं था दूसरे का चंद्रमा कहीं यह कहानी है
says: Same sign does not mean same result: he says Ram and Ravan had the same rashi yet were opposite in nature because their planets were placed differently, for instance the Moon sat in different places in each chart.
cells_derived_method: This is the multi-cell idea itself: one sign gives 12 different lagnas depending on the house it occupies, so a planet in the same sign reads differently in each house cell. Moon in its own sign Cancer shows it: the house changes the life area the mind-and-comfort theme lands on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Moon in own sign on the lagna: strong, sensitive, self-centred emotional nature.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (4-6+1=-1, so 11). Moon in own sign in the 6th: a worried mind, disturbed by rivals, work pressure and health habits.
Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). Moon in own sign in the 10th: public-facing, caring or crowd-linked career, emotions tied to status.

ambiguity: 'राशि बदली जाती है' is garbled (maybe 'the result of a rashi changes'); he does not say whether Ram and Ravan share the Moon sign or the lagna.
classical_check: The principle (placement changes results) agrees with classical practice; tradition gives Ram a Cancer lagna with the Moon in Cancer, and Ravana has no fixed classical chart, so the same-rashi claim is unverified.

hindi: सात नंबर आपका वरुण का देवता का है वरुण देव कौन है आंख
says: Number seven is Varuna's number (the water god), and he defines Varuna as the eye, the god of seeing.
cells_derived_method: Sign is fixed (Libra; Varuna is Neptune in his 12-planet scheme). The house only sets where the watching, observing theme lands: on the 5th it colours devotion and learning, on the 9th dharma and guru, on the 12th the sea, foreign lands and loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini (7-5+1=3). Libra is the 5th house, so a Varuna-type Ishta shows as a quiet, observing devotion and a watchful mind in studies.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (7-9+1=-1, so 11). Libra is the 9th house, so the all-seeing Varuna is read as the guide of dharma and the guru path.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (7-12+1=-4, so 8). Libra is the 12th house, so Varuna links to the sea, foreign lands and hidden or lost things.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is read as sign seven (Libra) because he later says seven is also Venus's number; which chart factor picks a person's Ishta number is not stated in this slice.
classical_check: Partly agrees: in the Vedas Varuna is the all-seeing watcher and god of waters; the Neptune and Libra pairing is his scheme.

hindi: अगर अकेली एक आंख की भी आकृति आप ड फ में लगा दोगे या सिर्फ नेत्रों के द्वारा ही जीवन को चेक के चलोगे कि पहले देख लू ऑब्जर्वेशन आपका इष्ट सा सिद्ध हो गया
says: Varuna worship can be as simple as placing even a lone eye figure somewhere, or living by looking and observing first; either way he says your Ishta, Varuna, is established.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy of habit and symbol, not house or sign dependent beyond the Varuna sign.
ambiguity: 'ड फ में' is unreadable (maybe a room or an office); 'सिद्ध हो गया' could mean the Ishta is proven for you or the worship is accomplished.
classical_check: Silent; an eye symbol is a folk practice, though the Vedic Varuna as all-seeing watcher is consistent with it.

hindi: आपका चश्मा धासू होना चाहिए अगर आप वरुण देव की तरह हो यानी ज्ञान है आपकी हर जगह नजर है लेकिन आप बोलते नहीं आपको चश्मे गिफ्ट मिलेंगे
says: A person who is like Varuna Dev, knowledgeable and watching everywhere but not talking, should own a stylish pair of glasses and will receive spectacles as gifts.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka-style behaviour and gift claim for the Varuna type, not house or sign dependent beyond the Varuna sign.
ambiguity: It is not said whether this describes only people whose Ishta is Varuna or anyone with a strong Neptune or Libra; the Libra cell is carried over from the previous Varuna sentences.
classical_check: Silent; classical karakatwas give eyes to the Sun and Moon, and Neptune is outside the classical seven.

gist: Joke about shop schemes: 'oh my god, there is a scheme', these days spectacles come one plus one free.

hindi: आपको चश्मा गिफ्ट कैसे मिलेगा आंखों का मेकअप मिलेगा गिफ्ट
says: Extending the Varuna gift idea, he says the eye-related gift that comes to such a person can also be eye makeup, not only spectacles.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The question 'how will you get glasses as a gift?' is rhetorical; he answers with eye makeup, and it is unclear whether he means this replaces glasses or adds to them.
classical_check: Silent; this is a Varuna-as-eye extension in his own scheme.

gist: Anecdote: women with small eyes who use eye makeup to look bigger often come and talk to him, and he describes one such meeting where he did not notice at first.
Anecdote continues: he tells the woman he saw she had makeup done and asks her not to repeat it next time; she forgets, and he jokes that a free fee comes his way.

hindi: फ्री पस गिफ्ट में अचानक स देने लग पर्स गिफ्ट में मिलता है लेदर का है कपड़े का है ब्यूटी आइटम है सब शुक्र है सारे कॉस्मेटिक्स आपको शुक्र इंप्रूव करना है
says: Venus karaka list: purses (leather or cloth), beauty items and all cosmetics are Venus things, and a purse is a typical gift; so to improve Venus you work with these objects.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka list, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The opening words ('फ्री पस ... अचानक स देने लग') are garbled; the purse-as-gift reading rests on the clear words that follow.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Venus karakatwas include cosmetics, ornaments, cloth, leather and luxury goods.

hindi: आपके बायोलॉजी का पेपर है सौंदर्य की चीज है
says: He ties a biology exam to Venus: biology is about the beauty of living forms, so it falls under Venus, which must be strong before that paper.
cells_derived_method: none: a subject-to-planet link, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut mid-way ('सौंदर्य की चीज' then 'है' in the next caption line); the Venus link is implied by the next sentences, not spoken here.
classical_check: Differs: classically education and learning go to Mercury and Jupiter, and the Venus link to biology is his own extension.

hindi: आप क्या करो स्त्री है आप गाय माता है गाय माता को बढ़िया सा धासू खाना खिलाओ बायोलॉजी के पेपर वाले दिन अगर शुक्रवार है कोई सा भी पेपर है गाय माता की सेवा कर दो
says: Remedy for Venus: on the day of a biology paper, or any paper falling on a Friday, feed the cow a very good meal and serve her, because woman and cow both stand for Venus.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether the Friday condition is for the biology paper only or for any paper; I read it as any paper that falls on a Friday.
classical_check: Agrees with common tradition: cow service and Friday are standard Venus remedies, though no specific classical verse is cited.

hindi: स्त्री सुंदर स्त्री नहीं सॉरी सॉरी स्त्री स्त्री सुंदर ही होती है यह मैंने पाप किया कहके सिलेक्ट नहीं करना ऑल स्त्री आर सुंदर
says: Qualifier to the Venus service remedy: he corrects himself and says every woman is beautiful, so one should not pick and choose by looks; any woman you serve or praise counts as Venus.
cells_derived_method: none: a qualifier on a remedy, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He apologises mid-sentence ('sorry sorry'), so it is not fully clear whether the point is about remedy scope or only a courtesy remark.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बगर पेपर के भी स्त्री की रीफ कर सकते स्त्री की रीफ करते शुक्र बढ़िया रहेगा भोजन बढ़िया
says: Even without an exam you can keep Venus in good shape by praising women, and he adds that meals and food will also stay good as a result.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'रीफ' is a garble of 'तारीफ' (praise); 'भोजन बढ़िया' could mean you will get good food, or that serving good food is part of the remedy.
classical_check: Silent; respect for women as a Venus remedy is common in later remedial astrology.

hindi: आपने क्या आपने आपने स्त्री को कोई भी कोई भी सौंदर्य प्रसाधन देना है परफ्यूम जैसे कि अब पहले होता था सौंदर्य की सामग्री दे दी चूड़ी बिंदी कंगन पाउडर ये सब कहा जाता था
says: Remedy: give a woman some beauty article such as perfume; in the old days the gift was bangles, bindi, bracelets or face powder, which are the traditional Venus offerings.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees with common Venus remedies (cosmetics, ornaments, fragrance as gifts to women); not from a classical verse.

gist: Joke: these days women ask for purses or iPhones, even a girlfriend says she will not accept less, so the choice of gift is up to you.

hindi: ये नेचुरली क्यों है कि स्त्री को गिफ्ट दो अच्छा लगता है उसे जो स्त्री दुनिया की सबसे रजी हुई स्त्री है उसको भी गिफ्ट लेना पसंद आएगा यह प्रकृति ने बनाया है
says: He explains why the gift remedy works: even the richest and most satisfied woman in the world likes receiving a gift, and he says this is nature's design, not a social habit.
cells_derived_method: none: a general claim about women and gifts.
ambiguity: 'रजी हुई' is probably 'रजी-गजी' or 'अघाई हुई' (well satisfied); the sense is a woman who needs nothing.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural claim, not a classical rule.

hindi: उसको लगेगा मेरे लिए कोई चिजी आई है चिजी वो चिजी से बहुत प्रसन्न होती है पुरुष किससे प्रसन्न होता है चिजी गई तेल लेने भाव दिखाओ मुझे मुझे लग नहीं रहा ते अंदर से नहीं आवाज आ रही
says: A woman feels that something has come for her and is pleased by the object itself, while a man is pleased by feeling: for him the object means little and he asks to be shown sentiment.
cells_derived_method: none: a contrast between sexes, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'चिजी' is a recurring caption garble of 'चीज' (thing); the man-versus-woman contrast is clear.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the traditional split of Venus (things, comfort) and the Sun and Mars (sentiment, action) only loosely.

hindi: पुरुष पुरुष पर जाता है स्त्री प्रकृति पर जाती है चिजी पर पुरुष एनर्जी को पकड़ता है उसको कोई चीज देक करो बड़ा कठिन है जटिल है
says: Man gravitates toward Purusha (consciousness) and woman toward Prakriti (matter and things); a man catches on to energy, so winning him over with a gift is hard and complicated.
cells_derived_method: none: a philosophical contrast, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'मुझे लग नहीं रहा ... अंदर से नहीं आवाज आ रही' just before it is the man's imagined reply, which I fold into the previous row.
classical_check: Silent; Purusha and Prakriti are Samkhya terms, applied here by him to sex differences.

hindi: जिस पुरुष में स्त्री तत्व है वो चियों के लिए पागल रहेगा अदर वाइज वो पुरुष चियों को नहीं पकड़ेगा इस प्रकार दोनों का अलग अलग है
says: Exception to the above: a man in whom the feminine element is strong will be crazy about things, otherwise he does not grab at objects, so the two types work differently.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent; he gives no chart marker for a man with a strong feminine element.
ambiguity: He does not say how to recognise the feminine element in a man from the chart (for example a strong Venus or Moon).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो स्त्री की सेवा करो स्त्री को कुछ भी सौंदर्य दो कुछ नहीं तो परफ्यूम सुगंधी यह शुक्र का हिसाब किताब है
says: Conclusion of the Venus remedy: serve women and give them any beauty item, and if nothing else a perfume or fragrance; this, he says, is how Venus's accounts are settled.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees with common Venus remedies (service to women, fragrance); no classical verse is cited.

hindi: सुंदर ठीक साफ सुथरे कपड़े मेले कपड़े डबल मत पहनो एग्जाम वाले दिन मत खराब करके जाओ शुक्र
says: For a normal Venus, wear neat, clean clothes on exam day and do not go in soiled clothing or a spoiled state, so that Venus stays favourable.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent; the case of an afflicted Venus follows in the next sentences.
ambiguity: 'मैले कपड़े डबल मत पहनो' is unclear: 'double' may stress the ban on soiled clothes or mean do not wear two soiled layers.
classical_check: Agrees with the common rule of clean, bright clothes for Venus; he reverses it for an afflicted Venus in the next sentence, so he treats that as the opposite case.

hindi: यदि नीच का है खराब है छ नंबर में खराब होता है ये नीच का होता है
says: If Venus is debilitated it turns bad; he states that Venus goes bad at number six, the sign Virgo, where it is in its fall.
cells_derived_method: Sign is fixed (Virgo, Venus debilitated). The house decides which Venus topic is damaged and, via lagna, which houses Venus rules: Venus rules 2nd and 9th for Virgo lagna, 1st and 6th for Taurus lagna, and so on, so the harm lands on different life areas in each cell. Neecha-bhanga cancellation would have to be checked separately.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (6-2+1=5). Venus rules the 3rd and 10th for Leo lagna; fallen in the 2nd it weakens speech, savings and the support of the career lord.
Derived: lagna Taurus (6-5+1=2). Venus is lagna lord and 6th lord; fallen in the 5th it weakens concentration and learning, which fits his biology-exam example.
Derived: lagna Pisces (6-7+1=0, so 12). Venus rules the 3rd and 8th; fallen in the 7th it brings friction and imbalance in partnership, with the 8th lordship adding hidden strain.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (6-10+1=-3, so 9). Venus rules the 6th and 11th; fallen in the 10th it weakens gains from work and makes workplace rivalry troublesome.

ambiguity: 'छ नंबर में' is read as sign six (Virgo); if read as the 6th house it would not be a dignity rule. 'खराब' and 'नीच का' are one claim here.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is debilitated in Virgo in all classical texts (BPHS).

gist: Garbled joke on the spoiled-Venus theme: a slap will come, 'he was teasing me', 'she kept it and will not return it', a sure guarantee.

hindi: अगर शुक्र में आपके दोष है उस दिन मैले कपड़े पहनकर एग्जाम देने जाओ
says: Reverse rule for a flawed Venus: if your Venus carries a dosha, go to the exam on that day wearing soiled (unwashed) clothes instead of clean ones.
cells_derived_method: He gives no placement for the dosha, so the cells are mine: the remedy would trigger wherever Venus is afflicted, most clearly where it is debilitated in Virgo (his previous sentence) and in cells where Venus rules a trouble house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo (6-1+1=6). Venus rules the 2nd and 9th and is debilitated on the lagna; the soiled-clothes remedy would be used by a native whose body and image carry the dosha.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (6-8+1=-1, so 11). Venus rules the 4th and 9th and is debilitated in the 8th; the remedy would apply to exams and important meetings when this Venus is running.
Derived: lagna Libra (6-12+1=-5, so 7). Venus is lagna lord and 8th lord, debilitated in the 12th; the same remedy would be tried for exam and work outcomes.

ambiguity: He does not define 'dosha in Venus' (debilitation, combustion, enemy sign or affliction); I assume it includes the Virgo debilitation he just mentioned.
classical_check: Differs: the usual rule for Venus is clean, bright clothes; he reverses it for a weak Venus and contradicts his own clean-clothes advice two sentences earlier, treating an afflicted Venus as the opposite case. Not found in classical texts.

hindi: कितनी डेप्थ है सोचने वाली बात है एक कपड़ा मैला शरीर पर होना चाहिए उस दिन आप जरूर एग्जाम देने जाओ
says: He asks the listener to think about the depth of this remedy and states the first instruction: one soiled garment must be on the body on the day you go in for the exam.
cells_derived_method: none: a general remedy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether the rule is for everyone or only for those with afflicted Venus as in the previous sentence; the clause about going to the exam without fail is a reminder to turn up.
classical_check: Silent; this resembles a folk idea of spoiling perfection to avoid the evil eye, not a classical rule.

hindi: किसी शुभ कार्य के लिए जा रहे हो अच्छी मीटिंग में जा रहे हो एक मेला कपड़ा पहन के जाओ सिर्फ एग्जाम की लड़ाई नहीं हो रही बायोलॉजी के लिए हर चीज के लिए हो रहा है
says: The same soiled-cloth rule is widened to any auspicious task or good meeting, and he says it is not only for the biology exam but a general protective gesture used for everything.
cells_derived_method: none: a general remedy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'मेला कपड़ा' is read as 'मैला कपड़ा' (soiled cloth); 'हो रहा है' is loose, read as 'this is being done for everything'.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text prescribes soiled clothes for important events, so this is his own remedy.

hindi: आठ नंबर य यह समुद्र का देवता है समुद्र की पूजा करो इष्ट है आपके वरुण देव
says: The deity of the sea sits at this number; if Varuna Dev is your Ishta, you should worship the sea, he says.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed (Libra). House only changes the life area the sea-worship supports, as already shown for the Varuna sign; no new house rule is given here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (7-4+1=4). Libra is the 4th house, so sea or water worship is read as a remedy for peace of mind, home and mother.
Derived: lagna Pisces (7-8+1=0, so 12). Libra is the 8th house, so Varuna worship is read as a remedy for hidden fears and sudden or deep-water type troubles.

ambiguity: The caption says 'eight' (आठ), but I read it as seven: he calls seven Varuna earlier and says eight is Hanuman a few sentences later. If 'eight' were right the cell would be Scorpio; I choose Libra and mark low confidence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Varuna is the Vedic god of the waters and ocean; sea worship as a remedy is a folk extension.

hindi: आंखें नेत्र के द्वारा दिखाए जाते हैं आपके घर के नॉर्थ ईस्ट के अंदर वरुण देव एक ब्लू आई इविल आई लगाते हैं वो लगा सकते आप
says: Vastu remedy: Varuna is shown through the eyes, so a person whose Ishta is Varuna can place a blue evil-eye (nazar) symbol in the north-east corner of the house.
cells_derived_method: none: a direction-based Vastu remedy, not dependent on house or sign beyond the Varuna sign.
ambiguity: 'वरुण देव ... लगाते हैं' is garbled; I read it as 'for Varuna Dev people put a blue eye'. Whether 'north-east' is exact is not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Differs: classical Vastu gives the west to Varuna, while the north-east belongs to Ishana (Shiva) and Jupiter; evil-eye charms are a folk practice.

hindi: और सात नंबर ही शुक्र का है साथ शेयर करता है तो लक्ष्मी भी वही आ गई सात नंबर लक्ष्मी है
says: Number seven is also Venus's sign and Varuna shares it with Venus, so Lakshmi also arrives at the same number; he calls number seven Lakshmi as well as Varuna.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed (Libra, shared by Venus and Neptune in his scheme). Lakshmi means wealth, comfort and luxury, so the house sets where that wealth theme lands: income on the 11th, savings on the 2nd, home comforts on the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo (7-2+1=6). Libra is the 2nd house, so the Lakshmi Ishta is read as support for savings, speech and family wealth.
Derived: lagna Cancer (7-4+1=4). Libra is the 4th house, so Lakshmi is read as comfort at home, vehicles and property.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (7-11+1=-3, so 9). Libra is the 11th house, so Lakshmi is read as steady income and fulfilment of gains.

ambiguity: 'साथ शेयर करता है' does not say who shares with whom; I read it as Varuna sharing Libra with Venus. 'सात नंबर' is sign seven.
classical_check: The Venus to Lakshmi link and Libra as Venus's sign are classical; the Neptune/Varuna share of Libra is his 12-planet scheme.

hindi: आठ नंबर आपके हनुमान जी है
says: Number eight, the sign Scorpio, is Hanuman's number.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed (Scorpio; Mars or Uranus in his scheme). House decides where the courage and protection theme shows: the 1st as body and self, the 5th as devotion, the 10th as career strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (8-1+1=8). Scorpio is the lagna, so the Hanuman Ishta shows as personal drive, stamina and a protective instinct.
Derived: lagna Cancer (8-5+1=4). Scorpio is the 5th house, so Hanuman is read as the devotional Ishta, with courage in studies and in matters of children.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (8-10+1=-1, so 11). Scorpio is the 10th house, so Hanuman is read as the protector of career and the source of working strength.

ambiguity: He does not name Mars here; Mars is added from Scorpio's lordship and Hanuman's usual link. 'आठ नंबर' is sign eight.
classical_check: Silent on the Hanuman to Scorpio link; Hanuman as a Mars deity and Scorpio as a Mars sign are traditional.

hindi: ही हनुमान अलाव होते हैं अगर विवाहित नॉन विवाहित का लफड़ा अदर वाइज राम की पूजा करो कृष्ण की करो यह अवतार है
says: A caveat on Hanuman as Ishta: there is an issue of married versus unmarried devotees (Hanuman being celibate); otherwise he says worship Ram or Krishna, who are avatars.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent beyond the Hanuman sign.
ambiguity: 'अलाव' is probably 'allowed'; it is unclear whether he says Hanuman is fine for both or has a restriction for married people. The sentence runs across two caption lines, so the exact words are uncertain.
classical_check: Silent; Rama and Krishna as Vishnu avatars is standard, and BPHS gives Rama to the Sun and Krishna to the Moon, not to Mars.

hindi: नौ नंबर बृहस्पति का है ये विष्णु स्वरूप होते हैं
says: Number nine, the sign Sagittarius, belongs to Jupiter and its deities are forms of Vishnu.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed (Sagittarius, Jupiter). The house decides which life area the Vishnu-type Ishta supports: wisdom and children on the 5th, dharma and luck on the 9th, release on the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5). Sagittarius is the 5th house, so a Vishnu-form Ishta sits on the house of devotion, mantra and children, with Jupiter in its own sign.
Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1). Sagittarius is the 9th house, so Vishnu worship doubles with the house of dharma, guru and luck.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (9-12+1=-2, so 10). Sagittarius is the 12th house, so Vishnu worship is tied to retreat, foreign places and release.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर' is sign nine; 'विष्णु स्वरूप होते हैं' is plural, so he means several Vishnu forms without naming them.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is linked to Vishnu in tradition and Sagittarius is Jupiter's own sign.

hindi: विष्णु जी ही पांच नंबर है नौ नंबर बेसिकली गुरु है
says: He adds that Vishnu is also found at number five (Leo), while number nine is basically the guru's number.
cells_derived_method: Two signs are named: Leo (5) for Vishnu and Sagittarius (9) for the guru. The house sets the area: Leo on the 5th or 9th is a trikona link to Vishnu or Rama devotion, and Sagittarius on the lagna makes the guru nature personal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (5-5+1=1). Leo is the 5th house, so the Vishnu link falls on the classical house of Ishta and purva-punya.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (5-9+1=-3, so 9). Leo is the 9th house, so a Vishnu or Rama devotion is read as part of dharma and fortune.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (9-1+1=9). Sagittarius on the lagna makes the guru nature part of the native's own character.

ambiguity: 'विष्णु जी ही पांच नंबर है' may be 'Vishnu is also number five' or 'Vishnu is number five'; it is also not clear whether 'पांच' is a sign or a lost house number. Jupiter is added from the guru remark, not from the Leo clause.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Vishnu is linked to the Sun (Surya-Narayana, Rama as the Sun's avatar), which fits Leo, and to Jupiter, which fits Sagittarius.

hindi: आपके परिवार में जो गुरु की आपकी मानता है उस गुरु की फोटो मात्र रखना उसके लिए स्मर करना मात्र आपके जीवन
says: For a guru-type Ishta it is enough to keep just the photograph of the guru your family follows and to remember him; no elaborate ritual is required.
cells_derived_method: none: a simple remedy, not house or sign dependent beyond the guru sign.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at 'आपके जीवन'; the Sagittarius cell is carried from the 'nine is basically guru' sentence before it.
classical_check: Silent; guru photo and remembrance is a modern devotional practice, while the classical idea is guru-smarana and guru-bhakti.

hindi: लोग कई ऐसे मंदिर में कहते हैं हमने गुरु जी की फोटो रखी है यह पाप है नहीं बिल्कुल पाप नहीं है हो सकता है भैया आपकी कुंडली में ही ऐसा ग्रह है
says: Answering a worry: many people say they keep a guru's photo in the home temple and ask if that is a sin; he says it is absolutely not a sin, and that your own chart may simply carry a planet that makes this your path.
cells_derived_method: He names no placement. Derived: the chart marker would be a strong guru planet, such as Jupiter exalted in Cancer or in its own sign Sagittarius or Pisces, especially in a kendra or trikona.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Jupiter exalted on the lagna: a natural pull to guru devotion and a teacher-like character.
Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5). Jupiter in its own sign in the 5th: guru mantra and devotion carried from past merit.
Derived: lagna Virgo (12-7+1=6). Jupiter in its own sign in the 7th: gurus and mentors arrive through partners and public dealings.

ambiguity: 'ऐसा ग्रह' does not say which planet; Jupiter is my reading from the guru context.
classical_check: Silent on guru photographs; the classical principle that the chart shows one's devotional bent (5th, 9th, Jupiter) agrees in spirit.

hindi: अब नौ नंबर है 10 नंबर आपका आ गया तो शनि महाराज है शनि आपका इष्ट है
says: Moving on, number ten, the sign Capricorn, is Saturn Maharaj; if your number is ten, Saturn is your Ishta.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed (Capricorn, Saturn's own sign). The house decides which Saturn topic the Ishta carries: partner and delay on the 7th, secrecy and research on the 8th, work and discipline on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (10-7+1=4). Saturn rules the 7th and 8th and sits in its own sign in the 7th, so the Saturn Ishta brings a disciplined, sober partner theme and slow marriage matters.
Derived: lagna Gemini (10-8+1=3). Saturn rules the 8th and 9th and sits in its own sign in the 8th, so the Ishta leans to research, secrecy and slow transformation.
Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Saturn rules the 10th and 11th and sits in its own sign in the 10th, so the Ishta works through hard work, discipline and long service.

ambiguity: 'अब नौ नंबर है 10 नंबर आपका आ गया' is loosely worded; I read it as 'after nine comes ten, and if ten is yours'. Sign ten, not house ten.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn as the deity-ruler of Capricorn is classical; Saturn as a person's Ishta is unusual in the texts and is his scheme.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर ऐसी कई बीमारियां है आपकी जो होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन से ठीक होती हैं
says: He claims that for a Saturn-Ishta person many of the ailments in life are of the kind that get better with homeopathic medicine; recorded only as his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives no house or sign beyond the Saturn Ishta context.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether this applies to every Saturn-Ishta person or only some listeners; the claim is not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link Saturn to chronic ailments but homeopathy postdates them.

hindi: अगर होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन काम नहीं कर रही तो नॉर्थ ईस्ट के एग्जैक्ट साथ में है नॉर्थ नॉर्थ ईस्ट वहां शराब की बोतल रखो होम्योपैथिक दवाई से आराम आएगा
says: Vastu remedy as he states it: if homeopathic medicine is not working, keep a bottle of liquor in the north-north-east, next to the north-east, and the homeopathic medicine will then bring relief. A tradition claim only, neither medical advice nor an endorsement.
cells_derived_method: none: a direction-based Vastu remedy, not dependent on house or sign beyond the Saturn Ishta context.
ambiguity: 'एग्जैक्ट साथ में है नॉर्थ' is garbled; I read it as the direction right beside the north-east, i.e. north-north-east.
classical_check: Differs: classical Vastu keeps the north-east pure for Ishana, so liquor there conflicts with it; this is his own Saturn remedy.

hindi: अब बताओ दे का स्थान है मंदिर बनाते हैं वहां शराब रखी जाती है वहां उसकी कुंडली का वही हाल है उसको वही चलेगा ऐसा क्यों होता है
says: He points to deity places and temples where liquor is offered, argues that the worshippers there have a chart in the same condition so that practice suits them, and poses the question of why this happens; the answer is not in this slice.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives no house or sign; the idea is that a person's chart condition decides which offering suits the Ishta.
ambiguity: 'दे का स्थान' is probably 'देव का स्थान' (a deity's seat); which deity or temple he means (for example a Bhairav shrine) is not named, and the link to Saturn is carried from the previous rows.
classical_check: Silent in the texts; liquor offerings at certain shrines are a living folk practice, not a classical rule.

hindi: अजीबो गरीब रिवर्स साइकोलॉजी काम करती है
says: Taking up the question left open about liquor at a deity's place, he says a strange reverse psychology is at work: what looks like the opposite of a pious remedy can be exactly what works for some people.
cells_derived_method: none: a general principle, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He does not say what the reverse psychology is attached to; I read it as the answer to the previous 'why does this happen' about liquor offerings, but the link is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies do not use a reverse-psychology idea, this is his own explanation.

gist: Anecdotes of cures: people healed by homeopathy after a doctor advised an operation, and Ramdev's Ayurveda healing paralysis patients, which he calls a miracle; recorded as his stories only, not as medical claims.

hindi: ये अलग-अलग ग्रहों के कारण से हो रहा है आपको वो सूट करता है आपके मामा को वो सूट करता है चाचा को वो मम्मी को वैसा पापा को वो सबको अलग-अलग लेकिन सब ठीक हो रहे हैं
says: What suits a person differs because their planets differ: one treatment suits you, another your maternal uncle, another your uncle, mother or father, yet each is getting better with their own, so no single method is right for all.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign given; the idea is that remedy fit follows each person's planetary condition.
ambiguity: He names no planets and gives no rule for matching a method to a planet; the medical examples are his stories, not advice.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical remedial practice picks a remedy by the planet and house that is troubled; he gives no such mapping here.

hindi: आप लकीर के फकीर बन के मत चलो वो पकड़ो जो आपको चाहिए
says: Do not be a blind follower of one fixed line of practice; pick up whichever method or deity actually suits you.
cells_derived_method: none: general advice, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he is warning against rigid ritual, against one-size-fits-all remedies, or both.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 10 और 11 नंबर सेम चलेगा
says: Numbers ten and eleven, Saturn's signs Capricorn and Aquarius, are treated alike: the same Saturn-type Ishta and remedies he just gave for ten will run for eleven.
cells_derived_method: Two Saturn signs share one deity treatment. The house decides how the Saturn Ishta shows: Aquarius in the 5th gives devotion with Saturn's strictness, Aquarius in the 8th research and secrecy, Capricorn in the 10th disciplined work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra (11-5+1=7). Saturn rules the 4th and 5th and Aquarius is the 5th house, so a Saturn Ishta is strongly supported, with a serious, patient devotion and learning.
Derived: lagna Cancer (11-8+1=4). Saturn rules the 7th and 8th and Aquarius is the 8th house, so the Saturn Ishta leans to research, hidden matters and slow, deep change.
Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Saturn rules the 10th and 11th and Capricorn is the 10th house, so the Ishta works through career discipline and long service.

ambiguity: 'सेम चलेगा' could mean the same deity (Saturn) or the same remedies; Aquarius also has Pluto as an alternate lord in his scheme, and he does not say whether Yama's deity applies to eleven.
classical_check: Agrees that Capricorn and Aquarius are both Saturn's signs; the sharing of one Ishta treatment is his scheme.

hindi: हनुमान जी का भी उच्च है यहां लाजवाब
says: Hanuman's (Mars's) exaltation is also here at number ten, Capricorn, which he calls wonderful, so Hanuman is strong at this number alongside Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Mars exalted in Capricorn is strongest in kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), where Ruchaka Mahapurusha yoga forms; the house also decides which lordships Mars carries into that exaltation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (10-1+1=10). Mars rules the 4th and 11th and is exalted on the lagna, giving Ruchaka yoga, a strong body, drive and a Hanuman-type protective nature.
Derived: lagna Libra (10-4+1=7). Mars rules the 2nd and 7th and is exalted in the 4th, giving Ruchaka yoga, with courage at home but possible heat in family and partner matters.
Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Mars is lagna lord and 8th lord and is exalted in the 10th, giving Ruchaka yoga and a powerful, action-driven career.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is read as number ten (Capricorn), since he has just named ten and eleven together; Mars is exalted only in Capricorn, not in Aquarius.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn, and Hanuman as a Mars deity is common tradition.

hindi: 12 नंबर केतु का है केतु है गणपति गणेश जी
says: Number twelve, the sign Pisces, is Ketu's number in his scheme, and Ketu's deity is Ganapati, Lord Ganesh.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed (Pisces, shared with Jupiter in his scheme). The house sets the theme of the Ganesh Ishta: intellect and children on the 5th, guru and dharma on the 9th, release and loss on the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (12-5+1=8). Pisces is the 5th house, so the Ganesh Ishta sits on intellect, mantra and children, with Jupiter's wisdom behind it.
Derived: lagna Cancer (12-9+1=4). Pisces is the 9th house, so Ganesh links with guru, dharma and fortune.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Pisces is the 12th house, so Ganesh as Ketu shows through withdrawal, expenses and moksha themes.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर' is sign twelve (Pisces); Ketu owning Pisces is his scheme, and Jupiter also owns it, so the deity for a Pisces person could be read as Jupiter's or Ketu's.
classical_check: Differs in part: Ganesh is classically linked to Ketu in many traditions, but Ketu does not rule Pisces in the classical texts; Jupiter does.

hindi: अगर आ गए तो फिर तो खत्म सारा पैसा सारी अपॉर्चुनिटी सारी बुद्धि सारी लेखनी सब गणपति के पास है
says: If Ganapati comes in as your Ishta nothing more is needed, because all money, opportunity, intelligence and writing ability are said to lie with him.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka list for Ganesh, not house or sign dependent beyond the Ketu sign.
ambiguity: 'फिर तो खत्म' is read as 'then everything is settled'; it could also be read as 'then it is over' in the sense of finished, but the list that follows supports the first.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ganesh is the remover of obstacles and patron of intellect and writing, but classical Ketu karakatwas are moksha, detachment and sudden events, not money.

hindi: केतु यही सेक्स का देवता है
says: Karaka claim: Ketu is the god of sex, so sexual drive and satisfaction fall under Ketu in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka statement, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'यही' (this very one) refers back to Ketu as Ganapati; it is not clear whether he treats sex as Ketu's only theme or one among several.
classical_check: Differs: classically sexual pleasure is Venus's karaka, with Mars for desire; Ketu is mainly detachment and moksha, so this is his assignment.

hindi: आप पार्टी करते हो आप अपने जीवन के अंदर ज्ञान चर्चा करोगे पार्टी करते हुए भी
says: A Ganesh-type person parties yet will still carry on talk of knowledge in life, even in the middle of a party.
cells_derived_method: none: a behaviour description, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether this is a prediction for the Ganesh-Ishta person or a general remark about Ketu-type people.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गणपति इष्ट हो जाने से आप पार्टी प्लेस में दारू का गिलास में हाथ पकड़ के ज्ञान की बात कर रहे होंगे आपका ज्ञान कौन सा है हो सकता है वर्ल्ड पॉलिटिक्स की बात कर रहे हैं
says: With Ganesh as Ishta you may be standing at a party with a glass of liquor in hand talking about knowledge, and the topics could be world politics among other things; he is describing a lifestyle, not recommending drink.
cells_derived_method: none: a lifestyle illustration, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he treats drinking as part of the Ganesh nature or only as a setting for the example.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हो सकता है आप सांसारिक की बात कर रहे हैं हो सकता है आप कह रहे हैं मनी इन्वेस्टमेंट ऐसे करनी चाहिए ज्ञान का मुद्दा ये नहीं है स्पिरिचुअल हो गए
says: The knowledge he means is not worldly party talk, whether that is everyday matters or how money should be invested (he cites investment talk only as an example of the worldly kind, and gives no investment advice); real knowledge here means spiritual knowledge.
cells_derived_method: none: a clarification of what 'knowledge' means, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across a caption line break ('ज्ञान का मुद्दा ये नहीं' / 'है स्पिरिचुअल हो गए'); I read it as 'the issue of knowledge is not this, it is spiritual'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अकेले स्पिरिचुअल तो व्यक्ति दारूबाज भी हो सकता है कोई भी हो सकता है पर यह ज्ञान से भर देगा पूरी तरह आपके जीवन के अंदर
says: Being merely spiritual proves nothing, since anyone, even a heavy drinker, can be that; the Ganesh-Ketu Ishta is different because it will fill your life completely with knowledge.
cells_derived_method: none: a contrast, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'यह' is read as Ganesh as Ishta; he does not say how Ganesh fills a life with knowledge in chart terms.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको करना क्या है गणपति क्या है काफी मोटा शरीर दिखाया है पेट निकला हुआ है सूंड है लिखने का काम ते बुद्धिजीवी सब बुद्धि से करते हैं
says: He points to Ganesh's form as the clue: a heavy body, a protruding belly, a trunk and the scribe's task of writing, meaning the intellectual who does everything through the mind; the image ties Ganesh and Ketu to intellect and writing.
cells_derived_method: none: an iconography reading, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'आपको करना क्या है' is a lead-in question with no answer in the caption; the reading of each symbol (belly, trunk, writing) is partly mine.
classical_check: Silent; Ganesh as scribe of the Mahabharata is Puranic and the planet link is his scheme.

hindi: जिस जिस का केतु नाइंथ हाउस का पावर पकड़ा बैठा है
says: For those whose Ketu sits holding the power of the ninth house, he reads Ketu as strong and Ganesh-like in their chart.
cells_derived_method: House fixed (9th), sign free. The sign Ketu occupies in the 9th changes the flavour: Jupiter's signs give a guru-blessed Ketu, a Mercury sign gives an analytical, detached view of dharma.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (12-9+1=4). Ketu in Pisces in the 9th: strong spiritual detachment, with Jupiter's sign softening it into a guru-oriented, devotional nature.
Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1). Ketu in Sagittarius in the 9th: his exaltation case, giving deep dharma and philosophical depth.
Derived: lagna Libra (3-9+1=-5, so 7). Ketu in Gemini in the 9th: a questioning, analytical stance towards religion and the father, with detachment rather than devotion.

ambiguity: 'नाइंथ हाउस का पावर पकड़ा बैठा है' could mean Ketu placed in the 9th house or Ketu holding the 9th-house strength by sign; his next sentence speaks of the ninth sign, so the two may be blended.
classical_check: Silent on a special strength of Ketu in the 9th; classical texts treat it as detachment from father and rituals, which differs from his Ganesh reading.

hindi: 12 नंबर राशि है नौ नंबर में उच्च होता है केतु उच्च बृहस्पति के घर सर्वोत्तम सबसे बड़ा आसन
says: Pisces, number twelve, is Ketu's sign, and Ketu is exalted at number nine, Sagittarius, in Jupiter's house, which he calls the best and biggest seat for Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Ketu is at home in Pisces and exalted in Sagittarius. The house sets what the strength serves: Sagittarius in the 5th gives an exalted Ketu in the house of intellect, Pisces in the 12th puts Ketu in its natural moksha house, Sagittarius in the 10th gives a detached but powerful career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5). Ketu exalted in the 5th: deep intuition, past-life mantra strength, but a detached or interrupted bond with children.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). Ketu in its own sign (his scheme) in the 12th: strong pull to moksha, retreat and charity, with a quiet inner life.
Derived: lagna Pisces (9-10+1=0, so 12). Ketu exalted in the 10th: respected, knowledge-based work that the native holds with detachment.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर में' is sign nine (Sagittarius) since he calls it Jupiter's house; the earlier clause about the ninth house may refer to the 9th house instead.
classical_check: Partly agrees: traditions differ on Ketu's exaltation, Scorpio in most South Indian texts and Sagittarius in some others, so Sagittarius is one accepted view; Ketu owning Pisces is not classical.

hindi: गुरु किसका सम्मान कर रहा है सोच के चलो गुरु किसका सम्मान कर रहा है सेक्स चक्र है हमारा वाटर चक्र है
says: He reads Ketu's exaltation in Jupiter's house as the guru honouring Ketu, and tells you to ask whom the guru is honouring: the sex chakra, our water chakra.
cells_derived_method: none: a symbolic reading of an exaltation, no extra house or sign dependence beyond Sagittarius.
ambiguity: The Sagittarius cell is carried from the previous sentence; 'वाटर चक्र' most likely means the Swadhisthana (water) chakra.
classical_check: Silent; mapping Ketu to the Swadhisthana chakra is a yogic overlay, not a classical Jyotish rule.

hindi: य जहां गुरु और केतु की स्थापना है वो ज्ञान की स्थापना कर रहा है कौन है ज्ञान संभोग वो कह रहा है संभोग से तृप्त हो जाओ फिर ज्ञान पकड़ोगे
says: Where Jupiter and Ketu are established together, knowledge is being established, and that knowledge, he says, is sexual union: be satisfied through sex first, then you will take up knowledge.
cells_derived_method: none: no houses are given for the Jupiter-Ketu pairing beyond the sign Sagittarius where Ketu is exalted in his view.
ambiguity: 'स्थापना' could mean a conjunction, Ketu in Jupiter's sign, or just the pairing of the two as ideas; I take it as Ketu placed in Jupiter's house, linked to the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent; the Jupiter-Ketu pairing is classically a moksha and spiritual combination, not a sexual-fulfilment one.

gist: Refers to the Osho story 'from sex to superconsciousness' and its advice to finish this nuisance if sex is a nuisance in your life; a philosophical aside, not a chart rule.

hindi: है इससे फ्री हो जाओ बॉडी का ब्रेन त्रस्त नहीं रहेगा तृप्त हो जाएगा अब तुम समाधि की ओर जा सकते हो
says: Once the sexual need is settled the body's brain stops being tormented and becomes satisfied, and only then can you move toward samadhi; fulfilment comes before transcendence in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: none: a general sequence from fulfilment to samadhi, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence begins mid-thought ('है इससे फ्री हो जाओ'), continuing the Osho aside; 'बॉडी का ब्रेन' is an odd phrase, read as the mind tied to bodily urges.
classical_check: Silent; this is a philosophical stance borrowed from Osho, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: यानी नीचे के चक्र से स्वाधिष्ठान से सहसरारा च चक्र तक की यात्रा आपका यह तब होगा जब केतु को गुरु सम्मान दे रहा है जब केतु महाराज आते हैं गुरु के घर पर
says: The inner journey from the lower chakra, Swadhisthana, up to Sahasrara happens when the guru honours Ketu, that is, when Ketu comes into the guru's (Jupiter's) house.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in Jupiter's house means Sagittarius (his exaltation sign for Ketu). The house sets the road of the ascent: the 9th through dharma and teachers, the 12th through solitude and retreat, the 1st through the native's own temperament.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1). Ketu exalted in the 9th: the upward journey becomes a main life theme, reached through dharma, teachers and pilgrimage.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (9-12+1=-2, so 10). Ketu exalted in the 12th: the ascent runs through meditation, solitude and time spent away from home or abroad.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (9-1+1=9). Ketu exalted on the lagna: the seeker's temperament shows in body and manner, and the climb is a personal project.

ambiguity: 'गुरु के घर' is read as Sagittarius, where he said Ketu is exalted; Pisces is also Jupiter's house and is not excluded.
classical_check: Silent; the chakra journey is a yogic idea and the Ketu-in-Jupiter's-sign link is his own reading.

hindi: यानी कि हमारे शरीर के सारे वो ऑर्गन जो शरीर में हड्डी के फ हमारा लिंग वक्ष यह सारा का सारा शरीर का जो मासल एरिया है यह सारा का सारा केतु है
says: Karaka claim: Ketu is the physical body, meaning its organs, the bony frame, the genital organ, the chest and the whole fleshy, muscular part; a list of body parts, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka list, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'हड्डी के फ' is cut off (perhaps 'फ्रेम', bone frame); 'वक्ष' means chest or breast.
classical_check: Differs: classically bones go to Saturn and the Sun, the chest to the Moon and the genitals to Venus and Mars; this body-wide assignment to Ketu is his own.

hindi: इसको सम्मान देता गुरु गुरु कहता है आओ तुम सम्मानित हो गुरु क्या कर रहा है सम्मान देके ज्ञानी व्यक्ति हाथ जोड़ रहा है यह नहीं कह रहा फिसल गया
says: The guru honours this bodily side of Ketu, telling it 'come, you are respected'; a wise person greets it with folded hands, acknowledging the body without sliding into it.
cells_derived_method: none: a symbolic description of Jupiter honouring Ketu, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'यह नहीं कह रहा फिसल गया' is read as 'he is not saying he has slipped'; the contrast with falling comes in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर गुरु फिसल गया तो सहसरारा से फिसल के बेज्जती और तबाही पर आएगा
says: If the guru slips, he falls down from Sahasrara into disgrace and ruin; so a teacher or wise person who yields to temptation loses status and standing.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given for this fall.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether 'गुरु' here is Jupiter in the chart or a human guru; I read it as the guru principle in general.
classical_check: Silent; classically an afflicted Jupiter is linked with loss of reputation, similar in result but not in mechanism.

hindi: इसलिए गुरु वही व्यक्ति है जो सौंदर्य से चिज जियों से पुरुष पुरुष की दूसरे की गाड़ी से या स्त्री के सौंदर्य से उसके स्पर्श से पागल नहीं हो रहा उसने उसको नमस्कार कर दिया है क्या तू
says: Definition of a guru: the person who is not driven mad by beauty, by things, by another man's car or by a woman's beauty and touch, because he has already bowed to them and moved on.
cells_derived_method: none: a character definition, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'चिज जियों' is a garble of 'चीजों' (things); 'पुरुष पुरुष की दूसरे की गाड़ी' is read as another man's car.
classical_check: Silent; classically Jupiter signifies wisdom and self-restraint, which fits in spirit.

gist: Mimics the guru casually dismissing temptation: 'what, you sit, take it, done, okay bye'.

hindi: तो केतु को इसीलिए बहुत महत्त्वपूर्ण कहा गया क्योंकि य गुरु के समक्ष है जहां से हम ज्ञान की बात कर रहे हैं वही से हम जन्म की बात कर रहे हैं
says: He gives the reason Ketu is called very important: it stands facing the guru, so the very place from which we speak of knowledge is also the place from which we speak of birth.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement of Ketu's importance, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'गुरु के समक्ष' (in front of or facing the guru) is spatial and probably refers to the lowest and highest chakra pair, not a chart aspect.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu's importance is usually put as moksha and past-life karma, not as birth.

hindi: वही मेंसी है वही हमारा सेक्स तंत्र है वहीं से हमारा प्रजनन है वहीं से हम मूत्र विसर्जन करते हैं
says: Karaka list for Ketu: menstruation, the sexual system, reproduction and urinary excretion all belong to the same place, which he assigns to Ketu; a body-function list, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka list, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'मेंसी' is read as 'menses'.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon rules menstruation and Venus and Mars the reproductive and urinary systems, so this assignment to Ketu is his own.

hindi: हमारी किड इसके पास है हमारा लिवर इसके पास है हमारे शरीर की सारी स्किन इसके पास है
says: More Ketu karakas: the kidneys, the liver and all of the body's skin are said to be under Ketu; a list of body parts as he gives it, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka list, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'किड' is read as 'kidney'.
classical_check: Differs: classical lists give kidneys to Venus, the liver to Jupiter and skin to Mercury and Saturn, while Ketu is assigned all three here.

hindi: आपके जीवन में बीमार पड़ के भी अगर आप चल रहे हैं तो केतु की पावर है
says: If you keep going in life even after falling ill, that is Ketu's power at work: he links endurance through sickness to Ketu rather than to weakness.
cells_derived_method: none: a general karaka claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether this describes any Ketu-strong person or just those who have Ganesh as Ishta.
classical_check: Differs: classically Ketu is linked with sudden or mysterious ailments, not with resilience through them.

hindi: केतु 75 पर का देवता है 100 नहीं है अगर केतु आपके कर्म स्थान में बैठा है तो 75 पर सक्सेस
says: Ketu is the god of seventy-five percent, never a full hundred; if Ketu sits in your karma sthana, the 10th house, you get about seventy-five percent success in work.
cells_derived_method: House fixed (10th), sign free. The sign Ketu holds in the 10th colours which field gives the 75 percent result: a Mercury sign points to writing and trade, a Jupiter sign to teaching or advice, an earth sign to service and analysis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces (9-10+1=0, so 12). Ketu in the 10th in his exaltation sign: respected, knowledge-based work, held with detachment, a strong but incomplete success.
Derived: lagna Virgo (3-10+1=-6, so 6). Ketu in the 10th in a Mercury sign: partial success in writing, communication or trade, with a restless, change-prone career.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (6-10+1=-3, so 9). Ketu in the 10th in an earth sign: service and analysis work where the result is good but never complete.

ambiguity: 'कर्म स्थान' is read as the 10th house; it could also mean the house of karma in a wider sense, but the 10th is the standard meaning. The 75 percent is a rough figure, not a computed one.
classical_check: Silent on a percentage rule; classical texts read Ketu in the 10th as detached or sudden-change career results, which loosely fits partial success.

hindi: शादी चली तो 75 पर सक्सेस एक जगह शादी की बात चल के छूटेगी या टूटेगी अगर केतु की दृष्टि है फिर शादी होगी
says: In marriage too Ketu gives about seventy-five percent success: one proposal will go forward and then slip away or break, but if Ketu aspects the marriage house, a marriage does happen afterwards.
cells_derived_method: House read as the 7th (marriage), sign free. The sign on the 7th changes how the break-then-marry pattern looks: Venus signs give a smooth later union, Saturn signs a delayed one, Jupiter signs a union arranged through elders.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1). Libra is the 7th house; a Ketu glance gives one broken proposal and then a union, with Venus ruling the 7th favouring a pleasant outcome later.
Derived: lagna Cancer (10-7+1=4). Capricorn is the 7th house; with Ketu aspecting it, one proposal fails and the marriage comes late, in Saturn's slow manner.
Derived: lagna Gemini (9-7+1=3). Sagittarius is the 7th house; after a broken proposal the match comes through elders or a guru's advice, in Jupiter's style.

classical_check: Silent on Ketu aspects: BPHS gives no special aspect to Ketu, though many modern schools give Rahu and Ketu the 5th, 7th and 9th.

hindi: एक अफेर हो के छूटेगा टूटेगा फिर शादी के लिए अफेयर पूरा होगा

hindi: एक पढ़ाई बच्चा छोड़ेगा अगर पांचवे घर पर दृष्टि है उसके बाद पढ़ाई पूरी करेगा एक एक बार फेलियर जरूर देता है

Derived: lagna Cancer (8-5+1=4). Scorpio is the 5th house; the break comes through conflict or sudden events, and the studies are picked up again after.
Derived: lagna Virgo (10-5+1=6). Capricorn is the 5th house; the interruption is long, so the degree is finished late but finished.

ambiguity: 'अगर पांचवे घर पर दृष्टि है' does not say whose aspect; Ketu's is carried from the previous sentences. 'फेलियर' may refer to an exam failure or any setback in studies.
classical_check: Silent on Ketu aspects; classically Ketu in or on the 5th is linked with disturbed education and children, which loosely fits an interruption.

hindi: तो इसकी कृपा कब होगी जब आप पार्टी करते हैं जब पार्टी करते हो ज्ञान की बात करते हैं यह गणपति है

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गणपति शैतान बहुत है कहानिया है उनकी बहुत मिसचिवस शैतानी के देवता है छोटा सा हाथी देखा आपने कितना शैतान होता घूमता भागता खेलता है

hindi: तो शैतान है तो आप शैतान है लेकिन उसके बावजूद ये गणपति की कृपा है यह कृपा आपको मिल जाएगी आपकी सेक्स लाइफ बढ़िया है जो एक बहुत महत्त्वपूर्ण बात है

classical_check: Silent; classically a happy married life is read from the 7th house and Venus, not from Ketu.

hindi: इसकी बात हम व्यर्थ नहीं करते तभी जाकर आप ज्ञानी भी बनोगे
says: He defends talking about sex: it is not discussed in vain, because only when that part of life is in order will you also become a knower.
cells_derived_method: none: a justification, not house or sign dependent.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे शास्त्रों में जितने ऋषि रहे हैं सबकी ऋषि पत्नियां थी गुरु थे गुरु माता थी

hindi: काहे के लिए स्यापा खत्म स्वाधिष्ठान से तो ऊपर उठना ही है छोड़ना थोड़ी है तब आपके गणपति

hindi: अब जो जो ग्रह जिस जिस ग्रह के साथ मित्र है उस उसका देवता उसका मित्र बन सकता है

cells_derived_method: Uses classical natural friendships (not stated by him): Moon's friends are Sun and Mercury, Venus's are Mercury and Saturn, Jupiter's are Sun, Moon and Mars. The lagna sign's lord decides which friend deities are open to a person.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Moon's friends are the Sun and Mercury, so a Shiva-type person could also take the Sun's deity (Ram or Surya) or Mercury's (Saraswati or Durga).
Derived: lagna Taurus (2-1+1=2). Venus's friends are Mercury and Saturn, so a Lakshmi-type person could also take Mercury's deities or Saturn's.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (9-1+1=9). Jupiter's friends are the Sun, Moon and Mars, so a Vishnu or guru-type person could also take Ram, Shiva or Hanuman.

ambiguity: 'उस उसका देवता उसका मित्र बन सकता है' is loose; I read it as the deity of a friend planet becoming a usable Ishta for the other planet's people. He does not say which friendship table he uses.
classical_check: Silent on substituting deities; the classical natural-friendship tables (naisargika maitri) are real, but using them to change Ishta is his rule.

hindi: जैसे कि एक नंबर राशि के साथ बृहस्पति की भी मित्र है मंगल तो है मंगल की राशि तो है ही सूर्य की भी है तो वहां पर सब हनुमान जी की पूजा कर सकते हैं
says: Example of the friend rule: number one, Aries, is Mars's own sign, friendly to Jupiter and linked with the Sun, so people tied to any of those three can all worship Hanuman there.

Derived: lagna Leo (1-9+1=-7, so 5). Aries is the 9th house, so Hanuman works as a protector of dharma and fortune, in line with the Sun's close link to Aries.
Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4). Aries is the 10th house, so Hanuman is read as the protector of career and the source of working strength.

classical_check: Agrees in part: Aries is Mars's own sign, the Sun is exalted there, and the Sun and Jupiter are Mars's natural friends.

hindi: आप हनुमान की पूजा कर सकते हो हनुमान इष्ट बना सकते हो नहीं तो राम की कर सकते हो कोई भी समस्या नहीं है लाजवाब फल और रिजल्ट्स मिलेंगे आपके जीवन में

classical_check: Silent; Ram as the avatar linked to the Sun (BPHS) fits the Sun's tie to Aries.

hindi: आपको कॉन्फिडेंस की कमी है तो सिंदूरी हनुमान जी साउथ साउथ ईस्ट में रखो घुटना लगा हुआ जमीन पर हनुमान जी लाल रंग के आप साउथ में रखो

hindi: छोटे बच्चे आ साल से छोटे बच्चे एक्चुअली कहते हैं ना बंदर की तरह नकलची बंदर बंदर क्या करता है मनुष्य की नकल 8 साल से छोटे बच्चे की सेवा करो उसको मीठा खिलाओ बच्चा चॉकलेट खाता है

Finishes the wondering about milk teeth: why they come at all as a stop-gap, then fall and are replaced, and who designed it; the system seems to run by itself.

hindi: तो छोटा बच्चा जिसके दूध के दांत टूटे नहीं उस बच्चे की सेवा करो मंगल

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर छोटा बच्चा जो 8 साल से 9 साल का छोटा बच्चा है उसके पास क्या करता है खेलता है ज्ञान करता है मस्ती मारता है धासू नींद आपको ये सारी समस्याए आ रही है

Asks how the child's dopamine would be made otherwise, and says boys eat more sweets than girls while girls prefer spicy food, as nature has set it.
Says boys also drink more liquor than girls, that both get dopamine from it, and that some women drink a lot but men are the large majority.
Says nature has arranged some dopamine game and that he does not know what the story behind it is.

hindi: क्योंकि ग्रह भी पुरुष ग्रह और स्त्री ग्रह होते हैं सूर्य मंगल बृहस्पति य पुरुष ग्रह शुक्र चंद्रमा स्त्री ग्रह है
says: Planets too have a sex: the Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male planets and Venus and the Moon are female planets, which he offers as the reason men and women differ in their habits.

hindi: शनि नपुंसक है बुध भी नपुंसक है एक स्त्री नपुंसक है एक पुरुष नपुंसक है

classical_check: Agrees that Saturn and Mercury are classically neuter (napumsaka); the female-neuter and male-neuter split is not in the texts I know.

hindi: यह सारे के सारे सूचक है इनके द्वारा हम जीवन के ऊपर इंपैक्ट पड़ते हैं

hindi: आपके किसी ग्रह की फॉल्ट है तो वह जगह अगर बुध शनि के अंडर है व नपुंसक हो गई

Derived: lagna Sagittarius (11-3+1=9). Mercury rules the 7th and 10th and sits in Saturn's sign in the 3rd; under his rule business effort, deals and writing read as slow and lacking drive.
Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Mercury rules the 3rd and 6th and sits in Saturn's sign in the 10th; under his rule a communication or trade career reads as over-serious and ineffective.

gist: Remarks that Saturn is such an interesting planet that talking about him needs a separate class, which would not fit in one session.

hindi: तो आपको कामना करके अमीर बनाता है कमाल हो गया यार काम मत करो पूजा पाठ मत करो तभी कृपा दूंगा
says: Saturn's paradox as he voices it: he makes you rich through wanting, but his message is do not work and do not do puja and rituals, and only then will he give his grace; a wealth claim, not investment advice.

classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn rewards sustained work and discipline; this inverted idea is his own.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि क्या डार्क एनर्जी तमस का देवता
says: He defines Saturn as dark energy, the deity of tamas, the heavy and inert quality.

ambiguity: 'डार्क एनर्जी' is his own phrase and is not meant in the physics sense.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the tamasic planet in the classical gunas.

gist: Garbled aside ('who is he, Munna, Munna does not need parma at all') whose meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: व तो छुपा हुआ है शनि छुपा हुआ बृहस्पति के अंडर व तक सूरज की किरण नहीं आती काला मानते हैं उसे कैसे चलेगा
says: Saturn is hidden, placed under Jupiter, where even the Sun's rays do not reach, and people call him black; he asks how that can be dealt with.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given; 'under Jupiter' is a positional idea, not a stated chart cell.

classical_check: Silent on 'under Jupiter'; classically Saturn is the darkest planet and the Sun his enemy, so no sunlight is consistent in spirit.

hindi: और कृष्ण की बात क्या है वह काला एक बांसुरी वाला काला है शनि का रंग लेकर पैदा हुआ है
