cells_derived_method: none: a deity-to-planet link, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'शनि का रंग' (Saturn's colour) is read as dark or black.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS gives Krishna to the Moon and Saturn's avatar is Kurma, so the Krishna to Saturn link is his own.

hindi: इसलिए व किसकी पूजा करे अरे उसी की पूजा करो सब
says: Conclusion for the Saturn type: whom should he worship? Worship that same dark Krishna, he tells everyone.
cells_derived_method: none: a deity-choice remedy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'व' (he) may be a Saturn-natured person or Krishna himself; 'सब' may mean all of you or all kinds of worship.
classical_check: Silent; Krishna worship for Saturn is not a classical remedy, which prefers Hanuman, Shani or Bhairava.

hindi: और कितना चालू है साम दाम दंड भेद ऐसी की तैसी सारे नौटंकी कर लूंगा
says: He describes how shrewd the Krishna-Saturn type is: he uses all four strategies of persuasion, payment, punishment and division, and says he will play every trick as needed.
cells_derived_method: none: a trait description, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'चालू' (shrewd) could describe Krishna, Saturn or the person; the quoted voice is Krishna-like.
classical_check: Silent; saam, daam, danda and bheda are the classical four upayas of statecraft, and linking them to Saturn is his own.

gist: Puranic story: the deity Jayant carried the nectar to the gods during the churning of the ocean, and he asks how he managed it.

hindi: हमारे शरीर में देवता भी है असुर भी है हमारे शरीर में पोटी भी है सुसू भी है अमृत भी है अमृत चक्र भी है
says: Our body holds opposites together: gods and demons, waste and urine as well as nectar, and even a chakra of nectar, so purity and impurity coexist in one body.
cells_derived_method: none: a general statement, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He names no planet for the body's nectar chakra or its opposites in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; the 'amrita chakra' is a yogic or tantric idea, not a Jyotish one.

hindi: घर में हमारे कूड़े दान भी है घर में हमारे अमृत का एरिया भोजन का एरिया भी है प्यार भी करते हैं हम घर में कुत्ते खानी लड़ाई भी खूब करते हैं
says: The house is the same as the body: it has a dustbin and also a nectar zone, the food area, and we both love and fight like dogs in it, so a home too holds opposites side by side.
cells_derived_method: none: a general Vastu-style remark, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'अमृत का एरिया भोजन का एरिया' equates the nectar zone with the kitchen or food area; no direction is given.
classical_check: Silent; classical Vastu does separate food and waste zones but he gives no direction here.

hindi: ये कौन करेगा सेट जयंत
says: He asks who will balance all these opposites in the body and the home, and answers: Jayant, the nectar-bearing deity.
cells_derived_method: none: no planet, house or sign is given for Jayant.
ambiguity: He does not link Jayant to a planet or number in this slice; the sentence follows the caption line break.
classical_check: Silent; Jayant (Indra's son) carrying the nectar is Puranic, with no Jyotish role.

gist: Story continues: Jayant ran round and round with the pot of nectar and declared he would deliver it to the gods, only then would the whole pot work.
Mentions that what Vishnu did in his Mohini form is a different story, not told here.

hindi: उसने कैसे किया साम दम दंड भेद थ की एंट्रेंस कुछ भी हो जाए मैं साम दम दंड भेद लगाऊंगा
says: How Jayant managed it: by saam, daam, dand and bhed (persuasion, payment, punishment, division), whatever happened; this is the method behind the balancing job.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement of method, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'थ की एंट्रेंस' is garbled and is dropped; the quoted voice is Jayant's.
classical_check: Silent; the four upayas come from statecraft texts, not from Jyotish.

hindi: किसने किया वो काला एक बांसरी वाला कौन कृष्ण कन्हैया शनि को भी जेब में लेकर घूम रहा है रावण पैर के नीचे रखे बैठा था कृष्ण ने वो भी जेब में रख लिया
says: Who did this? The dark flute-player, Krishna, who goes around with even Saturn in his pocket; Ravana had kept Saturn under his foot, but Krishna put him in his pocket, meaning devotion to Krishna masters Saturn.
cells_derived_method: none: a deity-over-planet claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether 'वो' is Krishna or Jayant doing the setting; I read the answer as Krishna.
classical_check: Silent on Krishna over Saturn; Ravana keeping the planets under his feet is Puranic folklore.

hindi: व्यक्ति का चरित्र कैसा होना चाहिए मर्यादा पुरुषोत्तम राम अलग कॉन्शसनेस है अमर्यादित कृष्ण वो भी एक कॉन्शसनेस है उसको भी लाइसेंस दिया है साम दाम दंड भेद
says: On what a person's character should be, he offers two models of consciousness: Ram, the rule-bound ideal man, and Krishna, the one beyond limits, who has also been given the licence to use saam, daam, dand and bhed; both are valid.
cells_derived_method: none: a character model, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'अमर्यादित' (without limits) is used admiringly, not as a fault; he does not say which type suits which chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rama is Maryada Purushottama and Krishna the Purna Avatar in tradition; assigning them as two consciousness types is his own.

hindi: यदि पति और पत्नी बच्चे के साथ घर के सब बड़े बुजुर्ग एक दूसरे को लाइसेंस दे दे मस्त र यार तुझे जैसे रहना है प्रेम आएगा जब प्रेम आता है तो हृदय चक्र बढ़िया काम करता है
says: If husband, wife, children and the elders of a home give each other the licence to be as they like, love will come, and when love comes the heart chakra works well; the next words connect this to Varuna and Venus.
cells_derived_method: none: a family-conduct principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'लाइसेंस' means freedom to be oneself; the Varuna and Venus link is carried from the next sentence at the line break.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as the planet of love fits, the heart-chakra and Varuna link is his scheme.

hindi: तो वरुण और शुक्र काम करते हैं शुक्र चिजी बनाता है और वरुण जो है वह टॉप है जिसके अंदर देवता स्थापित होता है
says: Then Varuna and Venus come into play: Venus makes the things (objects and comforts), while Varuna is the top, the highest part, within which the deity is established.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka split between Venus and Varuna, shown only through the Libra sign they share in his scheme.
ambiguity: 'टॉप' is vague, possibly the top of the heart centre; the Libra cell is carried from his earlier statement that Venus and Varuna share number seven.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus signifies comforts and objects; Neptune as Varuna in the heart is his scheme.

hindi: वरुण वो स्थान है हृदय में इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल बनता है ये बहुत डीप बातें हैं इलेक्ट्रो यहां बनता है मैग्नेटिक य इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक यहीं से
says: Varuna is the place in the heart where an electromagnetic signal is formed, which he calls a very deep matter, with the electro part forming here and the magnetic part there, together electromagnetic from this point.
cells_derived_method: none: a heart-centre claim, not house or sign dependent beyond the Varuna sign.
ambiguity: 'मैग्नेटिक य' is cut off; the split between electric and magnetic parts is loosely worded.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; the heart's electromagnetic field is a measurable biological fact, but tying it to Varuna is his own idea.

hindi: सी क्यूब की स्पीड से अंतरिक्ष में हमारे वाइब्रेशन जाती है और जो हमने य लगातार सोच लिया
says: From the heart our vibrations travel into space at 'C-cube' speed, carrying whatever we have been thinking continuously.

classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; 'C cubed' is not a speed in physics, so the claim cannot be verified.

gist: Picture of a village girl walking a footpath with a pot on her head and a child in her lap, humming; he asks whether Ram's name is living in her.

hindi: ऐसे ही कबीर अपने हृदय में राम और कृष्ण का नाम रचते थे काम बॉडी कर रही है मुन्ना कर रहा है अंदर राम और कृष्ण ही नकत है
says: Like that, Kabir kept the names of Ram and Krishna in his heart while the body went about its work: the hands do the work but inside only Ram and Krishna are inscribed, so constant inner remembrance of the Ishta during daily work is the practice.
cells_derived_method: none: a devotional principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'नकत' may be 'अंकित' (inscribed) or 'नक्श'; 'मुन्ना कर रहा है' (the child does it) is garbled.
classical_check: Silent; nama-smarana in the manner of Kabir is a devotional tradition and agrees in spirit with Ishta remembrance.

gist: Closes the village-woman picture: that woman knows it all and keeps singing while carrying her child.

hindi: ऐसे ही आपको कॉस्मस से जोड़ने वाली आपकी सी क्यूब क्या होता है लाइट की स्पीड थ्री टाइम्स क्यूब रूट क्यूब से तीन बार आपस में गुणा करना 64.4 क्वाड्रिलियन माइल्स पर सेकंड की स्पीड से

classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; the speed of light cubed is not a speed and the quoted figure does not match it, so it cannot be verified.

hindi: य यहां से आपके वेव्स जाते हैं अंतरिक्ष में और वो कम हो जाता है आप मेनिफेस्ट ही कर रहे हैं 24 घंटे
says: Your waves go out from here into space and then it works out; he says you are manifesting all day, twenty-four hours, whether you know it or not.
cells_derived_method: none: a general manifestation claim, not house or sign dependent.

classical_check: Silent; manifestation as a continuous process is a modern idea, not a classical Jyotish one.

hindi: यदि साक्षी भाव से जान के समझ के करेंगे यानी बृहस्पति और शनि यानी इन दोनों को सेट करते हुए अपने इन दोनों चक्रों को सेट करके

cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is given for the two planets.

classical_check: Silent; classically Jupiter and Saturn are the two slow outer planets of the visible seven, but the chakra mapping is not classical.

hindi: सेट कैसे होंगे वक्री है तो इनका स्टोन पहनो
says: How to set them: if Jupiter or Saturn is retrograde, wear their gemstone.
cells_derived_method: none: retrograde motion is not a house or sign cell.
ambiguity: 'वक्री है' may refer to either or both planets; the 'if retrograde' condition rests on one word, and 'इनका' means the stones of both.
classical_check: Differs: classically a retrograde planet gains cheshta bala (strength) and gems are advised mainly for weak or benefic lords; wearing a stone because of retrogression is a modern practice.

hindi: इनसे मिले हुए जुड़े हुए लोगों की सेवा करो ध्यान दो गुरु को पकड़ो गुरु कौन है दूसरा सेवक
says: Further remedy: serve the people connected with these two planets, pay attention to them and hold on to the guru; asked who the guru is, he says the second one is the servant.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy of service, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'दूसरा सेवक' is read as the second guru being the servant; the first guru is the teacher.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter signifies teachers and Saturn servants and subordinates, so serving both groups is consistent with karakatwas.

hindi: सेवक भी गुरु है उसको खुश करके रखो खुश नहीं रखते हम
says: The servant is also a guru, so keep him happy, but he complains that we do not do so.
cells_derived_method: none: a conduct remedy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: No planet is named for the servant; Saturn is my reading from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is the karaka of servants and subordinates; calling the servant a guru is his own.

hindi: पत्नी बहुत सेवा करती है पति की और हम पत्नियों से लड़ते हैं हमें उसका आभार प्रकट करना चाहिए उसकी कृपा माननी चाहिए उसने हमें पाला है
says: He turns this to marriage: a wife serves her husband greatly while husbands quarrel with wives, so one should thank her and honour her grace, since she has nurtured him; he goes on to call her the first mother after his own mother.
cells_derived_method: none: a conduct remedy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He speaks from the husband's side, and no planet is named for the wife in this slice; the 'first mother' claim continues into the next phrase.
classical_check: Silent; classically the wife is read from the 7th house and Venus, but he gives no chart marker here.

hindi: बच्चे की तरह प्रथम माता है वो हमारी अपनी माता के बाद वही प्रथम माता है बच्चे तो बाद में आए उनकी कृपा मांग के चलेंगे तो कुंडलिनी ऊपर उठेगी
says: The wife is the first mother after your own mother, since the children came later; if you proceed asking for her grace and theirs, the kundalini will rise.
cells_derived_method: none: a conduct and kundalini claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'उनकी कृपा' (their grace) is read as the wife's and the children's together; it could also mean only the wife's.
classical_check: Silent; a kundalini rise from a wife's grace is not in the classical texts.

hindi: अन्यथा स्त्री में पुरुष तत्व आएगा और व खुद लड़ाकी हो जाएगी कोई प्रेम नहीं देगा
says: The warning side: otherwise masculine energy enters the woman, she herself turns quarrelsome and no one gives love.
cells_derived_method: none: a conduct warning, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'पुरुष तत्व' (male element) is his own term and no chart marker is given.
classical_check: Silent.

says: The chain he warns of: when love ends the heart ends, then manifestation ends and you cannot build anything good; you would live and die like an insect, not like a human; a rhetorical warning, not a prediction of death.
cells_derived_method: none: a warning, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'कीड़े की तरह मरोगे' is rhetorical and gives no date or event.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी लाइफ का य उठाव सारी मूवमेंट तब आएगी जब इष्ट की कृपा मिले
says: The uplift and all forward movement in your life will come only when the Ishta's grace is received, so the Ishta is the trigger for progress.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts treat the Ishta devata as a key to fortune, though they give no timing rule.

gist: Begins to say that the complication with Ishta is that in our life, when birth ...; the sentence is cut off at the end of the batch.
Says that once the chart is made the ordinary pandit is not really at fault, the poor man is not being allowed to rise.

hindi: उसने स्वयं ज्ञान नहीं लिया उसके ऊपर क्या है कृपा नहीं है इसलिए उसको ज्ञान मिला ही नहीं
says: He says the ordinary pandit did not pick up the knowledge himself and has no grace (kripa) upon him, which is why real knowledge never reached him; grace is treated as the gate to deeper understanding, not study alone.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement about grace and learning, not about any house or sign.
ambiguity: The 'ordinary pandit' is a general jibe and not one named person; he does not say which chart factor shows grace.
classical_check: Silent here; classical texts link guru and deity grace to the 5th and 9th houses but he does not name them in this sentence.

hindi: हम कृपा ले कृपा ले कृपा कैसे ले यह कुंडली में लिखा होता है कि कृपा सेही होगा

classical_check: Silent; closest classical idea is purva-punya (past merit) read from the 5th house, which he does not name here.

hindi: अब बताओ इंसान फिर करे क्या अगर नहीं लिखा कुंडली में तो कृपा भी नहीं मिलेगी
says: He turns the point around: if grace is not written in the chart for some matter, grace will not arrive for it either, and he poses the dilemma of what a human being can then do; this sets up his answer about awareness.

classical_check: Silent; classical fatalism (prarabdha) agrees in spirit that unwritten results do not come, and remedies are said to soften only.

hindi: अब बताओ इंसान करे क्या अवेयरनेस ला कि यार हो सकता है मेरे भाग्य में यहां कृपा नहीं मिल रही जिस क्षेत्र काम पैसा पढ़ाई प्यार विदेश यात्रा कोई चीज जिसमें रात की नींद घर का काम जहां सुख नहीं मिल रहा
says: His answer to what a person should do: bring awareness that in whichever life area comfort is missing (work, money, studies, love, foreign travel, night sleep, home) grace is probably absent and the chart is not supporting it there, and then go looking for help in exactly that area.

By classical house topics: work 10th, money 2nd and 11th, studies 4th and 5th, love 5th and 7th, foreign travel 9th and 12th, night sleep 12th, home 4th. The sign on that house and its lord then colour how the missing comfort shows. All cell links below are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Work comfort is read from the 10th, here Capricorn with Saturn as its lord, so lack of ease at work is traced through Saturn's strength and the planets in or aspecting the 10th, not through the whole chart.
Derived: lagna Cancer (3-12+1=-8, so 4). Night sleep sits in the 12th; Mercury-ruled Gemini there makes lost sleep a restless-mind pattern, so the area to work on is mind and routine.
Derived: lagna Cancer (7-4+1=4). Home comfort sits in the 4th; Libra (Venus) there ties domestic ease to harmony with family and spouse and to money spent on the household.

ambiguity: He lists areas loosely and does not tie them to houses; 'grace' is his own term for support from destiny.
classical_check: Not a classical rule; the area-to-house mapping used for derived readings is the standard house karakatva list.

hindi: तो मुझे डॉक्टर के पास जाना है डॉक्टर की दवाई लगे ऐसे कृपा मिल जाए वो ढूंढना है
says: Using a doctor as a picture, he says that once the weak area is known the person must find the doctor whose medicine actually works, meaning the right guide or remedy through which grace flows; it is an analogy about seeking the right helper, not a medical statement.
