ambiguity: 'Doctor' stands for an astrologer, guide or remedy-giver and not a literal physician.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts prescribe specific upayas but do not describe this search-for-a-helper approach.

hindi: आपके मन में भाव आने से मुन्ना ढूंढने लग जाएगा आपका मुन्ना काम पर लगाएगा मुन्ना से दोस्ती करो मुन्ना से सेटिंग करो मुन्ना ढूंढ के देगा आपको आपको सही जगह पहुंचा देगा
says: He says that once the wish arises in your mind your 'Munna' starts searching, so befriend and set things up with him and he will find and deliver you to the right place; Munna is his playful name for the inner self that locates the right helper.
cells_derived_method: none: a spiritual-psychology remark, no house or sign given.
ambiguity: 'Munna' may mean the mind (man), the inner self or a pet word for the subconscious; he does not link it to the Moon here.
classical_check: Silent; the Moon as karaka of mind is classical but he does not say it here.

hindi: आपको सड़क पर बैठा एक बंदा भी कोई दवाई बता देगा वो भी लग जाएगी और वह हैरान होगा
says: He claims that when grace is active for you, even a stranger sitting on the road can name a remedy and it will work, to that person's own surprise; the working of a remedy depends on grace and not on the adviser's skill.
cells_derived_method: none: it is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the caption break ('और वह हैरान | होगा'); sense is clear.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts say upayas bear fruit by faith and karma but do not say any adviser works.

gist: Joke in the roadside adviser's voice: he has told medicine to 1.5 crore people, none worked, and it worked on you only by fluke; he was lying.

hindi: एक को लग गई क्योंकि आपने कृपा ली है
says: Punchline of the roadside joke: the one remedy that worked did so because you had taken grace, so the result is credited to grace and not to the adviser's knowledge.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign involved.
ambiguity: The joke wrapper makes it hard to tell how seriously he means it as a rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Caption 'कई बार आप अपने उत्तम से साधु को नाम कर जाओगे' is garbled; it seems to say that you may bow to a saint but the meaning cannot be recovered.
Says the birth chart is made and comes ready-made, and nobody knows exactly what happens inside the software.

hindi: फिर बनती है केपी कुंडली कृष्ण मूर्ति पद्धति की ये बहुत बड़े हमारे ज्ञानी रहे हैं
says: He names the KP chart, from the Krishnamurti Paddhati system, as the next chart produced after the birth chart and calls its author a very great scholar of ours; it is one more view of the same planets.
cells_derived_method: none: a naming of a chart type, not a house or sign rule.
ambiguity: He does not say what the KP chart changes; only that it exists and that he respects its author.
classical_check: KP is a twentieth-century system (K. S. Krishnamurti, sub-lords), not a classical text; his respect for it is a stance, not a rule.

hindi: फिर बनती है चलित कुंडली ऐसे ऐसे ग्रहों का हिसाब किताब बनता है
says: He lists the Chalit chart as the next chart in the sequence after the KP chart and calls it another accounting of where the planets stand; how it differs from the sign chart comes in the following sentences.
cells_derived_method: none: it only names the chart.
ambiguity: 'ऐसे ऐसे ग्रहों का हिसाब किताब' is loose; it may refer to all three charts together.
classical_check: Bhava chalit is classical (Sripati and equal-house variants); agrees.

hindi: अब इसमें होता क्या है यह आपकी कुंडली है लगन इसमें एक डिग्री का य है नहीं हम मोटे तौर पर लेंगे छोटी सी बात क्योंकि हम इष्ट की बात पूरी कर रहे हैं
says: He starts an example chart whose lagna sits at about one degree and says he will treat degrees only roughly, because the aim of this session is to finish the Ishta (chosen deity) topic and not to teach chalit calculation.
cells_derived_method: none: this only sets up the example; the lagna degree matters later because an early-degree lagna pulls in the previous sign.
ambiguity: 'य है नहीं' is garbled filler; not clear whether he means 1 degree exactly or about one degree.
classical_check: Silent; lagna degree is a standard input for bhava chalit.

hindi: यह लगन है एक डिग्री का जब एक डिग्री का लगन है आठ नंबर का लगन लिखा है आठ नंबर है वृश्चिक सात नंबर है तुला
says: He states the example lagna is at 1 degree and is written as number 8, then spells out that 8 is Scorpio and 7 is Libra (confirming Aries-to-Pisces numbering); so this is a Scorpio lagna at the very start of its sign with Libra just before it.
cells_derived_method: none: it names the lagna sign; what Libra's nearness does is in the next rows.
ambiguity: 'लगन लिखा है आठ नंबर' could be misheard as the 8th house; he clarifies 8 is Scorpio, so it is a sign number.
classical_check: Agrees: Scorpio is sign 8 and Libra is sign 7 in standard order.

hindi: जब एक डिग्री का लगन लिखा है चार नंबर यहां है तो शिवजी ट होने चाहिए हमारे कायदे की प्रैक्टिकल बात
says: He says that for this example, with lagna at 1 degree and number 4 in place here, Lord Shiva should come out as the Ishta (the caption word before 'should be' is garbled and probably reads Ishta); he presents it as a practical rule of his own system.
cells_derived_method: Read as the sign Cancer (number 4), which later lines in this lecture support because the sign rotation turns 4 into 3 and the Navamsa is said to show 12; an Ishta pointer standing in Cancer reads Shiva, and the house it sits in says which life area carries that devotion. If 4 were the 4th house instead, the pointer would be read by house. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (4-9+1=-4, so 8). A Shiva pointer in Cancer in the 9th ties Shiva devotion to dharma, fortune and the father line; this is the example chart as I read it.
Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). A Shiva pointer in Cancer in the lagna makes Shiva devotion part of identity and temperament, with the Moon as lagna lord.
Derived: lagna Pisces (4-5+1=0, so 12). A Shiva pointer in Cancer in the 5th links Shiva to mantra, devotion and children.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign 4 (Cancer) because later lines turn 4 into 3 under the rotation and give the Navamsa a '12'; it could still be the 4th house. The word 'शिवजी ट...' is garbled and the Ishta word is my reading.
classical_check: Differs: classical Ishta is read from the Atmakaraka in Navamsa (Karakamsa) and the 12th from it, or from the 5th house; a 4th-house rule is his own.

hindi: अब जब इसके अंदर हम राशियां घुमा के भाव चलित लेते हैं तो हमारे पास एक और कुंडली आती है
says: He explains that when the signs are 'rotated' inside the same chart to take the bhava chalit, one more chart results; so the chalit is the same planets re-read by house boundaries rather than sign boundaries, and the sign label under each house can change.
cells_derived_method: none: it describes how the chalit chart arises; the shifts it causes are in the next rows.
ambiguity: 'राशियां घुमा के' is his picture of shifting sign boundaries against house boundaries; no formula given. Next caption starts with garbled 'व य है नहीं'.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that bhava chalit re-assigns planets to houses by cusp boundaries rather than by sign.

hindi: लेकिन वो कुंडली बड़ी आसान है समझनी उसमें एक्चुअली में क्या होगा वह कुंडली ऐसी होगी उस कुंडली में यह जितने ग्रह है ना यह सात नंबर पर होंगे
says: He says the chalit chart is easy to understand and that in this example all the planets he is looking at (those sitting in the Scorpio lagna) will show at number 7 (Libra) in it, so the house keeps its place but the sign label slides back one sign.
cells_derived_method: In his picture an early-degree lagna makes the chalit lagna house mostly the previous sign, so planets of the lagna sign are relabelled one sign back. The same slide would hold for other lagnas at a very early degree; he states it only for this chart, so the other cases are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (2-1+1=2). With the lagna near 1 degree, planets in Taurus would read as Aries in the chalit, so Mars's sign joins Venus's lagna sign in the first house.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (10-1+1=10). With the lagna near 1 degree, planets in Capricorn would read as Sagittarius, so Jupiter's sign softens Saturn's lagna sign.

ambiguity: Unclear whether the planets truly move to Libra in the chalit or whether the house is just read as Libra-dominated; the planets are not named in the sentence.
classical_check: Differs in detail: classical Sripati chalit moves a planet only if it crosses the cusp boundary, about 15 degrees either side; a blanket slide of every planet is his simplification.

gist: Says this chart also arrives ready-made, nobody has to make or learn it, and he is speaking from experience.

hindi: अगर एक डिग्री का लगन है ना 5 डिग्री है 6 है सा है 10 है 30 डिग्री तक होता है यानी य अगर 10 10 एक डिग्री तक का है तो यह गारंटी है राशि काम कर रही है
says: General rule: if the lagna degree is small, anywhere from about 1 up to 10 degrees of its sign (he reads out 1, 5, 6, 7, 10 against the full 30), it is guaranteed that the neighbouring previous sign is also working in the lagna house; he calls it certain, not a maybe.
cells_derived_method: The previous sign borrows part of an early-degree lagna's first house, and its lord and nature add to the first-house reading. For each lagna the borrowed sign is the one just before it (Aries borrows Pisces, Taurus borrows Aries, and so on). All examples below are derived by me.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). At an early degree, Pisces also works in the first house, so Jupiter's watery, spiritual sign softens the sharp Mars first-house nature.
Derived: lagna Leo (5-1+1=5). Cancer also works in the first house, so the Moon's feeling and nurturing side mixes with the Sun's pride.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (9-1+1=9). Scorpio also works in the first house, adding Mars's intensity and secretiveness to Jupiter's optimism.

ambiguity: Which sign is 'working' is only settled by the next sentence (number 7, the previous sign); the 10-degree cut-off is approximate and caption numbers are garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sripati and equal-house chalit also pull the previous sign into an early-degree lagna house, but at about 15 degrees; his 10-degree 'guarantee' is his own.

hindi: अभ एक डिग्री का है तो सात नंबर भी य है यानी इस 30 डिग्री का लगन है इसमें एक ही डिग्री है आठ नंबर भी अभी आया है आठ नंबर भी बना है तो दिखा आठ रहे है
says: He applies it to the example: with lagna at 1 degree, number 7 (Libra) is also present in the first house, because this 30-degree lagna house holds just one degree of number 8 (Scorpio), which has only now arrived; the chart still shows 8 but most of the house is 7.
cells_derived_method: Count the degrees of the 30-degree house that fall in each sign: a lagna at d degrees gives d degrees to the lagna sign and 30-d to the previous sign in his picture. So lagna at 5 degrees is a 5/25 split and lagna at 10 degrees is 10/20. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini (3-1+1=3). At 5 degrees, Taurus holds 25 of the 30 degrees and Gemini only 5, so the first house reads mostly Venus-like (material, steady) under a Mercury label.
Derived: lagna Pisces (12-1+1=12). At 10 degrees, Aquarius holds 20 degrees and Pisces 10, so Saturn's sign outweighs Jupiter's in the lagna house.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the house runs backward from the lagna degree or is centred on it; his picture puts 29 of 30 degrees in the previous sign.
classical_check: Differs: classical chalit centres the first house on the lagna degree (15 degrees each side), which would give about 14 degrees of Libra and 16 of Scorpio here, not 29 and 1.

hindi: लेकिन आठ नंबर एक डिग्री 29 डिग्री जो पिछली है ना उस 29 डिग्री में जितना है सारा नहीं हो सकता थोड़ा होता है वो भी कॉम्प्लिकेटेड बात है तो सात नंबर चल रहा है
says: He adds that the other 29 degrees of the house belong to the previous sign, but cautions that not everything those degrees hold can act in full, only a part does, calls this a complicated point, and concludes that number 7 is the sign running in the lagna house.
cells_derived_method: The weight of the previous sign is a share of the house shown by the degree count, so use a weighted share and not an on-off switch. A lagna at 2 degrees gives the previous sign about 28/30, though he says its full effect does not pass over. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). At 2 degrees about 28 of the 30 degrees lie in Gemini, so Mercury's talkative, restless nature shapes the first house even though the label says Cancer, but only partly as he cautions.
Derived: lagna Virgo (6-1+1=6). At 12 degrees Leo holds 18 degrees and Virgo 12, so the Sun's confident, leading side is a little heavier than Mercury's analytical side.

ambiguity: 'सारा नहीं हो सकता थोड़ा होता है' is unclear: either only a share of the previous sign's effect applies, or planets in those degrees count only partly; caption is garbled.
classical_check: Silent on a weighted-share view; the later influence-share method is closer to it than any classical text.

hindi: अब यहां चंद्रमा नीच का हो गया आठ नंबर में बहुत बुरा चंद्रमा है इस व्यक्ति के सिर पर चोट देता है ये चोट का निशान आएगा ही आएगा
says: He says the Moon here has become debilitated in number 8 (Scorpio) in the lagna house, a very bad Moon, which gives this person a head injury leaving a scar that will certainly show; an injury claim recorded as his tradition statement, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Moon in the lagna points to the head (lagna rules the head) and the mind, and Scorpio adds sharpness and sudden hurts. The same Moon-in-Scorpio reading moves with the house: in the 4th it hits home and heart, in the 8th hidden worries, in the 10th public image. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (8-4+1=5). Debilitated Moon in the 4th disturbs the mind and home peace and the comfort from the mother; no head-injury link as the lagna is not touched.
Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Debilitated Moon in the 8th, as lord of the 4th, brings sudden emotional swings and hidden worries and a hit to home peace in a concealed way.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (8-10+1=-1, so 11). Debilitated Moon in the 10th, as 6th lord, makes public image shaky and work moods unsteady, with enemies handled through emotion.

ambiguity: The sentence runs across the caption break ('इस व्यक्ति के | सिर पर चोट'); 'scar will come' is his emphasis, and the cause is a Moon-Mars pair later.
classical_check: Debilitated Moon in Scorpio and lagna as the head are classical; a certain scar is his own strong claim, not a textual rule.

hindi: इसको बचपन में मंगल मंगल अपने घर का बैठा है मंगल कहता है जाने नहीं दूंगा
says: He says that in this person's childhood the injury is held in place by Mars, which sits in its own house and 'says it will not let go'; an own-sign Mars joined to or aspecting the weak Moon keeps the hurt from fading and fixes the scar.
cells_derived_method: A strong Mars in its own sign (Aries or Scorpio) joining or aspecting a hurt Moon makes the hurt persistent; the house decides the life area: the lagna the body, the 4th home, the 7th partners. The own-sign point is the same in any house; examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (8-1+1=8). Mars in own sign in the lagna, as lagna lord, keeps the Moon's blow on the body so a scar remains; this is the example chart.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (1-4+1=-2, so 10). Mars in own sign Aries in the 4th holds on to home-related hurt, such as childhood trouble at home or attachment to the mother's house.
Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7). Mars in own sign in the 7th (Ruchaka-type kendra cell) clings on in partnerships, so the hold shows as stubbornness in relationships and not on the body.

ambiguity: 'अपने घर का' means an own sign of Mars, Aries or Scorpio; he does not name which, but later lines put Mars with the Moon in the lagna, which points to Scorpio.
classical_check: Mars in own sign is classical; reading it as holder of a Moon injury is his own idea.

gist: Says degrees matter and that he is complicating the example on purpose to show how difficult the reading is.

hindi: चंद्रमा 8 डिग्री का मंगल जी डिग्री का है मंगल अभी पानी से बहुत दूर है सड़ा हुआ पानी है आग को बुझा देगा ये ये चोट मार के छोड़ेगा
says: He gives the Moon as 8 degrees (the Mars degree is garbled in the caption) and says Mars is still far from the 'water', the Moon here being stagnant, rotten water that would quench the fire of Mars; so the two together deliver a blow and then leave, and the degree gap between Moon and Mars decides how hard it hits.
cells_derived_method: Distance in degrees between a fire planet and a water planet in one sign: close together the Moon dampens Mars and the blow is mixed, far apart Mars acts first and the Moon's weakness shows separately. The house decides what is hit; examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (8-1+1=8). Moon at 8 degrees, debilitated, is the 'rotten water'; with Mars at a wider distance the Moon cannot quench it, so the injury stays but is short-lived.
Derived: lagna Pisces (8-9+1=0, so 12). Debilitated Moon with own-sign Mars in the 9th: the clash falls on father, elders or fortune, as bitter emotional quarrels and not a bodily blow.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (8-12+1=-3, so 9). The same pair in the 12th: hurts in far places or hospitals, and disturbed sleep.

ambiguity: The Mars degree is lost in the caption ('मंगल जी डिग्री का'); 'water' and 'fire' are his words for Moon and Mars.
classical_check: Moon-Mars conjunction is classical (Chandra-Mangala) and mixed in effect; the rotten-water image and degree-gap reading are his own.

hindi: लेकिन राशि घूम गई सात नंबर समझ नहीं आएगा ये जरूरी नहीं है समझना लेकिन यह घूमती है
says: He says the sign has rotated back to number 7, admits the students will not follow it and need not follow it fully, but insists that the sign does rotate when the house is read by its real boundaries; this is the key step behind his chalit-based corrections.
cells_derived_method: none: it restates the 8-to-7 shift of the example; the effects follow in the next rows.
ambiguity: 'राशि घूम गई' could mean the sign label in the chalit differs or that the running sign of the house changes; he treats both as one.
classical_check: Partly agrees with bhava chalit practice (planets change houses and sign influence by cusp), though classical texts do not say the sign 'rotates'.

hindi: जब सात नंबर घूम गई तो म चंद्रमा का लास्टिंग इफेक्ट क्या है वो हड्डी तोड़ गर्दन काट नहीं करेगा चोट मार के निकल लाएगा क्यों क्योंकि बाद में इमीडिएट सात नंबर रनिंग राशि है
says: He says that once the sign has rotated to 7 the Moon's lasting effect is mild: it will not break a bone or sever the neck, it delivers one blow and moves on, because the sign running immediately in the house is 7; a damage-limiting injury claim recorded as his tradition statement, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated planet in the lagna sign is tempered when the previous sign running in the same house has a gentler lord. Here Libra (Venus) tempers Scorpio's Moon. For other debilitated planets in the lagna the borrowed sign softens or sharpens by its lord. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Saturn debilitated in Aries in the lagna at an early degree: Pisces (Jupiter) is the running sign, softening Saturn's cold, heavy result into a milder one.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (10-1+1=10). Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the lagna at an early degree: Sagittarius, a sign ruled by Jupiter itself, is running, so the weakness is strongly cushioned.
Derived: lagna Libra (7-1+1=7). Sun debilitated in Libra in the lagna at an early degree: Virgo (Mercury, friend of the Sun) is running, giving modest relief to the Sun's loss of authority.

ambiguity: The 'running' sign is not explained beyond being the sign before the lagna sign; 'निकल लाएगा' is a caption slip for 'निकल जाएगा'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not temper a debilitation by the previous sign; this is his chalit-based refinement.

gist: Repeats that it is very simple: the Moon will strike just this much of a blow and no more.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा आठ नंबर का नीच का य उच्च का है उच्च इस व्यक्ति को ऐसा पति या पत्नी मिलना चाहिए धरती पर उससे अच्छा नहीं हो सकता उससे अच्छा हो नहीं सकता चाहे कुछ भी उखाड़ लो
says: Reading the plain D1 first, he says this Moon, debilitated in number 8, also looks at the 7th-house sign where it is exalted, so on paper this person should get a husband or wife than whom none better exists on earth, whatever you try; this is the naive reading he is about to overturn.
cells_derived_method: A planet's 7th aspect falls on the sign opposite. Moon in Scorpio always looks at Taurus, its exaltation sign, and which house Taurus is depends on the lagna. So the spouse reading is lifted only if Taurus is the 7th house; elsewhere the lift goes to another house topic. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo (8-4+1=5). Moon in the 4th looks at Taurus, which is the 10th house, so the lift goes to work and status.
Derived: lagna Aries (8-8+1=1). Moon in the 8th looks at Taurus, the 2nd house, so family wealth and speech get the support.
Derived: lagna Libra (8-2+1=7). Moon in the 2nd looks at Taurus, the 8th house, so the support goes to inheritance and hidden resources.

ambiguity: The caption 'नीच का य उच्च का है उच्च' is garbled; I read it as the Moon's 7th-house look landing on Taurus (sign 2), its exaltation sign, which fits a Scorpio lagna and the 'best spouse' claim.
classical_check: Moon exalted in Taurus and the 7th aspect are classical; judging a spouse by an aspect on an exaltation sign is his own naive step and he overturns it next.

hindi: लेकिन एक्चुअल में यह सात नंबर है और एक नंबर है जो एक्टिवेटेड है एक्चुअली याय एक नंबर एक्टिवेटेड है सात के आगे एक आएगा सामने ही
says: He overturns the naive reading: since the running sign of the lagna house is 7 (Libra), the sign activated in the 7th house is 1 (Aries), directly opposite 7, and not Taurus; so the Moon's look has to be read on Aries and not on its exaltation sign.
cells_derived_method: The 7th-house sign shifts with the running sign of the lagna house: whichever sign runs as lagna, the active 7th sign is the one opposite it (Aries-Libra, Taurus-Scorpio, Gemini-Sagittarius, Cancer-Capricorn, Leo-Aquarius, Virgo-Pisces). An early-degree lagna swaps the 7th sign for the opposite of the previous sign. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus (8-7+1=2). With Taurus lagna at an early degree, Aries runs in the lagna house, so the active 7th sign moves from Scorpio to Libra and the spouse reading shifts from Mars-like intensity to Venus-like partnership.

Derived: lagna Gemini (9-7+1=3). Early-degree Gemini lagna runs Taurus, so the active 7th sign moves from Sagittarius to Scorpio and the partner reads deeper and more guarded than the plain chart suggests.

Derived: lagna Cancer (10-7+1=4). Early-degree Cancer lagna runs Gemini, so the active 7th sign moves from Capricorn to Sagittarius and the partner reads more open and philosophical than the plain chart shows.

ambiguity: 'एक्टिवेटेड' is his own word for the sign made active by the rotation; whether Taurus then stops counting is not said.
classical_check: Differs: classically the 7th house is the sign on the 7th cusp and aspects are read by sign from D1 or from the chalit planet shift; a sign swap by lagna degree is his own method.

hindi: ऐसे तो यहां तो य तलाक होना चाहिए इस व्यक्ति का तलाक होना चाहिए
says: On the activated-sign reading he concludes that this person should face a divorce; the weak Moon's look on Aries in the 7th, rather than on exalted Taurus, makes the marriage fragile.
cells_derived_method: A Moon in the lagna house looks at the 7th and the sign there decides the quality of the strain. Taurus gives a steady spouse, Aries a quick-tempered one. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Moon in own sign in the lagna looks at Capricorn in the 7th, so the strain is of cold, duty-bound or delayed partnership and not of anger.
Derived: lagna Taurus (2-1+1=2). Exalted Moon in the lagna looks at Scorpio in the 7th, so the spouse is intense but the exalted Moon steadies the bond.

Derived: lagna Scorpio (8-1+1=8). The plain look is on Taurus (good), but with Libra running the 7th becomes Aries (Mars), and the Moon, weak in Scorpio, facing that Mars sign gives the divorce signal he reads.

ambiguity: He says 'divorce' in a flat way; the sentence is a conclusion from the prior reading and not an independent rule.
classical_check: Moon aspecting a spouse house with weakness can trouble marriage classically, but divorce as a certain result is his own.

hindi: चंद्रमा एक नंबर में नीच जैसा आठ और एक खत्म करता है यानी कि इसकी शादी खत्म होगी इस आदमी की शादी का सुख नहीं होगा
says: He says the Moon on number 1 (Aries) acts almost like a debilitated Moon and that the pair 8 and 1 finish it off, meaning this man's marriage will end and he will not have marital happiness; a marriage-outcome claim recorded as his tradition statement, not a guarantee.
cells_derived_method: Moon in or looking at Aries is read by him as near-debilitation and Aries and Scorpio (both Mars signs) together end the partnership. The cell shows where the Moon stands and which sign it faces; examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Moon in Aries in the lagna, as 4th lord, makes the mind quick and impatient and looks at Libra in the 7th; by his near-debilitation idea the marriage suffers from a restless mind.

Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7). Moon in Aries in the 7th, as 10th lord, ties career and spouse together and the partner is bold and impatient; the mood clash is where his marriage-ending claim would apply.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर में नीच जैसा' is unclear; 'आठ और एक खत्म करता है' may mean the Scorpio Moon in the lagna and Aries on the 7th end the marriage together, or that both are Mars signs.
classical_check: Differs: the Moon is exalted in Taurus and debilitated in Scorpio; Aries is neutral for it, so 'nīcha-jaisa' in Aries is his own phrasing and not classical.

hindi: और यहां यह दिखा शादी उच्च का सबसे बढ़िया होना चाहिए इससे सुंदर धरती पर हो नहीं सकती शादी इसकी पत्नी लेकिन यहां पर वह कह रहा कि खराब है
says: He sums up the clash: the D1 shows an exalted Moon and so the best marriage and spouse on earth, but the sign-activated reading says the marriage is bad; he uses the clash to show why the running chalit sign must be checked before trusting the plain chart.
cells_derived_method: none: it restates the Taurus-versus-Aries contrast of the earlier rows; the cell logic for other lagnas is in the row on the opposite sign.
ambiguity: It is not said which reading he trusts more in general; for this chart he trusts the activated-sign reading.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not weigh D1 against a sign shift this way.

hindi: अब मंगल भी यही बैठा मंगल की भी यही दृष्टि है मंगल क्या कहता है मंगल थोड़े पावर का चंद्रमा ज्यादा यानी तलाक होगा तो पत्नी तंग करेगी इसको पत्नी तंग नहीं कर पाएगी
says: He adds that Mars also sits in this same house and its aspect also reaches the 7th; Mars has a little power but the Moon more, so the divorce will come but the wife will not be able to harass him; the caption has a self-contradicting 'wife will trouble' phrase before 'will not be able to', so only the final sense is recorded.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the lagna looks at the 7th with its 7th aspect, so the native's own Mars strength checks the spouse's pressure. The check is cleaner when Mars is in its own or exalted sign and weaker when debilitated. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Mars in own sign in the lagna looks at Libra in the 7th; the native is dominant and the spouse cannot press him, as in his reading.
Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Mars debilitated in the lagna looks at Capricorn, Mars's exaltation sign, so the spouse side is strong and the native's own Mars cannot check it.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (8-1+1=8). Mars in own sign in the lagna looks at Taurus (or Aries when Libra runs) in the 7th; this is the example, where Mars is the check on the spouse.

ambiguity: 'पत्नी तंग करेगी' followed by 'तंग नहीं कर पाएगी' contradicts itself in the caption; the final sense, that she cannot harass him, matches his later line.
classical_check: Mars aspecting the 7th (Kuja dosha idea) usually harms the partner side; his claim that it protects the native is the reverse emphasis and is his own.

hindi: अब बोले शादी होगी तलाक लिखा है तो शादी तो जरूर होगी तलाक होता ही उसका जिसकी शादी हुई इंपॉसिबल है कैसे हो सकता है
says: He says that if a chart shows divorce, the marriage itself is certain to happen first, since divorce can only come to someone who has married; so a divorce indication is also a marriage indication, and he calls the opposite impossible.
cells_derived_method: none: it is logic about divorce implying marriage, not dependent on a particular house or sign cell.
ambiguity: 'अब बोले' is his voice for an audience objection; he does not say whether the marriage will be early or late.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; consistent with later practice of reading separation only for those who have a marriage yoga.

gist: Disclaimer: he is going on with his own freedom and makes no claim of having sat down and given a guarantee; naming whose chart it is could raise an uproar, though that is not necessarily so.

hindi: ऐसा जरूरी थोड़ी है पर यह हमारे मोदी जी की कुंडली है
says: He reveals that the example chart is that of Prime Minister Modi (as widely published, Scorpio lagna with the Moon in the lagna), so everything said about the lagna at 1 degree, the debilitated Moon and own-sign Mars is being tied to this public chart; no birth data is given here.
cells_derived_method: none: it identifies the example chart and has no house or sign dependency of its own.
ambiguity: The sentence begins with the tail of the uproar remark ('ऐसा जरूरी थोड़ी है'); the identification itself is clear.
classical_check: Not applicable; it is an identification of a public chart and not a rule.

hindi: सप्तम भाव पर चंद्रमा की दृष्टि है य यहां पर तलाक लिखा नहीं है इस कुंडली में पंडित य कहेंगे सब पंडितों पर कृपा है
says: He says the Moon's aspect falls on the 7th house and that, read plainly, no divorce is written in this chart, which is what ordinary pandits would say, adding a jibe that grace is on all pandits; so the plain chart gives the expected 'no divorce' answer.
cells_derived_method: none: it states the plain-chart reading again; the sign-by-lagna cases are in the earlier row on the swap of the 7th sign.
ambiguity: The 'grace on all pandits' phrase is ironic or garbled, and the tone cannot be settled from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees that a plain D1 reading, with the Moon on an exaltation-sign 7th, would not show divorce; the correction is his chalit logic.

hindi: समझना कि एक्चुअली वहां पर चंद्रमा नाश कर रहा है शादी टिकेगी नहीं
says: He tells the student to understand that in reality the Moon is destroying the 7th house here, so the marriage will not last, restating the chalit-corrected reading in plain words.
cells_derived_method: none: it repeats the corrected-sign result already derived; it adds no new house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: 'नाश' (destroy) is strong wording; he does not say if separation is legal divorce or distance.
classical_check: Silent; a debilitated Moon harming a spouse house is plausible classically but 'will not last' is his own certainty.

hindi: लेकिन मंगल भी साथ दृष्टि दे रहा है मंगल का अपना घर है पत्नी तंग कभी नहीं करेगी
says: He balances it: Mars is also casting its aspect on the 7th and Mars is in its own house, so the wife will never harass him; an own-sign Mars in the lagna is read as shielding the native from the spouse's pressure even while the marriage itself breaks.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 7th house from the 1st (7th aspect), from the 4th (4th aspect) and from the 12th (8th aspect). In own sign it can shield the native, but the spouse's sign decides whether Mars is looking at a friend or a weak spot. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn (1-4+1=-2, so 10). Mars in own sign in the 4th looks at Cancer in the 7th with its 4th aspect; the shield is less clean as Cancer is the sign where Mars falls weakest.

Derived: lagna Sagittarius (8-12+1=-3, so 9). Mars in own sign in the 12th looks at Gemini in the 7th with its 8th aspect; protection works from a distance, so the native keeps the upper hand through hidden or foreign matters.
Derived: lagna Aries (1-1+1=1). Mars in own sign in the lagna looks at Libra in the 7th, so the native is assertive and the spouse is pressed to adjust.

ambiguity: Whether 'अपना घर' is Scorpio (with the Moon) or Aries is not said but is likely the lagna sign Scorpio; 'कभी नहीं' is absolute wording.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: classical Kuja dosha says Mars in or aspecting the 7th troubles the partner; his reading that it protects the native is his own twist.

hindi: और आदमी चौथे घर पर उच्च दृष्टि है मंगल की या गुरु नीच का है 11 नंबर नीच तुल्य होता है
says: He says the 4th house, sign 11 (Aquarius) here, receives a strong aspect from Mars, and a Jupiter there counts as nearly debilitated because number 11 is 'nīcha-tulya' (equal to debilitation) in his view; the caption mixes the two thoughts, so only the 11 = debilitation-like claim is firm.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Aquarius is read by him as weakened, and the effect follows the house it sits in. Mars looks at the 4th with its 4th aspect from the 1st. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (11-4+1=8). Jupiter in the 4th is the 2nd and 5th lord in a weak sign, so home comfort and the mother's blessing come with strain but stay present.
Derived: lagna Gemini (11-9+1=3). Jupiter in the 9th as 7th and 10th lord in a weak sign: fortune and guru-grace come late or through unusual channels.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (11-2+1=10). Jupiter in the 2nd as 3rd and 12th lord in a weak sign: family speech and savings leak and values are unconventional.

ambiguity: 'या' (or) is the caption link between Mars's aspect and Jupiter; it is not clear whether Jupiter sits in the 4th or is only linked to it.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter is debilitated in Capricorn, not Aquarius, which is a neutral sign for it; 'nīcha-tulya' for 11 is his own phrase.

hindi: दुनिया में कहां नाम नहीं है मोदी जी का कौन सी जगह धरती पर ज नाम नहीं है
says: He asks rhetorically where on earth Modi's name is not known and offers world-wide fame as the result of the 4th-house factors just described, followed by his statement that the 4th house governs name.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a result tied to this example chart; the 4th-house meaning itself is in the next rows.
ambiguity: The link from the 4th-house factors to fame is stated in the next sentence, not in this one; 'ज नाम' is a caption slip.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts tie fame mostly to the 10th house and the lagna, not the 4th.

hindi: कृष्ण जी का देखा था ना नौवे घर में उच्च का मंगल भाग्यशाली
says: He recalls Krishna's chart seen earlier in the series, with an exalted Mars in the 9th house, and calls that Mars fortunate; so exalted Mars in the 9th is his example of strong fortune (the sign is implied by exaltation: Capricorn).
cells_derived_method: Mars exalted in Capricorn raises the house it sits in; in the 9th it raises fortune, dharma and father. In other houses it raises that house's topic, and strongest in kendras. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (10-10+1=1). Mars exalted in the 10th as lagna lord and 8th lord forms a kendra Ruchaka cell: strong, forceful career and reputation.
Derived: lagna Virgo (10-5+1=6). Mars exalted in the 5th as 3rd and 8th lord: courage and intensity in creative work and children matters, with the 8th-lord edge adding sudden turns.

ambiguity: Which lagna Krishna's chart has is not said here; published charts differ, and the sign Capricorn is implied by 'उच्च' (exalted).
classical_check: Mars exalted in Capricorn is classical and exalted planets in the 9th give fortune; agrees. Krishna's exact chart varies by source.

hindi: यह चौथे घर में चौथा घर नाम का होता है यश प्रेम
says: He states that the 4th house is the house of name, fame and love in his scheme, which is why the 4th-house factors in this chart are tied to the person's world-wide name.
cells_derived_method: The 4th house gets its colour from the sign on it, so fame and love arrive by different roads: Libra by charm and the arts, Sagittarius by teaching and faith, Aquarius by networks and the masses. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer (7-4+1=4). Venus rules the 4th, so name and love come through charm, the arts and good relations.
Derived: lagna Virgo (9-4+1=6). Jupiter rules the 4th, so name comes through teaching, ethics and a faith-based image.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (11-4+1=8). Saturn (and Pluto in his scheme) rules the 4th, so name comes through masses, networks and a long steady climb.

ambiguity: 'नाम का होता है यश प्रेम' is clipped; 'यश प्रेम' may be fame and affection, or fame and love together.
classical_check: Differs: the 4th classically is mother, home, vehicles, land, happiness and the heart; name and fame belong mainly to the 10th, so this is his own extension.

hindi: अभी घरों की बात नहीं की चौथा घर माता का होता है इस आदमी को माता का सुख मिला आशीर्वाद मिला
says: He notes he has not yet formally covered houses but adds that the 4th house is the mother's house, and that this man received his mother's happiness and blessing; the 4th-house factors are read as favourable for the mother link.
cells_derived_method: The mother's nature is read from the sign on the 4th: Cancer a nurturing mother, Capricorn a strict hard-working one, Aquarius a detached, principled one. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (4-4+1=1). Moon's own sign on the 4th: a caring mother and a strong emotional bond.
Derived: lagna Libra (10-4+1=7). Saturn rules the 4th: a strict, hard-working mother and a bond built on duty.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (11-4+1=8). Aquarius on the 4th: a principled, somewhat detached mother, shown in this example as blessing despite the weak Jupiter.

ambiguity: He says he has not discussed houses yet, so this is a preview and not a full rule.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th house signifies the mother in the classical texts.

hindi: मां के रहते तो सुख ही सुख है जब तक मां रही लगातार उठाव मां के जाने के बाद सीटें गिर गई
says: He claims that while the mother was alive there was only happiness and a steady rise, and that after her passing the person's electoral seats fell; he ties the native's rise and the dip to the mother's lifetime through the 4th-house factor. It is a reading of past events and not a prediction.
cells_derived_method: The 4th is the mother, so the native's fortune is read as moving with her presence; the sign on the 4th shapes how. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (11-4+1=8). The example chart: rise during the mother's life, a fall after, because the support was tied to her.
Derived: lagna Gemini (6-4+1=3). Mercury-ruled 4th: the mother is a practical adviser, and after she is gone the day-to-day guidance goes.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (12-4+1=9). Jupiter-ruled 4th: the mother's blessings act as protection, and after her death faith-based support weakens.

ambiguity: It refers to real events (seats falling) with no date, and the link to the mother is his own reading.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts tie the mother's well-being to the 4th, not the native's election outcomes.

gist: Says a caption-garbled remark ('प्री लिविंग हो गई'), then that it is not a big matter and that a wise man will catch it himself.

hindi: प्रॉब्लम कहां आती है ईष्ट की इनका चार नंबर है यहां प्लूटो लगा हुआ है
says: He says the question of where the trouble comes in the Ishta matter is answered by number 4 in this chart, where Pluto is placed; so the Ishta reading for this person goes through number 4 and Pluto, linking back to his earlier Shiva remark.
cells_derived_method: Read as the sign Cancer (number 4): a planet standing in the Ishta-pointer sign is the one that names the deity, and Pluto (Yama in his scheme, ruled over by Shiva) in Cancer ties the reading to Shiva. The house it sits in decides the life area of the devotion. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (4-9+1=-4, so 8). Pluto in Cancer in the 9th: deep, transforming faith around dharma, fortune and the father line, with a Shiva-type Ishta.
Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). Pluto in Cancer in the lagna: the Shiva link becomes part of identity, with intense inner change and emotional depth.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius (4-8+1=-3, so 9). Pluto in Cancer in the 8th: hidden, occult-leaning devotion, with Shiva read as lord of transformation.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign 4 (Cancer), supported by later lines where the rotation turns 4 into 3; it could still be the 4th house. 'प्रॉब्लम कहां आती है ईष्ट की' may be a mis-caption of 'Ishta's place'.
classical_check: Differs: classical Ishta comes from Karakamsa or the 5th and 9th, and the outer planets are absent from classical texts; a Pluto-in-4th rule is his own.

hindi: अब यहां पर घूम के तीन नंबर हो गया शिव जी थे अब हो गए दुर्गा
says: He says that after the sign rotation (one sign back) the Ishta number has become 3, so what read as Lord Shiva (number 4) now reads as Durga; the same chart gives a different deity once the chalit shift is applied, which he uses to show how unstable the Ishta reading is.
cells_derived_method: The rotation moves a planet's sign label one sign back for an early-degree lagna (his earlier 8 to 7), so an Ishta pointer in Cancer (4, Shiva) reads in Gemini (3, Durga) afterwards, while its house does not change. He gives deities only for 4, 3 and 12. Examples are mine, using the pointer he later names as Pluto.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (4-9+1=-4, so 8). A pointer in Cancer in the 9th reads Shiva in D1; after the rotation it reads in Gemini and Durga, so a dharma-and-fortune house pointer moves from Shiva-type to Durga-type devotion.

Derived: lagna Cancer (4-1+1=4). A pointer in Cancer in the lagna reads Shiva; after the early-degree rotation it reads Gemini and Durga, so the identity-level pointer moves from Shiva-type to Durga-type devotion.

Derived: lagna Pisces (4-5+1=0, so 12). A pointer in Cancer in the 5th (mantra and devotion) reads Shiva in D1; after the rotation it reads Gemini and Durga, so the mantra practice itself would change from Shiva to Durga.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर' is read as sign 3 (Gemini) because the rotation took 4 to 3 and 8 to 7 earlier; it could also be read as house 3. Whether Shiva belongs to number 4 itself or to the planet Pluto there is not said here.
classical_check: Differs: classical Ishta comes from Karakamsa or the 5th and 9th houses, not from a sign number with a deity attached, and a chalit shift does not enter it.

hindi: अब किसको पकड़े इसलिए आप इष्ट को यूं ही पकड़ के बैठ गए
says: He says that because the charts give different deities and one cannot tell whom to hold, people end up gripping some Ishta casually, without a proper determination.
cells_derived_method: none: it criticises common practice and has no house or sign content.
ambiguity: 'यूं ही' (casually) is his comment on common practice, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका नवांश कुंडली भी चाहिए नवांश क्या होता है एक नवांश होता है विवाह पश्चात तो देखना ही पड़ता है
says: He says the Navamsa chart is also needed for the Ishta reading, and that Navamsa is the chart one must examine after marriage, so it carries the married phase of life.
cells_derived_method: none: it names when the Navamsa is used and is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say how Navamsa is built; 'विवाह पश्चात' may mean after marriage in life or in matters of marriage.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Navamsa (D9) is classically the chart of marriage and dharma and is used to confirm planetary strength.

hindi: अगर इस कुंडली में तलाक नहीं और नवांश में तलाक है तो होगा
says: He says that if the main chart shows no divorce but the Navamsa shows divorce, the divorce will happen, so on a marital outcome the Navamsa outranks the birth chart.
cells_derived_method: In the Navamsa the 7th house and its sign set the post-marriage pattern. Mars-type and Saturn-type signs there carry the separation risk, Venus-type signs hold the bond. Examples are mine, cells read in D9.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7). A Mars-ruled 7th in the Navamsa gives quarrels and impatience; this is the kind of sign that, by his rule, would deliver the divorce even if D1 shows none.
Derived: lagna Cancer (10-7+1=4). A Saturn-ruled 7th in the Navamsa gives coldness, distance and delay, so a separation by duty or age gap would be the form it takes.
Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1). A Venus-ruled 7th in its own sign in the Navamsa holds the bond, so the divorce signal is weak here even if D1 shows trouble.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the Navamsa overrides only for divorce or for every marital result.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts use Navamsa to confirm or deny what D1 promises; 'Navamsa always wins' is his strong form of it.

gist: Moves on to show the example's Navamsa chart ('here it is'), with a stumbling repeat of the word Navamsa.

hindi: नवांश कुंडली में सूर्य बैठा है यहां पर बुध बैठा है यह अलग कहानी हो जाती है
says: He points at the example's Navamsa, saying the Sun sits in one place and Mercury in another, and that this makes it a different story from the birth chart; no house or sign is read out, so only the fact that the Navamsa differs is recorded.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is named for the Sun or Mercury in the caption.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर' are pointing words with no house or sign in the caption, so the positions are lost.
classical_check: Silent; D9 differing from D1 is normal.

hindi: यह कुंडली में 12 नंबर आ गया याय गणेश जी हो गए
says: He says number 12 has come in this chart (the Navamsa), so the Ishta reading turns to Ganesh; his mapping gives Ganesh for number 12, which is Pisces, the sign his scheme lists under Jupiter or Ketu.
cells_derived_method: A pointer in Pisces reads Ganesh, the remover of obstacles, and the house it sits in says which area of life gets the obstacle-removal. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (12-5+1=8). A Pisces pointer in the 5th links Ganesh to mantra, intellect and children, so blocks in study and mantra practice are the area his reading would target.
Derived: lagna Cancer (12-9+1=4). A Pisces pointer in the 9th links Ganesh to dharma, guru and fortune, so he opens luck by clearing obstacles in those matters.
Derived: lagna Aries (12-12+1=1). A Pisces pointer in the 12th links Ganesh to sleep, foreign places and letting go, so he clears blocks around expenses and isolation.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर' may be sign 12 (Pisces) or house 12; the Ishta pointers behave like sign numbers elsewhere in this lecture, so sign is assumed.
classical_check: Silent on the number-to-deity table; Ganesh is commonly linked to Ketu, and his scheme gives Ketu to Pisces.

hindi: यहां गणेश जी विध्वंसक है तीन नंबर में बर्बाद गणेश का केतु तीन नंबर का होता है तो बर्बाद कर देता तबाह कर देता का होता है
says: He says Ganesh is destructive here and that Ganesh's Ketu belonging to number 3 ruins and devastates; so the Ganesh pointer sitting in number 3 is a harmful Ishta indicator for this person.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in Gemini works through detachment from speech, siblings and skills, and the house it sits in decides what is cut off. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (3-3+1=1). Ketu in its 3rd house in Mercury's sign detaches the person from siblings and effort, with sudden gains and losses of courage.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (3-8+1=-4, so 8). Ketu in the 8th pulls a sharp mind into occult research, with sudden breaks in shared resources.
Derived: lagna Cancer (3-12+1=-8, so 4). Ketu in the 12th leans to withdrawal and moksha, with disturbed sleep and losses abroad.

ambiguity: The caption is garbled in its last words. 'तीन नंबर' is read as Gemini (sign 3) but could be house 3. It also clashes with his earlier line that number 3 is Durga and a later line that Ganapati is Mercury of number 3.
classical_check: Differs: Ketu has no classical rule of ruin in Gemini; Ketu is commonly linked to Ganesh in later tradition, which is only partly his claim.

hindi: अब यह कह रहे गणेश जी होना चाहिए यह कह रहे दुर्गा होना चाहिए यह कह रहे शिवजी होना चाहिए अब कौन सा करोगे
says: He sums up the clash: one chart says Ganesh should be the Ishta, another Durga and another Shiva (the Navamsa, the rotated chalit reading and the birth chart), and he asks which one the listener will follow.
cells_derived_method: none: it summarises the conflict between charts and is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say which chart gives which deity in this sentence; the mapping is my reading from the earlier lines (D1 Shiva, chalit Durga, D9 Ganesh).
classical_check: Silent; classical practice picks one method (Karakamsa) and does not compare charts.

gist: Analogy: four people live in one house and each runs a different drama, so whose will you follow, used to illustrate the conflicting Ishta readings.

hindi: तो मजे की बात है अभी एक राशि घूमी है कई जगह तीन राशि घूम रही है ऐसी कुंडलियां होती है जहां आठ नंबर भी काम कर रहा है सात भी कर रहा है और नौ भी कर रहा है
says: He says the fun part is that here only one sign has rotated, but in many charts three signs are rotating, where 8, 7 and 9 (Scorpio, Libra and Sagittarius) are all working at once; so a house can carry three signs and not only two.
cells_derived_method: A house that spans three signs has the middle sign as the main one and its two neighbours as minor ones, each with its own lord and nature. The house topic is read through all three, weighted by their share. Examples are mine, with the middle sign shown.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra (4-10+1=-5, so 7). The 10th is mainly Cancer, with Gemini and Leo also working, so career reads Moon-led with Mercury (trade, speech) and Sun (authority) mixed in.
Derived: lagna Cancer (5-2+1=4). The 2nd is mainly Leo, with Cancer and Virgo also working, so family and wealth are Sun-led with Moon's family feeling and Mercury's accounts mixed in.
Derived: lagna Scorpio (2-7+1=-4, so 8). The 7th is mainly Taurus, with Aries and Gemini also working, so the partner reads Venus-steady with a Mars spark and a Mercury talkative side.

ambiguity: The house is not named; 8, 7 and 9 are read as sign numbers (Scorpio, Libra, Sagittarius). The sentence runs across the caption break ('कई जगह | तीन राशि').
classical_check: Agrees in principle: in unequal-house systems (Sripati, Placidus, KP) a house can take parts of three signs, especially at higher latitudes.

hindi: अब उखाड़ लो यहां दो भी है तीन भी है चार भी है कौन सा इट करोगे
says: Challenging the listener to work it out, he says that here numbers 2, 3 and 4 are all present as well, so even more Ishta candidates appear, and he asks which one you will take.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives no deities for 2, and 3 and 4 are already covered above, so nothing new can be derived by house or sign.
ambiguity: 2, 3 and 4 are read as sign numbers (Taurus, Gemini, Cancer) but could be houses; he does not say which chart each belongs to.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए बताने वाला चाहिए जो आपके जीवन को पढ़कर समझ के बता सके कौन सा इट है
says: He concludes that you need an adviser who can read your whole life and tell which deity is truly your Ishta, because the chart rules alone do not settle it.
cells_derived_method: none: it is advice to consult a reader and is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say what qualifies someone to do this reading.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give a fixed method, he argues for judgment.

gist: Says he does not go around giving directions in class about whom a given person should worship, and that Modi is not being told what to do.

hindi: यह सबकी करते हैं इनके यहां 365 दिन रुद्राभिषेक होता है मोदी जी के
says: He says Modi worships all of them and that Rudrabhishek (Shiva worship) is performed at his place on all 365 days of the year; offered as evidence that the Shiva reading fits this chart. It is a claim about a real person's practice and is unverified.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a claimed life fact used as a check, not a house or sign rule.
ambiguity: 'यह सबकी करते हैं' may mean he worships all the deities named or all kinds of rituals; the source of the 365-day claim is not given.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical matter.

hindi: सोचो शिव को पकड़े बैठे हैं और कौन सा ग्रह है प्लूटो प्लूटो बैठा है य यह भी इट बता रहा है कितने सारे ग्रह इष्ट बता रहे हैं
says: He asks the listener to think: he holds Shiva, and the planet sitting there is Pluto, which also points to the Ishta; so many planets in one chart are pointing to an Ishta at the same time.
cells_derived_method: none: the place of Pluto is not repeated in this sentence; the placement was given earlier as number 4.
ambiguity: He does not repeat where Pluto sits; 'यह भी इट बता रहा है' means Pluto is a second Ishta indicator besides the sign number.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not use Pluto at all and name the Ishta from the Atmakaraka's Navamsa.

gist: Reports people saying 'just keep one Ishta, whom should we worship?' and says this is not a joking matter.
School analogy: going to school, completing one class and thinking one has graduated, used to say Ishta cannot be understood in a short time.

hindi: कौनसी इष्ट समझने लंबी यात्रा है तब इष्ट कृपा करेगा सही पकड़ लिया तो अन्यथा नहीं
says: He says understanding the Ishta is a long journey, and only when it is held correctly will the Ishta bestow grace, otherwise not; correct identification is the condition for grace.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: 'कौनसी इष्ट समझने' is garbled; the sense is that the Ishta takes long to understand.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो जो लोग जान गए वो एलन मस्क बन गए बिना पढ़े लिख बिना पूजा पाठ के बिना मंदिर गए
says: He says those who truly recognised their Ishta became people like Elon Musk with no study, no rituals and no temple visits, implying that recognising your own Ishta matters more than outward worship.
cells_derived_method: none: a general claim about recognising the Ishta, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence starts in one caption chunk and ends in the next; 'जान गए' means those who understood their Ishta. A named real person is used as an example only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कृष्ण ने लड़ते लड़ते पा लिया राम ने वनवास के धक्कों में पा लिया वो कहां है वो तो हर जगह है
says: He says Krishna found it while fighting and Ram found it in the knocks of exile, and asks where God is, answering that he is everywhere; so the Ishta can be reached through struggle and not only through temples.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'पा लिया' (got it) is not defined; it may mean realisation, grace or the Ishta itself.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Concludes once more that fixing the Ishta has become complex and difficult.

hindi: प्लट कौन है मौत का देवता यमराज शिव कौन है मौत का देवता का देवता मौत के देवता का देवता
says: He identifies Pluto as the god of death, Yamaraj, and Shiva as the god of that god of death, so in his scheme Pluto carries Shiva's line of power.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a planet identity and not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'प्लट' is a caption slip for Pluto.
classical_check: Differs: Pluto is not a classical graha; Yama as lord of death and Shiva as Mahakala who overcomes Yama are classical in the Puranas, but calling Pluto Yama is his scheme.

hindi: तो प्लूटो बड़ी पावर पकड़ के बैठा है इसलिए इनके रुद्राभिषेक चलता रहेगा
says: He says Pluto holds great power in this chart, which is why Rudrabhishek (worship of Shiva) will keep going on for this person; a strong Pluto is read as a lasting Shiva link.
cells_derived_method: none: the strength of Pluto is stated without a house or sign.
ambiguity: He does not say what makes Pluto powerful (sign, aspect or degree).
classical_check: Silent; no classical rule for Pluto.

hindi: मोदी जी रॉकेट है दुर्गा की पूजा करते रहेंगे गणपति की करते रहेंगे यहां ये एक्टिवेट होगा भाव नवांश काम करते हुए
says: He says the person will keep worshipping Durga and Ganapati as well, since the bhava (chalit) and Navamsa readings get activated and work alongside the birth chart; so more than one Ishta stays active over a life.
cells_derived_method: none: it says several chart views point to several deities at once, with no house or sign given.
ambiguity: 'मोदी जी रॉकेट है' is a remark on the person's drive; 'यहां ये एक्टिवेट होगा' is unclear on what activates and when.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गणपति तीन नंबर का बुद्ध होता है गजब काम करता है
says: He says Ganapati is the Mercury of number 3 and works wonders, tying Ganapati to Mercury in Gemini, the sign numbered 3.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in its own sign Gemini is strongest in the kendras (1, 4, 7, 10) and the house it sits in decides the area of wonder. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini (3-1+1=3). Mercury in own sign in the lagna (Bhadra-type) gives a sharp intellect and fluent speech, so the Ganapati link shows as wit and learning.
Derived: lagna Virgo (3-10+1=-6, so 6). Mercury in own sign in the 10th (Bhadra-type kendra) gives a career built on speech, trade and skill.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (3-6+1=-2, so 10). Mercury in own sign in the 6th works through analysis, service and competition, without the kendra boost.

ambiguity: Mercury ruling Gemini is clear, but earlier he tied 'Ganesh's Ketu' and Durga to number 3, so which deity belongs to number 3 is inconsistent in the caption.
classical_check: Differs from the usual graha-deity list, which gives Ganesh to Ketu; Ganesh as the deity of intellect links him to Mercury in some traditions.

hindi: लेकिन यहां बुद्ध आएगा दुर्गा की पूजा करेंगे ना अगर ये तो बर्बाद हो जाएंगे
says: He says that here Mercury comes in, and that if this person worships Durga he would be ruined; the caption does not make clear whether this is a warning about a mismatched deity, and it clashes with his earlier line that Durga keeps being worshipped.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is named for the Mercury he means.
ambiguity: 'यहां बुद्ध आएगा' does not say in which chart Mercury comes, and 'ये' may refer to the person or to the Ganapati worship; the sense of the warning is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not call a deity's worship ruinous.

hindi: लेकिन नवांश कुंडली शादी के बाद के लिए निर्धारण देती है
says: He says the Navamsa gives the determination of the Ishta for the period after marriage, so the deity that suits a person may change once the marriage has happened.
cells_derived_method: none: it says when the Navamsa applies, not a house or sign effect.
ambiguity: It is not said whether 'after marriage' is the calendar date or the 7th-house phase of life.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Navamsa is used for the later, married and dharmic phase of life classically, though not for choosing a deity this way.

hindi: अगर पत्नी के साथ इनका डाइवोर्स हो गया और यह फिर उसके बाद ये करते हैं तो कोई नुकसान नहीं है
says: He says that if the person's divorce from the wife has happened and he does this afterwards, there is no harm; so the Navamsa-indicated worship becomes safe once the marriage has ended.
cells_derived_method: none: it ties the worship to the marriage event and not to a house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: 'ये करते हैं' does not say what 'this' is, probably the Navamsa-indicated worship (Durga or Ganesh). The sentence runs across the caption break ('कोई नुकसान नहीं | है').
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not time worship to divorce.

hindi: यह सब घटनाएं दुर्घटनाएं आपके जीवन में इष्ट बदल देती हैं
says: He says that all the events and accidents that happen in a life change one's Ishta, so the deity that suits you is not fixed for life.
cells_derived_method: none: a general statement about change in the Ishta, with no house or sign.
ambiguity: He does not say whether the chart itself changes or only the deity that fits the person; the sentence starts in the previous caption chunk ('नुकसान नहीं | है').
classical_check: Differs: classical Ishta from the birth chart is fixed for life; a changing Ishta is his own view.

hindi: आप अगर रिंगू संगीता भी निकलवा होगे आज निकलवा होगे अभी बता दे कि ये ये भविष्य होना है 10 साल बाद आप देखोगे कई चीजें ठीक नहीं हुई क्योंकि आपने बीच में ल्टर कर दिया
says: He says that even if you have your Bhrigu Samhita read today and it says certain futures will happen, ten years later you will find several things did not come right because you altered things in between; a prediction fails when the person changes course.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement about the limits of fixed prediction, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'रिंगू संगीता' is read as Bhrigu Samhita; 'ल्टर' is read as 'alter'; the ten-year gap is an illustration.
classical_check: Silent on this point; the Bhrigu Samhita tradition claims fixed outcomes, so he is cautioning against that.

hindi: भृगु संगीता फिर सही बताएगी उसने एक नई अल्टरनेट रियलिटी का पाथ पढ़ लिया है और उसके हिसाब से एक नया फ्यूचर लिख दिया है फिर उसमें से कुछ सही होगा कुछ गलत क्योंकि फिर अल्टरनेट पाथ निकल गया
says: He says a fresh Bhrigu Samhita reading would again be correct for the new path, since it reads the alternate reality you have moved into and writes a new future, but part of that will also go wrong because yet another alternate path branches off after it; the caption begins with an unclear 'can you now get it'.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'अब निकल पाओगे' at the start of the sentence is unclear, probably 'can you get it read now'; 'alternate reality' is his modern phrase for a changed life path.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not discuss branching futures.

hindi: हम अपने कर्म के द्वारा यह सब बदलते चले जाते हैं इसलिए हमारे इट की साइकिल बहुत कुछ बदल जाती है इसलिए निर्धारित करना बड़ा जटिल है कौन सा किसका
says: He says we keep changing all of this through our karma, so the cycle of our Ishta changes a great deal, and hence deciding which deity belongs to whom is very complex.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a general statement about karma and the Ishta cycle.
ambiguity: 'इट की साइकिल' is read as the cycle of the Ishta over life; he does not give its length.
classical_check: Silent; a changing Ishta cycle is not classical.

hindi: इसलिए हलवा नहीं है आपको अपने हृदय में समाना पड़ेगा हृदय में समझना पड़ेगा तब इष्ट की कृपा
says: He says it is therefore no piece of cake: the listener must absorb it in the heart and understand it in the heart, and only then comes the Ishta's grace.
cells_derived_method: none: advice about inner understanding, not a house or sign matter.
ambiguity: 'हलवा नहीं है' is an idiom meaning it is not easy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कृपा को फिर समझ लीजिए आपके जीवन में में जब जब जहां जहां जो जो दिक्कत आ रही है इसका मतलब कृपा नहीं है
says: He tells the listener to understand grace again: wherever and whenever a difficulty is coming in your life, it means grace is absent in that matter.
cells_derived_method: none: he names no house; the life area where the difficulty sits tells which house is affected (see the earlier row on awareness).
ambiguity: He treats every difficulty as lack of grace and does not separate difficulties of karma from lack of grace.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts tie difficulty to afflicted houses and past karma and he restates it as lack of grace.

hindi: आपके पास किसी की पिता की नहीं है मां की नहीं है गुरु की नहीं है चाचा की नहीं है कोई तो है जो कृपा की कमी है
says: He lists whose grace may be missing: father's, mother's, guru's or an uncle's; some person's grace is lacking, and the difficulty is the sign of it.
cells_derived_method: The relation can be tied to a house by classical karakatva: mother 4th, father and guru 9th, a paternal uncle (father's younger brother, 3rd from the 9th) 11th. The sign on that house colours how the grace is lost. Examples are mine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra (3-9+1=-5, so 7). A Mercury-ruled 9th: father's or guru's grace is blocked by arguments and misunderstanding, so respectful communication is the area to repair.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (1-4+1=-2, so 10). A Mars-ruled 4th: the mother's grace is lost through anger and a heated home, so calming the temper at home is the area.
Derived: lagna Aquarius (9-11+1=-1, so 11). A Jupiter-ruled 11th: the missing grace is the elder advice and support of the paternal uncle's line.

ambiguity: He gives people and not houses; the house links are my mapping. 'चाचा' could be any uncle.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 4th mother, 9th father and guru are classical; the idea that missing grace shows as difficulty is his own.

hindi: उससे संबंधित व्यक्ति लोग चीजों का हिसाब किताब सेट करो आपको कृपा मिलेगी
says: Remedy: settle the accounts with the persons and things connected to the missing grace, and then grace will come to you.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a general remedy with no house or sign dependence; which persons to settle with follows from the previous row.
ambiguity: 'हिसाब किताब सेट करो' (settle accounts) is not defined: it may mean apology, repayment, service or reconciliation. The sentence runs across the caption break ('आपको कृपा | मिलेगी').
classical_check: Silent; closest classical idea is rina-mukti (clearing debts to parents and elders) as a remedy.

gist: Starts a story about a swami, Nirmal Baba, saying it is funny and some may not have heard of him.
Mimics Nirmal Baba's routine: asks a follower when he ate golgappas and with what water (red water, so eat with green), and says grace is stuck there; then asks whether this is strange or madness.
Continues the mimicry with questions about washing clothes: which bucket (blue or yellow), which detergent, with the same 'grace is stuck there' line.
Asks what kind of issue this is and whether such grace-talk is madness, setting up the point he makes next.

hindi: उस व्यक्ति की भावना में निर्मल बाबा ही कृपा देने वाले देवता वरुण है और उसने कह दिया कि बाबा जी आप जो कह दोगे ना वह हो जाएगा
says: He says that in that follower's feeling Nirmal Baba was Varuna, the deity who gives grace, and the man declared that whatever Baba says will happen; so Varuna (Neptune in his 12-planet scheme) is the grace-giver, and anyone can be placed in that role by belief.
cells_derived_method: none: it assigns grace-giving to Varuna and is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He speaks of the deity Varuna; that Varuna is the planet Neptune is implied by his 12-planet scheme and not said here. The sentence runs across the caption break ('कृपा | देने वाले').
classical_check: Differs: Neptune and Varuna as a planet are outside classical Jyotish; Varuna as a Vedic deity of waters and order is classical but not a graha.

hindi: अब मजे की बात निर्मल बाबा बहुत ज्ञानी थे क्योंकि उन्हें पता था यह संस्कार का आईडिया था बंदे को
says: He says Nirmal Baba was very wise because he knew the follower's belief was a samskara idea, an ingrained conviction, so the effect would come through that conviction and not through the Baba himself.
cells_derived_method: none: it explains the mechanism of belief, not a house or sign effect.
ambiguity: 'संस्कार का आईडिया' is read as an ingrained impression in the person's mind; the praise of Nirmal Baba is his comment, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कि भैया इसके सबकॉन्शियस में इसको संतुष्ट करके जाना वरुण बन के जैसे ही ये संतुष्ट होगा कि बाबा जी हरा पानी लूंगा उसका काम हो जाएगा
says: He says the trick was to satisfy the person's subconscious: once the man is satisfied that taking green water will work, Baba has become Varuna for him and his work gets done.
cells_derived_method: none: it describes a mechanism, not a house or sign.
ambiguity: 'वरुण बन के' is read as 'becoming Varuna for him'; the green-water detail is a story detail, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent; closest is the classical role of shraddha (faith) in upaya.

gist: Anecdote: an industrialist came to him about 15 years ago saying something amazing had happened.
